There's a section of sea which is cordoned off so you feel very safe swimming there, and when we went there the beach was virtually deserted.

Title: Worth the trip only if you have time
Text: A bit out of the way, expensive to get there. But lovely on a hot day,take your own food and drinks.

Title: Clean sand and crystal clear water
Text: My family and I loved this beach where you can wade out even if you can't swim. The sand is like soft glitter and the water is so clean tropical fish can be seen almost right up to the shore! Loved it.

Title: Nice to have sea bath
Text:
Waves are less on this beach enable to have nice sea bath.
Place bit off from town..
I think..we need to go 14km from town,otherwise very nice place.
Need to get a ticket /pass from security personals.
Non salt water shavers available

Title: Nice Beach
Text: This beach is aprrox 20 mins drive from the town of Trincomalee .We called off here after visiting the hot springs.It is on a stretch of beach owned by the Air Force with a small entry charge .Part of the beach is not for public use.This beach is a long stretch of white sands with a calm clear sea.When we visited there was a lot of locals playing in the shallow sea really enjoying theirselves .There were seats and parasols on the beach and a small snack bar.

Title: Marble Beach - a meautiful beach
Text: I was traveling to Tincomalee from Batticaloa and when I crossed Kinniya my driver told me that justfive minutes on right side there I one of the beautiful beach of Sri Lanka. So we did the quick tour, indeed it was beautiful and deserve to be in to do list while in Sri Lanka. We had lunch at the beach resort and food was also delicious, I wish had some more time to enjoy the beautiful view.

Title: Spoilt by segregation
Text:
This lovely beach is a trek if staying in Trinco / uppuveli and not worth the journey out there. 2 / 3 fenced off for VIPs and very busy on the other side with local families which doesn't make for a relaxing beach afternoon. It's a very sheltered bay so would be great for safe swimming with small children and the water is crystal clear. 

Try nilaveli instead.

Title: locals beach
Text: A nice spot but nilavelli beach is nicer, be prepared to be asked to be photographed with the locals, I find this very amusing but it can be off putting to some.

Title: Clean Crowded Beach
Text: We went to the Marble Beach at China Bay. The water was clean and clear. Very tempting to jump on and swim. The charges to enter not much. However it was very crowded. I think going on a Poya day is not a good idea as it is a holiday. I would recommend Marble Beach on weekdays, to be able to enjoy swimming etc

Title: Great beach clearly a locals favourite
Text:
A beautiful but odd beach situated in the air force base and run by them.

Our guide took us there it was full of locals bathing which you must do in a designated area including about 75 young schoolchildren in the sea in their school uniforms on a school trip.

There are better beaches at Uppuveli etc but noe give you this slice of local life.

Title: Lovely for swimming and water games! Not for sunbathing
Text: The journey to Marble beach seemed like it was going to be a quiet remote place to hang out (you'll defnitely need a good local driver or taxi). When we arrived it was late morning about 11am and only some trainee child monks were in the water. They quickly got out when they saw our group of mostly young women. Two of my lady friends quickly realised that here you cover up unless you want to to be stared at or disrespect someone. At first we enjoyed the beach just to ourselves then  suddenly after lunchtime, a throng of school children arrived crowding on the beach splashing their feet in the water. Soon after it seemed like the whole village followed, people splashing about and playing games mostly fully clothed. The monk children returned to the water to play ball games with us which was the best! A great way to experience beach culture but don't even try to sunbathe unless you want to offend.

Title: Rather regimented and small
Text:
Not really impressed.  It takes a 20 minute drive from Trico and you pay Rs 120 for people and car parking. It is run by the army but don't ask me why.

We arrived 5 pm and there were many school children, including Muslim girls swimming in their full black regalia. The beach is in an inlet so is safe for swimming (there are areas marked with flags to make sure you did not stray). There are not that many good safe areas in Trico so you take it or leave it.

It is only about 100m long with rocks either side so hardly expansive but good for supervised groups.  

PS Europeans have a bad reputation for <cough> unhealthy interest in children so males on their own should be careful of their 'looking' behaviour. I was getting stares when I wandered away from my company.

Title: Clean beach
Text: Very clean water with white sand. Food is very expensive and not suitable for kids. But Fine beach to enjoy.

Title: Great little beach
Text: Did not stay there,but went in for a look. Quite a popular beach,good for families. The resort looked ok,run by the army,so would have to stay there to know. Have stayed at Thalsevena Resort near Jaffna  which is run by the army and it is very nice,

Title: If you want a clean and tidy beach...this is the one
Text: I had a wonderful 2 days at this place. very clean and tidy beach managed by Sri Lankan Air force. we booked "Tamarind" and "blue Whale". Tamarind is little bit out dated but has a wonderful  private beach area for children to play and also for relaxation. It has a three rooms and Open Dining area as well and all facing the lovely beach. " Blue Whale" is newly built room and a wonderful sea breeze balcony. lucky we went on New year holidays and they have organised some new year games which we were participated. Staff were very nice and helpful. food is not excellent but for the price it's worthy. if you want to relax at a beach try this place.

Title: a cozy place
Text:
we stayed there for two nights and enjoyed soooo much, the rooms are so close to seawater, anytime any moment i can jump into the sea if i want as the beach are in privacy not in public.
the breakfast is nice..generally speaking, it is a place worth visiting for weekend or holiday...

Title: a peaceful paradise
Text:
If you are looking for a peaceful place this is it, beautiful and safe sea, lovely beach, food is excellent and the portions and varieties are vast. the airforce Management staff is excellent and friendly, they really helped us with a special food request for health purposes.
the chalets are very clean, quite spacious. 
it's nicer to be in a group as it can be a bit too quiet, depends on what you look for. if you want to be lost to the rest of the world then you got it right, the ayuveda massage is such a wonderful experience, very reasonable charges.
snorkling is just next to the resort, from here we travelled to see the famous hindu temple( nice place) and the hot water wells (nothing much to see).

Title: Watchout for perverts
Text:
Before I write my experience, I need to put things into perspective so that the appropriate audience can be guided.

If you are a bunch of guys looking to go to the beach for the day, then you will love this place. The beach is clean, acceptable water conditions for a swim and even for snorkeling. 

The problems lie if there are women in the group and they tend to expose a little more skin than you would typically see in such a location. My sister was not even on the beach, and there was a military guy who was secretly filming her or taking pictures with his cell phone camera. You basically have a bunch of military men running a resort with no etiquette on being respectful to women. 

I can only imagine if a bunch of women were to travel to this location by themselves. Who is to know what could transpire? So given this experience, I would never encourage females and certainly not Westerners (women) to visit this so called "resort" in Trincomalee. There are other safer places to put on a bathing suit and enjoy a nice tan in Trincomalee without having perverts around you. 

They also have rooms for rent. I guess you need to be really looking for fun to stay overnight in this place!!

Title: They say the ocean looks like rolling marbles....
Text:
This quiet and peaceful beach is a delight.  

Unlike other readers we found that there was adequate place to change in the shower areas.

The food was a disappointment....I had what I would call an "invisible tuna" sandwich....3 slices of bread but nary a bit of tuna! But it didn't really matter and swimming in the Indian Ocean better than lunch!

Title: What a beach!
Text: Beautiful place which is completely off the beaten track. So calm, quiet and serene. There wasn't another person on the beach when I was there last. When compared to other beaches in Sri Lanka I would have to say that the remote and unknown factor off this beach makes it a winner for me/1

Title: stunning clear blue sea
Text: we were welcomed by the sri lankan airforce who actually run the hotel and restuarants at marble beach its truly beautiful and probably the best place i went to in trinco

Title: Paradise!
Text:
A very well manage place, with clean and warm waters (the military aviation service are in control of the area)
A little a bit of paradise.

Title: One of the best beaches in Sri Lanka
Text:
This has a wonderfully wide clean beach with thick vegetation surrounding it. The ocean is shallow and ideal for relaxing in water, swimming, and play. For the most part of the day you can have the beach all to yourself. There are at least two lifeguards on duty all the time. Only part of this beach is accessible to the public. The large part of the beach is a private beach operated by the Sri Lanka Air Force with it's wonderful bungalows, dinning areas and chalets.
The food we had there was one of the neatest and most well prepared Sri Lankan style meals we had in Sri Lanka. The service provided by the staff was highest quality(Felt like they were under the command of someone all the time :)) Upon inquiry we were told all these guys have gone through at least the basic military training. 
We were here in June 2013.The two rooms we occupied were basic, yet spacious clean and comfortable, had air conditioning, and bath rooms were extremely clean. Linen and pillows were fresh. Next time we go to Sri Lanka we will plan on staying here longer and will definitely stay at one of the over the water bungalows.  
Also there is a wonderful wooded hiking trail that takes you to another little cove ideal for swimming and pictures.

Title: Day Trip With Mohan
Text:
Marble Beach is a great swimming and lunch stop. It's an unspoilt beach with an Army barracks at the back of the beach. Generous portions, surprisingly good food and not over-priced. Great selection of drinks too. We spent over 2 hours over lunch! Rs.20 entrance fee per person incl tuk tuk driver to marble beach.

We had the best day with Mohan (+94 (0) 779017207). For Rs.2,200 he picked us up at 9am took us shopping for lungis/sarongs, found us great local breakfast, took us to all the places we wanted to go (Suwami Rock and temple, Marble Beach etc...). We spent so much time at Marble Beach  that by the time we topped up our phones, collected our lungis, got take away dinner etc. it was already 7pm! So we didn't get a chance to see the hot pools but Mohan was prepared to take us anywhere that we wanted to go for the same price within a certain time frame (which we clearly went over!)

For Rs.250 he delivered red wine and takeaways to our hotel in Uppuveli (6kms away) - there was just nothing that he wasn't prepared to do for us. He was so kind and easy to be around. I shed a tear when we left because his kindness and generosity had touched me so much.

And he does not take commission if he collects you from the bus station and takes you to a guesthouse. For Rs.250 he took us from the bus station to three different guesthouses on Uppuveli Beach (6kms away) until we decided which one we wanted. He did not come inside so he had nothing to do with the prices we negotiated with the hotel we stayed at. Whether or not something was arranged without our knowing we'll never know, but I think he was sincere. Genuine human being!

Title: Unspoilt and beautiful Marble beach
Text: fabulous unspoilt beach with great accommodation facilities and a neat little café that served a lovely lunch and cool beer.

Title: Don't see a reason to go there
Text: I felt awkward being the only woman at the beach with literally hundred of local men around. Decided not to go swimming. Beach bar looked poor. No sense going there as the beaches in Uppuvali are as good as Marble Beach.

Title: Air Force Resort @ Marble Beach!
Text:
What can one say? The Marble Beach is simply breathtaking! Nowhere in Sri Lanka can one ever find such a beautiful beach and a memorizing sea! 

We stayed at the Tamarind Bungalow which can house 6-8 people, although we were a party of 6.
The rooms are comfortable, except the room below which smelt of dampness. The bathrooms were OK but more work needs to be done. We were fine with this, as we were planning on a fairly rustic holiday. The good news is that there are new chalets coming up and should be ready by end of 2012.

Bar that everything else at this resort was simply - magical! The staff couldn't do enough to make you feel at home..yes, the crabs were great but so were the rest of the food! The beers were chilled and we certainly couldn't keep our eyes away from the sea! 

Aloka Bandara - the lifeguard was exceptionally good taking us snorkeling and keep a sly eye on us whilst we were at sea! Eranga Rukshan - who manages the facility is a remarkable young man who ensures everything is in place and more often than not does the impossible!

Great place to be and next to Maldives, this is the best ever beach I've ever been on!!

Title: secluded beach with character
Text: The beach are is controlled by the Air Force ( from memory) and has beach front accomodation, an excellent restaurant and a separate bar . Unlike the beach at Trincomalee this is really a bay with bush down to the waters edge and is reasonably sheltered with good swimming and snorkeling ( so we were told)

Title: Lovely, Scenic
Text: You can wade into the water for a kilometer or more and still the water will only be up to about your waist or lower depending on the time of year. Waves are very mild - it really does not evoke the full sense of the sea. Strangely the water is not as salty either - possibly because the great Mahaweli River flows into the sea close by. But still - superb experience!

Title: Super Beach
Text: Supper food and service at Airforce resort, Loved the Crab curry Lunch. Plan to go back to stay at least 2 days at the chalet. They are very basic but good for a beach holiday. ALso need to do it during the Season from March onwards. We visited last week and it was over cast and rainy.

Title: Interesting
Text: Beach is ok, the best part was all the animals we saw on the dirt road leading up to the beach, it wasn't the season to be here they told us as the seas are rough and you can't see a thing, supposedly the sea is crystal clear in the summers..

Title: Quiet private beach.
Text: We had a great couple of days at Marble Beach. Even the overcast skies couldn't spoil it. I recommend staying at the Marble Beach Airforce Resort- the staff are great, it is run by the Airforce so it is very efficient. The prices are good, it is the best way to see the bay of Marble Beach as you have access to a private section of the beach.

Title: Nice quiet beach in an army camp
Text: There is noone around other than a few army boys enjoying their time off. Great little flat beach with beautifully clear water.

Title: Quiet still sea water
Text: Best place to learn to swim. One must not go to the crowded public beach but there is a more secluded and private restaurant beach maintained by the Airforce. Food at the restaurant is not great but the access to this part of the beach is beautiful.

Title: Clean bleach, Clear water
Text: This is a clean sandy beach. The water is clear you can see the small fishes underneath. There is a entrance fee for this beach but worth it.

Title: Great, safe swimming beach down the end of a dirt road...
Text:
Marble Beach is located on Sri Lankan Air Force property, down the end of a bumpy dirt road. There's a vehicle admission fee too (Rs110).

The water when we visited was flat, warm and jellyfish free. The East Coast of Sri Lanka at the time of our holiday was suffering from an inundation of jellyfish. Marble Beach swimming area was protected. The majority of beach goers were locals.

The sun was baking hot, so was the sand. We understood there was a cheap food place to eat lunch at the beach. When we arrived, we were told they no longer served food there (only a sri lankan fried snack) because the nearby resort had a restaurant and a monopoly on food. The resort was also very pricey. So, either bring your own food or eat at the resort.

The water was clear and refreshing. If you are in Trincomlaee, go for a swim there!

Title: Gorgeous beach - no crowds, no food
Text: Beautiful beach, though less than a third is open to the public. The rest is for the Air Force run hotel that was under renovation. Worth visiting but bring all your food and drinks!

Title: nice place to spend the day
Text: The beach is well known for locals. it is a nice occasion to mix with them. and to enjoy a very beautiful warm day on the beach. Perfect place to swim

Title: Only Beach
Text: We visited this beach,because in every book it's mentioned,,but i'ts only a beach as so manny along this coast,,the only difference,is, that foreigners have to pay a small amount for the visit

Title: Nothing special
Text: The beach is OK but you have no facilities. No showers ,no restaurants etc. The sea is calm and the water clean and warm

Title: Very crowded
Text: The beach was crowded and did not live up to expectations. It was also not very easily accessible - military checkpoints are a turnoff.

Title: Fantastic beach
Text: Never seen such calm ocean and shallow, warm water, almost like bathing in a swimming pool. Not crowded but did not like the fact you have go through a couple of air force security checks to get there.

Title: Cheap and Clean but not special
Text: It is a clean beach and one of the few cheap beaches we visited , the entrance is something like 20 rupees ... Nothing special though about it and the swimmable parts are mostly shallow , the rest was off limit at that point ... Nothing special about it and for a drive of about twenty to thirty minutes to get there from the hotel it was not worth it at all ... It closes at around six

Title: Over rated .DO NOT GO.
Text: Definetly a good options for locals who like more private beaches.For visitors it is just ok beach with no clean facilities.You would waste your time as there are so many things to do in Sri Lanka .

Title: Oh dear what a pity.
Text:
This used to be one of the most beautiful beaches in Trincomalee. Accessed by boat and great for swimming and BBQ. Now the Air Force have taken it over, build and R&R retreat for officers and ruined it. They have appropriated 2/3rds of the beach and left 1/3rd for everyone else. As a result a small part is crowded and huge expanse empty, but if you try walking along it you get chased off, despite the fact no one is using it. 

The sand is soft and great to walk on but given what has been done don't bother.

Title: Beautiful beach popular with locals and tourists
Text: I went by car it was a nice drive but at area where marble beach is, suppose to have marble stones there, is owned by the Sri Lankan Airforce, There was a bottle neck as I went on a week end may local tour buses full of people I went to the gate and queue a little to pay. Rs 20 each same price for foreigners as locals the car cost Rs 50 for the carpark entry,. Although There were 3 buses and 2 vans ahead but it was quickly sorted out, Got back to the car and drove to the end of the road where the car park was and handle over the tickets there The beach was magnificent with soft sandy bottom and clear blue water.

Title: It's Not Crowded if You Stay at the Resort
Text: Most of the complaints that the beach is too crowded, is about the public beach. If you stay at Marble Beach Resort, the beach area is private for the resort guests.

Title: Lovely Beach... But Over crowded
Text: Loved the Beach... But the place is over crowded! You could hardly get to the beach with so many people covering it.

Title: Truly Great
Text: best place to swim; clear calm water; safe; invigorating and refreshing given the ambient heat and humidity

Title: Why not take it to World
Text:
I was going through Trip Advisor's latest on "Find beaches with Crystal clear water and none in Sri Lanka was rated and found that to be a draw back as we have many such lovely and safe places like Marble beach, Plantain Point, Trinco Naval Dockyard, Pasikudah, Kalkudah etc. Some of these places we have messed up through debris and concrete structures that are not merging well with the environ. Here Marble beach scores very high as the beaches are virgin and the development merges well with the rest. Hospitality of the Air Force Welfare persons and staff is good as well as safety is best. Food has always been best for the price and with the option of a la carte of par excellence.
Further the hotel is rated as a place where as it is a hotel proper with limited number of cabins but with all essentials.

Title: very nice beach
Text: No waves. Crystal clear water. Cafe on the beach serving cold drinks. Don´t know if they serve food there. Many locals also use this beach.

Title: Nothing special
Text: Not so special. If you stay in Chaaya Blue not worth visiting unless you want to assimilate with the locals

Title: Really Good Beach
Text: If you dont like waves this is the place to go... very clean and safe. I went through a check point but they did not check any thing and there was a small fee

Title: Strange place
Text: Built by and for the military, this area is now 'open' to tourists, but not really open without going through checkpoints.

Title: Best Beach on the Planet
Text:
Marble beach is a quasi private beach on a property belonging to the Sri Lanka Air Force. This has kept the beach well protected and clean from human disruption. 

Today the beach front features modern facilities built by the Air Force, and is available to visitors at a fee. 

I have known this beach since my earliest memories when I was 3-4 years old. Beyond doubt it is one of the best safest beaches in the world!!

Title: serene
Text: Really nice beach with many restaurants offering top indian cuisine nearby , very relaxing to sit and watch the world go by ,.

Title: Beautiful and Clean Beach
Text: It's a beautiful beach and clean surrounding. The near by Coconut Tree Hill is interesting and picture friendly.

Title: Stunning Beach  Clean surroundings Awesome food
Text: Mirissa Beach is a awesome place in the South of Srilanka.. Great place to chill out have a swim in the ocean and have awesome food

Title: Mirissa Beach - Definitely visit this.
Text:
Mirissa beach is one of the most clean and awesome beach in Srilanka, atleast in my opinion.
There is a nice hike at the left end of the beach, where you can climb. The view from the top is amazing and strongly recommended. You get a 360 degree view of the beach and the photos from the top are superb. Must visit.

Title: LOVED MIRISSA BEACH
Text:
Amazing, clean beach, with a super vibe and energy.

Different as not packed with people, night restaurants beautifully lit, many restaurants, and still a sense of peace.
One of the nicer beaches I have been to!

Title: Must visit if you are in Sri Lanka
Text:
A beautiful Sandy beach and though the water wasnt the turquoise blue you would see in few islands , it was a perfect beach to play in the water .Also an ideal location  for learning surfing . 
There were lots of high rising waves but no dangerous currents . 
Not rocky either so was safe in the sense that you didnt need to worry about hitting against the rocks . 
Since we visited soon after tourism was recovering  post covid lockdown , it wasnt crowded . 
Lots of food shacks  right on the beach . Beach parties for the party lovers at night . 
One of the main activities around ,other than surfing is whale watching and a must try if you are in Mirissa. 
To reach here , its a two and a half hour drive from the airport , through the beautiful highway . 
Would surely suggest that you plan a day or two stay around Mirissa bay if  you are visiting Sri Lanka.

Title: Techno music terror
Text:
A beautiful stretch of beach with some quite strong waves. Perfect for a romantic stroll at sunset and having a bite to eat in one of the many beach restaurants.  

However beautiful this beach is during the day, in the evening  the techno-terror starts. From early evening until early morning the beach is covered by the bum-bum and electronic drums of the local techno-beach club. The basses are hamming through every wall.

What a pity. One single dance club destroying this previously pristine location with its noise.

Sad to say that I will not return anymore.

Title: Beautiful
Text:
If you visit the beach you should check the sunshine bar and surf view bar! The sunsets are amazing! Me and my girlfriend enjoyed a lot!  If you need a surf lessons please DON'T go to CHUTYS SURFSCHOOL that's a JOKE and not professional at all!!!! There are much more better ones at the Mirissa Beach! 
Just to let you know!

Title: Chilling place
Text: We spend a few days on Mirissa  beach. We had great time. Lots of restaurants, pubs, amazing food, great people and lots of activities. It wasnt crowded. And only a few minutes walking from our hotel. Was my favourites place in Sri Lanka

Title: Beautiful Sunset!!!
Text: We came here in the late afternoon stroll along the beach when its not too hot under scorching sun. This is a busy beach with a stretch of hotels and restaurants. Hence, its very crowded, but still a lovely place to hangout for late afternoon stroll; to enjoy the sea breeze; to play with the strong wave; to relax on the beach, etc. The sunset at the beach was lovely and we had an unforgettable time spent at the beach. There are other nearby attractions where is worth to check out are the Parrot Rock Bridge with lots of crow flying around and the Coconut Tree Hill for the breathtaking sunset view!!!

Title: Mirissa beach surfing
Text: Huge beach. With lot of water sport activities especially lot of surfing schools for beginners and Intermediates. Snorkelling and good for beach activities

Title: one of my beat beach
Text:
Mirissa Beach is located just 20 minutes away from Matara by bus, making it easily accessible for tourists and locals alike. The beach is known for its stunning scenery, crystal-clear waters, and pristine sands, making it the perfect spot for swimming and relaxing under the sun.

One of the highlights of Mirissa Beach is its cozy bars and restaurants, which offer a variety of delicious food and drinks for visitors to enjoy. Whether you're looking for a refreshing cocktail or a delicious seafood dinner, you'll find plenty of options here.

In addition to the beach itself, Mirissa also boasts the famous Coconut Tree Hill, which is just a 10-minute walk away, and the famosus parrot rock. This scenic spot is a must-visit for anyone who loves breathtaking views and Instagram-worthy photo opportunities.

Title: Mirissa Beach is amazing
Text: Coming to Mirissa Beach after two years, and I must say this is an amazing beach. It is not too crowded, if you are a surfer, you come to paradise, and the beach itself is amazing. It is a very family-friendly place. And the ocean itself is very safe.

Title: Spend your time in Mirrissa Beach
Text: Don't leave Sri Lanka without seeing Mirissa Beach. It is one of the longest and widest beaches we have seen on the south coast. It is a great place to swim all day long and spend time in the waves of the ocean. After sunset, don't forget to taste the fresh seafood at the restaurants on the beach. And of course visit the Coconut Tree Hill.

Title: Stunning beach great ambience
Text: The most stunning beach. Great for swimming too. Loungers on the beach for free and many restaurants along the beach front. Vibrant.

Title: Beautiful Beach
Text: Great beach for swimming. Well known for surfing. It is a very popular, clean, and serene beach. It must be there in your itinerary if you are visiting Sri Lanka.

Title: Great beach location with lively crowd
Text:
Just returned from Sri lanka, where we stayed for 3 nights in Mirissa beach. We had stayed in Unawatuna on a previous visit, so wanted to try a different beach this time. Having spent 7 days on the east coast, which was off season, Mirissa was nearing the end of peak season and much livilier. 
We wanted a place on the beach side of the road, so choose Sea World hotel, which had fantastic views and excellent breakfast. We didnt book evening meals, because the daily blackouts meant that we had to choose places with a generator. The blackouts during the day didnt bother us, as we spent most of this time travelling around to different beaches and places. Cold beers and food was always available somewhere.
The beach bars and restaurants on Mirissa beach were mostly all open day and evening, and even when the blackouts came there were plenty of candles making it even more romantic.
I had heard the road along Mirissa beach was very busy and no footpaths and I would have to say it was really dangerous when we were there, especially at night when there was no street lighting. It really was a challenge to avoid speeding tuk tuks and buses.
If I was to compare Mirissa to Unawatuna I would say that Unawatuna is at the end of a small road far from the main road, so much safer to walk around the main street and go in and out of bars shops etc

Title: Great beach
Text: Lovely beach fringed with bars and restaurants. Big waves and a bit of shade, sunbeds available although plenty of space for those who dont want them. A bit of litter, tourists, take your rubbish to the bin!!!

Title: Beach for everyone
Text: Great restaurants with daily fresh fish and seafood (catch of the day), nice water, place for experienced surfers.

Title: Great Sunsets
Text:
I recently visited Mirissa Beach. It is a very nice beach with beautiful sand and very clear and clean sea water. It is a very busy beach with many hotels and restaurant dotted along the beach, so it gets very busy and at night it quite noisy. Not good if you want a quiet nights sleep, lol.
Otherwise it is worth a visit. It is a very popular beach for tourists.

Title: Fantastic beach for anyone!
Text:
Lovely long sandy beach with plenty of space. There are areas with cafes and restaurants with sunbeds, as well as areas for you to lay down on a towel and stay away from more crowded places. Don't miss the rock in the Eastern area if you are able to climb the stairs for a great view over the beach and the ocean front (skip this if you have impaired mobility as the stairs are made of large cranes and ropes). 
For surfers, you have the classic "Mirissa Right" in the western side, as well as nice waves after the rock in the Easter when the wind blows E/SE. 
Good areas for swimming without swell (near the rock) and also areas with more waves (central)

Title: The most beautiful beach I have ever seen
Text: I have actually visited a lot of beaches. But this is the most beautiful beach I have ever seen. It's really a creation of nature ....

Title: Enjoying Beachlife !!
Text: For Sri Lankan beaches it is one of the busier ones but still very relaxing and tranquil beach, Plenty of sunbeds and restaurant / bars

Title: A great beach for the partygoers.
Text: If youre looking for a nice relaxing beach then look elsewhere. This is a beach for the younger, we like to party, have no respect for the local culture, crowd. There are lots of nicer beaches in Sri Lanka,  this one is overhyped and crowded.

Title: Best beach
Text: One of the best beaches in srilanka. Its clean and has many restaurants to choose from. The crowd is also great.

Title: Great beach
Text: Wonderful place. But lacks in environmental consideration on the beach-restaurants. Lot of plastics and straw for drinks

Title: There are much nicer beaches in Sri Lanka
Text: We stayed here for three nights and were slightly disappointed we had booked our accommodation before arriving as we would have happily moved on sooner. The beach is very busy and quite hectic. It felt a bit like Magaluf which was not really the vibe we were after! Tangalle and Unawatuna were much nicer and very close by. The beach itself is pretty but is just a bit over developed and none of the restaurants we tried were very good for the price we paid.

Title: Overcrowded, noisy, dirty
Text: Have seen better times. Construction sites on every corner, ugly new buildings are built without concept. traffic jams on the main road, which goes next to the beach bars. So sad to watch a former pretty village ran down by lack of city development concepts.

Title: Beach with freedom
Text: Very nice beach with clean water and no plastics around. You must walk barefoot with your lover and feel the freedom through winds. ?ts like a dream...

Title: Beautiful sunset and nice beach !
Text: Small tourist city with a very beautiful sunset and nice beach. So many activities to do around. Nice party places around. Enjoy !

Title: Great place for relaxing
Text: If you go to Sri Lanka, you have many beach options, But I was most satisfied in Mirissa Beach! Although you have many restaurants and bars along the beach it stays calm and relaxed. And there is a lot to see, like Coconut tree hill, Turtle bay, Secret beach.... So I totally recommend Mirissa Beach from Singles to Families.

Title: An afternoon lazing in the sun
Text: The main bay is lively with tourists but not too packed. We enjoyed playing in the choppy waves and then we strolled across the beach for sunset. We saw a wild monkey in the palm trees. There's lots of restaurants serving seafood. The ambience for dining is great, although our experience of food was not amazing but ok - you pay a premium for the setting.

Title: Clean beach
Text:
Very nice beach with lots of bars who provide free sun loungers. 
Each night a different bar hosts a beach party

Title: Easy Waves
Text: Mirissa Beach was much nicer than we expected. It was refreshing to be on a tropical beach that wasn't completed converted into high-rise hotel properties. Not very large, but clean and a lot of fun.

Title: Clean beach but very busy (if you like that)
Text: We found Mirissa to be a lovely clean Sri Lankan beach with nice clear water. There is a bit of a shore wave dump and the water exit is slightly inclined but overall a safe beach. There are cafes/restaurants lined from one end to the other all with drinks, seafood and deckchairs/umbrellas to be had. We were there on Bob Marley's birthday so reggae played throughout the night(s) but that probably happens normally anyway. Yes there are definateley quiter more pristine beaches but for fun in the sun Mirissa ticks all the boxes.

Title: Nice beach
Text: Great water, great beach but unfortunatelly slowly turning into tourists mekka so too much loud music in the evening and too many "sir please come to our restaurant" guys...

Title: Beautiful
Text: Such a beautiful beach. Sand was soft. Waves are super fun but not too rough. Lots of chairs and umbrellas available

Title: Good swimming beach & even snorkelling opportunities!
Text: Mirissa Beach consists of the large main beach, which has many restaurants with sun loungers & umbrellas, the smaller beach to the right on this visual, which also has a few restaurants etc. & turtle bay which is seperated with a break water. It is in Turtle bay that you can snorkel close to the shore. There is not much naturals shade on any of the 3 bays, so you can either patronize 1 of the restaurants or hire beds & umbrellas in some areas.

Title: Great chill beach
Text: Soft sand, ample spots to eat or grab a drink, different size waves depending on which end of the beach you choose. Do not underestimate the strength of the breaks though. We lost two pairs of sunglasses to waves although we thought we were watching carefully. A shower to rinse as you leave beach area would be welcome.

Title: Ok beach
Text: This is not so big beach, it is ok, full of restaurants and bars. But there are big waves all the time so it is a bit hard to relax in the ocean

Title: One of the best coast for relax and feel osean.
Text: Great beach on Shri Lanka coast. With good beach bars and great atmosphere. There main Marissa beach with natural waves and few small bays with small waves and wild entrance (need coral shoes) where you can see turtles.

Title: Mirissa Beach is a great location to spend a couple of days.
Text: The beach is great. Good waves with some undertow but not too, too dangerous. Hot sunny days so make sure you wear sunscreen. Lots of restaurants and bars along the beach when you get thirsty or hungry. Enjoyed the crashing waves and all round ambiance of a real beach location. Plenty of places to stay for all kinds of visitors. Upmarket places may have a pool even though close to the beach. Prices are still reasonable for what you can enjoy here in Mirissa.

Title: Ideal place to base yourself on South Coast
Text:
We visited Mirissa for 10 days and visited 4 beaches, ate at several restaurants, swam with wild seat turtles, watched baby turtles hatching (by shear luck and coincidence) surfed, was taught yoga, had massages and met lovely people.
The beaches we visited were all beautiful to look at as you might expect. The main beach to the west was the largest and were we spotted the turtles. Perfect for lazy days and strolling along rather than using the road that runs parallel. It has an abundance of restaurants all selling fish (some fresher than others). At night is is quite noisy with every restaurant and bar trying to out do the other with trance/ dance music which kind of ruined the atmosphere for us a little. The smaller bays to the east are far more relaxed and just as beautiful with some lovely bars and hammocks. The music can still turn a little hectic but you can still find some chilled spots to drink and hang out. 
There are some scenic spots to check out (perfect for intsergrammers) but if you like to go to them to see the beauty for what it is rather than take a picture of yourself in a just stumbled across me like this pose it can be a little annoying as they are everywhere! 
On the whole its a great place to base yourself and check out the south coast of Sri Lanka.  
Turtle Bar was one of our favourites to hang out at. The staff are super friendly and the food was the best of all the restaurants we ate at.

Title: Avoid at all costs
Text:
After two weeks in Sri Lanka, this was by far the worst place I have eaten. 

Opted for catch of the day seafood, big mistake. Firstly, the prices were extortionate. Once we had ordered we were disregarded, as finding new people to rip off was more important than serving existing customers. I had to take my teapot to the bar for a refill despite the 10% service charge......? 

When my two jumbo prawns finally arrived, one was completely mushy & black. The meal was served with cold dry rice (supposed to be chips). When being charged 2000 R, I expected much better. 

After resistance, It was agreed that I wouldnt be charged for the inedible prawn but it was still added to the bill as one last attempt to catch us out. The manager had no interest in customer service and just laughed at us. 

Avoid at all costs, there are much better places. Dishonest & disgusting.

Title: Lovely Beach
Text: This is a really nice beach to sit an people watch and there are several eateries along the beach to grab a drink or something good to eat. The water was quite choppy when we were here so it didnt allow for a great swim and you had to be attentive to the waves  but it was still nice to be in the water in the heat. If you get bored you can always walk to parrot rock and coconut hill which are easily accessible from here.

Title: Aquamarine waters
Text:
A bit more protected than Weligama to the west, the next bay over, Marissa Beach is a gorgeous double cove with pristine aquamarine waters.

We enjoyed the view over both after climbing Parrot Island that divides them.

Title: Crowded beach with nothing special
Text: This beach is very average beach. Full of tourist and nothing different from european beaches. If you want to have a more personal experience of Sri Lanka I recommend visiting less crowded beaches. There are tons of them. Mirissa beach is more for  taking a walk at night or have a drink.

Title: amazing beach
Text: we love Mirissa, its our second time. we have a bungalow directly on the beach and we spend mista of our time walking on the long beach.. morning and evening because is hot in this season. the rest of time we swim (although waves) here is fun and not dangerous to swim. In the evening dining at the beach is a fantastic experience.

Title: An excellent beach for swimming
Text: While having lunch near the beach, we took the opportunity to have a swim and really enjoyed it. This was not the surf part of the beach and was very safe for simply swimming.

Title: Lovely beach
Text: We went for a walk and swimming a bit since time was short and all i can say is that it was very clean beach, quite and spectacular views worth to visit ??

Title: must visit
Text: They have beach restaurants with reasonable pricing. They even have water games and surfing too. Even if you walk into the ocean for 200 m you wont sink. I love the beach and it has a great view in the eve. Dont ever miss this beach when you travel southern part of Sri Lanka which is called southern province.

Title: Noisy Beach and too much respectless people
Text:
I been in mirissa and i expect a beautiful Beach. Instead i find a totally crowded Beach full od terrible Kind of tourists with no respect for the local culture. Very noisy Techno music. 
Some Girls were topless at the Beach or in very short tangas. A absolutly NO GO IN Sri Lanka. I feel so embarrassing for the Sri Lankan people.i decide to leave directly and go somewhere else.

Title: Nice beach
Text: One of the best beaches in Srilanka. Very serene and quiet. Safe for kids to get into water. Has lots of restaurants around.

Title: Stunning
Text: Lovely place to watch the sunset .  Good restaurants.  Lots of activities available- surfing, snorkelling, fishing and eating crab from Papa Mango.

Title: Absolutely loved it - wish I could surf
Text:
Stopped at Mirissa on our way to Colombo from the south. The town is charming and the open beach spots are spectacular. A wonderful blend of people of all ages swimming, walking down the beach, eating what seems to be super great sea food, surfing, bathing in the sun, having refreshments. The spots serving food/drinks are peppered throughout and you can simply setup on the beach or stay at one of them. Simple and easy yet an experience not to miss.
Wish I could surf!

Title: The Beach
Text: We stayed for only one day and it was marvelous. Big big beach with many many fish restaurants and cocktail bars. It was clean. Mostly. The only thing i disliked are wandering dogs all over the place

Title: Beautiful clean beach
Text: We we're surprised of how few people were present. The sunbeds/umbrellas are free and the beer is cheap. Piece of heaven.

Title: Must visited beach
Text: Believe me the Mirissa beach the must visited and must popular beach in Sri Lanka its large and very nice

Title: Noisy, slightly tacky people, good place to pass through
Text:
Of the paces we have visited in Sri Lanka this is my least favourite. The beach restaurants all compete with each other (all house music), so none of its actually enjoyable and certainly not relaxing. Why does it have to be so very loud?

Other than whale watching, not a massive amount to do here. The beach is pretty but crowded and everything has a budget/ slightly tacky feel. We spent our time looking for places to get out of the doof doof noise which seems to be never ending.

Title: Locals here are genuinely helpful, and nice to come during off peak!
Text: I'd seen some pictures where the beach is quite crowded - glad that when I was here it wasnt that bad! Quite a good walk, and nice for sunrise too. Nice place to eat - Zephyr along the beach, quite easy to find :) Drop by Parrot Rock, Coconut Tree Hill definitely!

Title: Touristic but still nice
Text: There is a lot of restaurants and bar on the beach but it still has a lot of charm and is a fun place to be. It is quite big so it is possible to escape the loud music and the crowds and have a lovely walk on the sand.

Title: A fine beach
Text: Very nice beach, wide and fairly long and most importantly clean. Lots of restaurants and bars with quite good food and good drink pricing. Free beach lounges if you spend some money on food/beverages. Ocean is clean and the waves are reasonably big and fun.

Title: Great for families
Text:
We visited during the day in December, we arrived at around 9am with two children under 4.

We found a nice area to sit as part of a bar / restaurant, there is no charge to use the seats as long as you use the bar for drinks.

We had fresh coconuts (priced around £1 each) and some nice food.

The sea is calm compared to some of the coast, so perfect for children.  The beach is not as busy as others along the coast, and shops etc near by if needed.

It is a sand only beach which is perfect for the kids.

Title: wooow
Text: lovely beach and priceless view specially the sunset ,, if you looking to heal the energy this place one of the best place and there s a place to surf also and some beach party every nights you can chill with your friends..

Title: Surf & Seafood
Text:
My husband and I have just spent four days at the northern end of Marisa Beach in a hotel called Number One Marisa. (See my review RE this hotel.)

The surf has been constant during our stay here and my husband has averaged two surfs a day, early morning and early evening.

There is a main road of simple shops; a supermarket, atm, wine store and a few handicraft shops. 

Along the beach are several restaurants, and of an evening the beach comes to life with seafood restaurants. Boats and carts stacked with ice and displaying todays catch ...prawns, lobsters, fish, calamari etc. Just select what you want to eat and they cook it for you. Most of them offer happy hour beverages.

At the south end of the bay is an island that is accessible at low tide... challenging but a great vantage point. 

Tips: 
Rock shoes for the coral bottom when surfing. 
Be patient with the language - Sri Lankans are very happy people and try hard to please. 
Tip$$$ ....as their wages are quite minimal and hours of work long.

Title: A great beach
Text: My partner and I had 3 lovely days at a nearby hotel. We walked along this beach to the town and also had cocktails watching the sunset. Its a lovely setting.

Title: Clean and stunning beach
Text: Incredibly clean and beautiful beach. Soft is completely free is seaweed and stones which is fab. Easy to walk along and admire. The tide comes very high so there are no sun loungers on the sand. Lovely beach bars and restaurants nearby.

Title: Nice beach, big wavessssss
Text: Lovely beach but be aware of the sea it can be deadly as it drags you in if u go out too far! Waves can be huge, hence why a lot of surfers love it here. Lively bars/restaurants and quite cheap for food and drinks. Lots of happy hour drinks through your the day 3pm until 8pm ok all classic cocktails

Title: Scenic beach views.!
Text: Great place for relaxing on the beach and taking pics. Must visit if youre in the area. Also has some good seafood restaurants in the area

Title: Big beach
Text: Big beach, amazing waves to swim in. A lot of bars and restaurants along the way, good amount of chairs. Nice place to spend the day.

Title: Lovely beach to watch the sunset
Text: Mirissa Beach is beautiful.I enjoyed swimming in the ocean and this place did not disappoint. The water was crystal clear and warm.

Title: Good Beach - Day and Night
Text: For the four days we spent in Mirissa, we chose the same spot, next to the lifeguard tower, in front of a turtle egg nursery, and in the shade of some low trees. It was a perfect place to enjoy the beach. The waves can sometimes be big and me and my pre-teen daughter had great fun diving under them as they broke over our heads. But smaller children should stick to paddling in the shallows. There were no hawkers hassling us to buy drinks or trinkets, and the three small stray dogs, whose patch seemed to include that part of the beach, paid us no attention and didn't bother us at all. At night, the beach bars are lit up and are a great place to chill out after a hot day. Note: I didn't see any showers at the beach, so to freshen up, you'll have to go back to your accommodation.

Title: Most beautiful beach
Text: What a beautiful place! Cant describe it. Tropical views. Postcard! Enjoy the warm water and all the good food and drinks you find on the beach. Good accommodations and beach restaurants. Excellent surfing. Watch out for the reef, rocks and sea urchins!

Title: Treacherous waves with no competent lifesavers
Text:
Tragically on Mon 15 Apr at 2:40pm there was a drowning incident at this beach. The waves were extremely strong, further compromising the normal conditions which feature a strong tidal rip.

Assisting with the rescue were two doctors, a nurse, a paramedic and a firefighter. All foreigners. It took ten minutes for local lifesavers to arrive on scene even though they were less than 200m down the beach. Once there the lifesavers stood back and observed without relieving tiring people whom were performing CPR or offering any direction or reassurance that further assistance was on the way. 

The CPR balloon and defibrillator on site did not function. After we loaded the individual in the ambulance it took a further three minutes for the driver to turn the vehicle around and get it moving towards the hospital.

After the ambulance had departed witnesses sought out lifeguards to give a statement; they seemed surprised at this and there was no template for an incident report or recording our details. During discussion one of the lifeguards indicated today was a bad day to go in the water but shrugged when asked why people were not being discouraged. 

I would strongly caution against young children or inexperienced swimmers entering the water here. I hope the individual and his family are okay and I offer my thanks and respect to those people that did what they could to assist.

Title: Perfect beach
Text:
Mirissa Beach is beautiful.  We love swimming in the ocean and this place did not disappoint. The water was crystal clear and warm. There was a few big waves which may be challenging for inexperienced swimmers but I would recommend they swim in the patrolled section in the middle of the beach.

The southern end of the beach near Parrot Rock is great for snorkelling as well as a shallow pool for little kids to swim. There are plenty of bars and restaurants along the stretch of the beach if you would like a bite to eat or something to drink.

Title: Beach bars, restaurants & a small clothing shop for very good prices
Text:
Probably the best beach in the area to chill on as theres lots of bars and restaurants where you can either pay for beds or get a drink and chill on the beds. Also shaded area next to the lifeguard hut. 
Towards the end of the beach as if you are walking the direction to welligama (west) there is a man selling beautiful clothes for very cheap. So cheap its not even worth haggling with him. 400 for shorts, 500-700 for dresses, trousers and jump suits. Also little purses and bunting made out of Sri Lankan/Indian material. Very kind man lets you try clothes on and has a mirror. When I was there there was a group of girls trying to haggle the price down but it seemed so silly as theyre SO cheap anyway. He has a factory in Weligama where he makes the clothes so is able to sell at bottom prices.
Overall nice beach to chill out on during the day and eat/drink at night.

Title: Just love it!
Text: It has three beaches and all of them are very nice! I especially love the small ones. We found our nice spot with lovely puppies and enjoyed our time there. Just loved Mirissa and the beach.

Title: Holiday
Text: Lovely beach with a very nice vibe ultra safe no crime whatsoever the sea is shallow although can be a few large waves although my 10 yr old was fine. Lots of restaurants and bars to choose from a lovely spot

Title: Fun Beach
Text: Mostly tourists, this beach has some good and powerful waves and a beautiful sandy beach not too overcrowded.  Nice place to swim or body surf.  Be careful of the undertow!

Title: Lovely Beach
Text: Mirissa Beach was a lovely place to relax and swim. Lots of great restaurant options on the beach in the evening.

Title: One of the top beaches along the southcoast
Text: Mirissa Beach is up there with the best beaches along the south coast. It has a multitude of restaurants and bars overlooking the water. It's a very well-known spot for surfers as the water is fit for both beginners and more experienced surfers alike. It's very easy to get to and there are a ton of hotel accommodations nearby should you plan to stay in the area. Tuk tuks flood the streets throughout the day making it easy to just swing by, or stay the whole day. It's also one of the more lively, party-like spots of the South Coast.

Title: CAN BE VERY ROUGH
Text: Most of the time a nice clean beach to visit. Plenty of Sunbeds, which are free, providing you eat or drink there. Can get fairly rough with 2 to 3 meter waves. Otherwise good.

Title: LOVED the beach
Text: We spent 5 days on Mirissa beach. The kids absolutely loved the waves. The beach is amazing early in the morning, but gets a lot busier as the day progresses.

Title: Perfect
Text:
The night life here , is just near to the beach all bars , restuarant . And every night just one bar has party, the big light indicated party place. We enjoy staying near to this beach, the food was good. At the end of the beach there was a big rock that you can go up and see the wonderful view.
The sea become 2 parts.

Title: Good beach!
Text: Great place to chill out in evening. The shacks offer beer and food at reasonable rates. Glad that this was in itinerary.

Title: Beautiful Beach
Text:
Clean and pretty
Sea very rough, with strong currents, great for surfers but not young children.
Lots of beach from restaurants some have free sun beds others ask for minimum spend or charge around 1000 lkr

Title: An amazing chilled beach vibe!
Text: Marissa beach is definitely up there with my favourite beaches in the world. It has so much to offer with water sports, restaurants on the shore and the evening atmosphere is incredible! If you walk along the beach you get to see all the different hotels that open up onto the beach aswell. I will be going back to Mirissa Beach as soon as possible!

Title: A fantastic beach for surfers and dinners
Text: The beach had a myriad of restaurants and bars, to suit every taste and budget, most had table and chairs out on the sand this added to a wonderful sunset each evening, the surf at one end  was good for surfing, the middle part good for swimming, at the left on side there was a small hill which you could climb to get a good view of the beach and the next bay, we saw small sharks in the rock pools, all in all a good place to chill out.

Title: One of the best
Text: Very clean & clear beach to do sea sports.  we saw beautiful fish during our snorkelling. One of the best experience.

Title: Very Picturesque Beach
Text: This is a nice beach with loads of seafood style restaurants to choose from. Plenty of sand to get between your toes.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: It is a beautiful beach but very touristy. Trendy restaurants and lots of tourist trying to be trendy.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Glorious soft sand, clear warm waters, what else do you need! Take a nice long stroll along the beach exploring, the waves are fun and good for learning to surf. Really enjoyed mirissa and will be returning to do a scuba dive as the water is the clearest Ive seen in Sri Lanka.

Title: Plastic, plastic everywhere!
Text: As avid travelers we go out of our way to leave a place better than we found it. We couldnt begin to make a difference (even though we tried) with the amount of trash on this beach.

Title: large beautiful beach
Text: I LOVE Mirissa Beach! during the day, it is perfect for playing in the waves (lifeguard is on duty), volleyball, sun bathing, eating. at night all the restaurants put their tables on the sand and serve your choice of freshly caught seafood (choose from a beautiful display table) to be eaten by candlelight

Title: Great beach.
Text: The beach is beautiful,with waves crashing on the shore to add fun to your swimming experience. Hundreds of baby turtles hatched out and made their way to the sea during our visit. A lovely experience. Good,reasonably priced restaurants are plentiful on the seafront.

Title: Beach is nicer than most people
Text: Throughout Sri Lanka we've met so many nice people and although mirissa is very nice, the nice people are a rare sight, very few bars have friendly and kind staff..

Title: Intrepid tour
Text: The beach is clean, white sand and the ocean is warm. It wasnt too busy and there were restaurants, hotels with sun lounges on the beach. Very relaxing atmosphere. Not too far away, towards Galle, is a perfect learners surf beach offering surf lessons and board hire. You can hire boards at Marissa but the waves are dumpers towards the afternoon and the water is flat earlier on. There is a spot if you are a fit, good surfer. Theres a break near the rocks (point) where you can catch some waves.

Title: Surf and sand
Text: This is a fairly active and clean beach, very good for surfers, nice big rolling waves. A lot of scuba diving and primarily whale watching tours are available here.

Title: A shambles in places
Text: The beach and rear of the beach leading to the road is a mess. Lots of rubbish and rubble. Could do with a tidy up, and removing some rubble. It is however nice in places, but can be a bit crowded and noisy in the late evening. We did however enjoy having a meal on the beach.

Title: Beautiful beach but large waves for small children!
Text: The beach was gorgeous! However as we have a 3 year old, the waves were a little too rough for her to be able to feel safe in the water. With all the green surroundings, it is really amazing!

Title: Swim with big turtles near Mirissa Beach
Text: If you want to swim with big turtles search the small beach named Coconut bay just under the Coconut Tree Hill also named Coconut Garden. For a very small price you can rent snorkeling equipment from a nice guy named Sandaru. No other taxes are requested. You cand find him on the beach at Turtle Point. I attached picture with him. We rented flippers from him for around 200 LKR/ person as we had snorkeling masks. He will show you the best place to search and swim with the turtles. We went two times there. In the first day we saw one big turtle and in the second day in the morning we saw 4 turtles out of which one was extremly big. We higly recommand to spend few hours on this beach. Also, on the hill you can take very nice pictures.

Title: Lovely clean beach with great facilities
Text: This is one of the best beaches weve been to in Sri Lanka. Sea is good to swim in and very warm. The beach is clean and well maintained. There are bars and restaurants with sun loungers.

Title: Awesome beach
Text: Most popular beach in Sri Lanka. This place many activities, food, restaurant, hotel. Highly recommend this place in Sri Lanka.

Title: sunset on Mirissa Beach
Text: The beach is the cleanest I have ever seen, I havent spotted even one piece of washed-up plastic or litter. The sea is crystal clear and warm, but not too warm. The surf is huge,

Title: Lovely beach
Text: Went in a walk this morning in the beach. The water was warm and air was fresh. Lots of surfers on the beach enjoying the waves.  Only problem is there are lots of stray dogs.

Title: Lovely place
Text: Very, very nice place to visit.  We walked from the east send to the west end and back, stopping only for a quick dip in the ocean when it got too hot.  Bars and restaurants line the edge of the beach and groups of people sunbaking are scattered  along the entire length.  Very, very nice,

Title: EXOTIC TROPIC WINTER BREAK
Text: Beutifully situated hotel on the beach.  Beach combing and listening to the waves is at its best in this hotel.  Excellent and helpful staff.

Title: Beautiful sandy beach seemed very safe with life guards.
Text: We spent many hours on the beach soaking up the sun and making use of the free sun beds provided by all the beach front eateries as long as you made a purchase. Price of the food and drinks were all very reasinable and good value for money.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Its a great beach for swimmers and surfers little areas where you can snorkel like turtle beach and surf locations in front of coconut tree hill and night plenty of locations where you can have a drink or fresh seafood

Title: Party beach.
Text: Mornings and nights are not crowded. Good restaurants for dinner. Afternoon is horribly crowded with Euro and Russian tourists. Hardly any native tourists. Good for sunbathing but Cant really swim or surf. Very windy, rocky in places and rough waves.

Title: Stunning
Text:
Such a beautiful long beach,
Great to relax and sunbathe or even just for a walk along the beach.

The sea is also a lot calmer In this area so better for swimming rather than surfing

Title: Flawless
Text: Huge waves, lovely restaurants, sand strip between the waters, a small rock to have a view of the beach, all you need you can find it here!

Title: amazing
Text: just reached here, what an amazing beach, with just the right amount of tourists, lots of food and drinks option along the beach too

Title: Beach is crowded
Text: Came to Mirissa to see whales (which was amazing) and enjoy relaxing beach time. We knew that the tourism had been developing in Mirissa but didn't expect it to be this crowded. There is still natural beauty left but all beach parties during night (we had to change accommodation away from Mirissa centre to get some sleep), trash and unfinished construction sites and crazy traffic along the beach are not helping the experience.

Title: Some good swimming a bit loud and trendy for older folks
Text: We enjoyed the swimming, the waves are not too strong, and the people watching during happy hour. Probably a young persons place!

Title: Great location but pretty busy
Text: This beach is very clean and well maintained. We highly recommend coming here but just don't expect to have this beach to yourself. Very busy for a good reason.

Title: Dogs!
Text:
Mirissa beach could be beautiful. 
The water is lovely, the scenery is beautiful, a few great restaurants to hang out in, but...

Unfortunately it has a pack of street dogs and some owned dogs treating it as their toilet. 
 The dogs are aggressive and need removing. 
 Some locals bring their dogs to the beach and they are equally unpleasant.
 Also be careful when the jet skis are out on the water if you are swimming. Nobody is paying attention to swimmers.

Title: Nice beach but very crowded
Text: Unfortunately we had booked for two weeks here. It became a little too much by the end. If you are young with a beautiful body and want to strut your stuff this is the place for you. Lots of places to eat on the beach, some very good. Jet ski hire, body board hire, wake boarding and plenty of people wanting you to go whale watching or snorkling. The sea can get quite rough with big waves. Not a beach I would say for children unless they are confident in the water . Either side of the beach people are surfing. Unfortunately our hotel was very close to the beach and there was loud music until the early hours. So again if you are young (or old) and that is what you want, then go for it. There was hardly anywhere to souvenir shop only a few tiny shops which did not want to barter, fixed price. To buy alcohol you had to visit the store opposite the Cargills supermarket. You can not go in but have to jostle with the queue and stand at the barred windows and ask for what you want.

Title: Nice beach, rough ocean
Text: The beach is clean, and you can rent sunbeds at the local places. The sea is quite rough. You can order a whale-watching tour from the local vendors.

Title: Great beach but too much development.
Text: This was a fantastic beach full of tourists, sun loungers and parasols. Plenty of bars and restaurants. Also surfing for beginners and an added break for experienced surfers at the eastern end. Sadly, this is not the beach for us. Jet Skis in the sea and a seriously busy road that runs the length of the beach. Far too much noise! The restaurants and bars were characterless too. We much preferred the amenities at Weligama Beach but both were eclypsed by Polhena. At Polhena, you're away from the road, it's a reef so there's no jet skis, you can swim with turtles and just down the road is Madiha; proper surf! My advice is to stay in Polhena and take a day trip to Mirissa.

Title: Clean Beach, lacking Sunbeds
Text:
The beach is clean and the sea very warm (didnt risk the big waves but lovely when calm). Hardly any sunbeds but you can pay them...we prefer to find a nice shack, chill and eat & drink there all day but here you have to pay for food and drinks up front rather that waiting until the end of the day...no trust maybe?!?! The staff already have a 10% service charge so no effort is put in to make you feel welcome or valued. 
I know we shouldnt compare but going to South Goa (Agonda) was a 10/10  experience for food, service and friendliness. We dont travel all that way to eat western food like chips, burgers, pizza, or bland noodles. We wont be back

Title: Very lovely beach
Text: I loved this beach! I had a very relaxing time there. One advice, if you go there from 12-15h better you find a place in the shade, the sun is very strong!

Title: A bit touristy but nice beach...
Text: Nice beach close to the city that at times gets a bit crowded. it is dotted with bars and cafes. I enjoyed frolicking among the waves during the day and sipping beer in the evening while watching the sunset...

Title: Great beach
Text: Mirissa Beach strikes the balance nicely between having plenty of options for eating on the beach, but yet it isnt too commercialised so retains its beauty. Its a beautiful beach and the perfect place to head for dinner and drinks when the sun goes down and the candles all get lit at the tables at the various eateries along the beach. There are still a lot of open beach spaces so its not packed with tables and loungers, just the right balance. We based ourselves in mirissa for our 3 days on the south coast so we could eat and enjoy the evening life in mirissa and then just caught tuktuk to weligama for the day to surf. The waves can be pretty rough here at Mirissa Beach so not the best for swimming, surfers seem to prefer other bays also.

Title: Nice beach
Text:
Really nice beach. Sand is soft under foot, clean and the sea is fantastic. Waves are  can be a little rough so maybe not one for kids but lots of nice restaurants. 

Ps. Love the comment below from the person complaining the beach is too sandy and took 4 showers to remove. Its a beach, there is sand.....! Thought it was the best all rounder beach i had been to in a while

Title: Good Surfing beach
Text:
The beach is really beautiful specially at night time.

During day time you can stay in one of the places that offers sunbeds and enjoy the see. I will say the see is rough all the time and it is a great spot for surfing. You can rent surfing board and also you can take surfing lessons.

In the evening time you can enjoy all the restaurants on the beach. 

Great beach.

Title: Something for everyone
Text: Not being a beach person myself I have to say even I enjoyed Mirissa beach. There's decent surfing at either end of the beach, a small island to walk up and enjoy the view, clean white sand, decent shallows for young children to paddle safely and great restaurants and bars. Not too commercial and nicely laid back. A good balance.

Title: Niceee
Text: Nice waves and the view from parrtot rock is breathtaking. Probably the best beach in Sri Lanka (my opinion as a local)

Title: Great waves
Text: A must visit beach. Quite busy but there are lots of cafes and spots to chill out in. Great waves for body surfing and a surfing spot at the western end.

Title: Clean Beautiful Happening Lively Beach
Text:
Very Clean Lively and Fun Beach. Lots of Beach shacks for food and drinks options. Beautiful waves to enjoy, Fun to go in the Ocean and play the waves. Near to the Parrot rock , you can just walk to it. Music and Candle Light dinner tables in the Evening. 
Near to Coconut hills too, just a small tuk tuk ride .
Overall Good Experience, we all enjoyed to the max at this beach. Must Visit if you are in or crossing Mirissa.

Title: Nice beach.... Though not best
Text:
Beach is pretty and clean with bit of a wave crashing in..

Small and cramped and quite commercialised, big downer for us was had a main road running along back of it.. 
Too much noise pollution from road and bars 

Best place to chill very top of beach small ayurveda complex. Quiet shady and tasty food forgot name sorry..

Tangalle beaches far better

Title: Glorious mirissa
Text:
Stunning beach with to die for sunrises and sunsets. It gets very busy at night, but what a fabulous atmosphere to soak up the warm tropical air!
A beautiful walk along the front will take you past the many restaurants and diners, and sun beds are readily available and free! 
The service at restaurants can vary from incredibly poor to very good, depending on which one you choose, the busier ones are often poor service and waiters can just ignore you completely, so if you do stop for a drink, don't wait for them to come to you! 
Prices are more expensive on the beach and can be unreasonable if you've got poor service. Beware of the surf during the day, it gets very high and very strong, small children would need supervising and even string swimmers need to be cautious! 
A must visit when in mirrissa!

Title: Nice beach but busy!
Text: We stayed close to Marissa beach but did not visit every day as when we did go it was very busy. Nice beach and good waves with a large number of place to et and drink at the back of the beach but over the Christmas holiday it was quite crowded and took away from the experience. The town has a few shops and a couple of good places to eat

Title: Great beach to watch the sunset
Text: Mirissa beach is quite touristy but not in an unpleasant way. Its a must do if youre staying near by especially to sit with a drink as the sun sets to watch the last of the hopeful surfers and before you wander down past all the restaurants with their freshly caught fish on display. Stop at any restaurant, select your fish and theyll cook it for you while you sip another drink.

Title: Relaxing beach
Text: Mirissa beach is good for relaxing on soft, sandy beaches.. waves are big enough to enjoy body surfing and surfing for beginners. I love the surfing part of beach, less people and less hurry..There are not so many sunbeds as should be, but excellent beach anyway.

Title: Great beach
Text: The beach is amazing! Go to the left of the beach for sunset and the right of the beach for restaurants and late nights party

Title: Great for New Years Eve
Text:
We stayed on Turtle Beach, a 10 minute walk away. We mainly visited Mirissa beach at night for dinner and a bit of partying. New Years Eve was fantastic, different music systems set up along the beach and fantastic fireworks.
I was glad we weren't staying on the beach as it might be noisy at night. 
It is a shame they have ruined the beach with too many buildings. 
This is not an upmarket place: its good for families, backpackers and those who dont mind it being a bit low at heel.

Title: Nice and calm beach
Text: Nice relaxing beach. There are lot of water activities to do or you can simply read a book and do sunbathing.

Title: Love it
Text: Lovely beach, clear water, nice sand, full of services but no annnoying sunglasses/ t shirt salesmen

Title: Beautiful
Text: Beautiful beach in a wonderful setting!!! Lots of delicious food options right off the water. Great island life.

Title: Mr
Text: Amazing views not crowded and very friendly locals all around. Great beach to surf and relax. Is a good spot for a great holiday away from the city..

Title: Mirissa beach review
Text: Mirissa beach is filled with sea life including sharks, whale sharks, whales, dolphins etc. There are also many water sports such as surfing and just hanging out on the beach!

Title: Double feeling
Text: During the day the Beach is marvellous. Great swimming, lot of Beach bars, Great vibe. At night it becomes hell with all bars cranking up their music to outvolume the competition. They will keep going until 7 in the morning making it impossible for hotelguests with children to sleep. Horrible.

Title: Beautiful, beautiful,beautiful
Text: Mirissa beach is one of the best beaches I have been to. The waves are a bit challenging but lots of fun if you dont mind being tossed around a bit!!! Since the clean-up the beach bar/ restaurants are great quality with lots of great deals and good food. The evenings on mirissa are fun too with great beach parties going on till late

Title: Great Sunsets
Text:
We really liked this beach especially the sunsets ??.

Half moon shaped and nice sand, its a lovely walk from end to end. Loads to see as there are restaurants and hotels spilling onto the beach all the way along. Breaking waves make for good body boarding and surfers ????? have the north end of the beach to themselves.

Nice..??

Title: Lifes Beachy!
Text:
We really enjoyed Mirissa Beach. Its not too long from end to end, its not too crowded, and each bar/hotel that joins the beach to the main road isnt too expensive. 

The west side is quieter and is best for surfing.

The middle has the most parasols and is the best for swimming.

The east side has a little island to walk to and get great views. This side is the nosiest (closest to the road) and is the best for party bars.

In summary - its not expensive to eat and drink from breakfast to dinner, its safe for kids and pensioners, its clean, its not overcrowded, the sand is very soft.... what more could you ask for!

Title: Nice Beach, Lots going on!
Text: Not bad, if you are looking for the experience with lots of umbrellas and cabanas, and people.  It was enjoyable watching the kids play on the beach.

Title: Feel Relaxed on the Mirissa Beach
Text: A beautiful beach very near Mirissa Beach! It was a gorgeous sunny day and I wish we had had time to spend more time there.

Title: Best relax on the beach
Text: we found big waves on our stay in Mirissa, but still it was so nice to jump in water, because it was so warm! the beach is spacious, not that overcrowed, a nice place for your lunches, dinners where they grill fresh fish right away, or just for a cold beer.

Title: Worst beach we visited in Sri Lanka
Text: We visited around 8 different beaches in Sri Lanka and this was the worst . There were few bars along the seafront but many looked as if they had been knocked down . As soon as you came off the beach you are met with dykes full of plastic bottles and dirty streets

Title: Excellent beach
Text: Excellent beach - very clean, despite the large number of food joints located on the beach. Very nice views of the sunset. There is one rock located inside the water at one end of the beach. It offers excellent views. I think that is called the parrot beach. Very clean and peaceful. Surely worth visiting.

Title: Clean and tidy. Good for swimming in the shallow.
Text: Nice and clean beach in central Mirissa. Good reastaurants located on the beachfront. Nice walking path all the way to coconut rock.

Title: Great beach
Text: Great beach. Snorkeling on the left side of the bay. Good restaurants and good bars. Sea is warm and safe to swim in

Title: Lovely quiet beach
Text: Just spent 4 nights in Mirissa beach. Its a lovely quiet beach split into 2 areas, big beach and little beach. Both have plenty of bars and restaurants along them and very scenic. Big beach however has much softer sand than little beach and the sea is very strong on both beaches although still swimmable. There is also a nice view point on little beach.

Title: Nice beach
Text: Nic beach with plenty of great restaurants to choose from. I especially liked Zephyr, food was great and cheap. Youre gonna feel bad for not paying more. There are several points of interest like and accessible island, a beach where sea turtles swim, you can actually swim with them. Go scuba diving, surfing whale watching. So much to choose from...Im sad that Im leaving soon...

Title: Good time
Text: One of the most famous beaches in Mirissa. Great place to have a taste of the high waves. Good quality sea food available.

Title: Quick Visit
Text: We visited the beach on the way back from whale watching. It's a pretty beach near the south coast which kind of reminded me of the beaches in North Goa.

Title: Nice vibe
Text: The beach is beautiful and pretty clean. The waves are really fun for jumping through - especially at high tide. There are some great places to eat and drink along the beach. You can also see the turtles making their journey from hatching at the sanctuary to the sea.

Title: Very beautiful and clean beach, service & area around it could be much better
Text:
The beach is very nice and clean, the water was very warm (around 28 degrees) and also clean and there were some nice big waves sometimes (that's if you are into big waves). 
But be aware that it can get very crowded sometimes. We were in February 2019 and until 10 am you had to occupy a sun bed, otherwise they was nothing free anymore until around 4 pm (or you had to be lucky). 

One thing which i didn't like: all the restaurants (to whom the sunbeds belonged) were telling you at around 4:30 pm-5 pm to get off the sunbeds, because they were replacing them with tables for dinners. I found that they did this much too early ! It was exactly the time when the sun wasn't that strong anymore and it was really nice to lie in the sun and you had to go. I know that it gets dark really fast there, but still , I wish they had begun with this at 6 pm or later. 
The area around the beach is not nice though. There is a LOT of garbage lying around  everywhere and stinking (especially in the small river, yuck), there is a lot of dust and a lot of noise from the traffic on the main street and also no sidewalk, so you had to pay a lot of attention to the cars coming from both sides. So not really a place to walk relaxed in the evening.
The service on the beach is terrible (with a few exceptions).
