Title: Beautiful beach
Text: I spent a wonderful couple of days enjoying this beach during late October of 1980.  The waters are calm and warm enough that you can float for a long time without getting the chills.  There are warnings about riptides, though , if you venture out too far.     ( the when drop down list only has 2018 in it, but the geological features are still relevant). this beach is lose to the hotel, as well as the train and is a nice afternoon's walk from the downtown/Fort area - about 2 1/2 hours.

Title: stunning
Text:
A beautiful sandy stretch of beach on the Indian Ocean
great for a long morning walk along the waters edge. Several beach side restaurants and bars .Great for dinner as well as a casual breakfast or Coffee to pass the time.

Title: Take the train from Colombo
Text: The train ride from Colombo to Mount Lavinia is about 15-20 minutes - what a fantastic experience. So glad we did this. It cost just pennies and runs right next to the coast. Beautiful scenery. Unlike Britain with its health and safety regulations, the doors dont shut on this train - you just hang on and hang out! Amazing, and if youre lucky a man will come along the train with fresh pineapples. When you come out of the station at mount Lavinia, turn left then left again and left again. Youll cross the train track (just walk over it like the locals do) and be right on the beach with views back to Colombo. The Mount Lavinia hotel is worth a visit too

Title: Average beach
Text: Mount Lavinia Beach is a small patch of beach close to Colombo, just south of the city. It is an average beach as such because I found that the shacks didn't really maintain the acceptable level of hygiene and the beach was broadly speaking quite littered. Now I won't be the first one to say that it was filthy, but it is a bit over crowded and that is only adding to the problem. Mt Lavinia beach has great scope for becoming a welcome short drive from Colombo, but thanks to the increasing traffic and over crowding it is being slowly becoming like most of the beaches in the sub continent.

Title: Good Beach
Text: Nice beach with nice view one can watch nicely Sunset there and can enjoy beauty of nature just nearby one Railway line is there where train passes in regular intervals

Title: Nice beach near Colombo!!
Text: Nice beach near Colombo city. Has some good scenic views. The tides are good is a place to visit in Colombo city.

Title: We use to enjoy our morning run on the beach What a shame that we cannot do it anymore!
Text: Very sad to see this beautiful beach which was once a clean and a nice place to go for a morning run or a stroll, is now dirty. We saw plastic bags of curry, plastic bottles and garbage thrown on the beach. Why isn't anyone responsible to maintain the beach? This is the only beach in Colombo that people can enjoy. Why is keeping the beach clean such a hard thing to do? It is also very crowded in the evenings. The only time it's a bit quiet is in the afternoon. Good for a sea bath. But of course it's terribly hot. Nice restaurants close by.

Title: True Sri Lankan experience
Text: Want to experience Sri Lanka beaches like a local... head here.  Its great but not the white sands and sun lounges with shady palm trees! Its the grungy Sri Lanka with locals playing soccer, warm beers served on plastic outdoor furniture and plenty of hawkers with dancing monkeys and cobra snakes ??

Title: Best beach for relaxation
Text:
Lavinia beach best relaxation via Galle road in south part Colombo.
where you get all budget/4 star etc hotel restaurants parks..hiring cars self-driving cars as i stayed at hotel road..and Sidhalepa Ayurveda spa close by and rented self drive car from Advent travels which 5-10 mnts close to mount Lavinia Hotel and delivered car also.
recommend stay close to Lavinia where close to safest beach and life guards on duty always..

Title: Best beach in Colombo but could be better
Text: The beach itself is soft sand but there is litter everywhere which is a shame. There are a couple of places with sunbeds with modest charges. There are a lot of derelict buildings and empty bars etc. Lots of locals use the beach which is great but it does need to be cleaned.

Title: Private hotel beach
Text:
When we went there it was still the monsoon season, the tail end of it, so the beach had red flags. However, there was a nice restaurant/bar right on the beach. They served all types of drinks and freshly made seafood. We had Margaritas and beers with our friends.
If you are not staying at the hotel you can a small fee that allows to use their pool as well as the beach.

Title: A nice beach.
Text: Spent a pleasant afternoon on this beach. A few restaurants to have a meal or drinks. People selling items on the beach. Sand nice and beach clean.

Title: Afternoon at the beach
Text: Golden sand, ocean very strong, check the signs or ask if it's good to have a bath. The view is perfect and the place is very well equipped with the seafood restaurant, surfs and people to ask informations are really kind.

Title: Just an average but dirty beach
Text: We were there when it was raining and very windy. The waves were very strong. The sand wasn't fine but still acceptable, but there was quite a fair bit of trash in the section we were at. Do be careful when getting to the beach as one has to cross the train track that runs parallel to the beach.

Title: Local Beach
Text:
Its a local beach.  Nice to see the locals out and about.  Definitely not a tourist trap, but somewhat boring...

Not recommended.

Title: The best!
Text: This was the best of the Colombo trip!! Had high-tea here while it was raining. Loved the view/ food/ open sitting and everything about this place!

Title: excellent place to have a quite and romantic dinner
Text: only 1/2 an hour drive from Colombo city,Excelent fresh sea food, sea side, soothing breeze, amazing feelings.

Title: Mount Lavinia
Text: We spent several weeks in a Mount Lavinia budget beach hotel eating mostly in a beach restaurant, which was cheep but with descent food and inexpensive beer. It was close to the train track, but it  did not bother too much. The sandy beach is very long - not too many people. The nearby Mount Lavinia luxury hotel was much more expensive providing private beach.

Title: Not so clean waters
Text: More sand in the beach than normal west coast beaches. Could be maintained better. Children had skin allergy after playing in it. Not sure if it on account of the cleanliness of the water. May be because of the drainage water which is let into it nearby.

Title: Best beach area in Colombo city
Text: Go on early morning or in the evening to spend a relaxing time. I went with my family and my daughter had an awesome time playing on the beach and also playing with water rafts. Collecting different types of sea shells and don't forget to hydrate well with tropical fruit juices available in near by restaurants. Also we loved the Loon tao restaurant near by. Loon Tao is the expensive side but their food and drinks are very good.

Title: Could be beautiful but litter strewn
Text: Mount Lavinia Beach could be lovely but is not looked after.  It is covered in litter and the local people don't seem to notice.  It's a real shame, because it could be a great tourist attraction.  The Mount Lavinia Hotel is nice and the village is pretty, but spoilt by the unloved beach.

Title: An uncrowded beach, perfect venue to unwind at
Text: Wish we had spent more time there. The beach was empty which was a good thing. Didn;t walk very far to check out the area, but it seemed like a fun place to relax and spend a nice day swimming and chilling out. Just 15 minutes away from the beach and inside the village, check out the turtle conservation project. Run by a husband and wife, they charge 1000 LKR per head.

Title: Relaxed evening.
Text:
This is the perfect place to rest and relax in the evening till late. The breeze will take away all your tiredness. 
The place provides tasty dishes. I loved the jumbo prawns and fried Handella. Friendly staff. Little busy over weekends. Try it.

Title: Lovely beach and bars by the beach
Text:
If you have an extra / spare day in Colombo as we did go to Lavinia beach  as its great scape to enjoy de sun and view the sunset as well 
Bar are good nice deco and well service

Title: A big city beach
Text: Sometimes it's quite crowded with local people. The water is not clean as on other beaches in Sri Lanka. Some garbage, not very clean.

Title: Nice and clean
Text: Nice and clean beach with good service and a great seafood restaurants. One is fish market style, other al local style menus.

Title: Afternoon Tea is a 'Must Do' at this lovely hotel
Text: We arrived early for a pre-booked afternoon tea and we were allowed to make use of the swimming pool free of charge. They even provided towels! The food and service was first class and thoroughly enjoyable. We liked the taste of the large leaf tea so much that the waitress kindly fetched us an empty packet so that we could buy the correct product.

Title: Quiet and amazingly clear water
Text: Enjoyed walking up and down the beach while we stayed in Mr. Lavinia Hotel.  Quite interesting to see the change from the hotel to the local beach occupied by fisherman's boats.  You can do quite a long walk south of Mr. Lavinia Hotel.

Title: Nice Evening
Text: Sudden plan make me to come here long sleep after tired of long flying time. It was a good place to relax me in a evening. Hope to go again before leaving Srilanka

Title: fantastic
Text: very nice place to spend hours and hours. many restaurants over there open till midnight and night clubs as well.

Title: Pleasant beach but not the cleanest
Text: Mount Lavinia Beach (by Mount Laviania Hotel) is a beach of golden sand that is extremely busy with both local people and tourists. The best aspects of it are the sunsets which are wonderful to observe and space to walk adjacent to the sea in this bustling and noisy part of the city. There are numerous places to find drinks, street food and so on. Unfortunately we are saddened by the litter and general messy nature of parts of it. If you are looking for pristine golden sands and peace, there are better places on the island.

Title: Sunset and local food
Text:
Not quite a beach as there is more grass and weed than sand. It's a bit messy, too.
Although, it is a fine spot to admire the sunset and have something local to eat.

Title: Lots of sand...
Text:
Very nice beach. Lots of small places to buy a beer, a plate full of fruit or a nice dish of local food.

Been there twice, on Independence day. Busy but not overcrowded. The day after that was even quieter with free sunbeds and lots of space.

Watch out for the current and big waves when you travel with small children

Title: Sunset..by a beach
Text: If you love to see the sunset.. capture breathtaking images then a stroll down Mount beach will satisfy you.. this is if you're close to Colombo. Sri Lanka has many many beautiful lookouts.. but this is a good place for a quick drive from the city of Colombo.. walk on the beach.. maybe enjoy a drink and some food from the many restaurants by the beach!

Title: Nice quaint older hotel with a posh feeling
Text: I had dinner on the beach at the sort-of hide-away restaurant. I ordered appetizers (delicious) and fresh crab (very disappointing). They were out of large crab so I ordered two medium size live crabs which I personally selected. However, when they arrived on my dinner plate, the claws were missing, and it was difficult to be sure I actually got what I ordered. I complained to the staff but I was ensured that what I ordered was what i received.  Not so--the claws were missing, for sure. as a consequent, my high-dollar meals provided very little crab meat. My business partner gave me some claw meat from his own plate so I could actually have a meager meal. Do not order medium to small size crab--i think I was not given what I paid for or expected. Sad.

Title: Very Very Good.
Text: We stayed in Mount Lavinia hotel. Very Expensive. Good Food. Fantastic Experience on last day of our stay in Sri Lanka it was a treat.The beach was quiet and there was staff to be of help all day. Quiet and Peaceful. Good to sit in sun and have a drink in shade of bar. I Love Sri Lanka

Title: disappointing beach after seeing others
Text: Visited this beach but was disappointed in all the rubbish on it.What does it take for people to tidy up after themselves??Piles of rubbish had been heaped up, but who is going to take it away? Some parts cleaner than others but wouldnt rush to go back

Title: Nice sunset Beach
Text:
Visited the beach in Aug17. We went in the afternoon and it was quite empty but it did get crowded towards the evening. 
We watched the sunset and had a small meal at the restaurant. The coconut trees give you some shades and you can hire some beach-chairs. 
Overall it is OK but there are beautiful beaches in the East and North coast.

Title: A huge beach, but not very clean.
Text: There are some sections of the beach that are clean, but lots of it isn't! We only saw 1 rubbish bin the whole 7 days we were there & that was overflowing! There is rubbish that has been collected into black bags, but they are not taken away! If the restaurants don't clean their immediate area, then it is not done! The locals & tourists generate a good deal of rubbish that could be recycled if only the infrastructure were in place! It's a shame that this stretch of beautiful beach is marred by flotsum & jetson!

Title: Beach at the heart of Colombo
Text: Mount Lavinia beach or "Mount" as it's referred to is probably the nicest beach within the confines of Colombo. I, and a group of friends had a few snacks and a lot of drinks at a local beach side bar. The beach is relatively clean, although it could be cleaner. I suspect the odd piece of trash is generated by the numerous bars and restaurants that line the extensive coast line. However, it is still a beautiful spectacle as the beach arches around to the famous Mount Lavinia Beach hotel. It's definitely worth a visit at night to experience the lively atmosphere and to enjoy the company of the locals, who are friendly and welcoming. You can also experience the local wildlife - dogs, cats and crows! I would definitely recommend this beach on any visit to beautiful Sri Lanka.

Title: holiday
Text: There are plenty of local dogs on the beach . The beach is never swept. Good to swim and have dinner on the beach eating fresh hauls from the sea .

Title: Outstanding vibe; questionable water
Text:
This place was a stones throw from my hotel, thus it was frequently visited.

It is a very memorable experience to swim here while the sun is setting.

As others pointed out, the water is not the cleanest.  Upon walking a few hundred metres up the beach, I noticed that a stormwater drain/sewer (?) drains straight into the water.

Alarmingly, there was an oil spill one afternoon, unbeknownst to the swimmers already in the water!  Oil was left in the sand, and was visible in the crashing waves.  Yuck.

There are countless nicer beaches in Sri Lanka, however, this is worth the visit for its location.  In the evening, locals pack the beach, creating a very lively atmosphere.

Title: We had a nice day.
Text:
Six English tourists aged between 11-60 visiting on a Tuesday afternoon.
Beach easily reached by tuk tuk. Half an hour from Galle Face Hotel.
We had a drink in a newly refurbished bar with a white picket fence, was clean, good service and comfortable, with sunbeds.
Walked along beach to Mount Lavinia Hotel. You cant access the hotel from the beach unless your a resident. Walk along the train track and up through main entrance.
Ate lunch on the terrace, then jumped in a tuk tuk. 
Beach was quiet, no boats for hire, one stall selling balls ect. A handful of beach bars. Nice sand, lovely locals, but a little bit of litter. You could catch the train from here near the hotel. We worked out they seemed to come about every 45 minutes.

Title: A nice bech
Text: It is a clean beach with many restaurants. It is a great beach to swim or go fo a nice walk. There are people selling souvenirs, but they do not hassle you too much.

Title: Beautiful
Text: Have been here several times now & have never been disappointed . Meal as always beautiful , the service fantastic. Love the old colonial building & the views are great .

Title: What a lovely beach
Text: A perfect place for a lazy sunday afternoon and then watch the nice sunset. it offers a wide variety of seafood restaurants and bars to enjoy the evening as well.

Title: Safe beach, lots of families but come back before dark
Text: The beach was safe, waves not too big, great to see families out in force having fun. Lots of places to stop if you walk *towards* Mount Lavinia Hotel. Don't walk the other direction

Title: Serene beach
Text: This beach is an hour away from Colombo city. There are a lot of restaurants and bars alongside the beach. Good for walking!

Title: Nice walk on the beach
Text:
A very nice clean beach with lots of food and drink to stop for...

Can walk or sunbathe..

The sea can be a little rough at times,  but as long as you are careful should be fine..

Title: Very nice
Text: Our hotel has very best private beach. Clean, has showers. Couple of restaurants, no locals. We went for New Years Holidays, it was perfect. Mild waves.

Title: Pleasant location
Text: Clean and well organised place. Of course good location as it is attached to the very nice hotel. You can find really tasty and well cooked food or directly on the beach, or in the hotel. Service was also fast.

Title: Beaches In srilanka
Text: It's a nice beach. Full of fun and parties. At night there are dance parties near beach. Might be the good place for sea food lover

Title: Beautiful sunset
Text: Beautiful sunset over the Indian ocean especially so when there is cloud & you can see sun rays as the sun sets over the horizon. Manage to view double rainbow as the sky opens up with a short shower.

Title: Unfortunately quite scruffy...
Text: Sorry to say we were not impressed with this beach it was quite scruffy and there are a lot of places just full of rubbish... Could be nice if locals made an effort to give it a good tidy....

Title: Nice beach, but not unique.
Text: It was a nice enough place to walk on the beach, but there wasn't a whole lot going on there. I did see a few restaurants around and there were some locals with fishing boats, which is a nice cultural touch. I think there are probably some nicer beaches on the island, but if you're in Colombo and looking for a place to see the water, then this will work.

Title: Sea side
Text: My wife and I  stayed  for 3 nights  on our journey  to Sri Lanka. We really enjoyed  our  room  / direct sea view  on the  4th  floor. I approached  the manager  and booked another  4 nights  after  our  trip  to  Kandy. I must  say  he was  very  helpful  and we had  the same  room  on our return. Over  a great  stay and nice  hotel  for a relaxing  holiday

Title: Nice place. Beach ok. Jojo Food vendor bad experience
Text: Overall beach is nice. However it was bit crowded when i went on sunday. Beach sand quality was not too good as it was black at some places. Plus the jojo food vendor experience was pretty bad. 4 star for the beach.

Title: Most important for me it is very clean !
Text:
A beautiful beach next to the railway station and approx 30 mins drive from central Colombo - the place had a nice vibe and topography with a number of local restaurants and bars to relax and enjoy the view. Considering this is a "city beach" it was very clean.
On the other side of the railway tracks is a busy suburb with lots of shopping options (big and small) and restaurants etc

Title: excellent sea view
Text: well maintained hotel , good food and service , the sea view from the restaurant is amazing, a must visit place

Title: Fantastic hotel full of character -Tarick
Text: The staff at the Mount Lavinia were so welcoming and always happy to help you. The hotel has some beautiful surroundings and is perfect to relax before trips out later. A member of staff named Tarick was kind enough to show us around the hotel and always greeted us with a warm welcome. Seeing Staff happy to see you makes your stay feel so special. VIP tours are also based there and offer plenty of information on trips you may wish to go on. Himari has been fantastic in organising our tour around Sri Lanka. Thank you Tarick and the staff of Mount Lavinia.

Title: Beautiful place to see the sunset.
Text:
We went here 3-4 times.
But all times there was no season here to swim.
Anyway I would like not to swim in Colombo.
But to sit and enjoy sea cove restaurant on the beach - this is must have.

Title: Gets very busy in the evenings
Text: Nice beach comparatively bigger than ones in Colombo. Fairly clean, waters can be a bit rough. Some nice restaurants along the beach. Good for jogging or long walks or even a dip during the calmer seasons. The beach gets very crowded in the evenings so better chances of enjoying more during mornings or afternoons. Keep an eye on personal belongings as some dodgy folk do tend to hang around.

Title: ok had a couple of drinks at one of the bars it was ok, nothing special.
Text: went there for an afternoon drink and a walk on the beach. Had a nice atmosphere on the beach, customer service was ok. not great, had to wait a while for our order?

Title: Excellent night and performance
Text:
I got the opportunity to visit Mount Lavinia Beach on the business trip. I visited this place along with my colleagues and we spent a perfect musical night here.
The performance from the local team was excellent and having a group dinner with top management team was memorable.

Title: Lunch on the beach
Text: The hotel is a throw back to a previous Colonial life and is an oasis in a hustling bustling city. The swimming pool is child friendly and it also has access to a beach where a variety of beach food is available - including freshly cooked, freshly caught sea food. Nice but the Galle Face hotel is so much nicer.

Title: Mountlavina Nice beach
Text: Nice beach & beautiful sunset. There some places parties at night . it is good place having fresh sea food . not so good for swimming, snorkeling because currents in this month.

Title: Filthy
Text:
Very unclean... Just awful rubbish everywhere 

Restaurant lacking in hygiene standards

To many hawkers interrupting dinner

Title: A Good Sea Beach!
Text: Mount Lavinia Beach is located just out of the Colombo city, it took long time to go there from our hotel located in the Colombo city Centre. Its a nice place to roaming around the sea side with sands. The beach was not crowded during our visit, it was very hot and humid day. One can see the Mount Lavania Hotel from the beach, which is one of the oldest renowned hotel in Colombo. There are some Sea Fish restaurants available beside the beach. One can also enjoy famous Srilankan coconut water from the small shops near the beach.

Title: Lovely place but dangerous
Text:
Beautiful beach. But the sea is treacherous with under currents. Being a resident of the area we have seen so many deaths due to drowning.
Humbly request all visitors NOT to get into water but enjoy the beach.

Title: Loved this Beach
Text: I got here just before the sunset and I was awe-inspired to see the beautiful sunset it had to offer. One can get here by train or can simply take any southbound bus from Colombo and get down here. Transports to and from Colombo are frequently available from here. I would recommend people to get to this beach just fir its brilliant sunset. Would love to go back there someday.

Title: Routine beach
Text: Just like any other beach. Few fast food corners along the beach. Few people taking a dip in the warm waters. Mostly sandy with few rocks. Best thing is life guards on duty with watch towers along the beach.

Title: South end of beach OK
Text:
As long as you walk the South end of the beach it's OK. Further North passed the fishermen it gets a bit smelly.
Enjoyed watching the fishermen bringing in their catch

Title: Late night outing
Text: Really nice seating arrangements. Impressive collection of fresh seafood. Loved the multilingual singers on the beach. Food was of highest quality and taste. One if the best place to have a candle night dinner right on the beach. A must destination during colombo visit

Title: Great seaside view
Text: A great place to view the sunset while having a couple of beers. There are many restaurants along the beach you can choose.

Title: Not a relaxing experience.
Text:
I arrived in Negombo around 9am, as it was too early to check in to my hotel I dumped my bag and headed to the beach to explore. 

From the moment I set foot onto the beach I was continuously hounded by numerous locals, each trying to sell me something - either a boat trip, or various wares they were trying to flog. 

I just wanted to be left alone, explore, feel the sun on my skin, and enjoy the views. But I didnt get one minutes peace. After about half an hour Id had enough and left the beach. 

Yes, theyre relatively friendly, but its just damn annoying! When one of them is talking to you, you can see about four or five other vendors circling, waiting for them to leave, so they can then pounce. Not a good experience, unfortunately.

Title: Not a nice beach
Text: The beach is so dirty, full of rubbish with what looks like an oil spill.. such a Health hazard..    ..

Title: Local beach
Text: Very windy local beach. The sea is not one of the best in Sri Lanka, but the atmosphere is beautiful. Characteristic on weekends, full of local people who come here to swim and spend a day at the beach.

Title: Head for the South Coast beaches instead!
Text: Much more of a locals beach, not any amenities and not very clean. Not great for sunbathing and anything, we just walked up and down in 5 minutes!

Title: Will not rush back
Text:
Looks great, golden sands, fishing boats, locals playing, lovely breeze. Lots of traders, but friendly and polite when you say no thank you. 
Lots of litter and a bit like a scene from Alfred Hitchcock The crow. They are everywhere and it feels as if they are watching you. Roosting time is eerie.

Title: Dreadful pollution
Text:
Looking forward a nice long walk on the beach which looked lovely from the hotel - an hour Ill never get back.
Black oil under the sand, extensive rubbish, dead turtle ??, plastic and rubbish everywhere

Title: Power Cuts and uncared for mess
Text:
Writing in early March 2022 the main issue is power cuts. I have travelled all over SL in the last 2 months, from Jaffna to Tangalle and the only place I have stayed with long daily power cuts is Negombo. Fine if you're in one of the characterless hotels like Jetwings etc. with their noisey diesel generators. But no fun for the majority staying at smaller more environmentally friendly hotels and guest houses.
And the beach is filthy. 
This is the town most tourists visit on the way in and out of the country. Not a good impression.

Title: Negombo Garbage Beach Clean it up!!
Text:
The locals should be ashamed. The beach is littered with plastic and junk .
Cant blame it on the tourists because there are hardly any here. If the locals want tourists to come, then they need to treat their own backyard with more dignity.
So bad and such a disappointment. 
Plus the sea is rough and brown.
If coming to Sri Lanka, choose elsewhere on the island.

Title: I never come back!
Text:
We planned to spend one day at the beach before leaving home. As soon as we arrived at the beach our minds changed. The beach was full of all kinds of rubbish and the sea water was brown. The whole beach area looked like that locas were using it as dump. 

There are so many nice beaches in Sri Lanka but this was just huge dissapointment!

Title: Garbage site
Text:
Filthy. The entire beach / all of Negombo is basically Sri Lanka's garbage disposal.

The beach itself is littered with rubbish to the extent where every other step is on a bottle or some plastic bags etc.

Bizarrely you find some residents of the hotels going to swim in the sea here. Can't understand why, as the sea is brown.

Also beware the beggars and scammers.

Would not recommend at all... Go far, far away from smelly Negombo

Title: Quiet Beach ...
Text: This is a quieter beach front as compared to the Galle Face Beach. A nice place to relax on the beach; enjoy the sea breeze; enjoy the sunset view with peaceful surroundings. We were told by our driver/ guide that Negombo is usually a starting point or ending point of Sri Lanka trip since it is closer to the International Airport. We were so glad that we made Negombo as our last destination during our Sri Lanka Trip as it is indeed a relaxing place to end the trip after the extensive tour around Sri Lanka Island.

Title: Wide quiet beach
Text: Great beach facing the west so sunset photos over the ocean.  Opportunity to swim in the  Indian Ocean- warm and inviting.  Jetwing Blue is right on Negombo Beach.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text:
Negombo beach is really nice some nice bars that lead onto the beach itself great location, watch out for seller's there are quite a lot walking up and down the beach but you can get a bargain just as I did.

Mr D Meadows

Title: Nice but not as pretty as others
Text: The beach is long and goes on for miles. Very relaxed beach but the undercurrent in the sea can be deceiving on some days, but if you can swim, you will be fine. We enjoyed it but would have  liked to have seen more shacks on the beach with sunbeds which would have been a nice addition.

Title: good for 1 night before taking my flight
Text:
Last year I also was in Sri Lanka and I spent my last night in a big hotel at the airport. This year looking better at the map I discovered that Negombo beach is not fare, so we decided to spend our last night here. The beach is not clean, but anyhow we took a long walk on the beach. 
we really enjoyed our night at Bacco Italian Restaurant eating great food and a bottle of good wine.

Title: Dirty beach with potential
Text: I recommend cleaning this beach. Lots of plastic crap and dirty water. It could be way nicer with a cleanup.

Title: Clean pristine!
Text:
It's a pristine sea face definitely worth a visit.
They offer catamaran rides that we didn't try though.

Title: Walk along the beach
Text: Nice sand beach, but no sun beds anywhere around. There are also some annoying sellers going around the beach selling bracelets and fishing trips. Nice place to go for a walk.

Title: Lovely beach
Text: Stayed in goldi sands hotel right on the beach from with a sea view of this beautiful beach. Morning is very pea full all you can hear are the birds and see squirrels running around in the trees. Afternoon the you see people chilling on the beach then in the early evening it comes to life with locals play volley ball, football and even weddings. Lovely to just sit and watch the world go by

Title: Terrible place
Text: Avoid! DIRTY!!! Go to the south if you want nice turquoise waters and clean sand. the water is sandy and the sand is not cleaned. You find almost anything on that beach, unfortunately! Public beach left uncleaned and unattended.

Title: A fishermans beach
Text:
Fairly clean, probably 100 metres wide.
High rise hotels.
The beach drops steeply into the sea.
I wouldnt recommend it as a swimming beach.
Traditional fishing boats and swarthy fishing folk.
Faces west so good for sunsets.

Title: No beach loungers
Text: Nice wide beach with golden sand but beach loungers is not a thing on this side of the world.  Not a private beach so you do get vendors trying to sell merchandise and tours but not overly aggressive.  Warm very warm and was calm.

Title: Nothing much to do..
Text: Rough waves , deep ocean and nothing much to do on this beach. Negombo has nothing much to do or see around. Prices here are high compared to mirissa. Good place for a one night or two. However you feel bored after couple of nights. Choose wisely. Good eating joints like lords and serendib pub.

Title: Very nice and adventurous
Text: I visited brown beach. It was beautiful but less managed so looked little messy as compared to other beaches. It is having little steep shores therefore the waves are little deeper and higher, though it may not look so in photographs. It's has restaurants and hotels nearby. Go ahead and enjoy.

Title: Quiet and opportune
Text: Easy going with a few pedlars but a wide beach good for riding in a local skiff, a dip (mind the tow), fishing, beach soccer, volleyball, cricket, sun-bathing, a drink or meal.

Title: A NICE STRETCH OF SAND
Text: There are apparently better beaches to the north of the town but the one opposite the town proper is more than suitable for a walk or a short dip. You will probably see some oruwas, a catamaran that uses hollowed out trees as its base. It is little wonder all the fishermen you see are thin. Cap off the day with a sunset over the Indian Ocean.

Title: Wind swept beach with drains emptying onto ocean
Text: Close to airport, so Negambo worth an overnight stay  or two. We srrived on full moon so fun to see locals enjoying beach. Beach not idyllic so don't come for yhe beach go to Mirissa.

Title: Stop over for few days
Text:
We were in Tangalle where beaches are exceptional.
This is a town beach, with open drains flowing into sea, I didn't swim here. Busy stretches quiet spots can be found. Only one place Sea look to stretch out on a lounger. There are areas of rubbish on beach but not everywhere it is a town beach. 
Beach vendors but they are usually quite polite.

Sunset and long cool drink, must do....

Title: Hectic in the evenings
Text: a large beach with lots going on especially in the late afternoon when it cools down. Boat trips are fun as the speed boats fly straight up the beach when coming into land. music and dancing going on and a small market for street food etc.. trouble is the locals don't respect what they have and tend to leave a lot of rubbish around which is a shame.

Title: Large but dirty
Text: Went to the beach for xmas holidays and it was pretty crowded with locals which is fine but they threw thrash everywhere. It is a large beach with grainy yellow sand, but unfortunately several insisting salesperson trying hard to make you buy bracelets while talking about money to support his kids. So not a place to chill - I went once and never again.

Title: Family trip
Text:
Good beach, well maintained.
Neatly maintained.
Public behavior is good.
Friendly fishermen.
Nicely decorated hotel backyards.

Title: Good
Text: This beautiful beach is close to the main Katunayake airport. This is a good beach. This popular with locals and tourists.

Title: Dirty and too wide
Text:
Nothing like the smaller, cozy beaches in the south. Also it's dirty, very wide with very big waves and not really welcoming at all.

Good for a quick stay before going or coming from the airport.

Title: Hallo madam, hallo?
Text:
Hallo madam. Hallo? Hallo? is what you will hear all the time while trying to relax after a swim in the see. One after the other sellers will offer various products and wont leave you alone until you dont tell them at least three times thank you, Im not interested in buying anything. Then they will insist on at least showing you their collection of goodies. After the second day, I used the hello, no thank you, Im not interested even before they would approach me. Sometimes it worked, sometimes it didnt. 
As for the beach, its extremely dirty, there is trash literally everywhere! There is no shade where one could hide and since the water is full of sand, your swimwear will be also! 
If you happen to wear a bikini, be prepared to receive some stares because local women go in the water with their clothes on.

Title: Good for a short visit

nice beach to spend the last day

Title: Ok

Title: Nice beach
Text: Very nice beach, water not very clean but perfect for walks and watching crabs :) Not many places on the beach itself so it makes for a rare view of quite untouched beach with palm trees.

Title: Not a lot to see or do. Mostly dirty.
Text:
Since our flight was landing midnight at Colombo airport, we decided to give Negombo a try as it was closer to the airport than Colombo. The only thing worth doing in Negombo was the beach so we decided to head to the beach after having our breakfast. The beach is very small and mostly dirty. You will be troubled with people trying to lure you for a pathetic boat ride.

This beach is mostly for locals. There are some local snacks shops and ice cream trucks here. Most of the beach is tarred with trash and after every 20 meters someone will approach you for boat ride or try to sell you something. That's another buzzkill.

You can spend around half an hour to one hour here but nothing more. We found beaches in Bentota much better than Negombo.

Title: Not too bad
Text: The beach at Negombo is just ok. There is a lot of rubbish on the beach but most of it is cleaned up each morning by a tractor. Even after the clean up there is still a far bit Id waste left. You would only go to this beach if you are staying in one of the hotels along it after or before your flight. Its not a place I would visit for the beach alone.  In saying that we swam there each day we were there. The water was pretty good in the mornings but by the afternoon there was a lot of debris floating in it. Its not the kind of beach where you go and lay on it like we do in Australia. The sand is course and there is the rubbish issue.  The other thing to contend with are the hawkers trying to sell your their wares and the boat owners wanting to take you for a boat trip.  Its an ok beach if you are there but dont go out of your way to visit.

Title: Not the best...
Text: After coming from the Maldives, any beach would pale in comparison. However; there was lots of litter on the beach, and we had to consistently have to say "no" to the hoards of people trying to sell us nick nacks.

Title: Clean
Text: The beach is a little different to those on Aussie shores. It gets cleaned daily, is frequented by hawkers and there are lots of stray dogs. The dogs wont bother you. The hawkers will. However, they are a polite nation and are just trying to earn a living. If youre not interested, a polite no is all it takes. The sea is incredibly warm but those waves are strong so please watch out for your little ones.

Title: Beach
Text: There is t loads to do at the beach other than sit on the sand as there are no chairs other than with the hotels

Title: Can be boring!

Title: Slightly Disappointed

Title: Lovely beach
Text: I love the beach. Its quite clean and theres a play area for kids too. Go out into the sea and check out the shipwreck and the corals.

Title: A few dead cats
Text: We stayed in Negombo for one night for our layover. The beach was nice, however, we had a dead cat wash up ashore right in front of us and a few meters down another dead dried  up cat from the sun. As you can probably tell the beach wasnt very clean. Otherwise beautiful views.

Title: A little hmmm
Text: Whilst it good for a stroll, there is just too much litter for me. The sand is a light brown and slightly coarse. The are a few polite touts to keep you on your toes.

Title: Health Hazard
Text:
A beautiful stretch of beach several miles long completely ruined by the amount of rubbish strewn across the whole length of it.

Plastic of all descriptions from tooth brushes to old toys, and of course many many plastic bottles.  Also glass bottles whole and smashed,  as well as other detritus.  Yet worse than this from the wild life perspective is the bits of old fish nets and lines scattered all over the place. A real danger to all forms of marine life.

Feral dogs run loose and defecate everywhere,  worse still my wife witnessed a local also defecating on the edge of the water.

A half-hearted attempt is made to clean the beach by use of a tractor and sand scoop but does not cover even half the beach leaving most of the beach untouched. Saw one so called recycling bin that was used as a general rubbish bin, apart from that there appears no attempt to recycle any of this mess.  

At one point a stream runs across the beach then out to sea that smells strongly of sweage . There is also a small pond that also smells the same.

All the beach bars  and hotels that front onto this stretch of sand serve all their drinks with plastic straws and there are thousands of them every where you look on what should be a lovely natural space.

So if you do walk on this beach keep your saddles on

Title: Dirty
Text: Negombo is a sandy beach with muddy waters. No shade to be found. Only got approached by one seller. This beach needs a clean, dead cats and rubbish filtering into the sea .

Title: Vendors can be annoying
Text:
Negombo Beach is actually quite long.  Our first encounter was on a Sunday near the Jetwing Hotel as the sun was setting.  We saw local families packing up, preparing to head home.  Groups of young men playing beach volleyball and others kicking a soccer ball around.  A few female vendors approached us but we said "no thank you" and they left us alone. 

Two weeks later, we walked to the beach in the morning near the Heritance Hotel and were immediately barraged by people offering tours, boat rides, and souvenirs.  We had wanted to take a nice quiet stroll by the water but left after 10 minutes because it got unbearably annoying because the vendors kept following us.   The sand itself is a tan color and the water seemed clean.  Not the powdery soft white sand and crystal blue clear water that we associate with the South Pacific.

Title: Very clean beach
Text: Great beach to swim in and very clean. Fantastic sunsets. Very romantic setting for couples. Children can play freely and there are always locals on the beach playing volleyball and softball and they always enjoy foreigners joining in.

Title: nice beach shame about the plastic
Text: really nice beach to wander on - just a issue we had with the amount of drift plastic washed up most of it not created in sri lanka but brought here by the indian ocean - a shame clean up operations do not seem to be in place would make it a wonderful destination

Text:
Beaches are beautiful. But you still find some rubbish which locals leave and go . Mornings you can see fishermen bringing fresh fish from
the sea . Kids enjoyed it seeing it for the first time . Even in those fish nets we saw plastic , drink cartons etc...

Title: Lovely
Text:
First stop in Sri Lanka. So can't compare it to the other beaches.
A little rubbish but we found it clean enough to walk on bare foot. Lot's of locals and tourists playing in the sea, jogging, romantic strolls. Plenty of bars along the beach. Lot's of boats parked up on the sand and fishermen attending their nets.

Title: Lack of facilities
Text: Negombo is pretty awful as a resort, it stinks of sewage. It's selling point is it's close proximity to the airport. We walked on the beach and could not see hired out sunbeds. Although I'm sure some of the bars may have had some. As usual there was a fair bit of rubbish.

Title: Don't expect much
Text:
The water in the ocean seems dirty here. The view is beautiful only at sunset. There's nothing to do, no sunbeds, no shadow. Sometimes, there is waste, sometimes locals burn waste(including plastic) and the smell is awful.

We do not recommend to visit Negombo at all.

Title: Big beach but dirty
Text:
The beach is long and wide and you can take a very nice walk at sunset.
On the other side, the beach does not offer any sports activities (like beach volleyball) and it is very very dirty

Title: Worst beach we visited
Text: This is fine for a transit place but why people would choose to spend their holiday in Sri Lanka at this location is beyond me. The beach has a lot of litter and the sea is not clear due to run off from streams. Worst place we had for mosquito and the locals here are not as friendly as elsewhere in the county. No sun loungers and limited beach bars/restaurant but lots of places on the road side. We chose here rather than finishing in Colombo for the end of our holiday

Title: Nagombo beach
Text: It has a long stretch of white sands not crowded with small sailing ?? boats you can take trips with people are cleaning up the beachs local cafe owners are giving free coffee for every bag of plastic rubbish collected we have been swimming there most mornings drinking fresh coconut ?? from the beach ?? And chopped up with machetes by the locals for 50p

Title: Pretty, but..
Text:
A pretty beach at distance, and some parts are quite nice. 
Packed with sellers, and you cant go anywhere or look anywhere without a lot of people trying to sell stuff or guided tours. The water is quite brown, dont know why. Trash laying around. Many locals at the northern part, which is great.

Title: Clean, Tidy and beautiful  scenery.
Text:
Once you navigate your way to the beach the experience  is worth the effort.
With beautiful scenery and miles of golden sand to walk on Negombo beach is a visit not to be missed. 
Recommended.

Title: Adequate but not the best For Sri Lanka
Text: Sun, sand, plenty beachside hotels and restaurants of all sorts. Good for relaxation and easily access to airport.

Title: Warm seas
Text: Great beach with warm seas. Very peaceful surprisingly as its the city. And great views of the local fishermen at work

Title: Lovely sandy beach and warm water for swimming
Text: The beach is a great place to hang out and swim in the warm sea. It gets crowded on the afternoon at the weekends and you have to learn to ignore the traders trying to sell their wares but they are all polite and move on if you are not interested.

Title: Stunning unspoiled beach
Text: We loveed this beach. It's wide and the sand is very fine. There were some boats adding charm and authenticity. Waves were rather high but the water was really  warm and pleasant.

Title: Dirty
Text: The beach would be nice if it wasn't full of rubbish like bottle lids other plastic and paper. This is a very very touristy beach and dosnt have that wow factor that other beaches have in Sri lanka (go to bentota instead) you also get hassled by the locals wanting you to buy thing or go on there boats that look like they are about to fall apart.

Title: Pleasant morning walk
Text: It was really pleasant just wandering the beach. The locals were friendly and although some wanted to get you to GI for a ride in their boats or sell you something no one was pushy or annoying. The ocean looked beautiful and very tempting. Good way to start the day.

Title: Nice beach
Text: We came to beach to relax on the first day on our arrival to srilanka and we stayed on the last day which quite near to the airport. Good place to have a walk and swim and good seafood restaurants are nearby u can choose all of sea fish varieties. Recommended!

Title: Vacation
Text: Absolutely a clean and beautiful beach that goes on for miles. Great for watching the sun set and picnics and just relaxing. Good for the entire family.

Title: Rough seas
Text: The seas were very rough and it was impossible  to swim. There are no amenities on the beach and no shade. I knocked over by the first wave when I was only knee deep.

Title: Becoming trashy
Text: Seems to have more trash on the beach than in the past. Path from the road to the beach is particularly strewn with rubbish.  In addition, high rise buildings are being constructed long the beach.  Another island paradise ruined.  If I want  a Miami Beach, Ill go to Florida.

Title: Sri Lanka tour
Text: Lovely expansive sandy beach. Surf can be a little vigorous but a joy to see. There are plenty of people selling their wares and boat rides...negotiations. is  the key and part of the fun

Title: Nice beach, nice people
Text: My fiancée and I went to the beach together in Negombo three days in a row.  The beach is huge and has multiple sections.  We took some photographs on the rocks and the beach itself.  I dropped my phone out of my pocket and a local found it and when we went back to look for it, he gave it to me.  He does catamaran trips, so we went out for a 40 minute trip.  I also went swimming there.  The water is brown and full of sand, but the sand didnt stick to me like Mirissa beach sand did and care off easily with 1 shower.  The water is calm and makes for easy swimming regardless of ability.  The people there are very friendly.  The beach is more dirty (with garbage/rubbish) all over the place, however, it is nice that you can pretty much guarantee finding a decent amount of space at any part of the beach to call your own.  Of course it doesnt hurt that some of the best restaurants and shopping can be found on the road that runs along the beach.  If youre in Negombo and havent been here yet, then youre really missing out.

Title: Beautiful....
Text:
Very nice beach. Not only for tourists. Many locals swim here. 
Quite clean and nice. Many cafe's and restaurants near

Title: Better than expected
Text: Not a bad beach. Clean enough, big enough, fab sunset, some beach bars although service a bit mayhem, see some local activity.

Title: If this is the worst beach of Sri Lanka, how the beautiful must look like!
Text:
It it pretty nice beach. Wild n wawy, but u can just walk n stop by. In the mroning till noon, u wont get bothered by much locals coz its the hottest time if the day.
Few restaurants there, I enjoyed, was relaxing before my flight. I would not stay there for vacation, but for layover why not. Not much dirty actually.
Just stick with group of foreigners there n u will feel more safe.

Title: For local life not for swimming
Text: We were dropped off by tuk tuk by the main church.  Turning left we walked to the port, taking in the village of the fishermen, watching the fish drying on the beach.  There is a drop off from the beach so I would not suggest swimming and if you watch the rubbish and effluent coming down the river it's probably not that clean either (nothing like India though!).  The port is really interesting with larger boats with beautiful colours.  If you want to see local life and miss out on large western hotels this is the place for you.  Tuk tuks think this is the 'not so nice beach' so further round there may be big western hotels, I'm not sure.

Title: Average beach
Text: Average beach with murky rough shore breaks and a slightly polluted feel. A few veach front bars to sit at and have a drink or feed but these werent anything special.

Title: Nice Place to stay leasurely in Negambo
Text: Very beautiful and rushed environment place to stay and visit in Negambo beach. Peoples past timing and enjoying very well. Lot of snacks shops and Ice cream carrers available entire beach front.

Title: Better beaches easily found
Text: This beach is long. Thats the only positive I have. Its filthy, full of garbage, and when we stayed close (not in the monsun season) we couldnt bathe because of winds and currents. The beach is terrorized by enormous amounts of aggressive crows. Never tried myself, but understand beaches in the east and south are much better.

Title: In need of a good clean up!
Text: This could be a lovely beach indeed but its ruined by rubbish lying around and especially glass bottles are a little dangerous if children were to go there. We simply walked along and took some pictures and then left as we were also hounded by people trying to sell us their local handicrafts.

Title: Needs a good clean up
Text:
We booked two nights in Negombo as we had read that the beaches were lovely! This is not the case! We just went for a walk along one morning and saw so much rubbish laying around, this is truly worrying for all the sea life!
We walked along the beach to the left as if you were walking towards the town of Negombo!
It looks as if you walked the opposite direction it was cleaner as lots of bars and restaurants back on to this area of the beach! 
Also be aware that we had at least 4 touters within 30 minutes come up to try and get into a conversation and try and sell you things!
My advise is to say you havent brought any money down and then keep walking! If you give them anytime then they start laying out all of their options and you feel very guilty to say no when they ask you to buy something! 
Beaches in Colombo and Bentota are a lot cleaner!

Title: Huge waves in August
Text:
In the summer of 2018 we (Dutch familie of 4, kids 13 and 18) travelled to discover the beauties of Sri Lanka.
Don't expect a wide beach to relax and sunbathe in August: the wind blows fiercely towards the land and the waves are huge!
But we liked jumping in the big waves: we did it every day. It's not for the young, because the undercurrents are very stron and the waves unpredictable. We also recommend to use waterproof sunscreen, because without you noticing it and being all the time with the most part of your body under the cooling water, you will easily get sunburned.

Title: Dirty
Text: I went to this beach, but there was so much rubbish all over the place so I spent all my time in the sun nex to my hotel swimming pool

Title: Great ...
Text: Negombo beach is not that good but it's ok .this city best start your holiday or end ur holiday becoz it's only 20 minutes ride from airport. There are some great hotel s and resturents

Title: The beautiful Indian ocean
Text: The negombo beach is secluded and serene. I have experienced sunset at the beach and feeling the sea breeze is an unforgettable event. I had a small bottle of wine there and that  perfected for my solo trip.

Title: Negombo beach is sadder for  the plastic everywhere
Text:
A lovely beach except for the plastic that comes un with every tide. Tragically a condition of the world as it is today.  
The undertow was strong when we were there so care is needed.
Bot a suitable beach for weak swimmers or kids.

Title: Filthy
Text: The pollution needs to stop! Trash, old flip flops, cans and plastic strewn everywhere! Not a garbage can in sight! Peddlers on the beach harass you to buy stuff.

Title: Choppy waters
Text: When we were there, there were some big waves and red flags flying. So we didnt go in. The beach is a bit scuffy with random bits of rubbish on the sand. Facing the beach are an assortment of shacks and hotels, some under construction. Access is difficult as Hotels block access to the beach from the main road

Title: Needs a major cleanup
Text: Our hotel was on the beach. The breeze is nice at night and you can walk it during the day. However this is not a beach you want to sit out as it is very dirty.

Title: Not nice!
Text: We went there to see the sunset which was beautiful but sadly the beach was not! Full of garbage and a poor horse standing there more dead than alive for amusement to tourists. My kinda thought The saw a sea turtle in the waves but very sadly it was a dead dog. Nobody cared:(

Title: Rough waves this time of year
Text: The beach for the time of year that we were here was very rough. We couldnt really swim in it but it was nice to look at

Title: Dont even bother
Text:
Dirtiest beach in Sri Lanka with the most persistent souvenir sellers. If you are looking for a nice relaxing time on the beach with good restaurants, this is not the place to stay, unless you are just waiting for your plane back home.
Be careful, you might even see some locals jerking off while you pass by.

Title: Had a hotel on the beach
Text: Unfortunately visited in the off season and surf rough and dirty. Still good for a walk plenty of locals playing soccer and cricket. Generally clean and locals friendly

Title: Negombo Beach
Text:
I stayed at Breeze Residence and walked about 200m to the beach. This section is behind a church and a hotel. Very quiet and clean. Did not see any tourist at 9 am but  a few locals doing fishing on the beach. There is wave so not suitable for swimming and the water here looks blue.
Did not see any crows here maybe they go to where the food are at the tourist chain of hotels ?
The sandy beach is nice and long. Should have come again for a night stroll.

Title: Sandy beach
Text: Sea was a little rough when we were there they have a red flag system. Most hotels have a pool. Miles of sandy beach felt safe walking along people very friendly.

Title: Filthy beach
Text: Anything you'd find in a dumpster is scattered over this beach. The water is brown. I'd ask for my money back from the many boutique and chain hotels on the front if I'd arrived fir a beach holiday. Luckily I'm just here to wait for a flight

Title: Crows, crows & more crows
Text:
Ok beach but be prepared to fight the crows for space. At all the hotels, all you hear is caw, caw, caw! All day, even before the sun comes up, until sunset.
You have to protect your food and space or they will literally swoop down and take the food right out of your hand?
The hotels use nets to protect the restaurants but his is not enough, they need to string fishing lines all around the trees and over he pool. At the pools, the dirty flying rats, crows, use them to wash the garbage off there feet and bodies, not very nice to see all day long and the water gets pretty dirty.

Title: Beach is dirty
Text: Not worth a visit. The beach is dirty (we found a dead animal on our walk) and the water very murky.

Title: It's a beach....
Text: It's a beach. Depending on why you are there, it can be enjoyable. The water is unswimmable.. We walked along the shoreline and the water was rough. A random wave hit us while taking a photo. The water is warm and the locals sit on the beach.  The fishing boats are docked at night, but in the water prawn fishing during the day. Many small crabs scurrying about. Visible litter as other responders have mentioned.  Beautiful sunrise and sunsets. Water was warm. No sea shells. This is a great place for walking, water watching and people watching.  Definitely watching sunsets and sunrises. Supposedly there are other island beaches elsewhere for swimming.

Title: An okay walk
Text: Its a pretty dirty and unkept beach. You wouldnt really lie on it and spend the day there. Cant swim in the water (although some people were when there were red flags) I would head to a bar looking over it and can watch the sunset there

Title: Soft Clean and beautiful
Text: The beach is long, water is rough, the people are good, hawkers have a lot of nice things, food on beach is edible and life is good
Visited on our last day and glad we didnt spend too much time here. Considering how beautiful the Sri Lankan beaches are, this is one to miss. Beach was dirty and quite heavily littered.

Title: Nice and clean beach
Text:
I like this beach 
Very clean and big 
Many sport activities
Many nice hotels around 
Near to the airport

Title: First beach of Sri Lanka
Text:
I guess if you have an island with a population of 23 million, and a large chunk of that population is living around Colombo/Negombo, the chance of a pristine beach is almost nil. There was a large swell in the ocean which made swimming unsafe while we were there, plus a large amount of rubbish was washing up, so Im not sure how safe the swimming would be. 
But its still an enjoyable walk. Small beach food stalls are there with good street food, and the locals poured down to fly kites and dip themselves in the water. There are way better beaches in Sri Lanka ( Mirissa comes to mind ), but its a good intro into the beach culture in this area.

Title: Closest beach to airport.
Text: I would only stay here if I was wanting to chill out for a night or two before making a quick exit to the airport. Or a couple nights on arrival to unwind before continueing to the better beaches further south. This is a city beach, so 'what to do'!

Title: Plastic nightmare
Text: Beach is littered with plastic mostly dropped by locals. Even picking it up doesnt help as theres nowhere to put it. Not particularly nice beach. Some pleasant restaurants around but no nice beach view or atmosphere.

Title: Big beach. Nice tpwn
Text: This is a big beach close to the town of Negombo with a big selection of really good eating places and a nice little town. Great to visit if youre staying in Negombo for an airport shuttle. Unsure what else there is to do here as we didnt have time to explore. The sea looked quite rough; it was following storms but quite a steeply shelved beach and not sure if safe for bathing. But nice for a wander and perfectly positioned to watch a good sunset.

Title: Nothing to note
Text:
Stopped around the northern end, near the Jetway hotels, the beach is ok I wouldnt say its the prettiest beach and litter is a problem.
I wouldnt go out of my way to come here but as its so close to the airport I guess a lot do, me included.
We spent a few hours on a Sunday late afternoon into the evening, the best part of the beach was the multitude of locals flying kites from small ones to huge dragon like trailing kites of all different shapes and colours.
There are the usual beach Hawkers, but not too insistent.

Title: Not clean, not wide
Text: Negambo beach is not a wide beach as the beach in many  other parts of Sri Lanka. Unfortunately due to the visitors and people living close by its dirty as well. A few areas are maintained well by the hotels close to it.

Title: Surprisingly better than we expected
Text:
Unlike many reviews on here, our experience was of a very clean beachfront.

Potentially this could be down to what side of the beach you are, but we stayed at the Jetwing Beach hotel and the beach just off the hotel was lovely and clean. 

It was also very quiet which we liked as it gave us time to walk along the beach in peace.

There was some sort of beach gathering further down which we went to see with fun fair rides and stalls which was also lovely to see but I am glad our area was a bit further away so not to have too many people there.

The water is very choppy and rough so we couldn't go into the water but luckily this wasn't our aim so it didn't really impact our day.

I would recommend a stroll along this beach but worth noting that the water is rough and not the most blue.

Title: Hey clean up the beach!!
Text: A coast with potential but not until someone takes the bull by the horns and organises some weekly beach cleanups!!!

Title: Normal beach
Text: The water not clear, i did not swim. but it s nice to walk, it s full of local people wish is nice to see !

Title: Good beach if left alone
Text:
Negombo beach gets a lot of unfair comparisons to the other beaches along the west coast of the island. I heard a lot of complaints about pollution and cleanliness. However, I was pleasantly surprised at the condition of the beach - clean, long empty beaches right at the door step of the hotels.

I said empty above but this was in reference to actual beach goers... If you're brave enough to risk a venture onto the beach you will be hounded by local sellers within seconds. In my experience they don't take no for an answer and they come in their droves to prey on anyone foolish enough to dander onto the beach.

The beach could be good but you won't have time to actually enjoy it unfortunately.

Title: Stay By Your Hotel Pool
Text: This could be a beautiful beach but currently, this is not a relaxing way to spend your downtime. Needs a serious cleanup. Stay at your hotel pool and enjoy some tranquillity as down on this beach you will be pestered by salespeople wanting to sell you tacky souvenirs (okay I might have been talked into a batik style bed covering - which I do actually love I must confess). The theft was a bit of a problem here too. A friend had his expensive orthotic thongs stolen off the beach. I loved Negombo but I would stay off the beach.

Title: Don't bother
Text: Just had a quick stroll along a short part of the beach and that was enough. Quite dirty and litter strewn.On the plus side there quite a few restaurants/bars there but steer clear of the beach.

Title: Dirty and Rough
Text:
We visited in August and the sea was very rough as it is at this time of the year. The beach is dirty with the odd hotel scattered between shanty building.

Negombo is good for a stop over after a flight, however only stay for one night. There is not much else worth seeing here and there are much nicer beaches.

Title: Last days in country
Text: Beach is a mess and strewn with litter so in our view not worth visiting. There are a variety of local bars and cafes along the main road, those we tried were ok.

Title: Lovely unspoilt beach
Text: We stayed at the Moon Isle Beach Bungalows on the beach and it was simply stunning. Gorgeous sea and lovely sand that was not too spoilt by the typical litter of the region

Title: Outstanding Beachfront Hotel
Text:
Beautiful hotel, I had a sea view cottage and was made so welcome here the food is amazing and you are so well looked after. The manager is always at breakfast greeting you and always checking if all is good with you in the evening, long hours! Everyone was super  friendly, they have an amazing pool, the beach is perfection and the Hotel is very well maintained, because it is well run. All the grounds are maintained and picture perfect.

Nilaveli Crab dinner at the beach bar was sublime.

They have a shuttle bus that got me safely back to the international airport at a good price, thank you.

You can book diving, I think they are about to in house a dive school which would be even better.

Title: Laid back vibe
Text: Beautiful beach, white sand, stretches as far as the eye can see, fishermen bringing in the daily catch, shallow calm water.  A liytle.corner of paradise!!!  Beware of the argumentative black dogs though!

Title:
Nilaveli
????????
????????
Text:
Scenic sandy beach featuring clear water with coral & marine life & boats to Pigeon Island.
Quite, amazing and very clean beach

Title: Best beach on East Coast of Sri Lanka
Text: Clean beach with many palm trees, good restaurant and close to Pigeon Island where you can admire beautiful reefs. Highly recomend

Title: Nilaveli Beach off-season reviewed
Text:
This is a long beach some 8km long. Roughly in the middle there is a little grid of roads that stretch from the main road to the beach, with a number of restaurants and guesthouses. Most Sri Lankan visitors swim here and there is a 400m or so clean stretch of sand with lifeguards. South (towards Trinco) of this stretch there is a bit of plastic litter on the beach.This worsens after about 1km to the extent that you wouldn't want to walk further let alone swim. You can't directly walk North along the beach as there is a naval training facility. Beyond that there is a short decent stretch of sand in front of a couple of smart hotels (there is also a ticket booth for Pigeon Island here.) Further North the beach is pretty filthy. I would guess things would be better in-season as more hotels would make more of an effort and, I'm guessing, the prevailing winds might be from a better direction.

All along the beach the shore shelves in gently so its shallow a long way out and the waves aren't too big.

Title: Plastic plastic plastic
Text:
Like other places plastic is a problem.
Beach in front of hotel is public and almost clean.
Wild dogs and cows may be on the beach.

Title: Great Beach
Text:
This was a lovely beach and you could swim at any time of the day. The beach itself was really clean with no rubbish and the water was clean and resfreshing.
The town had everything you would need and was an interesting place however this is the only place in Sri Lanka where we saw rubbish on the side of the roads and in the housing areas
Karen M

Title: Filthy
Text:
Oh my gosh, plastic everywhere along this beach ??, cows poo ?? everywhere and buses driving fast down the small roads leading to the beach. 
Reconsider to look for a cleaner place

Title: There are many access points  choose wisely!
Text:
The beach is long and there are many places to get onto it. There is one access point north of the Navy station. Its lovely, very European but has no shade (unless youre staying at the Anilana or Nilaveli beach hotel). The public beach just south of the Navy place is where the boats go to Pigeon island from. It has lifeguards so its good for those unable to swim. Muslims would feel comfortable here as many bathe in clothing. there is a café called mamma Mia that has lounger platforms for free. 
Further south from this beach the water doesnt smell so strongly of diesel fumes from the outboard motors. You can walk for 4 kilometres walk down to bliss bay hotel at the far end. There are a few cafés along the beach.

Title: Nice and clean sandy beach
Text:
We stayed 4 nights to rest in a resort right on the beach. The beach is very wide, clean and sea was easily swimmable.
Super place to rest!

Title: Family sunbath
Text: Wide beach .long.excellent for children,if you want you dont have use watershoes,its safety and clean,a lot of bogata parking her? do you can go for a trip

Title: Nice but full of dogs
Text: On the beach there were free huts with shadows to rest and the beach was clean. But there were a lot of dogs begging for food as soon as you opened a bag of snacks. There were also a lot of boats driving people to the Pigeon island.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Gorgeous beach.  Clean and warm water.  A very large drag between sandbanks so take care but once past the waves it is a. Delight to float.  Very shallow water you can go out a long way.

Title: Very clean beach
Text: The beach is only 20 minutes away from Trincomalee and it is way cleaner and better for diving. Less restaurants and hotels but very calm and not at all busy.

Title: Amazing calm beach
Text: Beautiful beach. We spend 1 week at the end of our holiday and it was amazing. clean beach and calm sea. Was perfect for us with our 2 small kids. The beach is not steep and no big waves. So perfect choise for familys

Title: Just lovely
Text: Weve spent a month in Sri Lanka and this is by far the best beach we visited. Clean, quiet and great for swimming. There are many places to stay but we highly recommend Bella Nilaveli.

Title: Quiet beach
Text: Beautiful beach, with calm waters, perfect for families, long walkings and relax. From there you take the boats to Pigeon Island.

Title: Beautiful beach, shame about the ribbjsh
Text: As mentioned in other comments, this beach is beautiful with crystal waters but apart from the flagged section, it is covered in plastic. We went to watch the sunrise and spent most of our time collecting rubbish but theres a heck of a lot to clean up.

Title: Covered with garbage
Text: The beach would be a lovely place but except a few cleaned hotel/restaurant beach stretches, unfortunately it is covered with garbage.

Title: Two Thumps up!
Text: The beach is one of the uncrowded beaches weve ever visited. We are very lucky to spend our fifth anniversary with my wife at the Nilaveli Beach. From the crystal water, the white sand and breathtaking view... Everything is just perfect!

Title: Good uncrowded beach
Text: Beige sand, ultra clear water (depending on wind/currents), not much trash during high season, place to catch a boat to Pigeon Island for amazing snorkeling (it cost 5,000 in March 2019: 4,000 govt entry fee / 1,000 boatman.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Beach is huge and clean and slopes gently so it is safe for swimming when the waves are not too high. This is apparently March to October, though we swam three days out of four in the warm water in February. Military establishment mid way splits the beach into two halves since you cannot cross.

Title: Nice beach
Text: Quit beach, some parts are beautiful but unfortunately also pieces where a lot of junk including a lot of plastic is washed up. We stayed at Memos Beach Cabana who is cleaning the beach everyday

Title: Stay By Hotels
Text: The beach is lovely and clean by the hotels but there is quite a bit of rubbish once you walk away from the hotels beach front. We went in January which apparently is the off season for here so very few people on beach. Dont know why its classed as off season as it was 32 degrees for the 3 days we were there and no rain at all.

Title: Amazing beach
Text: The beach was amazing even though it was abit rough. Still can walk in and the water is not as deep.

Title: Beautiful and mostly untouched
Text: This seemed to me like the favorite beach for local families. You may not be completely comfortable in a skimpy swimsuit around the many families and children with women going in the water totally covered. Beautiful and natural beach without the resorts and restaurants. Very peaceful!

Title: Lovely quiet beach
Text: The beach of Nilaveli is unspoiled and wide. There arent many hotels and no vendors selling useless stuff on the beach. This is the perfect place where you want to relax a day or two. Be carefull the sand gets hot hot hot.

Title: Lovely beach
Text: Lovely pretty beach with nice soft sand. Locals and tourists alike use the beach. Quite a few stray dogs but nice ones and cut puppies! Sea is nice for swimming in though there are a few jelly fish to be aware of! There are a few bars on the beach but not many at all. I would definitely recommend getting a hotel that is on the beach or bringing your our parosol if you're not on the beach as there is little/no shade!

Title: Magnificent and crystal clear to miles.
Text: One of the most beautiful beaches I ever visited. Golden sand and blue waters combination make you jump in to a dip as soon as you see the beach. plenty of eateries and souvenir shops around. Always crowded as this is famous with foreigners and locals alike. must visit place in the eastern Sri Lanka as it is only half an hour drive from Trincomalee.

Title: Beautiful beaxh
Text: Uncrowded beach - beautiful weather. Quite a choppy sea but fun to swim in. Highly recommended. We stayed at nearby Nilaveli beach hotel

Title: Great for a swim
Text: We visited the beach before breakfast each morning and had it to ourselves, we also visited around 5pm each afternoon when it was still quite busy but most visitors were in the shallow water close to shore so it was pretty easy to enjoy a bit of swimming further out and body-surf the occasional wave. There seemed to be a bit of voluntary segregation between the foreign visitors in skimpy bathers and the Sri Lankan day-trippers who were mostly fully clothed even while swimming, but there was no unpleasantness around this and some Sri Lankans in lycra bathers (and some who were fully-clothed) were swimming in the same area as the foreign visitors at the northern end of the beach. There was a surf life-saver patrolled area further south beyond the Pigeon Island boat launching area, that section of the beach and further south was very busy.

Title: Pretty
Text:
Nice beach with two good restaurants. Super slow service but amazing food!

Super nice water!

Only Wierd thing is that the locals swim on one side and tourist on another. Which is a good thing considering they are so loud and obnoxious

When we went in August it was not packed at all, very calm and beautiful

Title: Fantastic Beach closes 6pm
Text:
Good beach, reasonably clean, ok for children till 6pm, beach football also good idea.

*Accommodation near Nilaveli Beach Trincomalee*

Title: Gorgeous gorgeous  gorgeous
Text:
White sandy clean beach on shores of Indian Ocean
Lifeguards and safe swimming area
If youre female think about covering up as not a commercial beach - thongs and topless would not be OK
There's a cafe on beach. 
No showers. 
Not commercial yet.

Title: Great beach
Text: The best beach in Sri Lanka. It has a lot of waves but the beach is awesome. Highly recommend. There is not much else to do in the area.

Title: Beach at its best
Text: The ocean on this part of the East coast of SL is amazing to say the least the beach is gentle and the sand white.

Title: too many tourist
Text: we enjoyed the beach and its extension although the type of send impeed to have a crystal clear water. Most of the beach is full of boat offering boat rides and you stay to close you spend all the time breathing their engien gas. Some nice bars offer good service at the sun set.

Title: Stunning
Text: A stunningly beautiful beach. Absolutely nothing on it. Pleased to see litter bins. There are a few hotels dotted along the beach, one would assume you could buy a drink or meal here. Its possible to get boats to Pigeon Island from the beach.

Title: Lovely tree lined beach
Text: We stayed at Oceanfront condos and enjoyed the beautiful Nilaveli beach. The water was lovely although there were a few jelly fish, but they did not seem to sting and it didn't stop us enjoying the beach.

Title: A very Nice beach
Text:
We visited this lovely Beach in july 2018.
There are Hardy any people there and it is wonderfull. It is easy to get a boat to Pigion Island if you like that og to go on a dolphine/whale watch in the early morning.
The waves Can be Big, but it is still a Nice place for kids too. 
The water is clear and clean.

Title: beach
Text: Nice wide beach. Usually bigger waves very good for fun and jumping. With view at the Pigeon Island. Possible boat taxi to the Pigeon Island.

Title: Decent beach. Not very busy.
Text: Took a walk along this beach after diving Nilaveli. Beach was pretty empty. I was looking for somewhere to eat. Not many options.

Title: Greatbeach
Text: Clean beach, great to swim, relax and enjoy the sun. I would recommend for anyone passing by the east of Sri Lanka.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Beautiful clean beach.This beach is really perfect  Not too many people's hear. Evening is the best  time to get a sunbath hear.

Title: Long beach
Text: Have only some old resort near bech. Only resort restaurant to buy soft drinks. If you like to be alone mayby beach is good for your.

Title: Nice beach, shame about the rubbish
Text: The beach here is quite good, but unfortunately there is a lot of plastic rubbish that washes up. Swimming is still good, and the sunrise over the ocean was good too. Try to pick up some rubbish while you walk the beach, every little bit helps. Most of the dogs on the beach are friendly, you may see the occasional herd of cattle too

Title: Unbelievable!
Text:
Absolutely brilliant beach. So quiet and tranquil. The beach is perfect to swim. Gentle waters with just the right waves. Not crowded. Some parts you can have it all to yourself. There are even fishes jumping ard the waves. That could delight or disturb you : )

In all my travels, i miss Nilaveli. I usualy never miss any beach location. Somehow i miss Nilaveli as i left. We prob made a connection. There is smth abt this place. Very romantic and blissfull. 

No touts, blaring beach pubs or restos etc. Just you, the beach and the waves!

Title: Amazing beach
Text: Untouched. White sandy beaches.  Smooth. No rubbish. Just you and nature. Also cows. Fisherman and a few stray dogs grace the beach. Not ruined at all. No one bothers you and no shops to ruin what nature intended. Sea is amazing. Clear blue. Warm and wonderful

Title: A Place Where You Need To Look Past What Lies On Top To See The Beauty
Text: For what lies on top of the beach, this gorgeous white sand beach, an uncrowded beach where the swimming is safe and the water is clear.  What washes up is masses and masses of plastic pollution.  . Bless the staff at the various properties dotted along the beach that now seem responsible for cleaning this up and disposing of it.

Title: Brilliant!
