Text: Me and my grandma walk this beach everyday and its a very relaxing place. There is life guard and two flags to swim in between for safety reasons which is brilliant. The lifeguards pick up the rubbish everyday at a walkable distance then get ready to support the locals and tourists that want to enjoy a swim. The sea is a warm temperature and everybody is full of joy here. Definitely would recommend

Title: Beautiful, quiet beach
Text: Really nice beach with clear, blue water that's great for swimming.  Very quiet though the season was just starting when I visited.  Just a few dive shops and accommodation options on the beach, with some restaurants on the side streets.   The marine runs many boats out to Pigeon Island or they can be arranged through hotels or dive shops.

Title: Off the beaten track beach in Sri Lanka
Text:
If you made it to Sri Lanka it's worth considering coming here for 4-5 days beach time rather than the more advanced south... it's quite developed but do not expect much. Nethertheless you can find all a happy tourist needs: local excellent quality seafood, reasonably priced hotels (never pay > $50 per double room here, anything above is a tourist trap) and amazing sunrises on the beach + scuba diving, snorkeling, fishing or dolphins watching trips...
The only dissapointing thing was trash on the beach and lots of stray dogs. Would have been an amazing place without these 2!

Title: Hurry
Text: The last of the virgin white sand beaches. Pristine and made for indulging yourself with doing nothing. Tourists are yet to land here in hordes. Enjoy it now, another two years it will be like another commercial beach.

Title: Beautiful Nice beach
Text: It is a nice beach to relax & sun bathe. But now it is getting dirty because of the misbehaviour of humans. Specually local people. They need not to protect this for future generation. I can not say about after few years what will happen if it is going on same way.

Title: Very dirty
Text: This beach looks like a giant trashbin off season... It is cleaned only in front of the biggest hotels. This might be different in high season though, no idea.

Title: Nice beach with clean water
Text: We visited Nilaveli beach off season so there were only few people and we could enjoy the beach. Water was clean, but the beach was full of litter - bottles, cans etc. - this was typical for all beaches which we visited. It is nothing exeptional at Sri Lanka.

Title: Beautiful water but beach itself has littering
Text: We went there during off season and were surprised to see so many people enjoying the lovely water. There were few life guards who were quite strict about how far people were allowed to swim. Was really good to see how they made sure everyone was safe. As for the beach itself, like most other beaches in SriLanka there is too much littering. Bottles, cans, plastic etc thrown everywhere. Takes away from the beauty of this fantastic beach.

Title: Clean beach
Text: This is a worth wile going to beach. The beach was clean and nice. There were enough parking places and some local shops. Only issue is changing rooms and toilet facility both of which don't exist.

Title: Beautiful beach, but not clean everywhere
Text:
Nilaveli is a very beautiful beach to walk along. We took a long walk when we stayed at Nilaveli Beach Resort toward the Nilaveli Beach Hotel. In between these two hotels, there were 3-4 little guest houses too. The beachfront belonging to these two hotels and the guesthouses was very clean. These beach areas were marked by a red flag. In between however, there was a lot of garbage on the beach. It looked like some people dumped their big black-plastic-bags-full of garbage on the beach. It was unfortunate that they could not find an alternative to this.

In front of our hotel, the beach was super clean. 

We even saw some beach patrol by armed military closer to the Nilaveli Beach Hotel.

Another interesting factor was seeing a lot of cows on the beach. In the evening they went back to their abode (wherever that might be) in small groups.

Title: Peacefull surrounding and best waves for bodyboarder
Text: If you want to visit a peaceful and friendly locaton with great beach, visit That's why Café and Beach Bar in Nilaveli Beach! We will be back!

Title: Not the best beach for a swim!
Text: We were staying at the Pigeon Island Resort and there are very limited opportunities to swim on the beach due to rocks and waves.

Title: Beautiful beach of golden sands.
Text: This beach is really perfect, with clean golden sand, backed by palmtrees and screwpines.  My hotel was only 2mins away, so I was very pleased to see there was a lifeguard area just 100m down the beach.  As it was the monsoon season, there were very few visitors, except at weekends when crowds of Sri Lankans arrived in buses to spend the day, bathing and partying, which was a lot of fun as everyone was so friendly.  There's a little lane of shops and cafes behind the beach where everyone gathered to buy toys, sweets and street food,  though it was closed during the week due to lack of visitors.  Most people stay in the lifeguard area, but I enjoy beach walks, so several times I walked a few kilometres southwards, and had it all to myself.  During the monsoon season the sea can be very rough, so it's almost impossible to swim as the current is so dangerous.  Most of the local visitors just stood in the water, in all their clothes!  I expect the beach would be totally different in the tourist season, probably with sunbeds etc., but I liked it as it was, wild and wonderful!

Title: Beautiful beach
Text:
Nilaveli beach is a beautiful, clean and vast beach overlooking Pigeon Island.
Excellent safe swimming here, with wide sandy beach, ideal for families with children.
Lots of trips to Pigeon Island.

Title: Beautiful white sandy beach
Text: Shallow water, warm and safe to a considerable distance. Quiet and peaceful beach. We enjoyed the day on the beach.

Title: Beautiful, clean beach
Text: We stayed at Nilaveli Beach for the whole afternoon, playing in the water and the calm waves. Beautiful place just to relax and enjoy a swim. The beach is clean and very long, so there were no crowds of people.

Title: Lovely quiet clean beach
Text: Enjoyed our 5 nights at this lovely beach. Very peaceful.  Good small surf for swimming. Not dangerous. Sand had a little rubbish washed up above high tide mark, but really not much. A highlight is watching the village fishermen haul their net onto the beach. Beautiful fine golden sand. Can recommend Nagenahira Beach Villas for accommodation.

Title: Fantastic Beach
Text: North of Trincomalee the beach at Nilaveli has to be one of the best in the whole of Sri Lanka with ocean normally calmer and warmer than the west coast of the island. Many activities for water and nature lovers. There are several upmarket hotels

Title: Best place for family
Text:
Golden sand
Very clean beach 
Not much crowded during weekdays 
No big waves 
Safe for Children
Life guard available till 6

Title: Beautiful long stretch of sand
Text:
We had read some reviews that implied this beach was dirty. We were glad to find this was untrue!
While we were here the beach had lots of people in the water near the life guard point but the rest of the beach was almost empty.  We spent hours splashing around in the waves.
You can see lots of cows on the beach if you make it down early enough! This is a relaxed beach which is not filled with tourists or touts.  It was great for us!

Title: Beautiful deserted beach
Text: Stunning beach with soft white Sam and clear blue sea. Beach has nobody on apart from a few tourists and local fishermen

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: This is also a very long stretch of beach.It being February this is not the season to be here , so maybe thats the reason I did not see any schools for diving open at the beach , same for the small restaurants. However the beach does have many resorts opening to it. A nice relaxing time you can have the beach.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: You can walk for hours (apart from the military park which stops you getting down to Tissa) which is a bit of a shame.

Title: Great, deserted beach
Text: This is a gorgeous, long, normally empty beach perfect for those wanting to get away from it all. The sea is clean, very warm and there are usually waves, which are fun for kids. You might come across the occasional cow, a friendly dog or two and perhaps some lines of fishermen hauling in their nets. Nothing else. Wonderful place.

Title: Picturesque beach
Text: A nice, laid back beach - seemed to be safe to swim with some surf suitable of for body surfing. On an international scale it is a nice beach and very quiet (i.e. no crowds), but it is not as good as most Australian beaches (I'm Australian).

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: I love this beach, it's beautiful, clean and not a lot of tourists, so it's quite! The sand is nice and the waves are cool! If you want to relax, this is the right beach for you!!

Title: Beautiful and quiet beach
Text:
Golden sand, wonderful blue Indian Ocean, calm shallow water with small waves, palm trees, boats.
Hardly anyone around, very quiet, one of the last crowd free beaches in Sri Lanka ü though I guess not for long as new and large hotels now being built.
Apart from enjoying the sunshine, the sea and the view  there is not much else to do, but this was exactly what I was looking for. There are funny dog families on the beach who like to spend their time with human company but they are not hungry beggars at all. They have a unique society and it is fun to observe.
Once in a while cows passing by, trying to chew everything they find, including shoes, but easy to scare them away :) 
I am sure for those who like the active kind of holiday these beaches are not the best but for those who seek for tranquillity and the tropic beaches at the same time this is a very good choice.

Title: Crowd Free Beach
Text:
While this beach is anything but pristine, what with roving cattle and. . .  frankly more garbage than usual, there are few people.   

Also, there are traditional net fisherman around who are happy enough enlisting you for some shore-pulling.

The sea drops off more than I would have expected so walking in the surf isn't really possible.

Title: Seeing is believing
Text: Went on a day trip to this fabulous beach. Miles and miles of white silky sand .  Sea itself is relatively calm and is sandy if you fancy a dip.

Title: One of the best in SL during hte season
Text: Stunning color of the water with sandy beach makes it on of the best in SL. Ability to snorkel in pigeon island is a plus.

Title: Beautiful Beach!
Text: Absolutely beautiful beach - you can walk for ages it seems on the silken sand.  When we were there, the water was nice and calm and you could walk, undisturbed ( face it, locals selling wares are sometimes a problem on Sri Lankan beaches).   I hear during the "season" the water is blue and stunning - when we went the season  was off and the weather was a tad gray and drab, but STILL the beach was beautiful

Title: One of the most beautiful beach in the country
Text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the country, and a very calm beach during the season with very limited waves. Ideal for beach lovers and also for snorkeling because of the very rich sea life.

Title: Great beach
Text: Beautiful beach, even off-season. Maybe some rubbish in some places but you can walk some distance and its fine

Title: Tranquil and Clean
Text: Serene and clean beaches, A lot of scuba fiving happening her during the the month of may to october.

Title: A nice beach but little haunted
Text: The beach is neat and clean and the water isn't too muddy as well. But there isn't much of the crowd in the beach. Good in one sense but becomes scary at times.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: A nice crowded local beach. The waves were high but the locals said usually here pretty calm and clean water. Don't plan your trip on the weekends because of the local crowed. Worth a try.

Title: What a stunning piece of coastline!
Text:
The water is so clean and blue, the sand is so soft and everything around is so quiet and peaceful.
What a gorgeous beach and somewhere the locals should be proud of...

Title: Good swimming beach
Text: Clean and not many people (or at least in September). 2 minutes to the famous pigeon island. Recommended.

Title: nice beach
Text: very nice marble beach, we loved swimming there and enjoying sun bathing, very quiet you can sleep or read a book in peace. lots of monkeys

Title: Lovely beach and very friendly atmosphere
Text: Safe to swim in (we travelled in August and almost everywhere else we stayed on Sri Lanka was unsafe for swimming).

Title: Clean powdery beach
Text: I was staying nearby at the Nilaveli beach hotel so the beach was directly in front of the hotel. It was a clean stretch of powdery white sand that wasn't too long but you could walk for quite a distance to get away from the local crowds. There are two large beach resorts there and a few dive centers. The waters look to be pretty clean and there were always some people playing in the waters so the current can't be too strong in the area.

Title: Sexual harrassment as female travellers
Text: Me and my friend visited this beach today after reading all the lovely reviews but have never felt more uncomfortable in an area. We were constantly harassed by men which made up the majority of the people on the beach and there was no way I would have got into my bikini or swimming costume. All the ladies were in full clothes in the sea. We got straight back into a tuktuk back to Uppeveli beach. If you want to relax in peace as a couple of female friends would not recommend this place

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Absolutely gorgeous beach with clear shallow water. Coral sand and pretty view of Pigeon island. Not much in the way of places to eat or drink - that's why it is unspoiled. Don't wander too far up the beach though as you'll be turned back by the Sri Lankan Navy guard - active base at top tip of beach.

Title: Really nice beach
Text: Very beautiful beach in eastern Sri Lanka. One of the beaches that tourists should visit along with Marble Beach and Passikudha

Title: White sandy beach
Text: Peaceful beach with white sand and crystal clear and warm waters. Clean beach regularly patrolled by the coast guards. Ideal for surfing and swimming.

Title: Crystel Beach
Text: the sea is so Crystal and so transparent clear water, mostly packed with locals. wave less beach, good for swimming, better to carry on your own food and mats.

Title: One of my favorite  beach of all time
Text: The water is warm and no big waves. While you are swimming you can also see some fish are swimming near by. Such a beautiful and quiet beach. I love it ??

Title: Big beach with high waves
Text: Visited in Feb and enjoyed the cooler and breezy beach. Great for beach walks but could be cool at this time of year for some. As a base to visit Trinco it is  ideal but you need a car and driver.

Title: feel the sand
Text: it is a large sand beach, ideal to walk barefoot for hours. its clean, calm, relaxing, everything u need for a perfect beach day!!

Title: Its even better than South Beach Miami as its serene and peaceful
Text: Nilaveli Beach is very clean, clear and safe to swim. We took a short boat trip to see the corals in Pigeon Island.

Title: Blue ocean and sandy beaches.
Text: A must see in Trinco. Couple of kilometres away from trincomalee town, towards the kuchchiweli road, you would find this blue heaven. Good spot if you love to have a bath in the sea, make sure there is no red flag.

Title: Nice quiet beach
Text: We spent three nights at a hotel that had access to this beach. The beach was the best part of the stay. It is nice and quite, there weren't a lot of people. Perfect place to relax and enjoy life.

Title: Great beach, no pollution and save to swim.
Text:
Nilaveli Beach is a really nice long white sand beach. There are a lot of hotels in Nilaveli and they keep the beach nice and clean. This beach is ideal for swimming, even with little kids (still keep them in your sight). 

Just take a long walk and see local fisherman trying to catch fish. Or sit down, relax and enjoy a cocktail. There are some nice spots where you can sit, drink and eat (owned by the hotels).

Looking at the sea you will notice a small island, this is the famous Pigeon Island (National Park). You can go by boat to this island and do some great snorkelling.

Nilaveli beach is for sure one of the best beaches to swim in Sri Lanka!

Title: Nice Beach
Text: The beach is excellent. Green water now very high waves (in Aug). They are clean as well. Can see fisherman activity in the morning.

Title: Wide beach
Text: The Nilavelli beach is about 5km long beach, It is wide like in Thailand... great place for chill out near the ocean.

Title: Relax
Text: A quiet place in september. The most of the Hotels and Homestays are nearly empty because of low season and all these nice white sand beaches are yours. You only need to share the view with some cows wich is pretty fun.

Title: Beautiful beach but not much around it
Text: Beautiful beach. Not much shade or hotels on the beach. Water very clear and clean lovely for swimming. This is a beach you might not see one other person on the beach the same time as you which we loved.

Title: Clean water and beach
Text:
Coming form a landlocked country, visiting a beach whenever we travel is a big deal for us. But most of the time, we are dispppointed when we see unclean beaches with stuff discarded by beach goers. Nilaveli was different. The beach was suprisingly clean. I could see why the beach was called Nilaveli - i loved the blue sand and the clean water. Though I didn't venture out of swim, I stood in the water for almost an hour enjoying the feel of clean water against the sand. 

The beach is relatively less crowded on a weekday and filled with locals. I can spend an entire day here, enjoying the sand and the water.

Title: Perfect holiday beach
Text:
We enjoyed a perfect 8 days relaxing on the beach here. Low currents this time of year so easy swimming. Nileveli up the coast is the most beautiful and quieter.

Watch out for the jellyfish there were loads when we 1st arrived and saw a few people who had been stung. They aren't dangerous but looks uncomfortable.

Title: Beautiful
Text: Beautiful, no hawkers just sea and sand. Only hotel bars though this may change in the coming years.

Title: wBeUtiful beach spoilt by tourists
Text: Go here for sunbaking, Western food and crowds. Book ahead as whole place really does get booked out, at least in August. Hard to get food early in morning.  Take your own alcohol if you dont always want to drink in bar.

Title: Quiet, clean, perfect!
Text: Squeekly clean sand, palm-fringed beach. Small shore break for body surfing. Get up early for a walk along the beach and you'll find hard-working locals pulling in their large fishing net. Give them a hand. They'll greatly appreciate the help.

Title: Like a Swimming Pool
Text: Wonderful Day Nilaveli Beach Beautiful Beach in Srilanka  Snorkling, Sharks, Turtle Lovely Day i had in Nilaveli I found Fairly Decent Accommodation as Well

Title: Trashy beach
Text: Biggest disappointment on Sri Lanka. Lots of trash and cow pats everywhere. Only next to the hotels is a little bit better. Very high prices for everything. Uppuveli is better but also nothing special.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Miles if deserted beach. Beautiful location. Only drawback is that it is very isolated from any amenities apart from the hotels

Title: nice and quit beach
Text: Nice and quit beach, perfect place to swim, play volleyball, or juts chill and read a book, have fun

Title: Beautiful but rough
Text: This is a beautiful beach but there are big(ish) waves so not ideal for little children. We stayed on a clean patch of beach which our hotel cleaned themselves but other areas are littered with rubbish which is sad to see. Nevertheless, we stayed for 6 days and thoroughly relaxed. It is never over crowded and felt like a private beach.

Title: Nice beach but..
Text: A very nice beach with clean waters. The only problem is that the wandering cows fill the place with excrements and makes it difficult to take a walk

Title: Too much rubbish
Text:
We were quite disappointed with our visit to Nilaveli beach. There is rubbish scattered all over the sand and in the water. It's disgusting! Also, there is barely any shade on the beach so you are stuck underneath the blazing hot sun the entire time. If you want a nicer beach, try Marble beach. 
The lack of restaurants/Cafes on the beach was also very disappointing.

Title: Very nice but damn expensive
Text:
The beach is a long strap sand with some trees. The water is nice without being exceptional. It is not as clear as some Thai beaches.

There are very beautiful hotels on and around the beach. I was there during the high season (August) and I have been surprised by the price. Impossible to find any room for less than 80 US$! 

There are beautiful hotels, like the Nilaveli beach Hotel, where is wonderful to spend the day. Bit at this season it was full booked and I guess a room would cost more than 200 US$. So if you watch your budget, don't go there during high season!

Title: Pristine calm waters and a long clean sandy beach
Text: Not much more to say, easy to see why this place is getting a reputation when it is in season. Very relaxing to spend a few days here.

Title: Nature and quiet place. On Aug.
Text:
We was here on Aug. It's nature and really quiet beach. Only little ppl are there, and more local ppl came. Only one restaurant(local restaurant, not expensive) is there. 

3-4 boat shop for going to the Pigeon island, and the couple of Diving shops there. 

We were there by Tuktuk and costed 600rs from 14km far from beach.

Title: Lovely beach
Text: Beautiful beach with calm water. Very peaceful place to just sit and relax. Lots of water sports available.

Title: Amazing!
Text: Me and my girl friend were the only people on this beautifull beach. So absolutly go if you are near by! I bet after 10 years it will be full of hotels and people so go before it is too late!

Title: Nice beach
Text:
Nice beach but a shame their is not a more local offering, just one bar and restaurant.  

Nice to see lots of families enjoying it.

Would loved to have seen local people making the most of it...but things are changing and fingers crossed this will happen.

Title: Best beach in Sri Lanka
Text: Beautiful and quiet would highly recommend, with the 'right' type of responsible tourism hope it stays this way. :)

Title: True Paradise
Text: One of the best beaches in the country. Can get busy on the weekends with family but for a traveler, it's a great way to experience this part of the country.

Title: Incredible beach
Text: Long sandy beach with incredible emerald blue sea.  The sea was almost bath temperature and extremely calm when we were there, although a slight undertow

Title: A few days on the Nilaveli Beach
Text: The Nilaveli Beach is quite nice with warm and clean water and white sand. In front of the hotels/resorts it is quite clean but it gets dirty anywhere else. Most places have beach facilities like chairs, shades, bar/restaurant, but we could not find a nice place to hang around. Very quiet area, not really a party place.

Title: amazing place to see
Text: amazing view. if you see some fisherman pulling a long net called "maa dela", make sure to go join to pull... wonderful experience

Title: Marvellous nature :)
Text:
remote & relaxing area in Sri Lanka, quiet surroundings, only nature around, few tourists in the whole Nilaveli, almost not seen.

Road from Colombo airport may be not very convenient, 6-8 hours by car, so take the driver or just stay somewhere in the middle for a night.

Trincomalee region is noth east coast, and that is far place to visit the whole country staying only there. I advise that to stay for relax after hiking or after visiting the south. However one day trips to Sigiriya, Dambulla or Wilpattu national park are possible if you hire the car or the driver with the car. That costs, but it is worth it, if you have a limited amount of days in Sri Lanka. 

if you are looking for the tourist facilities, a lot of shops and bars that is not the place for you. That is for the nature lovers and those you prefer to meet the real local culture and try origin local food.

Title: Goes On and On forever
Text: lovely beach - we caught it at the tail-end of a monsoon so there was quite a bit of stuff washed ashore - for some reason loads of shoes and sandals - odd.

Title: Touristic
Text: Average beach where all the tourists come because here are the only bars and restaurants in Trinco. Mostly clean but not so wide.

Title: Deep is so far away
Text: It's a beautiful place that you want to visit if you love the beach and sunshine. Normally, season starts in July and I went their when the season just started so I did not run into many tourists. During mid season time, I was told it could be crowded. If you go to the beach around 5.30, 6.00 a.m in the morning, you could see the sun rise.

Title: Perfect
Text: Loved loved loved the beach. It was super quiet, the water was amazing no currents .. and extremely clean. Perfect beach for a laid back day!

Title: nilaveli Guesthouse!
Text: i stay here in a really friendly and cosy guesthouse ist called NILAVELI GUEST home! the owner are so wonderfull and friendly! i can recommend this please.. when you Need a break from travel and a silence day go there.. the beach is awesome!!

Title: Beautifull and clean beach
Text: Beach was so beautiful, but december is not good for beach. Sea really rough. Water was not clean in December.

Title: Beautiful beach much nicer then upaweli beach
Text: I went there today by bicycle from Upawli where I am staying. The beach is lovely and I was the only person there for most of the afternoon. The whole place is shut down and it all looks like a ghost town.  I wanted to stay there but booking com stated that the cheapest room is 1500 rupees.  If you asked you will get a room for 1500 rupees but I decided to stay in upawli as I would be lonley there. The beach is great though and I enjoyed the body surfing there.

Title: Lovely beech, great views
Text:
We went out of season and so the water was choppy but I still went in and absolutely loved it. There were lifeguards on duty and they showed us where to swim. Funnily enough there is also a life saving division in the police, so there were a fair few uniformed people looking out for tourists and locals on the beech.
As its a large beach, there is plenty of space for everyone. Had a great time here.
Will definitely go again in season April time.

Title: Solitude and bliss
Text:
Clean and long beach. Comfortable entrance, very few people if you move away from the village. Beautiful views, there are several places where you can eat, but the infrastructure is poorly developed.
Great place if you want to stay alone with him. I recommend.

?????????? ???? - ????? ?????? ? ??????????, ?? ???? ????.

Title: Great Experience
Text: Great Experience at Nilaveli Beaches and super clean. Particularly we enjoyed the trip to Pigeon Island where there is very beautiful beaches too. We spend times to watch Coral and exotics fishes in shallow water.

Title: Just some random beach
Text: I was visiting Nilaveli and had high expectations. But seeing this beach was nothing special. Rubbish everywhere. Plastic is covering the beach. No nice atmosphere like other beaches for example Marakolliya beach in the south can offer!

Title: undiscovered
Text: Still a very quiet beach, not a lot of people. Perfect place to just kick back and really relax. Beautiful weather in May!

Title: Beautiful water, shame about the litter
Text: This is a beautiful beach to visit. The sea is warm & the sand is golden. Almost perfect. Except for the scores of litter - mainly plastic bottles - that litter the shoreline. If it was cleaned up & looked after it would be a definite 5*.

Title: A clean beach!
Text:
Wide, clean & quiet beach No beach sellers, no dogs, no fishermen, no cafe or restaurant .....only a small herd of cows roam the beach  which suited me fine with on interruptions. Sunrise is stunning if you can get up early enough but well worth it.
View over to Pigeon Island where you can snorkel or dive, boat trip of approx 10 mins you need a ticket for the island and of course pay the boatman. Again no shops or cafe on the island - wonderful, take your own water etc.,  Nilaveli Beach is heaven.

Title: Ultra blue waters
Text: The beach is nice an quiet, all you can hear is the ocean..... which is perfect for a swim unless it is rough, the waters are clear enough to go in neck deep and clearly see your feet and the tiny tropical fish around them :)

Title: Beautful, serene... and cows!
Text: The waves were great to ride, the atmosphere is perfect for lone travellers, couples or family. And we saw cows on the beach - hilarious!

Title: greit food
Text: good vegetable food, realy. good place, taste icecreame. It takes a long time for the execution of the order, but it is not critical

Title: Lovely beach
Text: It was a lovely place to relax it had long sandy beaches and not a busy beach so you had the beach to yourself. Found it difficult to change currency. Were entertained with the wild monkeys running a long the swimming pools.

Title: On the beach under the palms...!
Text:
You can chose the public beach frequented by the locals and stay under a palm, or other parts of Nilaveli beach in the shadow of the bar/hotel. 
Both good

Title: Beautiful beaxh
Text:
We stayed at Nagenahira beach villas and our part of the beach was beautiful - very little rubbish and few fishermen. Up the beach (500m to the north) there were always lots of people, much more rubbish, fishermen pulling in their nets, and discarded/rotting fish.
Dogs and cows roam the beach but do not bother us as we lounge in the hotel deck chairs. One dog even took to shooing the cows away. 
The light in the evenings is beautiful.

Title: Awful
Text: I have no idea who may think that this place is a "paradise". It's not worth a single hour of your time. Snorekling/ diving is highly overpriced. The beach is full of hungry stray dogs, crows, cows and their poo and nagging locals. Waters full of stinging sea lice. Stay away unless VERY cool.

Title: Very nice beach!
Text: It is a very nice beach with loads of palm trees and clear water. There are only few restaurants along the long beach, so have plety of water and check and plan where you want to eat. In other case you will find yourself walking long miles before getting to the restaurant. You can find some shade under the palm trees.

Title: Amazing beach
Text: Clean, scenic and safe beach. Starting point for boating to see dolfins, whales and snorckelling : just ask on the beach ;-)

Title: Nice long Beach
Text: It's nice long beach with almost no people.  Very calm not raf sea at high season. Very clean beach and 2-3 beach restaurants

Title: white sand and and strolling cows
Text: middlle and southern part are even more quiet. white sand, warm water - starting from april like a great pool with mostly calm waves. Not touristic.

Title: Best beach in the area
Text: Loved this beach. It's a long white sandy beach and pristine clear water. It's a lot quieter than Uppuveli - with only a lit bit of development along it. Only annoying thing was that the boats to pigeon island go back and forward all the time from here so there's a bit of boat noise. Beach and water was very clean. There's wasn't a huge amount of shade either.  Very easy to get to via tuk tuk from Trinco or Uppuveli. There was a small market near the beach with places to gets drinks etc

Title: Absolutely idyllic
Text:
This beach is 'in season' from May - October. At this time it is just beautiful.

Not too many hotels means that the beach is not packed with people and touts.

The sea is calm and the water warm. 

What more could one want.

Title: Fantastic beach
Text: This is one of the best beaches. When I went in the morning the entire beach was for myself and even then a Coast guard came with me to take care and srilankan people are so friendly and caring. Surely Trincomalee is the queen of beaches in Sri Lanka

Title: Calm Beach
Text: The nilaveli Beach is beautiful. The sea is a Bit wavy and gets eaven more on the afternoon. There were just a few tourists. There are a few hotel,guesthouses on the Beach Front. We stayed at Bella nilaveli. Also good is the 'thats why' bar and cottages.

Title: Quiet, peaceful, clean
Text:
Amazing beach, long stretch of white sand, extremely clean. 
No rocks or see weed to be found.
Few local dogs around but won't bother you and you can order your meal on the beach- not an issue.

Title: Just average
Text:
We went in off season I. E. February however the beach is nothing amazing.  Only average swell, nice blue water but a little misty. Beach itself is wonderfully long but there are spots where there is a lot of plastic around. And there is very little shade

Good family beach but can have big rips.

For us the south and west had nicer beaches this time of year.

Also if you come in off season there is little food or amenities around. This was actually quite nice, just a few local boats going out to pigeon island, but come prepared with supplies.

Title: One of my favorite beaches
Text: The beach is wide, the sand is warm and the Indian Ocean is hard to beat. Offers a lovely experience. We saw the sunrise, and the sky turned pink at sunset. This is an amazing beach

Title: Beach to relax and safe sea bath
Text:
December is not the season - but very good place to relax and enjoy the nature. Beach was a clean to a certain extent and a place and good for sea bath. Of course we had great pleasure in visiting the place.

its a 6 hour dive from colombo - but worth it.

Title: Beauty, marred
Text:
An absolutely beautiful stretch of beach, with a shallow entry and warm waters to enjoy.

It was a bit rough when we visited, but not at all unswimable (3-4 waves). The heavy surf did product a thick belt of shells, coral and other items at the entry, and a somewhat deep drop at the shore (which quickly levels off), making getting in or out tricky and uncomfortable on the feet.

The only major negative was the amount of waste, plastics and other random debris in the ocean. It was an ugly situation, and detracted from the natural splendour of the place. Sad the people would be so shortsighted and not respect the beautiful surroundings.

Title: What a peace!!!
Text: Beautiful beach with a lot charm, local fishermen in their traditional boats are great to see and on the side of the beach you the locals area which is also fantastic to experience, what about cricket on the beach!!!

Title: Really nice beach
Text: The beach was actually better than the grass that the hotel considered beach. Went for a walk here at sunset and view lovely

Title: Fantastic Beach!
Text: This beach is like a swimming pool at this time of the year! Very shallow, warm and calm.the beach sand is nice to walk along and there are spots close-by for snorkeling.

Title: Wonderful beach, see the big and the small wonders
Text:
Passikudah Beach is a beach with very different faces.
Beginning with many corals, then flat and sandy, as any tourist wants to have, 
then mixed with corals and sand, and in the end, at elephant rock, with huge rocks.
You must take your time to explore, it's worth it.
Make a long walk,
or, just go there for sunrise, it's really amazing, I'm still in love with it.

Title: Nice place
Text: Pasikudah beach is a nice place to visit. Be carefull if you go on the weekend because it's very crowdy of local people. Even that, you can walk a little bit and be alone because all the locals are gathered in the same place.

Title: Passikudah Beach - low water, Kalkudah Beach - deaper and better for swimming
Text:
If you have very small childern than I rather recommend Passikudah Beach where is low water even if you walk 50 m to the ocean.
But if you travel without childern, never go to Passikudah Beach - it is boring, it is more difficult go to swimm there. Definitely chose Kalkudah Beach where the ocean has beautiful color, it is easy to go to swim and there are almost no people on the beach.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: We recently spent 4 days in this area and Passikudah beach is lovely. It is nice and clean as a beach and the water is also clean and clear. It is shallow for miles out so great for a relaxing hangout and swim. We made it a ritual to stop here everyday for a bit. Gets a little busy on weekends but not unnameable.

Title: Quiet, clean beaches!
Text: Had a great time at the Amaya Beach resort! Loved the quiet and clean beaches, however not many restaurants  outside of the hotels. Snorkling possible .

Title: Clean, nice and sandy beach
Text:
Not a crowded beach and no salesmen are trying to sell souveniers. Watersports i.e. jetski.
Plenty of place to relax. And you feel very safe here.

Title: Beautiful safe beach!
Text: A safe (enclosed in a lagoon) sea to swim in, and a beautiful large white beach which is not crowded!

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Sand and beautiful water, cooling wind and nice people! Jet ski available for the teenagers and nice sandwich bars for lunch.????

Title: Best Beach
Text: Best beach I've visited in Sri Lanka. Clean white sand and crystal clear water. You can walk quite a ways into the ocean.

Title: Tranquil waters
Text: The part of Passikudah Beach we had access to from the Amethyst Resort was lovely.  Water is extremely calm and warm.  You have to walk out quite a long way to get to deeper water so fairly safe.  Protected by a reef.  Not many tourists as yet, but good to see the local people enjoying the water.

Title: Lovely beach but very little shade
Text: Lovely long, wide beach lined with resorts but it also has public access. Only downside is that there's little shade and no loungers/parasols to hire on the beach itself.

Title: Best beach in town
Text: Really enjoyed Pasikudah beach during my stay in June, 2019. I stayed at Uga Bay and it was well maintained, and well guarded. The sea is very nice and calm.

Title: Sri Lankan Maldives
Text: Passikudah Beach is one of the best in Sri Lanka. It's so attractive, calm, has beautiful white sand. There are good quality 4-5* hotels around. It's so peaceful,  no disturbance from beach boys.  We enjoyed swimming, had perfect relaxation.  Perfect time to travel from May to September.

Title: A paradise on earth
Text: What a beach... true paradise , the sand is white,white... its so peacefull! We love it here! Well come back here fore sure!!

Title: Amazing Beach
Text: This beach is absolutlely amazing. It deep blue ocean and clear sand make this beach one of the prettiest I have visited so far. The water is hot and almost with any waves, much more like a lake. Some areas have some dead coral so be careful with your feet. Loved it and higly recommend a visit to it.

Title: Beutify unspoilt beach
Text: Very quiet. Only a few hotels. Shallo water. Soft white sand. Some watersports but otherwise not much activity or dining possibilities.

Title: Deserted paradise
Text:
Just back from Sri lanka, where we stayed in Anantaya resort on Passikudah beach.  As I mentioned in a previous review for Arugam bay, it was of season and they are recovering from being closed for 2 years for Covid.
Positives:
The resort is really beautiful and its situated on a magnificent beach.
The people at the resort could not have been any friendlier and helpful.
The upgrade they gave us had a swim up pool right to our room, which was fab.
The resort is really a 5 start resort and it felt like that staying there.
Food was very varied and really good

Less positive feedback
There was no more than 10 people at the resort while we were there, which made it feel empty.
Most of the bars and restaurants that were advertised were closed. (only 1 was open)
They set up a temp restaurant and bar, so when people were finished dinner it then closed. (around 8pm)
We knew it would be off season, but didnt realise it would be so quiet, especially in the evening.

I would certainly recommend Anantaya resort and Passikudah as a fantastic destination, but plan your visit between May and September, when all the facilities should be open.

Title: Very nice place at the resorts area
Text: The beach area it's very good for swimming. I recommend to use the resorts area of the beach, where it's much cleaner and safe.

Title: Nice Beach
Text: Not crowded and a very shallow beach, you can really walk out a long way until it gets beep. Water is a very pretty color and it looks like a pst card. Very nice.

Title: wonderful beach, warm clear ocean
Text: just great for swimming, depth increases gradually and easy to get behind the waves. Warm and crystal clear - a wonderful beach

Title: Public part of beach is full of garbage. The rest is nice.
Text: Tragically, the public part of beach is full of garbage. The 5* hotels take care of the rest of the beach, so those parts are really nice. Sad that this is the case, but Sri Lanka has a terrible litter problem on most of the beaches.

Title: Superb
Text:
Definitely the east cost of Sri Lanka is wonderful. 

Sea like a lake, sand superb....

Just dont loose it.

Title: Excellent for a sea bathe
Text: One of the best place to have a sea bathe, If you love sandy beaches with shallow sea, this beach might be a good choice. The sea waves aren't that nicer compared to other beaches in Sri Lanka. but if you are looking to have asafe sea bathe this is definitely recommended. The best time for bathe in this place would be between 9 am until 2 pm as this place get crowded in the evenings.

Title: Decent
Text: Probably not the best of Sri Lankan beaches but still a nice spot. The middle of the cove is the best as the ends are rocky and the one section that seems to be frequented by locals has garbage strewn about. The rest of the beach is pretty clean. The sand is powdery and the water is clear. Downside if you arent staying at one of the beach resorts is that there is zero shade. All trees and structures are on private property and there is security to make sure you dont even sit under a tree on the border of resort and beach. Easy to burn fast!

Title: Loved it
Text:
Has to be one of the nicest resort beaches on the Island.
A long stretch of lovely golden sands, Azure calm waters that you can wade quite a distance out into. Great beach for long walks early in the morning or at sunset. 
Avoid the section of public beach towards the southern end, its noisy and overcrowded.
Great for diving, snorkeling and you can also hire Jet Skiis. 
One thing Passikuda lacks is a bit of the outside restaurant and bar scene. Perhaps they can allocate a specific area at the back of the resort for this.

Title: Unforgettable experience.
Text: Nice beach and not too busy, Very clean. Top place to spend several days in peace. This was one of best options we chose. Unforgettable experience, highly recommended.

Title: Perfect beach.
Text: The sand is very fine. Just aa fine as in Bretagne, France. The water is way warmer than in Bretagne. No cold sensation when getting in. The waves are very moderate. It is not crowded at all.

Title: Fabulous broad sandy Beach
Text: We spent wonderful 2 days at the passikudah beach and I would say this is a five star beach. Beach is incredibly Clean blue colour and calm so  even kids can enjoy. Beach is broad and sandy which is beautified by palm trees. There are few beautiful hotels that you can easily access to the beach. We wanted to experience the east coast and this was one of best options we chose.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Lovely beach with several hotels in the area.  The water is clean, calm and safe to swim in.  There are not many restaurants in the area so dining is fairly limited to hotel restaurants.

Title: Lovely Beach
Text: We used this beach whilst staying at the Calm Resort complex. Nice, sandy beach with shallow sea for quite a way out. The Indian Ocean here is the warmest sea I have ever swum in.

Title: Sandy but dangerous
Text: The beach was clean, sandy and empty. There was a red flag both days so swimming in the sea wasn't an option.

Title: Excellent beach
Text: Excellent sandy beach with good infrastructure. Beach is cleaned every day. I recommend for everyone.

Title: Best beach on the east coast
Text:
We live in the USA and can only visit Sri Lanka during our summer school holidays so we always go to Passikudah beach in June or July.  The beach is beautiful and extremely clean.  I love the fact that you can walk far out into the water at this time of year and there is no strong current and its not deep.

The beach is the best behind Anantaya, Maalu Maalu and Uga Bay.  However, if you go to the beach behind Anilana, it is terrible and you really cant go into the water because all of the sand is covered with broken coral fragments.  I love Anilana hotel, but not the beach behind it.

Dont miss the wonderful sunrise on Pasikudah beach. In addition, take a walk down to the fishing village at the end of the beach in the early morning hours just after sunrise as that is when the fisherman pull in their nets. Its really interesting to see what they catch.

Also keep in mind the water on this beach is calmest during June to September and it is really rough December through March.

Title: White sand east cost beach
Text: Fabulous very clean and neat east cost  beach for every one to enjoy. Specially for water sports and relax. For nature lovers too can enjoy .

Title: Beautiful views, needs a tidy!
Text: Incredible beach - water so warm and clean. Such a pity about plastic bottles etc strewn across the sand.

Title: Picture perfect
Text:
Passikudah beach is the classic beach paradise...with lovely white sand, bath-warm water and fringed with palms. Its a big bay where a busy public beach (we were there on the full moon public holiday)  sits happily alongside the quieter, hotel frontages. 
Only improvement would be to extend the exclusion zone for jet skis- although hardly an issue as only a couple are available, they would be better kept 100m or more offshore - they do break the peaceful setting and hamper a long swim out from the beach.

Title: Exploring Sri Lanka
Text: Beautiful beach ?? Quite a few big hotels use this beach and I believe you can use some of their beach bars. It is kept very clean and police were seen patrolling the beach. The sea is very clear and safe to swim in. It is quite shallow until quite a way out. There is a PADI Dive School on the beach which also rents jet skis, banana boat rides etc. My daughter did her PADI Open Water Qualfication whilst we were there and they were very professional and my daughter enjoyed diving with them.

Title: Really calm
Text: Realy lovely beach...calm and peaceful...beach is really clean water is realy warm great for children becuse water isnt deep about 250m in to the sea. The best part of the beach is in front of The Calm hotel...

Title: Perfect for young children
Text: We stayed at one of the large resorts, but loved our daily walks along the beach, and seeing all the locals enjoying their beautiful beach. Our 6 month old loved it!! The water was warm, no waves, he could have sat on the shoreline eating sand all day. There are cows and dogs around particularly at the public beach end which has a life guard, but its very relaxed. I only hope it can stay clean and not full of jet skis.

Title: A beautiful and clean beach
Text: Although Pasikudah is a distance from Colombo compared to the beaches on the southern coast of Sri Lanka, I would highly recommend this beach, if you are after a less crowded and clean beach. The beach is located in a bay hence it is not very rough.

Title: one of the most serene beaches in srilanka
Text: If you are looking for peace, peace and more peace then this is the place to be. it is far from the regular tourist circuit though on the way from trincomalee to arugambay. if not to stay for a couple of days be sure to stop to enjoy the beautiful blue waters.

Title: Great beach for swimming and walking along
Text: Ideal for families. Easy to swim in and spend a few hours. We spent time down in the local end and found some shade.

Title: excellent
Text: I snorkelled, saw a lot natural coral reef beauty, some fish but was very good and swam for miles into the ocean. Fabulous weather and scenic.

Title: Oh dear!
Text: Oh my goodness, its so sad to see this beautiful bay where we used to holiday in the 1960s full of expensive plastic hotels. Its also so popular with locals and the littering is a huge problem. I suggest there should be warnings that if youre caught dropping litter you should have to give up half an hour of your time to litter pick! Just one photo of a huge Hotel. I recommend staying in a small guest house instead. Nandawanam is excellent!

Title: Calm waters & uncrowded beach
Text: Visited during mid June and the weather was perfect. A bit sunny but the balmy breeze combined with the refreshing waters make floating around the calms pleasant. The only downside is that it is a 6 hour drive from Colombo.

Title: Beautiful Bay
Text: This has been the highlight of our trip to Sri Lanka. We feel that this is very close to paradise. Would definitely visit again.

Title: Private beach - Quiet and Clean.
Text: About 5-6 Hotels line the beach and have private access to it. It is a c shaped beach with not too much wave activity. Calm Indian Ocean waters.Swimming is safe. LSR Watersports is a large provider who organises everything here from JetSkiing to Scuba. At one end of the beach there is a Public access area - Not very clean unfortunately.Beautiful walk in the morning and evening. The other end has a Fishermen's colony.One shack and one convenience store near the public access otherwise no hawkers. Overall worth it only if you're staying at one of the Beach Hotels.

Title: White sand, warm seas - who needs anything else?
Text: This beach fronts a number of hotels - for UK visitors the Anantaya and Uga Bay - it is uncluttered, clean is calm and warm. You are only likely to go here if you are staying at a hotel, though it is a public beach

Title: Beech Walk.
Text: Great beech , could not believe how clean every where was. Beech was controlled by at least two policemen at all times. Felt very safe. Not forgetting the temperature of the water.

Title: Golden sands as far as you can see!
Text: This beach is clean and practically deserted.  The sea is warm and slopes gently.  Small crabs scurry around and we were advised to look out for snakes!  A perfect spot for a stroll if you are bored with sunbathing.

Title: holiday
Text: the beach is amazing one of the best we have ever been on the sand is real white and fine the water is hot and clean amazing

Title: Beautiful
Text: The local beach is beautiful. Quit and relax. The hotel offers various water sports. The entrance to the sea is gradual, it is shallow

Title: Long and wide beach ideal for walks
Text: This is a long beach, along it you can past a few resorts, coconut park, some fisher mans and theirs boats. You will meet many stray dogs and puppies but don't be afraid of them, they are very friendly and they welcome every kind touch :) and of course something to eat... But be prepared, that they will follow you :D You can reach a small village between resorts with public beach. Don't hesitate to look in, they are cows, groups of stray dogs and sri lankan peoples who salutes you and smiles at you. Resorts keeps their beaches clean, but behind resorts there are too many plastic bottles and waste at all on the beach. But water is clear, you can see some fishes also. Sand is light and nice, but beware of corals and broken shells when you walk without shoes. Water is really warm - we were here at the begining of february. There are some bars at resorts, where you can have some drink or tea, but the prices are about 900 rupies per cocktail. The village includes muslim inhabitants so women don't go there only in swim suit, it is different culture so you have to respect it. But short pants or short skirt and t-shirt is ok :) you don't have to be fully covered :D

Title: Lovely beach
Text: Passikudah beach but crowded with hotels.  The neighbouring beach - Kalkudah - is far more natural. However, great for swimming and a stroll

Title: merveilleuse expérience
Text: A calm area with plenty of beach. The sea is a bit rough but one could explore with a known person of the area.

Title: One of the best beaches in the world
Text:
Both Passikudah beach is one of the best in the world. Although the hotels are upmarket you have an amazing beach. You usually can walk into some of the hotels for a meal or drinks.
 Drive 45minutes to Batticaloa and you have another wonderful beach which is public. I think it is called Old Kallady Bridge by the locals ...just as you pass the bridge on to the left which is the seas side and not the lagoon side. Take a look at the old dutch fort too.

Title: Clean beach, almost white
Text: December is considered low season for this side of Sri Lanka, but we enjoyed the beach immensely. It's open sea so water can be rough at times. Watch out for the flag colours and stay safe and have fun!

Title: Great hotel with good service
Text: Fantastic hotel great accommodation food and service. Chef very accommodating. F&B service staff great. Front office and HK staff efficient. Highly recommend

Title: Calm
Text: One of the best beaches to go for a sea bath and swim.The water is clean and calm.The water is also warm.

Title: Quiet and surprising
Text:
Not croudy at all, still a few hotels nearby. Food and drink to find in the hotel on the beach. Sofar You are on the hotel's beach as a non hotel resident the hotel people try to convince You to buy tourist services ,boat tours by them over the real prices. Just decline!
At the evening cows can cross the beach or just stay for rest for a half an hour.

Title: Very  Busy with Locals at Weekends
Text: Nice beach very popular with locals at weekends and holidays. Surrounding luxury hotels have their own private beaches. Not too many shops or restaurants in the immediate area. Nearest local town Valaichchenai

Title: The reef broke the waves making it really nice and safe to swim!
Text: The reef broke the waves making it really nice and safe to swim! The beach was private with a great view of the sunrise.

Title: Hello warm water
Text: you can walk out quite a way, jets, swim, play or just laze around. Its a well protected bay with resorts facing on, and a local fishing boat launching place further along.  Tried snorkelling near the rocks, but not much to see there.

Title: Nice Uncrowded Beach
Text: The beach at Pasikudah is relatively quiet and uncrowded, although it does get busier down toward the larger (and cheaper) resorts.  Sand seems nice and clean.

Title: Pretty patch of sand
Text: Lovely beach, white sand and warm water. Safe for swimming. Not much to do, which makes it a perfect place to chill out.

Title: Warn waters
Text: It's a smooth beach perfect for families with kids, the water is always warm, specially in the afternoon. We had a great time snorkelling in the reef. Very affordable and had a great time.

Title: Wonderful tropical beach
Text: We are staying at the Uga Hotel on the beach here. It is totally a tropical paradise beach. Soft white sand, super warm, calm water, palm trees, coconuts. Everything a perfect tropical beach holiday needs.

Title: Great beach
Text:
This was my first time visiting East coast of Sri Lanka. Stayed at Amethyst Passikudah and went to the beach with kids. Great for morning sunrise walk along the beach which we did. Don't forget sun cream, it can get really sunny as early as 7:30am.
We collected lots of sea shells and spotted at least four little crabs.

Title: Dirty public beach and nice hotel beaches
Text:
Some of the reviews have already mentioned the "problem": if you're a guest in the hotels Maalu Maalu, Uga Bay, The Calm... you have a very nice and clean beach.

If you are a guest from the other hotels or come there for a day trip, there is no way you can enjoy the beach. The public beach is packed with hundreds of locals, swimming with their clothes and littering the place. Also, there is no shade, no sunbeds, no beachbars, just nothing. 

I would not recommend the beach if you're coming from outside, it's not worth the trip.

Title: Nice quaint beach
Text: Can be crowded with both local and foreign tourists on weekends. Really good for shallow wading and there's a separate water-sports section

Title: Maalu Maalu Spa and Resort
Text:
At last, a beach where the locals have been educated and not one single plastic bottle, bag or other rubbish is to be seen . 
Offers a fun array of water sports , skiing, jet skiing , restored reef snorkelling ( a lot of work has gone into this ) 
A gentle and classic tropical beach, high season is August through to end of November. 
Well worth the drive from Negombo Airport .

Title: Best beach in Sri Lanka
Text: It's an amazing beach! My kids loves it. The water is so calm and clear. It was an amazing trip!! We did snorkeling, took a swim in the blue waters and just relaxed. The peace and serenity whilst on passikuda beach is just what we needed.

Title: Good beach. Not too crowded.
Text: Good beach with good view for sunrise. Has options for jet ski. Not too crowded. Has good resorts along the beach where you can stay.

Title: Quiet at one end busy hotels and locals at the other -
Text: Great walking along the friendly beach . Smile with the locals. Watch the stars at night. Peek into the other hotels along the front .

Title: Lovely beach
Text: There are nice hotels by the beach. The beach has a common park where many people would come for the day.

Title: What a beautiful beach
Text: Our hotel had direct access to this beach and it was beautiful. Others told me that the further you walked along the beach there was a lot of rubbish but I never saw this. A variety of water sports were available.

Title: Stunning beach
Text: An amazing beach. Soft sands, clear and calm waters, very few tourists and friendly cows. Perfect for swimming and long walks. We loved it.

Title: Passi beach
Text:
Beautiful quiet beach,

Hope it stays like like this and doesnt get over developed. Walk down to the edge of the beach and see the intriguing fishermans huts

Title: Best beach ever
Text: Literally perfect - white sand, turquoise sea. Jet skiing, and donuts available but really empty beautiful beach.  The opposite of the crowded European beaches in August

Title: Beautiful Beach
Text: The beach is beautiful, white sand and clean sea infront of the hotels, after the hotels the beach is not as well kept and some areas full of coral. The weather was on in August, however, what we were not told is that there are high winds in August, with upto 25kmph which was every day and ruined the tranquility a bit as walking down the beach we were sand blasted.

Title: Calm sea
Text: The beach has soft sand and you can walk out for a fair distance as the water is shallow. It is clean and not many people. The resorts have areas of the beach so if you have a drink or a meal at the hotel you can use that part of the beach.

Title: Lovely and clean beach on Sri Lankas east coast.
Text: Clean and fresh beach. You can walk along without being hammered by salesmen and wild dogs. Very pleasant. Great to swim during of  monsoon season.

Title: Not ready for backpackers/budget travellers!
Text:
Amazing paradise beach! Warm clear water and white sand! Biggest drawback of this beach is that it is clearly aimed at families and people who are there to spend some money! We came as backpackers looking for a relaxing stay and found that our hotel was cheap, but everything else was expensive! 

Pros
Safe and secure, security guards
It is beautiful!!
Amazing sunshine
Nice beach restaurants 
Peaceful area away from the road
Beach activities available
 
Cons
Very windy, uncomfortable amount of sand in your face!
All beds are owned by hotels for only paying guests! 
No shade, cant even lie under a tree as it is hotel owned
Beach resorts own most of beach, 2m from shore is where the non payers can go! Were told the resorts dont want non payers too close to the guests
Hired beach beds for 900rupees from uga bay resort after negotiation! Were only alowed them until hotel guests arrived and no one was allowed to open up the accompanying umbrellas! We were made to feel very uncomfortable!! 
Only available food is from local shops or beach resorts! Resorts are lovely but very expensive!

Overall backpackers and people on a tighter budget avoid! Nice place for families and honeymooners! Bring your wallet!!!

Title: Beautiful bay
Text: Really nice bay with sandy beaches. There are many hotels in the bay and a small town near by. I recommend to go there if you are visiting the east coast.

Title: Very good beach
Text: The beach is very clean and the water its hot, you can play jet ski, wakeboard, diving, snorkeling, banana...! Its a very fun place with many kind of people... there is a bit of wind all day long! Very good!

Title: Depends where you are on the beach
Text: The middle to northern part of the beach is much better than the south where there is too much coral and too many people.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Beautiful beach, white sand, warm sea and not very many people on the beach. Lots of water activities which is great fun. Was beautiful and would definitely recommended

Title: Extraordinary
Text: Most incredible beach. Clean, basically empty and lovely soft sand. Amazing find and recommend thoroughly

Title: A beautiful unspoilt beach.
Text: A beautiful beach with lovely safe swimming. We stayed at Maalu Maalu so had the use of the beach right outside the hotel but you can walk the entire length of the beach whichnisnlovely to do early morning or evening.

Title: Beautiful white beach far from crowds
Text: Passikudah beach charm is in the fact that there are no crowds and you can have a lonely romantic walk at sunset or sunrise. The main entrance next to Analuya is a swimming place for locals - worth seeing the local families there. You can walk along the beach for 15#20 min. Some parts are full of corals, others - some garbage. The beach is part of the lagoon protected by coral reef and some people do snorkeling here as there are little waves within lagoon. Little activuties other than swimming and almost no shops. All in all it is a beautiful place

Title: Nice beach
Text: Very Nice beach where the water was very hot and not too much  on the beach...this was really appreciated

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Very beautiful beach with a lot of crabs, various types of shells and fish. Perfect fine sand and crystal clear water....

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: This is a great white sand beach with beautiful palm trees on both sides.  Its a wide beach and there are lots of resorts with cafes all along

Title: Beautiful
Text: Nice and clean. No rubbish and very clean water. Only resorts on this stretch, but wide spread. Very relaxed. (no crowds)

Title: Marvelous beach with no hustle and bustle as in Colombo
Text: Good for a relaxing holiday. This area is really good for family outings. There are plenty of beach hotels in Pasikudah.

Title: Beautiful
Text: We had a lovely walk the whole length of the beach.  Only the section near the car park was busy with locals and most of the hotels guests sun bathe in the hotel gardens so the beach it self was quiet.

Title: Well worth a visit
Text:
Well worth a visit to Passikuda beach.

Can do glass bottom boat trips out on the boat to check on the corals.

Will look to visit this place again.

Title: Clean beach with a large bay
Text: Great beach just to chill out. Very clean and it was like a spa. Many good hotels along the beach. Malumalu Resort provides great service by the beach

Title: Lovely beach
Text: Great beach with lovely sand and crystal clear water... however not much sea life. Lovely walks up and down the beach for hours.

Title: Clean - which is a bonus
Text: Generally we have been saddened by how badly polluted the beaches on the east coast of Sri Lanka are but Pasikudah beach is generally better than most. Just dont walk all the way to the southern end which is a bit of a mess

Title: Quite deserted
Text:
We came here in October, everything looks pretty deserted and packed up for the season. 
Food in the hotels extremely expensive, couple of places on the street between Pasikuda and Kalkudah beach, but hard to get fresh seafood. 
Probably better to come here in the season (June, July, August) to get better weather.

Title: Kalkudah nice
Text:
Better Kalkudah beach than Passikudah more quite nobody is on the beach.  Clear blue water .
The only presence sometimes are the sacred cows!!!

User_Location: Grand Baie, Riviere du Rempart, Mauritius
Title: Idyllic Beach - fabulous water
Text: Stunning 14 km long beach with a magical shoreline. Very chilled location - nothing but kilometer after kilometer of empty stunning sand on a huge natural bay. Some great wildlife and photo opportunities too.

Title: Relaxing Beach
Text: Not a lot to do but a nice beach. Worth a visit into town can bycle there & back. There were a few resorts & and some were empty.

Title: sunrise & sunshine beach amazing
Text:
This is located in the Eastern coast of Sri Lanka. The beach is beautiful and clean, and the waters are warm and inviting. The sandy beach here offer you a true glimpse of paradise!
Endless fun activities for everyone, from tots to tweens and teens..beach with cabanas, restaurants, water sports and entertainment, The area has hotels near Pasikuda Beach, and it makes a great base for sightseeing in and around Kalkudah.
The ocean isn't  deep for few meters from land, 
Greater place for a beach holiday !!!

Title: Magnificent
Text: Beautiful beach, clear water great soft sand . A pleaseant walk early in the morning or late afternoon

Title: Amazing calm beach like a natural swimming pool
Text: One of the best beaches in the country. Very quite & clear water. Can have a bath with out a risk as in the swimming pool most time of the year.

Title: crystal beach
Text: one of the beautiful beaches i have been. full of corals and crystal clear water. What a sunrise. outstanding.

Title: Lovely
Text: The beach is clean, largely due to the efforts of the hotels lining the coast. The public beach could be cleaner. But one of the prettiest beaches I've seen.

Title: Clear blue waters, calm waters most part of the year.
Text: Clear blue waters, but infested with coral on most of the strip, water shoes recommended. the area without coral can be overcrowded by locals and can get quite loud and rowdy.

Title: Rundresa
Text: The area is newbuilded after the sunami that destroyed the whole area. The charm is not there yet, but will be in a couple of years.

Title: Gorgeous!
Text: Love this beach!  Quite flat with nice sand so easy for long walks. Gentle surf and quite shallow during our stay made it great for swimming or rather just floating.  On a sunny day it is absolutely beautiful!

Title: Great beach.
Text:
The beach is lined with hotels for much of its length but they are set well back and low rise so you get the feeling of a tropical beach.
Expect the unexpected they say and while we were snorkeling a herd of cows were driven onto the beach and all but trampled on out beach towels.

Title: Heaven on earth
Text: Unspoilt, deserted, palm fringed, almost white sandy beach washed by a turquoise sea with not a tout or beggar in sight. Wonderful, truly heaven on earth

Title: Passikuda Beach East Coast.
Text:
Travel to Passikuda with East Coast Travel to explore the truly Srilankan cltural flavour. Takes approximately 6 hours by car. 
Many new hotels along the coast.

Title: The calm sea and flat sea bed make it ideal for sea bathing.
Text:
This region now freed of terrorist activity, has become popular with tourists. There are at least twelve luxury resorts around, and tourists don't mind the drive down more than 300 kms from Colombo. 
The sea is very calm between April and October, the busy tourist season. The flat sea bed ensures that you could walk for more than 200 metres without the water rising above your chest. Thus it's ideal for sea bathing.

Title: stunning!!!!
Text:
Simply a stunning and beautiful beach, by far the cleanest beach we got to see in Sri Lanka.

the beach is very long and get for an afternoon walk or morning run, the sea water is or was very calm on each day that we stayed at the local hotel.

Title: Wonderful beach
Text: This is one of the best beaches in the country. The waves are low due to a reef breaking the main waves about 100 metres from the beach itself. There are natural pool type of areas where there are hardly any waves even though it is open sea. A guy like me who doesn't swim this is an ideal beach. The area is pristine as there are no habitats around this area. Except for one fishing village the total beach is well isolated and very clean. We stayed in Uga Bay resort but most hotels in this area provides high privacy.

Title: A beautiful beach in Sri Lanka
Text:
Very side and open beach with an extremely beautiful reef.   
The bay is approximately 2 km long and the sand is white. 
A nice a relaxing bat where to spend few days of relax.

Title: Fantastic beach!
Text: Wonderfully soft sandy gentle sloping beach. Tropical water temperature. A few kilometers end to end lined with hotels well set back. Most hotel residents lounge by the pools leaving the beach to a few walkers and swimmers. No hawkers, a few watersport activities that don't cause a nuisance. Local traders sell drinks and snacks at the south west end at weekends.

Title: Excellent for kids
Text: Excellent in August. Smooth calm, waist deep water. Kids loved it. Amethyst resort was almost excellent. Water sports available.

Title: Wonderful beach
Text: Long soft white sand beach, water the perfect temperature, tranquil and safe ocean while we were there.  Plenty of palm trees for shade, which is important considering how hot it gets in August.

Title: Beautiful beach, but at what cost!
Text: This is a lovely looking beach although no real character - just big resort hotels. The sea is painful to walk into as there are huge quantities of sharp coral which you can't avoid. I spoke to local business owners whilst there and discovered that in 2009, the big hotels got together and destroyed the coral reefs in order to get rid of the waves created. The local businesses fought against this but there was nothing they could do. If you walk along the beach you will see piles and piles of dead coral - quite distressing. There is a Swiss NGO working to replant the coral and if you want to learn more, go chat to the manager Siva of Hotel Vasuki - a lovely man who is trying to improve the area and incidentally serves up an absolutely amazing curry and rice.

Title: best place for children
Text: many local families and very clean beach. tourist are wellcome but women must bath dressed. nice place.

Title: Great Location
Text: This beach is one of the most beautiful my wife and I have encountered in Asia. The only positive or drawback depending which way you look at it, is it is extremely under developed no restaurants except at hotels, no shops for tourists, no outside laundry services, ATMs and banks hard to find and it is 4 to 5 hours from Colombo but still very much worth it.

Title: An exceptional beach
Text: Clean sand, warm sea and a beautiful outlook. We will definitely make it back here again and for a longer stay.

Title: Stunning quiet beach
Text: Hardly anyone else on this beach in June. Very warm clear water. The coral reef is sadly dying though, although you can see many fish on a snorkelling trip there. The trip organisers and hotels could do more to protect and preserve the reef and limit visitor numbers to it. Maalu Maalu Hotel has an interesting outdoor museum about the reef, worth a visit. They also do conservation work on it.

Title: Season doesnt start till mid July!
Text: Nice place for couple or a get away. Nothing much going on except big resorts. I would recommend skipping it and heading straight to trincomalee

Title: Beautiful beach
Text:
A beautiful calm beach- we were there in July and it was flat and perfect for swimming in the sea.....
Loads of water sports on offer in the bay- jet skiing/ canoeing / snorkeling / fishing.
Long stretches of beach allowing lovely walks!

Title: Long sandy beach and warm sea
Text: You would probably be staying in one of the beach front hotels that are situated along this beach although there is a public area that seemed to be used by locals. The beach is long and sandy and in June there was a cool breeze. The sea is very warm but not clear. There are glass bottomed boats, fishing, snorkelling, diving and banana boats for hire.

Title: one of the beautiful beaches in sri lanka
Text: its a very long white sandy beach,, very beautiful... sea is very shallow and safe.. you can walk, jog, play sun bath, less crowded... ideal for a peaceful beach stay...

Title: One of the best in the Eastern Coast
Text: One of the best beaches in Sri Lankan Eastern Coast.  Very calm and peaceful, Enjoy.  Ideal for families and couples.

Title: Clean and nice swimming and no hawkers so peaceful.
Text: Best beach and vey clean and no surf so good for swimming and no hawkers so peaceful and good for relaxation. Only accessible from the hotels so very quiet.

Title: Long beach with very calm waters
Text: The ocean here is calm and one can swim or wade at ease. The sands of the beach are harsh due to pieces of coral. So walking can be slightly painful unless one walks along the edge of the water.

Title: Beautiful Beach
Text: Stunning location.  Clear water.  Sand and sea in some parts can be sharp with broken shells.  Great view.

Title: Great little place
Text: Wow white sand and blue water.  Nice little stop to break up our trio from arugam any to nivelli. Great walking Beach. Flat as a pancake so if looking for any waves u wont get any.  We stayed for 2 nights and that was a great amount of time.  There is no where to go eat or shop or anything like that, but all the hotels r along the beach and offer dining.  Def must visit if in the area.

Title: Excellent Beach
Text: Very nice beach. I strongly recommend this beach over south beach. There are no beach boys or food sellers to annoy you. Water is crystal clear and very peaceful. Beach has a very wide sand area.

Title: Stunning
Text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have visited especially the undeveloped end with its Palm tree backdrop it's all you would expect from a tropical beach

Title: Great for a beach only vacation
Text:
Far from Colombo or Mattala where the main international airports are. 

Excellent beach. Small town. Nothing much else to do in the area.

Since its a far place, ideal for a beach only vacation.

Title: Beautiful and well maintained if near hotel
Text: Postcard perfect beach.  Soft sand and warm calm waters.  Sadly a lot of rubbish where the hotel properties end their maintenance of their land.

Title: Gorgeous Beach but not for Swimming
Text: Clean beach that sits in a small bay protected from the waves by a coral reef some distance into the sea. The problem is, the entire area is full if corals and is very shallow. You can't swim here. I walked at least 80 feet into the water and it was hardly waist deep. The sandy bottom is full of large rocks and corals. You cannot swim here. Wear footwear to avoid injury from corals. Pieces of them are strewn all over the beach, literally.

Title: Gorgeous!
Text: Pasikudah beach is one of the last untouched beaches of Sri Lanka and already signs of human misuse is showing in the way corals are being destroyed and garbage accumulating. Its still gorgeous white sand and miles of calm clear waters teeming with marine life especially in the bay area. Try to access the beach front of a hotel in the area as the public beach can get crowded.

Title: Miles of sandy beach
Text: This is a beautiful region of the east coast of Sri Lanka. The beaches are not crowded and are clean. It is possible to swim safely close to the shore. There are a lot of new hotels here. They are little pricey. The place is rather remote and far from the town centers of the region.

Title: Wonderful Beach to Walk and Enjoy the Sea
Text: Must go place during the season. I suggest to go to a hotel by the beach as there are very little facilities to 'just hit the beach' - unlike what one would find in any many other famous beaches.

Title: excellent beach
Text: Passikudah beach is a wonderful beach for swimming and beach walking but there is no provision of facilities by any of the very expensive hotels which have been built in the area since the tsunami, there seems to be a total lack of visitors.  There are a few stalls owned by locals who charge cheap rates for drinks and beach clothing and the beach is almost entirely used by Sri Lankan people.

Title: sea is nice beach is average
Text: There so many nicer beaches in Sri Lanka why going to this artificial expensive compound with no sense of place and bed service.

Title: Smooth Sandy beach
Text: Very nice beach. The sea is shallow so can walk for few meters. Sometimes can be crowded but you have plenty of beach to walk. must visit.

Title: Nice and clean beach.
Text:
This beach is really one of the best in Sri Lanka. It's clean, you can swim and (in the season) do some snorkeling. It's a good place for everybody, couples but also families with (little) childeren.

There are enough resorts in the area were you also can have a good lunch or a drink. 

For tourists: Be aware of the power of the sun and use a good sunblock.

Title: One of the best...
Text: Nice clean beach. Good for early morning run or walk without any disturbances. Not crowded at this time of the year.. able to watch the sun rise peacefully....

Title: Could be good
Text:
This beach is missing cleaning in the public part. There is a lot af waste lying around the public area. The sand is actually coarse and there is old corals and small rocks many places which should be cleaned. The time we were there the waters were not clear most of the time, probably due to currents. The water was however children frindly still in most part(where the reef covers) at most times.  

Also many places thers is stones, rocks and corals right from shore beginning.

However it is picturesque in the evening with the sunset and in the morning.

But i expected more

Title: Such a beautiful place!
Text: It was picturesque. The clear blue water and the white sands were just like paradise. safe for bathing. the beach is clean too.

Title: Passikudah Beach
Text: Thou it is a long travel from the Colombo airport. I found it to be worth. Less congested beach. There are many new hotels opened after the end of the civil war in 2009.

Title: Water is so warm and calm!!
Text: Water is so warm and calm. most of the places the water level was up to knee high. which made it and excellent natural swimming pool for my 4 year old daughter.

Title: Beautiful beach
Text: Stunning beach with several hotels.  There is a public element which has a good ice cream shop which our kids loved.
