Title: Disgusting, depressing, plastic rubbish filled lake with jetskis and speed boats
Text:
Quite frankly, and utterly depressing experience given the sheer and shocking volume of plastic waste floating at every shoreline of the lake.  It is made worse by the fact that tourists actually pay to enter the park.  What do they do with the money?  They certainly don't clear up the garbage.

To add to the pollution, speed boats and jetskis tear up and down the small lake continually. Why anyone would want to take a pleasure cruise in this water is beyond me.

Sri Lankan people are in general the friendliest and most generous people you could wish to meet. However, the plastic is becoming a national shame. As a visitor to the country, touring around for six months, the rubbish/garbage/litter in every river, stream and beach is a disgrace. I went for a sea swim and collected 25 plastic bags in 10 minutes.

Title: Nothing here worth stopping for
Text:
Move on, nothing to see here. 
Family with young kids could maybe enjoy but very little to see. Food options looks horrible. :|

Title: A must visit while in Nuwara Eliya
Text: Beautiful lake with backdrop of mountains and well maintained gardens. Beautiful flowers everywhere. Ideal to relax and spend the day.

Title: A must visit in Nuwara Eliya
Text: Gregory Lake is one of the top attraction in Nuwara Eliya and offers a bunch of water sports from Jetskies to Speed Boats. Local vendors may ask you a higher price, one can bargain them to get the best deal.

Title: Beautiful Lake with a lot of activities for the family!
Text:
This is yet another iconic place in N'Eliya. I much prefer when it is during the week as it can get quite busy on weekends. There are lots of activities for the family including pony rides and jetskiing. 
Perfect place for an early morning or an evening walk. It is well kept, clean and lovely! Avoid if it is a long weekend as it does get very very crowded.

Title: Picturesque lake
Text: This is a large attractive leisure lake not too far from Ella town. There's a small entrance fee for tourists and then You can walk around the lake or perhaps take a boat ride for a little extra cost. Also popular with locals.

Title: Walk around and boat ride must to enjoy the beauty of this place
Text:
Visited on 20 Feb 2020

The lake big and hills providing a picturesque backdrop to the beauty of the place. If you visit the lake and take a stroll around it there is an entrance charge.

Boat ride point situated a short distance away from the main entrance can be accessed for free and boat ride will cost SLR 500/- per person for 30 minute ride. minimum 8 person per boat.

The lake is clean and the breeze is very comforting for a good walk in morning and evening. Horse rides are available in the lake as an additional attraction.

Go and enjoy this place.

Title: Nice walk but very dirty lake. Costs for white people.
Text: Unfortunately the lake is very dirty and it is very noisy on weekends. Many locals come from the city and drive around the lake very loudly with jet skis and boats. If you want to go around the lake, it costs because you are a foreigner. Too bad.

Title: Nice clean lake
Text: We enjoyed our boat ride around the lake. Suggest that you get your driver to negotiate the price if you are touring.

Title: Nice view
Text:
The lake look very beautiful. 
Natural beauty. I love this place. The look also look clean. Visitor for this time very less.

Title: Rip-off!!!
Text: This is a public lake located at the city of Nuwara Eliya. It is unbelievable that going to a public lake has to pay LKR300 per person for foreigners plus parking fee of LKR100. There are lakes in Colombo and Kandy City that open to public free of charge. We still dont understand why there is an entrance fee to access this particular lakeside. There are many different kind of boat rides and water ski activities on the lake with additional fees required. Many locals were here for the boat ride since there is no fee required to enter this lakeside park for locals. The surrounding of the lake is not particularly scenic nor beautiful. Few food vendors around, portable toilet and small patch of flower beds. Dont waste your money and time here. Seriously!!!

Title: Nice lake to visit with family
Text:
Very good lake, lots of activities for kids and complete family.
The lake is clean too with best location

Title: really little England
Text: Nuwara Eliya is a beautiful small town in central Srilanka. The lake is clean & well maintained. A boat ride costs LKR 4000 for one hour. You can negotiate & get it for LKR 2,500. surrounding is very scenic beautiful & photogenic.

Title: Nice walk around
Text: At the lake you can do all sorts of activities, but the best one is to walk and relax in the sun with a drink and a snack. All foreigners have to pay 300rs to get in

Title: average lake
Text:
ok lake in middle of town, there is a charge
of 300 rupees currently just to access
the walking path around the lake. plenty of other nicer places to go around nuwara eliya!

Title: Scenic Photo Spot
Text: The entry ticket costs LKR 200. It is good for a stroll and photo session. Tip from a local - DO NOT go for a Jetski ride in this lake. The reason is, the lake has a lot of slush under the super cold water surface  due to which in case of any accident involving a Jet Ski, there is a possibility of the riders getting stuck in slush and the rescue workers do not have the wherewithal to quickly rescue such a victim. In the meanwhile, the victim is likely to fatally freeze in the cold slushy bottom of the lake.

Title: Brilliant place !
Text:
Must visit in Nuwara eliya, actually there isnt much to do in nuwara other than Gregory ! Never the less its a brilliant place, the entire town is around this lake, you can do boating (lots of different boat options) , and the water is super chilly and nice ! Lots of eating options on the lake side ! 
Really beautiful place

Title: Walk from our accommodation
Text:
The lake was an easy walk from the centre of Nuwara Eliya via Victoria Park. It costs 300 RPS each adult to go in both Victoria Park and Gregory Lake (children free). We had two strollers and some of the walk was along the road.
The lake is quite large, there are boat rides and jet bikes and pedellos. Fast food type concessions are available at the lake - we chose a restaurant over the road.
Its a nice area to get away from the busy traffic in the town.

Title: Beautiful
Text: One of the must visit places in Nuwara Eliya is Gregory Lake/Park. Entry is 200 LKR. We went on a foggy day so it was too beautiful. U can easily spend hours here. If u r a boat person,do take a boat ride on d lake. Plenty of beauty to admire here. Can spend a very peaceful time here since its not too crowded. About 2 kms away from city

Title: Run around the lake
Text: It actually costs a little money to walk/run on the path around the lake. It is also a lot of animals there; horses/cows/dogs and a lot of garbage. Had a little smell as well. The lake is «man-made» but it Doesnt look like it. With a little cleaning up there this would be a great spot.

Title: Cool place to spend time
Text: A really cool place to spend some time in Nuwara eliya. The lake is moderate in size and one can enjoy boating, walking, cycling or some water sports near the area. The lake is maintained really well and you would love to spend hours here. The place also has some activities for kids making it a good picnic spot. You get some really good view of the houses nearby whole boating.

Title: Dont go out if your way
Text:
We walked to this lake only to find as foreigners we would be charged 200 rupees to walk around it. 
I know this is common but the whole area was covered in litter and debris so paying to walk around was not appealing!

There are at least two entrances both staff are on top if their game spotting the foreigners

There appeared to be some boats. Nd jet skis available should you wish to go in. 

Ive seen better everywhere to be fair so paying was not an option for me. 

I wouldnt bother. 

Go to little d gland and have a sarnie and a drink. Its much nicer.

Title: Water sport and bike riding
Text: Many outdoor activities around the lake. Beautiful vista great water sport and lovely for a relaxing bike ride.

Title: Waste of money
Text: Wouldnt recommend. It is nice, but you have to pay entrance and there is nothing to do there if you dont want to jet ski.

Title: nothing special to see
Text:
nice location but the lake is very busy, with Jetski and Boats and the water is dirty so i would not recommend to fall into it... but its nice to take a walk and also see the little horses walking around and you can easily deny a horseride trip 
so nice to see if you have time but not a must seen...
and your driver has to pay entrance for the car parking

Title: Picturesque setting
Text:
A beautiful setting, with a picturesque backdrop of mountains. 
There are activities all around the lake including cycling, boating, jet ski, horse riding & play areas of kids. Alternatively you can take a pleasant walk along the shore. There is a small charge for entry to a part of it.

Title: A nice walk away from town.
Text:
Foreigners has to pay 200 LKR to enter the walking path around the lake. At the lake it's possible to buy different rides like boat ride, speed boat and jet skis or you can simply just enjoy a nice walk.
Unfortunately there was a lot of plastic bottles in the lake, which I didn't expect as the rest of the location is very nice kept.

Title: beautifull
Text: Beautiful location great time. nice boat tour and horse ride everyone enjoy.  good peoples there also  everywhere sri lanka like this

Title: Lake Gregory
Text: It was great experience to spend at lake gregory..its really beautiful lake....specialy at the room balcony their was heart touching touching view of Lake Gregory. and i really enjoyed at the boating

Title: Nice spot
Text:
Gregory Lake is a nice spot for a stroll in Nurawa Eliya. 

Theres a small fee for foreign visitors. 

There are many vendors selling boat or jet sky rides, who are persistent, but not rude. 

The parking lot is patrolled by others offering pony rides. 

Theres a somewhat dingy offering of small rides for kids, as well as many vendors selling a range of products.

Title: Too good to be real! Must visit.
Text:
Too good to be real! Must visit.

This is a famous spot to be visited in Nuwara. Takes about an hour to enjoy the lake view and the various drives conducted over there.

The prices are a bit over rated for say, swan ride, jet ski ride or whatever. Couldn't see safety measures existing there-in. Still, the crowd is crazy and the locals keep pushing you to come and give it a try. 

The water in the lake doesn't look to be very clear as it should be. Maybe that is how the local setup works.

Date of Experience : March 2019.

Title: Fun on the lake
Text:
Great to relax and watch the world go by or enjoy water sports like jet skis and boating. 
Many stalls are open for business. 
Well maintained and clean.

Title: Gregory Lake
Text: Gregory Lake is one of the important sight seeing in Nuwara Eliya and it is in the city itself.  It is easily accessible and area is maintained neatly. This is suitable for relaxation and walking. Bike boating, Family boating activities are there. Entrance fee is LKR 200 for foreigners. It is a nice place to enjoy.

Title: Good place to spent you ideal time!
Text: Lake is located just beside the city center. Easily accessible. you have some boat activities and some cheap food carts. Good for spending some idle time.

Title: Nice if you never go by boat
Text:
Nice touristic thing to do. But you do need good weather and clear views. 
Quite busy with local tourists and thats good as well. Knowing that even local people visit this.  
When not to windy you can even try the swans and peddle across the lake. ??

Title: Do not visit in July on a windy and rainy day!
Text: Our driver took us to the lake thinking we would enjoy it but unfortunately it was a very underwhelming 30 minutes in the driving wind and rain. After paying an entrance fee we were hassled by locals trying to sell us pony rides, hassled by owners of very shabby looking boats to take a spin on the lake. Maybe on a warm sunny day you could have a better experience but we found it so bad it was comical. Reminiscent of a tired UK seaside town with attractions that had seen better days, including the bad weather!

Title: Walking
Text:
We got there by our driver they charge 500 rp to enter the park parking the place is clean and there is walking trail which is nice to take a walk there is deferent flowers and you will find the boats people asking you to ride a boat 
Also there is many small shop for food and drinks

Title: Beautiful
Text: The lake is massive and beautiful! Its nice to take a simple stroll and enjoy some snacks with a beautiful view of the lake!

Title: Nothing to see
Text: Unbelievably you have to pay entrance to this very ordinary lake. Very run down amusements. Half starved tiny ponies ridden by overweight tourists, no thanks.

Title: Excited
Text:
A must visited place in Nowara Eliya 
People who is looking for relax & nature must visit tye lake.

I advise to take a boat tour.
Or seat & take breakfast with cup of tea or coffee in the morning

Title: Beautiful lake
Text: Very beautiful place to enjoy.There are several water Sports available in hear.beautiful clean place

Title: Nice place to spend some time
Text: Nice beautiful place to spend some time when you are in Nuwara Eliya, can have fun doing water activities, fresh foods, snacks.

Title: Beautiful Lake
Text: It is a beautiful lake, would be nice to take a walk in a sunny day, and stop for a tea or coffee in one of those restaurant along the lake. it gets busy during the weekend, not free entrance, which was a little strange, because you can see everything too walking on the street outside.

Title: Place to relax, fun and boat rides
Text: I went with 4 foriegners. Entrance ticket is 200LKR and for car 100LKR. Its very nice and cool place and located at the heart of the city. Morning and evening is the best time to be there. You and do many types of boat rides including jetrides, family boat and swan boats. But you need to pay. I like jetrides as the operators are very skillful. walking, cycling and horse riding is a great experience. Dont forget to bring your cameras, there are many beautiful locations to capture. There are many parks around the lake. I like the very first one near the city.

Title: Nice boating
Text: Beautiful placid lake.  For LKR 6000, four people can go around in a fast jet boat for 7 to 8 min.  cheaper and slower options also available. Lake is kept very clean

Title: Wonderful Location
Text: We spent around 3 hours by the lake, had lunch lake side and walked around as far as we could, lovely location and you can take a number of different boat trips on the lake, a number of street styles eating cabins are also available but we chosen a hotel restaurant right on lake so able to enjoy the wonderful views / location.

Title: Walk
Text:
We walked to Gregory lake to look for kingfishers as we were told there were some there but didnt see any.
Sorry to say the lake is spoilt by loads rubbish which had been dredged out of the lake and left on the banks cans and plastic bottles!!!

Title: Lake in the heart of tea country
Text: Like Lake Kandy this is a sparkling clean lake, and is surrounded by the verdant hills of the tea country. Boating is possible, but probably best enjoyed from the shore.

Title: Nice area to relax
Text: We enjoyed the walk around the lake. Family friendly. Well-kept area. There were boats to rent with driver, sea-doos to ride with driver and paddle boats to rent. A little pricey to do: sea-doo was LKR 3500 and boat LKR 6000. LKR 200 each and LKR 100 to park.

Title: Good for a little walk
Text:
A nice and peaceful place to have a walk around in the garden and enjoy the lake.
There is also boating, jet ski and other options available.

Title: Lovely Sunday afternoon but so much plastic and garbage around
Text: This is a lovely lake and we spent a really lovely Sunday afternoon mooching about but my husband and I couldn't get over how much rubbish there was lying around by the sides. Obviously the staff are doing the best to clean up the area but it's so disappointing to see how people throw so much stuff around. Also there are loads of horses around who look really miserable , it was quite upsetting seeing their faces, not sure how well they are looked after.

Title: Pretty place to visit
Text: Very beautiful place, European style housing surrounds the lake. Well worth a stop off on your way through.

Title: Large lake
Text: Large attractive lake with some water sports mainly comprised of maniacs on jet skis showing off.  Not really worth visiting in my opinion.

Title: Excellent for picnics
Text: Very nice lake that is named after a previous English governor. There are lots of activities for family and adventure lovers and it is well worth spending a few hours relaxing

Title: A Place To Enjoy and relax
Text:
One of the Coolest Place in Srilanka to Relax and Enjoy with Family

 Been here for several Times with Friends and Family, And Still a Memorable Place With Lots of Enjoyment

Title: It's a place for relaxing
Text: It's very quite place, entrance is 200 Rupee per person for foreigner, and we rented bike to have a tour, you can sit there and just relax..

Title: Pretty and festive in Christmas
Text: Nice landscape, views, taking photos, picnics, riding bicycles (renting), and small boats. In the Christmas night, we saw a lot of celebrating buses and vehicles decorated by colorful light poles, and celebrating by horns, and saw local gaming area.

Title: Pretty lake
Text: Take an evening stroll along Gregory Lake. Stop for a snack at the stalls. There are activities like horse riding, paddle boating, swan love boats and even jet skiing.

Title: Good boating activity
Text: Nice on the Mountain top the lake is used for sport boat activity family place full crowded on holiday

Title: Beautiful hidden gem
Text: The lake is centraly located and undoubtedly a star attraction of Nuwara Eliya. Take a stroll around, enjoy the seren beauty or take a baot ride. It is so scenic and peaceful that it reminds one of lakes of Switzerland. Foggy and cool weather of the place makes the whoe experience wothwhile!

Title: Nice but nothing special
Text: We walk along the lake which was nice but far from spectacular. If you are going there just for the lake, youll probably be disappointed. For 2 adults and 2 children we payed 500Rs.

Title: Not worth a walk
Text: Gregory lake appears to be a dying lake. It was about a mile walk for us and upon arrival, we were very disappointed. It is suggested not to bother even if you are staying close

Title: Entry fee to get near the water
Text: This is extremely stupid. They have entry fee to get near the water. LKR 200 per person for foreign nationals. The fee for boat riding is extra. There is one area where kids of the age of 10 years are seen practicing driving cars without any supervision of elderly people. They also drive at pretty high speed. Not at all safe.

Title: Huge lake with recreational facilities
Text: Gregory lake is a big lake with boating facilities available. A drive around the lake is good fun and it is on the way to Sita ji's temple. A boat ride is enjoyable. The water is clean except around the corners and edges.

Title: Vacation
Text: We got to stay right on the banks of this lake in the rustic style bungalows called the Calamander. Its a beautiful spot and great for the entire family.

Title: Beautiful place for an evening or early morning walk
Text: The place is really beautiful but usually busy with visitors. I would recommend the best time would be to go for a run or jogging or simply relax on the grass in the early morning or late evening. Also breathtaking at night.

Title: Nice place for a walk
Text:
Good place to get away fro
The middle of the town to stretch your legs and maybe take a boat trip. There is food and drink available on the far side as well as bikes for hire.

Title: Awesome...Big and clean lake
Text: HAd a very lovely experience going around the Gregory Lake. With its vast expanse, neat and clean manicured lawns spread all over the periphery, its a visual treat and very good experience.

Title: Dont visit when the day trippers are in town
Text: The lake was an easy walk from our accommodation, located on the southern outskirts of Nuwara Eliya close to the racecourse, so we wandered out there for an evening stroll pre-dinner. To be honest, we didnt find the place all that appealing. The area of the lake closest to town has been turned into a recreation area and it was buzzing with bus loads of people, largely schoolchildren, visiting on a day trip (it was a Monday). The area also suffers from an excess of accumulated rubbish both in and out of the water. As you pass along the shoreline adjacent to the main road the area has been established as a park which costs 200 rupees for foreigners to enter and where you can partake in water sports, get food and drink etc. There was a jet ski whizzing around, a couple of motor boss offering trips and pedal boats for hire, all back by a general hullabaloo no music and drums. The other side of the lake was quieter if youre just looking for a walk although it does have a locked vehicle barrier which we just passed under (nobody came to challenge us). We wandered the shore for about 15 minutes but tranquility was out of the question due to the hubbub from the recreation zone.

Title: Not much to talk about, but a pleasant place to visit
Text: Short visit to the lake on the way to our accommodation and visit to the Sita Amman Temple; did not have much time to explore but the view of the lake from our hotel was magnificent

Title: Gregory Lake
Text: Nice  big lake  with greenery. It is well crowded when we  visited on 29th dec 2019. They  have  an entrance  fees of 200 rs  which  is  not reasonable since  we  had  little  time spent walking , seeing and  taking pictures. There  is  speed  boat  regular  boat, Jet ski rides  but since  we  enjoyed  the  same  in Kandy  lake , we  decided  not to opt  for  boat ride. The  helicopter  ride  is  available  but it  is  too expensive  for  merely 8 mins ride  costing you around 100  USD/person.

Title: Underwhelming
Text: We had a little bit of time before our train departed Nuwara Eliya so decided to visit Gregory Lake at the recommendation of our innkeeper.  It is apparently a very popular place with locals on a Sunday, enjoying boat rides and jet ski rides on the lake. There is a walking path around one side of the lake, but it ends abruptly.  The path on the other side is really for bicycles, but we walked there too.  Since we were not interested in a boat ride, this lake really did not provide any standout qualities for us.  I would skip this if pressed for time.

Title: Little England
Text: The lake has beautiful sightseeing places and a traveller should opt for boating. We had a great time, enjoyed scenic beauty and climate was too good which really synced with title of Nuwara Elliya as Little England. Perfect place to visit.

Title: Awesome place to spend the evening
Text: Awesome place to spend the evening. Has Jet Ski, boat rides, games, horse rides, etc. Do not book tour with Bhatia Lankan tours. The guy is an intermediate tour operator, does not have a vehicle and a cheat

Title: So busy and noisy!
Text: Not what I expected...really busy with boats and jet skis and also loads of hassle from people with horses and markets. Kids might like the idea of the craziness, but wouldnt recommend if youre coming to stay and get away from it all. The surrounding country side is absolutely stunning though so a must visit!!

Title: Easy walking path.
Text: Gregory Lake is a short trip from the centre of town and worth a visit for the easy walking and cycling path...such a contrast to some of the steep trekking walks in the area. There are loads of boating options to hire - jet ski, speed boat, paddle boats. There are food and drink stalls near the carparks.

Title: Highlight Of Nuwara Eliya
Text: Centre of attraction in Nuwara Eliya. The lake, the garden and the location is breathtaking in evening. Boating and other activities are a bonus. Not to be missed.

Title: Wow....
Text: The lake has an awesome view and the promenade is a best place to hang around. It is neat and well maintained. We got one boat ride of full lake 2500 rupees and we really enjoy with climate. It was good experience and really memorable place for us.

Title: Great Lake
Text: This lake has soo much activity around it, boats, people Walking Around it, festivals. Well worth a walk around

Title: Good place for Water sports
Text:
Nice place for water sports 

If any one wishes to go for water sports activities you can negotiate prices 

You can negotiate prices from 1000-1500 SL rupees depending on the activity

The price for Jet Ski was 3500 and final offers were 1500 - 2000 SL Rupee

Title: Wonderful Lake
Text:
The Gregory Lake is a place that you can enjoy and do many activities like riding a bourse or hire a bicycle or take a tour in lake with motorboat or even speed boat. You can also enter with 200 Rupee as (entrance fee ) and just have a walk around the lake and have coffee at the restaurants and coffee shop in the area. 

Highly recommended to visit and spend 2 hours there.

Title: Chilling and breathtaking
Text: It is a chilling and neat lake . Interested people can do boating or horse riding nearby. They have some entry charges and parking charges for the car. However a mix of tradition and nature.  Could sit there for hours to experience the serenity. And at night yoh could see small music groups dancing , singing playing .it was fun to watch them. Lot of coffee shops near by.  I was so bewitched by the serenity that i spent lot of time both early morning and evening in there. A must visit place.

Title: Enjoyed the speed boat ride!
Text: This man made lake offers some great views and in order to enjoy it to the fullest, book a high speed boat ride across the lake. They provide lifejackets and will stop boats in certain locations during the sail, allowing you to take some lovely pictures.

Title: Excellent lake
Text:
We rented a normal boat for 2000 rupee each some usd 12 for 30 min round this beautiful lake with great views. We were given life jackets and took a lot of pictures. You can also walk a little bit round the lake. We rented our boat near the bridge. There are also clean toilets at 20 rupee fee. You should also try local tea there. Tea everywhere!!@ since you are in a tea country. 
Dont miss this fun

Title: Vast lake
Text:
There were great views from here.  The lake itself is vast and worth walking some of it.

There were people boating around in the water which was a nice distraction.

Title: Nice Lake
Text: The Lake takes its name from British Governor, Sir William Gregory, who had the reservoir constructed in 1873 to aid electricity generation. Apparently it was never used for this purpose, becoming a place for recreation and leisure instead. In recent years the area has been upgraded and a variety of leisure facilities added. You can enjoy a picnic, paddle a swan shaped boat on the lake among the other speedboats, jetskis and windsurfers, take a stroll around the perimeter or go for a pony ride. Nothing seems to be free here, every activity has a price, really a pittance when compared to similar activities in Australia. Worth a visit even if only to enjoy the views.

Title: A good place to unwind
Text: The Gregory Lake at Nuwara Eliya is a reservoir constructed in 1873 during the Governorship of Sir William Gregory. A boat ride is a must and prices range from 4000 to 7000 LKR for upto 7 persons There are both fast and slow boats. There is also a helicopter ride available from a helipad adjoining the lake. Would definitely recommend.

Title: Walk around lake
Text:
It was a beautiful sunny morning so went for a stroll around the lake. The were many many boats on the water and even more jet skis going at full speed round and round the lake. It was a busy Sunday morning and there were even lineups to get into the parking lots.
We finally found spots far away from the town by the helipad from where helicopter tours departed and still had to pay 900 rupees to get into park!
A nice flat walk, but overpriced parking and too many noisy jet skis detracted from the beauty of surroundings.

Title: OK if you wish to use watersports/facilities. Cafes poor
Text: A pleasant location, very attractive area, great to see horses enjoying a good work out and watching locals get silly on the water! Quite expensive (relative, I know) to hire boats/have rides etc but you don't need to do it - enjoy the walk around it.  Food/cafes on site were, quite frankly, naff. All craving for business, selling similar foods - chips, plastic sausages, fizzy drinks. Not our scene but locals seemed to love all of it.

Title: Rude staff member, lots of litter.
Text: A rude and aggressive staff member who spoke to us like criminals for not realising we needed tickets left a bad taste in the mouth. One end has no ticket office or signs about tickets, so we were very surprised to be randomly approached and asked for tickets half way around the lake. This could have been done in a much more friendly manner. The lake was also surrounded at one end by large mounds of litter so I guess the money doesn't go towards keeping a pleasant environment. Very disappointing.

Title: Peaceful lake
Text: Peaceful place to watch the sunset and have your lunch. There are two sides. One is free for local with bicycles and horses to to ride and the other side is entered with tickets and has kids area and boats for renting.

Title: Pleasant walks and boating options
Text: As usual in Sri Lanka you have to pay even to walk 100 metres through the area - but it is a large lake with a good footpath all round it. There are various boating options and play areas. You can also walk to/from the town via the racecourse.

Title: Family vacation
Text:
The lake is absolutely awesome 
Cleanly maintained lawn and garden
Can spend hours by boating at just walking 
The setting is sooo scenic that you hate to leave

Title: Relaxed walk by the water
Text: Medium sized lake, with swan-shaped peddle-O boats, jet-skis, and speed boat rides.  Also a few little coffee and fast food units.  Could benefit from better toilet facilities.

Title: Gregory Lake
Text: Scenic lake overlooking the plains. Can just sit n relax enjoying the breeze or take a slow walk or have a cuppa in the cafes have s snack or take slow or fast boat ride. Evening time is the best

Title: Beautiful lake amidst idyllic settings
Text:
Gregory lake is located few kms away from the center of Nuwara Eliya Town. It is a man made water body, formed when a dam was built across a small stream flowing between hills that surround the town. The lake is beautiful and has a road along its bank on one side. Hotels and residential buildings also have come up along the bank. However, the lake is still beautiful with rolling hills, visible in the background.
Boating facility is available on the lake and the walk along the lake is also worth while. There are plenty of options for eating out, along the lake, including a floating restaurant.

Title: Ideal for family outing
Text: What strikes at the outset is the cleanliness of this place. One can have a long walk along the lake and enjoy speedboat rides. Food stalls serve local stuff.

Title: Mr Hasit Jagasheth
Text:
Nice lake about 2 kilometres from the Town of Nuwara Eliya.
Nice scenery of Lush Green Hills around the lake

Title: Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya
Text:
Pleasant place to be at - lake surrounded by mountains & fog. 
Scenic beauty & temperature had dropped as it had rained the morning we visited.  
This lake offers water sports which is a bit highly priced. 
They also had horse riding for kids.  
Many small snack joints around the lake - food is decently priced.

Title: A relaxing way to spend a couple of hours
Text:
We spent a relaxing afternoon meandering around Lake Gregory. I fail to understand how well off western visitors complain about spending an extra £1 or so than local residents to enter a place which was built by the labour and servitude of local Sri Lankans. The attractions in Nurawa Eliya were built to amuse the wealthy colonialists and it is helpful to remember some history before writing a tirade about the injustice of differential entry rates.
We took some samosas and a drink and had a lovely time.

Title: Pleasant stroll
Text: We took a walk along the lakeside which was a very pleasant stroll although pretty not spectacular scenery. There is a fun park and pony rides for children as well as boat trips, speedboats and jet ski hire available on the lake. Personally, by other activities in Sri Lanka thought the boat rides etc were over priced.

Title: Good fun
Text:
Great place to hangout and loads of water sports and activities safe and great  view
Grat street food and  good for photos

Title: Beautiful beautiful property!
Text:
Thoroughly enjoyed our lunch by the lake! Beautiful cottages with the most stunning view of the lake! 
Yummilicious food and great service. 
A must visit while in Nuwara Iliya..

Title: Best place in SL for a calm holiday
Text: European look and feel. This is an artificial lake which is very well done. Take a boat ride but the best thing to do is sit by the side and enjoy the calm this place has to offer. Sun can still be harsh so avoid sitting in the sun.

Title: 200 rupees for entrance
Text: Pretty lake, nice for a walk around in the sunshine. Pedal boats and jet skis available to take out on to the lake for a fee. A few shops around selling food and drinks.

Title: Large lake in attractive setting
Text: This large lake provides plenty of relaxing activities such as walking, boating, picnicking. It is set in a green valley with scenic views on every side.

Title: Good park to spend a couple of hours
Text: Nice area to visit specially when the whether is good. Key attraction is either the skijet or the speedboat. Price is very reasonable (5000 lkr)

Title: Lake
Text: Lake is very picturesque and we loved boat ride here. Later in the evening we walked around lake and spent lot of time walking/ cycling.

Title: Beautiful
Text: The lake is beautiful and the place is well maintained. You can either walk by it or even indulge in some water sports. There are cafes nearby for a cup of coffee and snacks.

Title: Gregory lake-a piece of heaven!
Text:
Oh Gregory! I fell in love with Nuwara Eliya the moment I entered it.

I just cant forget the sight of Gregory lake-deep blue water surrounded by lush green trees.It was surely a piece of Switzerland in Srilanka.

Just pay LKR 300 and you are good to go! Enjoy a beautiful walk along the lake and just sink that paradise in!

Title: srilanka  visit 2019
Text: we just passed by it as we had limited time.you can do boating here which we are not keen.huge lake.good place to take some photos.

Title: Great place for families, a walk or a run.
Text: We were very excited when we saw Gregorys lake as we were keen to go for a run but due to the mountains we didnt think there was a chance. You can run nearly all the way round. Its approx 8 km if you run around and back. Its a lovely place to chill as well as there are paths along the lake for a gentle stroll, alongside lots of water sport activities eg pedalos, jet skiing etc. There are also food stalls by the car park. Entry fee is 200 LKR.

Title: Boat ride on a sunny morning
Text: Gregory lake is located centre of Nuwara Eliya. Fantastic place to enjoy boat rides, paddle boats and water scooters. Boat service charges are very reasonable

Title: Lovely gardens and lake
Text:
The gardens are really lovely. The flowers were in bloom and we could see a riot of colours. The park around the lake has a lot of areas to sit and take in the views

The lake had a backdrop of the thickly forested mountains.

There are boats and water scooters available

Title: Tranquillity!!!
Text:
Reaching Nuwara Eliya was love at first sight, until i saw Lake Gregory middle of the mountains spread wide with gardens around.
It is a very pleasant location to spend a day and chill around. There are some small eateries, which offer local snacks and ice creams. Unfortunately, it was raining a bit so we couldnt stay longer.
The entrance is 200 Rs for foreigners and 100 Rs for the parking incase if you have a car.
There are water activities like speed boats, kayaking, jet skiing. The activities start with 2500 Rs. A great location, fog around the mountains, lots of greenery, a beautiful lake, i guess a perfect place to be in summer. A place worth definitely coming back....

Title: Nice lake
Text:
Beautiful place to be with ur loved ones..lot of garden view with backdrop of mountains.

The boat ride was really great.

Title: A reasonably nice park and a good place to observe the locals having fun ...
Text: The city of Nuwara Eliya is not exactly a touristic objective and if got here, other than visiting the interesting and nice little Seetha Mandhi Hindu Temple and a very short walk around the Grand Hotel there's not much else to see or visit. As we were getting ready to leave the city on the way to Nanu Oya Railway Station (for the train ride to Ella) we stopped for an hour or so at Gregory Lake Park. It was on a Sunday, the weather was nice and sunny, and a lot of locals were enjoying the day off in the park. Whole families with kids and grandparents enjoying a picnic on the grass, youngsters racing motor boats on the lake, others just taking it easier with paddle boats, young lovers walking hand-in-hand around the lake, people just sitting on a bench or on the grass talking or sharing a meal, etc. There were no foreign tourists and it was a good place to observe the locals having fun...

Title: Fantastic place to enjoy in Nuwaraeliya
Text: Gregory lake is located centre of Nuwaraeliya. Fantastic place to enjoy Veteran, Children and all ages. Boat rides  paddle boats and water schooters can ride on the lake. Boat service chrges are not expensive,reasonable.

Title: Do take a drive around the lake
Text: Gregory Lake at Nu El is not a large lake, A drive around the lake is recommended and you can get to see most of the sights of Nu El if you have a guide with you

Title: Not a very big lake
Text: Its not a very big lake but they have quite a fair bit of activities here, eg boat ride, jet ski, horseback riding, etc. Quite a nice view with the surrounding greenery and houses. Would not specially make a trip here, but its okay if you are in Nuwara Eliya city

Title: Amazing Lake with walk around...
Text: We were here for 1hour... Access to lake it chargeable and also for Boating cost is huge for speed boat we paid 5000LKR...which we found costly for 10mins or 1round around the lake... superb garden of flowers with walk for fresh walk...

Title: Very walkable
Text: As the sun was setting, we and almost all the town, visited, this beautiful lake for a stroll, kite flying seems to be a big hobby here, as many were flying a kite.

Title: Lovely place to stop.
Text:
This is a beautiful place. Although the entrance fee is rather steep for foreigners, but it is still cheaper than Victoria Park.

The prices of the vendor's are realistic, and note that you can bargain substantially with these people both for the boats and horseriding. You should be able to go horseriding for about 30 minutes for Rs.500.

Title: Stunning lake
Text: Best place to relax and hang around. Beautiful location and surrounding. Boat riding, Horse riding and many more happening in this place. There are many small food shops available.

Title: good lake
Text: visited many times. tried boat rides too. it is good water body. walking around the lake in mist is amazing. no fishing there. hope lanka govt add paragliding. fishing and more adventures.

Title: Lake
Text: This is just a lake where locals spend time. A good place to hang around go for walks or boat ride.You can have something to eat as well.

Title: Nice
Text: Nice place with great view and activities, and there is a delicious food in the Chinese boat restaurant by the lake don't miss it.

Title: Cool
Text: Boat safary will amaze you. When you'll look to the mountains on the other side of lake you'll feel heavenly. Very nice environment.

Title: Nothing to admire
Text: Visited the place with paid entrance but there was nothing actually to admire. I recommend to save money and skip going here

Title: Excellent site with lower utilisation
Text: This is an amazing place that could be much better should there be a focus on proper water services entertainment and family. I think that it will become better in upcoming years as more tourists who are non-European start going up to Nuwara Eliya

Title: Nice and Peaceful Lake
Text: My family had a nice walk by the lake, and enjoyed the local snacks sold by the little stalls there.

Title: A good place
Text:
We visited it early in the day just.as they opened to public and avoided the crowd. We were informed that it gets really crowded as you go into the day.
We were a group and took the 12 seat boat for a ride. it was a big round covering most part of the lake. There are also other options for boat ride. There is also water scooter which is more thrilling

Title: Beautiful Place For Families
Text: The place is beautiful with a lot of activities for water sports. The scenes are amazing. We went their with kids and they loved the place. We are photographers and took a lot of amazing and interesting shots. Ticket prices are also quite reasonable.

Title: Heaven on Earth....
Text:
This place is a stand out. It strongly reminds you of the bygone era of clean fresh air and clean fresh look, clean fresh times. yes, its so surreal. The govt has taken special care to maintain and keep it up as it were during the past.

No wonder why the Rich and the famous have their baits and houses here and one can surely see and wonder if they were in England as the land mass, the land marks and the houses are built as the British would do.

The whole lake has a good walking path, and some tourist activities which if extended would spoil the nature.. but its limited to one side only and the others are like a dream sequence from a romantic movie.

Title: Nice Lake Side Walk
Text: Has boat rides and lake side walk that is beautiful and set in nature. Low clouds make it misty and a little chilly, but well worth it for you to take a leisurely stroll.

Title: Heavenly
Text:
Heavenly views and vast waters.  Thus lake is beautiful and large. Water sports is a craze at this place and people just have fun doing the water skiing etc. 

Children enjoyed the sports and the boat ride.

Title: Well worth visiting
Text:
I would certainly recommend the speed boat ride to explore the lake.
I fact we enjoyed it so much decided to go again.
Good safety standers and responsible operators:

Title: Dirty
Text:
Filled with horse poops. Nice lake, but poorly managed. Cost a fee to enter. Forget it.

The place is filthy and poorly run

Title: Awesome place
Text: This is an awesome place with great view and for scenic beauty. We were charged 500 Sri Lankan rupees for entrance for 2 people and parking. They also have boat ride.

Title: Good for a walk
Text: The lake has some interesting facilities like boating, jet skis, funfairs and horse riding. We walked all around the lake which was pleasant and paved for most of the way. It is around 8k and fairly level. Some of the attraction areas do charge for access.

Title: Beautiful
Text: very nice evening walk..with so much nature.i was really enjoyed with nice evening sun shine...peaceful and wonderful

Title: Amazing place
Text: The whole place looks like alpes , Europe.. whether is perfect.. watching sunset there is an experience of a lifetime

Title: Quality time spent
Text:
I was there with my family and relatives . 

First we need to pay to enter 50 LKR for locals and much more for foreigners which I do not agree with . 

Lots of rides in the lake . We did the boat ride for 3000 LKR which took us all around the lake . 
Also Jetski ride for 1000 for short trip and 1500 LKR for long trip . Which was really thrilling . They will provide life jackets and there are lifeguards available in any unlikely situation. 

There are also some local food stalls , horse rides , peddle boats , high speed boats .

Title: Very strange experience
Text: There is a charge to go in to what should be a free space - and 'foreigners' have to pay FOUR TIMES what the locals pay. (I know it is still not much but the principle stinks.) The rubbish (and sludge smell) just outside the ticket entrance is appalling and there is much work going on. The horses look sad and could be in better condition. We saw no wildlife in our walks in the area. We had a meal in a lakeside restaurant where the prices were pretty much twice what you would expect to pay elsewhere in Sri Lanka.

Title: nice visit
Text: very good boating experience, nice maintained lake u can spend a quality time with your family, for kids they can enjoy horse raiding

Title: Best place for boat ride
Text: Gregory lake is surrounded by a small park and they charge a nominal fee to enter the lake. If you are there make sure to take boat ride around the lake. They charge LKR 7,000 for up to 7 people on the boat, The boat are categorized by horse power from fast boat to slow one. They take very fast loops around the lake so you need to hang on tight during the boat ride.

Title: NIce scenic lake
Text:
Nice landscape scenery and was good photo shoot  spots. Enjoy your walk around where you see boats, flocks of birds etc
Remember to bring an umbrella along as it heavy down pour and there is no where to hide !

Title: Absolutely beautiful !
Text: This beautiful Lake in Nuwara Eliya is a must visit. Had gone there with my family in the last week of June. We went in the evening and It was very windy with the temperature being around 15 degrees which made it even more chilly. The place was very clean and had a nominal entry charge.There are a few boating activities you can do here and the prices for these are fixed by the government. I tried the speed boat which was LKR 3500 for two people and was super fun.There are also a few food stalls which served some very nice biryani,fried rice,sandwiches and some sri lankan food. Should definitely visit the place in the evening with family and enjoy the fresh breeze around the lake.

Title: A beautiful walking track while enjoying the surrounding
Text: It was very well planned and executed by the developer for the visitors to enjoy this beautiful lake and it's surroundings.

Title: Awesome View
Text: This is a nice place to roam around. You can get a great view with very clean lake. Should be careful about the horse ride and other attractions as the price they charge is not consistent. Better to have local guide while going around this place.

Title: nice boatride through the cool lake
Text: This was a beautiful place for a lovely evening enjoying the cool weather... This place offers a variety of boats (self paddling/ motor/ speed boats) also some horse riding on the banks of the lake as well... Definitely take warm clothes and wind sheeter for the rain and cold...

Title: view is awesome
Text: Its a nice place and we can walk around,.. But the entry ticket is very pricey and so are the rides ..But children do enjoy the water skis ....The place per se is really charming

Title: Beautiful lake
Text:
We enjoyed walking around Gregory lake. Couldnt do any boat rides as the weather was windy n it was raining heavily. 
Beautiful view n awesome weather. Expensive entry fees. Doesnt make sense to enter lake to just walk around. One can just pass by and have a look at the lake if not interested in the boat activities.

Title: Scenic
Text: The lake is an amazing place with magnificent views. Its peaceful and tranquil. The weather was very nice. They charge a ticket from foreigners an amount of 200 rupees. Though the tickets for local people is only 20. But it was worth it. It had boating as well but as the waters were choppy they had discontinued the service that day. The park around it has a walkway and its well maintained. all in all a good experience.

Title: Nice park
Text: Beautiful park with nice lake.we had wonderful evening hear.The garden has beautiful variety of flowers.very nice place.

Title: Worth visiting once n try water rides
Text: It is worth visiting once n try all types of water rides. We were there during last week of May (total 14 people in family) and had done all water rides. It is reasonable one but still one can bargain in off season.

Title: Good for boat ride
Text: You can have cheap ride with whole family on high speed boat but they now not going pass the bridge because of restrictions.

Title: Lake with activities
Text: Gregory lake is fairly large and there is a park on the shore for which you have to pay to enter. There you can rent boats to go out on lake. It looked quaint but chose not to pay and just viewed the park and the lake from the road that lead to our B&B.

Title: Not worth it for 200 LKR entry fee, nothing to do
Text: We were quite disappointed by Lake Gregory. The 200 LKR entry fee is quite expensive compared to the other attractions in the area e.g Ramboda Falls, which had a 50 LKR entry fee and was absolutely gorgeous! Lake Gregory was just a lake, nothing to do unless you're interested in riding a speed boat (about 40-50 USD). The pony rides are about 1000 LKR for a short ride.

Title: Lake for Tourist  attraction
Text: Gregory lake is vast in area, fully surrounded by hills, Overall average when it comes to an attraction. just a view visit is  recommended.

Title: Pleasant lake and pretty park
Text: There are water sports (jet skiing) and boats for hire, and the park is very pretty with different species of flowers.

Title: very nice lake covering the center of town, water sports are very nicely organised
Text: We had wonderful view of this lake from our villa dining place. realy nice to stay there and watch the changing sunshade, color , clouds moving above lake. wonderful experience

Title: Scenic lake with high entry charge.
Text: Worth the boat ride in the lake. However the entry ticket to the lake side park is exorbitant for the value. Park is small and nothing worth looking at. We had to pay park fees only to reach the boats which have their own charge too.

Title: Nice place for a good walk
Text: Just a 20 minute walk from Victoria park is the entrance to Gregory lake park with its water activities and food outlets. This year the walk around the lake is now complete with the panoramic views of the surrounding mountains.

Title: beautiful lake surrounded by hills and great boating
Text: definitely do a super hi speed jet boat ride. tip the driver in advance, then he makes some daredevil stunts and also make perfect angles for photos. At side of lake are plenty of places for fast food and even sit down dinner.

Title: Superb
Text: Its very nice place in middle of the nuwaraeliya.the lake and surrounding is beautiful.boat ride was supperb

Title: Quite a dirty lake
Text: A lake that needs some cleaning. Nice walk around if you can stomach the debris in the water. Few pleasure boats etc but a walk around Victoria Park was nicer.

Title: Disappointed, very disappointed
Text: Firstly I was absolutely disgusted at the way they charged differing entrance fees for tourists versus locals. Were all entering the park, but just because I look western I have to pay more? Thats not right. Secondly, hiring a boat was incredibly overpriced and the water was so dirty and green. I was really looking forward to visiting the lake but honestly it was nothing special.

Title: Beautiful
Text: The lake and surrounding is beautiful cannot believe we are in Sri Lanka they have water scooter the children really enjoyed

Title: Good boating place
Text:
Its a place for an hour to two hours to visit. Visiting through the boat would be a good way to visit it. 

The lake is very clean and very good for outdoor activity.

Title: Good water sports
Text: Suggested bikes to be rented and a good 3 hour ride with family. Take your picnic items with you and there are so may not great spots to enjoy.

Title: Fine place to visit with family and children
Text: Looking for a place to spend your perfect Nuwara eliya evening? This is the place. If you have children- they will totally love the place.

Title: Okish
Text: If you are not into water sports that are being offered here (speed boats etc), it not worth the 200 fee (for foreigners). Just a normal lake and nothing warranting 200 fee.

Title: Nice clean surroundings
Text: Its a good place to spend an afternoon.Entry fee is 200 LKR per head for foreigners. The place is well maintained. If interested you can opt for a jet ski ride inside or simply sit on a bench and enjoy the sunset, just a word of caution it can get a bit chilly during evening so light woolen is recommended.

Title: A lovely walk round Lake Gregory
Text:
There was a small entrance fee to enter the lake area but it was worth the money. I took my time, stopping at one of the snack stalls to grab some chips and a drink. There were several types of boats to rent including paddle boats and noisy jetskis and even though it was a cold day there were a few locals on the jetskis. Towards the south of the lake i had to walk by the road until i was on the east side where i passed through a gate and continued my walk by the lake. It seems that the eastern side of the lake is being developed as the paths were new and the only thing available ere kayaks for rent.
Lake Gregory was an artificial lake, constructed by 1873 by the British Governor, Sir William Gregory. I noticed a few people fishing in the lake, without much success.

Title: Speedy Fun
Text: Very clean and relaxing lakeside walk. Good views. Choice of boat, jet ski rides, pony rides. Small entrance fee for vehicle and each persons. Passed a couple of hours.

Title: Not worth a 500km travel!
Text: Over-hyped as if it's the only lake in Asia. The weather is good in nuwara eliya and that's the savior else nothing special about the lake. It's about 500 M along the main road and has an entry fee of 200 slr for foreigners. There are water sports available if you are an enthusiast but that can cost you anywhere between 1-4k lkr. The roads to reach this place are full of twists and turns and get you sick. Avoid at best

Title: Ok but not great
Text: Wasnt what I thought, more an amusement park than a pleasant walk. Lots of people offering horse rides nearby on tired ponies so not great really.

Title: Nice
Text: During our trip throw Sri Lanka we visit Bambarakelle city. It's about 1800 meters above see level. In the centre there is very nice Gregory lake. This town looks like European city.

Title: Nice Walk!
Text:
Nice walk in the garden while looking at the beautiful lake ... Good place for couples, kids, friends etc  etc ... have a walk and take a boat ride.

Just make sure it is not raining.

Title: Pay to get in?
Text: Having to pay to just lay by a lake doesn't make sense to me. And of course foreigners have to pay more than the locals. So we just walked around the outside. Parts were littered with garbage. But there are definitely some good photo ops.

Title: beautiful lake !
Text: very very beautiful lake has many restaurants and horse riding as well , very clean , please wear heavy clothes coz its very cold over there , just beautiful to relax and enjoy the nature

Title: Nature at its best
Text: Gregory lake has to be one of the most beautiful places i have ever seen . Sitting in the lap of nature , this lake provides stunning views of mountains on one side and city on the other side . There are a few restaurants and local tea shops where you can njoy the nature while sipping on a hot cup of tea. Definitely a mist visit . No wonder , this place is called Mini England  .

Title: Stunning views
Text: This is beautiful there are many things here walk  small boats jet ski horse rides car parking wish I had more time there

Title: Excellent Lake with mountains on the background
Text: Excellent place to relax during a vacation. Plantation, Mountain, Lake. What else ??? Amazing is not just the word.

Title: Great Views
Text: Beautiful lake amidst stunning NuwaraEliya. Boating can be done here or just have a walk. Its all worth it.

Title: Fantastic lake with well maintained gardens
Text:
On the way to our hotel, we viewed this lake from the road only and found it to be very attractive.

So immediately after the check in we decided to visit it.

It turned out to be a worthwhile effort.

A must visit for all tourists visiting Nuwara Eliya. Those who miss visiting will be missing a great deal.

Title: nice for a stroll .
Text:
nothing too fancy , however its not a bad idea to have a stroll along its shores after lunch or dinner .
family friendly with few activities for families and kids.

Title: Avoid this spot
Text: This place should be lovely but in reality it was dirty and sad looking. The locals all have horses which roam around the area. There was horse manure everywhere. Plastic and rubbish in the lake. Horses look mistreated and miserable. Def avoid. I wouldnt bring kids anywhere near this place.

Title: Gregory Lake Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka
Text: Nuwara Eliya Lake which is nearly 13 km long with 200 mt wide lake and depth is of 100mt.  Here we also see the Horse race coerce yard.  Niced place of rchildern's as well as family. nice place for boating.

Title: Lovely views
Text: Excellent views of this lake but will cost 200 rupees to enter. The white cranes flying in tandem were a lovely sight to behold. Makes for a beautiful evening stroll especially after 5 pm when the weather cools down. Highly recommended.

Title: Gregory lake
Text: The lake is a spectacle in nuwiyra eliya. The water was just blue as can be, thrrescsurrounding tea plantations. You can ride a bike around or just stroll. I was blessed to have a sunny day as there was a slight breeze as well.

Title: Water and green
Text: the water activities with the lush green view and the cool breaze and thefood option , everything is perfect about this place

Title: Colombo Feb 23
Text:
The place was wonderful it was a walking distance from the hotel nice view all the way 
The weather is a bit cold  you will require more  cold clothes 
The sea attraction by using the boats which are specialy designed for that which cost 5000 Rupees for the trip in the lake takes around 45 min which include stops for photos

Title: One of the top tourist attractions in Newerelia.
Text:
This rather large lake in the hill station of Newerelia is a boating enthusiast 's bucket list of holiday activities.

The lake is long, water is cold and clear with a number of pleasure boats to carry the tourists who flock to this hill station.

The boats are moored in the rather crowded Pier.

The day we visited Newerelia, the weather was dark, raining and cold. Naturally, the boating Pier was empty. Even the boat handlers were taking shelter inside the tea shop to escape the rain.

A beautiful place to visit and enjoy nature with the family when the weather is good.

Title: Dont waste your time
Text: There is nothing to see, loud music and kiosks with bad food. Dont waste your time and pass by this small town. To make a way from Kandy to Ella with a short stop here is the best solution ;)

Title: Pleasant place for a stroll
Text: This was a nice and clean well tended lake area. We strolled around for about an hour and enjoyed the view. There are a bunch of snack shops and water activities. The only down side is that foreigners are charged a fee (a little over a dollar per person) which seemed unnecessary and opportunistic.

Title: Awesome boat ride
Text: This year very quite, Staff keep the place very tidy and clean. Paid car park but it is good to park on site, lot of beautiful flowers and nice boat ride

Title: Nice, relaxing walk
Text: This is a nice lake to walk around --- it's a deceiving 3.5 miles, but it's a pleasant walk just the same.   A pleasant way to spend an afternoon.  There are a few food stalls near the early part of the walking path (traveling counter-clock), but that's it.  After the first 1/4 or so of the path where there are beautiful flowers and gardens as well as tons of water-driven vendors trying to convince  you to endeavor a rise on one of their various water toys, the rest of the path is peaceful and natural.

Title: Enchanting water body on highest point in Sri Lanka
Text:
We reached here on 29th March, 2022 and were crossing the lake when very soothing music made us stop.  Groups of students were playing very pleasing tunes and were doing a sort of march past for some VIP Guests. We enjoyed their rythemic beats and cool breeze of Nuwara Eliya! 
Next was a boat ride in this lke.  Took a motor boat, which took approx 20+ minutes for SL Rupees 5000/- and it too was a great experience.

Title: Gregory lake,Nuwara eliya
Text: A beautiful lake beneath the hills with lush green surroundings, very tempting for a paddle boat ride.

Title: Nice place, cool and lots of things to do
Text: We were in Nuwara Eliya for one night, we visited the lake and had a boat ride, there are lots of fun thrill seeking activities here.

Title: Good
Text: Good, expensive boating . Foul smelling life jackets. But, took a big round in motor boat. Worth visiting. Nice flowers!

Title: Its ok
Text: Good place to see and playing,boat tours and horse riding but enterance and anything pay, many noice

Title: A Pretty Lake to come with family
Text: This is a pretty lake you can come with your family. There are boat rides for kids and also jet ski for adults. You will be accompanied when you go on a jet ski. Nothing much you can do here, along the park there is a place you can do horse riding. There are a lot eateries nearby.

Title: Usual place
Text:
For European tourists this place is nothing special. Really.
Yes,beautiful view.
And what else?boats?
Water activities? (If you want to use jet ski, it possible only with coach. And for couple its not acceptable??)
Sorry. For us it wasnt so interesting and we were really disappointed. And of course we werent surprised at all. And you need to pay for the entrance, of cause. They have their own parking.
this place needs more restaurants. Normal restaurants. Not only street food(hot dogs and fries)
It needs tasty wine,pastas,seafood etc. combined with embankment view.

But now its only ordinary big lake with cosy villas. Enough.

Title: A pleasant boat ride
Text: Gregory Lake is not a natural lake. It is very large with lovely scenic surrounding. At the main boat house one can hire a motor boat for a ride around the  lake.  Paddle boats are also available. The person manning the boat quite knowledgeable about it history.  Well worth visiting

Title: Great park
Text: A very nice park to visit at nuara eliya. 200 rupees to get in. Beautiful gardens and paths along the lake, perfect for a 2 hours walking tour.

Title: Walking in the rain
Text:
Wonderful lake with bikeroad between multicolor flowers and many water sports. 
I think  a little bit expensive.
Very interesting place for a walk,  you can visit it

Title: Cool park for relax and boat rides
Text:
Wonderful cool park to be visited in nuwaraeliya. Car park ticket is 100/- and entrance is 50/- per local. 
Very cool place.. nice to be with friends and family. Special children. Can rent boats. Jetsky is a awesome experience. For a team its better to get a big boat. 
There are many small shops to buy snaks. Lots of places to get photos too. Well maintain park.

Title: Waste of time
Text:
This lake offers boat trips and jet skiing, their are people offering you their boats etc all around lake. 
However I was not tempted the water is filthy and sewage runs into the water, debris and rubbish thrown into water too 
We paid to enter 500 rupees which is ridiculous as its a lake.  

Dont bother waste of time unless you dont mind entering this type of water.  

We went on not a great day it was drizzling with rain.

Title: Visit to Horton Plains and World end
Text: If you love nature, walking, viewpoints Horton Plains is a good place to visit in Sri Lanka. If you love hiking, there are a few stunning hiking tracks for you to follow. Here you find mountains and plains merge together and come to a sudden stop. Horton Plains National Park is total eye candy for tourists because of its popular landmarks.

Title: Breathtaking views
Text: Its one of the best point of interest if u visiting to nuwara eliya... you can do different kinds of boat rodes from jetski to paddle boats... all types of boats available at this place... must visit place

Title: Beautiful lake
Text: Gregory lake park is a must visit and most prominent attraction in inside Nuwara Eliya. We visited it on a rough windy day so the only option we had was a speed boat. On a calm day therere much more things to do. The park on the sides is a nice one too:

Title: Leisure in NuwaraEliya
Text:
The new look of the lake is really beautiful. It has been nicely landscaped recently. It is really enjoyable to have a walk the evening. Few shops alone the walking Path. You can have a snack.  Very nice flower beds. 

Enjoy your evening walk.

Title: Clean & well maintained
Text: The lake is clean and well maintained. Boating is very expensive and not value for money. Skip it if possible.

Title: Cycling is awesome here
Text: The lake is decent sized along with a cycling track around the lake.. its beautiful.. entry fees is 200 srilankan rupees fr foreigners .. cycles can be rented here as well.. the weather is beautiful and u ll feel super energized after visiting here..

Title: Afternoon walk
Text: A lovely little lake, well worth it if your hotel, like ours is the other side of the lake to the town. However I wouldnt make a specific visit to the lake from the town, you have to pay to walk around it and it is just a lake.

Title: Beutiful
Text: The best place in town, this is amazing lake and looks like straight out from European countries....

Title: Lovely lake
Text: Perfect to walk around, or you can rent a boat or a pedalo. This is truly little England. The houses overlooking the lake testify to that.

Title: Beautiful lake of nurwara eliye
Text:
This is a nice lake to have a walk ..I don't want to recommend you do any horse riding near .it is super over priced they are charging 1500 LKR to 2000 LKR for 10 mins..
Boating is ok .. I would say u can skip this one and do the boating in river safari..which is very  nice .
Boating charges are like 4000 to5000 LKR

Title: Beautiful place
Text: Gregory lake is a beautiful place and offers good options for water sports, this place also has a cafe just in case you feel hungry.

Title: Lovely lake and outlook
Text:
Worth a stroll around this lake. Its a beautiful town this one and would recommend staying here for 1 night only- we caught the train from here to demora which was a unique experience in itself 
The town has a real a British feel to it.
Travellers tip- 
Take warm clothes as its over 2000 metres above sea level

Title: Beautiful park
Text: Beautiful park with nice lake.There. very clean.we had wonderful even hear. Garden was beautiful very nice place.

Title: Boat Rides
Text: Visited september.All visitoes must keep the entrance ticket till you depart by chance you go out and want to come in have to buy another ticket.

Title: Fantastic
Text: Went for an early morning walk as the place was too crowded with school children and their picnic groups. Very peaceful strolling in the morning. Boat realted activities too

Title: Boating at Gregory lake
Text: Our group went to Gregory Lake. We were 17 persons. There is entry of SLR 200 per person for foreigners. We took 2 motor boats for 1/2 hr boating in the lake. Good experience. We had tea there which was very good.

Title: Quaint
Text: Any visit to nuwara elyia must include a strole along this lovely lake with Beaufort backdrops. Plenty of stops for lunch or drinks and not far from town.

Title: Over rated
Text: The costs of boating are over rated. The entrance ticket itself is a rip off. The walk and surrounding is very clean and lively, but not worth the money.

Title: Boat and horse ride
Text: The lake and it's immediate surrounds are very good looking. There are a number of boat companies to select. There is also other entertainment such as the horse ride and a very lovely flower garden.

Title: Beautiful and well maintained lake
Text: It's a beautiful and well maintained . The garden has beautiful variety of flowers it's a good place to spend time and relax

Title: Just a normal lakr
Text: Ridiculous price for foreigners. As most of places in Sri Lanka, they do overcharge tourists! This is only a lake to stroll around and Im pretty sure that back home I saw many places like this or even better for free. The condition is free to everyone (independent of race, gender, age, religion and mainly if you are a foreigner). Its kind of exploration over foreigners. Very sad ! Do not support this activity! You can see from outside!

Title: Must see during your visit to Sri Lanka
Text:
Lake Gregory is a picturesque location in NuwaraEliya hill station. A nice walking track and a park is built around it recently which allows you to enjoy the lake and if your keen to enjoy a boat ride on the cold waters. There are jet skis and fast boats which could be dangerous which I wouldnt recommend. But the normal boats which takes the families and groups up and down are much safer and nicer. 

PS : Try avoiding the month of April as its full of local tourists as its school vacations and true traffic will just frustrate you.

Title: Definitely Little England!!
Text: Such a beautifully stunning place - something like out of a child's story book! Lots going on and happy families around the area. We first took a little kayak in the river and then did horse riding around it. Be weary of the prices from the horse-riders though!

Title: Great place
Text: Gregory lake was situated at the middle of the nuwaraeliya.very nice beautiful place. There have lot of food outlets.Boat ride was superb.

Title: A very wonderful lake

The lake is the middle of the city.. you can rent a boat and take a tour for 25-30 minutes it will cost you 4000 rupies it's fix a price and also you can walk around it. It's a must landmark to visit in nuwara eliya..
