Title: Great place
Text: The kids will love this park, boarding the lake. Plenty to keep them occupied. Beautiful surroundings.

Title: Beautiful lake with some adventure activities.
Text:
If you are sleeping the night, avoid the east end of the lake as amplified prayers and music from the Hindu temple from 5am make a peaceful night's sleep difficult. I used earplugs!
Pretty views though.

Title: Beauty of Nuwaraeliya
Text: The best place to feel the beauty of Nuwaraeliya.Cool breeze flows across the lake gives you a real feel of cool Nuwaraeliya

Title: Interesting
Text: Gregory lake is located at the center of Nuwara Elya , main spot for locals to relax , enjoy boat and jet rides. Was interesting to stroll around and relax after intense sightseeing.

Title: Leisurely stroll
Text:
Enjoyed taking an hour out to have a stroll around the lake in the sunshine. 
An hour was plenty of time to take a walk and grab a cold drink. 
300 rupees each

Title: Nice Place to Visit
Text: A group of us, mixed kiwi and Sri Lankan families visited.  Kids had great fun with the assorted boat rides although a bit pricey.  Had food from the local stalls which was good.  Probably helped having locals to do the talking for us.  Overall a nice afternoon.

Title: Pleasant
Text: This is a decent-sized natural lake. There are lots of options for hiring a boat and puttering around it, or riding a pedalo boat. It was quiet when we were there but I imagine it's pretty busy during peak season.

Title: Good views
Text: Walked along this lake, have some great views of Nuwara Eliya. Could be better maintained with activities like kayaking rather than motor boats..

Title: Just a walk
Text: The lake is nice but nothing really special. There is a park around which is nice to walk through. There are some small boats but I don't recommend you to take it.

Title: Refreshing
Text: Refreshing place, good to spend few hours on the lake and have a trip on a boat cost around 3000 rs,  then have pizza on salmiya which is very near to lake.

Title: Nothing to write home about
Text: We spent an hour or so walking some of the perimeter past numerous speed boats, jet ski and others. A bit overpriced for a speed boat ride and not too many were taking the option. It is pleasant enough to walk and observe the water and distant hills but I wouldnt go out of my way to visit.

Title: Just a walk around a lake, oh yeah and pay 2 dollars here and 2 dollars there
Text: simple lake, maybe takes 2 hours to slowly walk around it, with local food and trinket cart trucks, and you have to pay a small fee at two different locations. If you get bored, skip the lake and walk up the hills into the tea farms, much cooler and more interesting and beautiful.

Title: Pleasant  walk around the lake
Text:
We spend about 40 minutes and walked round the lake. There were boats for hire and also a helicopter ride for about 10 minutes.
Very pleasant.

Title: Nice area but a bit over rated
Text:
Nice Nature , clean but not much to do when i visited few days ago. Helicopter rides were not there, speed boats were not that fast and nothing else to do
Might have spent the night in tea plantations area. Would have been a better choice

Title: Abundance of nature
Text: Its a big lake !! Lots of entertainment along the walkway. Horse ride, boat ride, stalls to eat - fresh potato chips. And if you want to keep healthy, just keep walking - you can burn quite a few calories, without getting bored !! The backdrop of hills and beautiful houses with sloping roofs makes a scenic walk throughout.

Title: Beautiful, scenic lake
Text: Beautiful, scenic lake with great water sports activities that makes for a great place to spend a few hours and click great photographs!

Title: Nice place but entry fee charged...
Text: We spend a couple of hours in the afternoon walking around. We started at a end that didnt have a gate or guards and when we got to the other end the guard came to us and asked us for the ticket in a not friendly manner. We had to pay 300 rupees each to get out, which sounds ridiculous for a public space in the middle of town.

Title: Nice Place to stroll around.
Text: A boat ride in Gregory Lake is pleasure. One can stroll in evening in and around Gregory lake. Good picture perfect location.

Title: Must visit place in Nuwara Eliya
Text:
Lake is clean and lot of food options are there..
If not raining it is a good place to spend 3-4 hours.

Title: Good option on a sunny day
Text:
Hired paddle boats and jet-skis at this location. Reasonable rates, life jackets included.

The lake is quite large, giving ample room for everyone but it appears that things get busy late December onwards due to the influx of holidaymakers.

Title: Pleasant walk
Text:
We walked around the lake in the morning. Its a nice stroll and we were able to spot lots of wildlife. Loads of fish, egret cranes, and we spotted a water monitor.
The road next to it is pretty noisy and of course you have a million tuk tuk drivers offering you the sights for 1000rs
Even a gentleman that pointed out turtles seemed just helpful... Until he mentions his tuk tuk.
Another dance teacher sparked up a conversation, told us we were lucky to be in Kandy because there's a special festival. High up Buddhists and dancers would be there and it's only for tourists, no locals. How lucky to be here on that day! We followed him to see the program, turns out its the cultural show you'll no doubt read about elsewhere... But happens nightly I believe.

Loads of birds on the far side (away from the temple of tooth) and loads of bat's in the trees on the side of the temple.

Nice walk just be prepared to get accosted. Of course!

Title: Noisy!
Text: Not the tranquil walk we expected. Its difficult to take in the lakes beauty without getting distracted by the noisy fuel laden traffic.

Title: Beautiful lake and historic buildings
Text: It is a must because the temple is here, also the museum of World Buddhist , National Museum  and Royal Bath and more. Beautiful shore to stroll on.

Title: Loved it a lake so calm in a very busy city
Text: We walked all around and a local gave us food for the fish so many it was amazing. And like all Sri Lanka people did not want money in return just a beautiful kind gesture

Title: Man made
Text: A beautiful lake that is totally man made we were told. Vendors on the lakeside are selling items that are given as offerings in the nearby temple of the sacred tooth. If you drive up the hill, you get a very good view of not only the lake but of the city as well.

Title: Disappointing experience
Text:
From the the descriptions on here,we were expecting a tranquil stroll around a beautiful lake,Im afraid I was disappointed ,at least half the walk is along a main thoroughfare for traffic in Kandy,with horns sounding and choking fumes and engine noise meters from the pavement,the lake is fairly unremarkable to look at.
There are Ducks and lots of massive carp and we saw an enormous bloated monitor lizard so there is undoubtedly wild life.
I love the outdoors but not an experience I would want to repeat,certainly wouldnt travel far to see it.

Title: Milk lake has green water
Text:
The city of Kandy has some special places to see, but the traffic and the driving, also the engines on busses belching out clouds of thick carciginetic fumes is Horrendous, 
A Tip for all travellers to Kandy Bring a breathing filter mask,

Title: Lovely Artificial Lake
Text:
We visited this lovely artificial lake before we went to the see the Temple of the Tooth.   It was built in 1807 by King Sri Wickrama Rajasinghe and is located next to the Temple of the Tooth.  It has a nice island in the middle that has a garden on it.  

It is lovely to walk around the lake in the evening and there are lots of marble benches that you can use to appreciate the view.

Title: Pleasant paved walk
Text:
A little piece of semi tranquility to walk the approximate 5000 steps around the paved Kandy Lake path.  See many birds, ducks and even a lizard.  

There is a white building along the path that is free admission and offers historical and interesting information of the area.

A must do activity in Kandy, especially if you like walking and photography!  Many marble benches along the way to rest.

Title: Nice scene
Text: Walking during the afternoon around the lake is an impressive feeling. Also you have the opportunity to do some birding, since you are able to see many species of birds, turtles and even fruit-bats hanging from some trees.

Title: AN EASY 40 MINUTE WALK AROUND
Text: The reflections of buildings are of course very nice but the far side was good for being less touristic. The 'Sea of Milk' is an artificial lake, established in 1807. Its circumference is just under 3.25 kilometers. The Temple of the Tooth Relic is just north of the lake; the Queen's Bathing Pavilion, within it. Fishing is banned.

Title: Big Lake. Has Island
Text: Not much happening here. Its a lake with a small island. Best viewed from a high vantage point. Looking at it takes 2 minutes...maybe.

Title: Walking along the lake side
Text: After visiting the Tooth Temple, it is lovely to take a stroll along the lake-side, maybe enjoying some local food to go.

Title: Lake
Text: Beautiful lake with many birds. There is a trail going all around it. Beautiful sunsets. Great place to chill out after seeing other things in the area.

Title: Amazing view...!
Text: This place is the most beautiful place in kandy. If you come to central province,  It's totally worth to come and see here.

Title: Large lake right in the centre of Kandy city, Sri Lanka.
Text:
This is a rather large and long lake right at the centre of a big hill station like Kandy in Sri Lanka.
The lake is long and clean.
We could not see any water sports activities on this water body.
The bunds of the lake are well maintained and clean.
Good place for a leasurely stroll inspite of the busy traffic.
The citizens of the city should be appreciated for keeping this large lake clean and well maintained.

Title: Kandy is beautiful!
Text: Visited the Beautiful Lake and Buddha's Relic Temple nearby. If you love architecture and ancient designs then don't miss this place. Very nicely decorated along with the history.

Title: A popular site
Text: A pleasant focal point in the centre of the city with the complex of buildings that is the Temple of the Tooth and the Palace on one side preventing traffic circumnavigating the whole lake. Nothing exceptional photogenically or architecturally it is just pleasant. In most cities it would be even more striking and welcome amongst an expanse of concrete, but Kandy is so green and tree filled a lake feels quite normal.

Title: Incredibly serene lake in the busy city
Text: Walk around the lake or get a tuk tuk to drive you round it. You can stop to get photos of the birds and see the massive white Buddha up on the hill overlooking Kandy.

Title: Awesome walk full of wildlife!
Text:
We went for a relaxing walk around the lake and wow it was beyond our wildest dreams. Nobody bugging us for money for a start which was good. Although a few tuk tuks tried it when we were near the road.

The wildlife was incredible! Multiple monkey troops, big water monitor lizards, lots of different exotic birds and a huge abundance of fish. We loved our walk around! Also gave us some decent views too!

Title: Lovely lake to take a walk
Text: Had a lovely walk around the lake and spotted plenty of wildlife. Was nice to get away from the busy city for a while

Title: A pleasant walk
Text:
The lake is central to Kandy and worth a walk around if in the city.  As well as beautiful views there are a range of other things to do on the way around including the Tooth Relic Temple and  cultural show. 

A pleasant way to spend an hour or two.

Title: Worth an hour or two
Text: Nice relaxed place in the heart of the city. Wander down to the far end to watch the ducks and fish fight over popcorn

Title: a lake beside the buddha's tooth relic

A visit to the Buddha's tooth relic temple is a must in Kandy and the lake is just besde this lake, flamingo can be seen at this lake. besides, there are several coffee places where you can have your leisure time. I visited back in 2014 but still i am eager to visit

Title: Pleasant area
Text: Good area to relax, feed the fish and birds. There are some stalls along to get refreshments or can get into restaurants.

Title: Kandy Lake
Text: Kandy Lake is situated adjacent to Tooth Temple. Walking path along the side of the temple is there. It is an artifical lake located in the heart of Kandy hill city. Water was there during our visit.

Title: Lake !
Text: Lake is located just beside the royal place and the temple. You will get to see it if you visit the sacred tooth temple.

Title: Excellant Lake
Text: Very beautiful and serene. Well maintained and clean. The las ke is thd heart of this Kandy City. It is sourrended by nice buzzling traffic andvery lively.

Title: Man made Lake

Title: A Nice walk around

Title: Buddha's Lake of compassion
Text:
I was in Kandy for 4 days. Stayed in a hostel near the train station and Kandy Lake is about half an hour walk from the train station. The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic is located at the southern end of the lake. The grand Victorian architectural style colonial Queens Hotel stands robustly opposite the lake.   

Kandy Lake reminded me of Hoan Kiem Lake in Hanoi. It was winter when I visited Hanoi few years back and I enjoyed my stroll around the lake in the comfortably cold weather. When exhaustion set in, I would just relax on the bench at the lakeside admiring the tranquility of the atmosphere. 

But the experience at Kandy Lake was different. The weather was terribly hot and humid in the month of March and the air was still. There were not many benches available and most were fully occupied by the locals. The incessant traffic flow at the northern end of the lake flooded my lungs with much toxic pollutants. It was not a place where you can really appreciate the lake scenery. 

The stretch of the lake near to the temple was much more peaceful as only few vehicles ply this road. While strolling along this stretch of the lake, I was surprised to find a gigantic monitor lizard crawling at one side of the lake. This is my first time seeing such a gigantic lizard emerging out of the water. 

At another corner, oblivious to the curious eyes of the onlookers, few beautiful geese with brightly colored feathers were seen mating and having fun in the water. The long slim legged white cranes hunt for her prey beneath the water surface. It was a fun filled nature world for the birds and animals as they wandered freely in their natural instinct at the lake side. 

As I passed the Temple of the Tooth Relics, I could see flock of devotees carrying bouquet of flowers in their hands climbing up the stairs into the temple halls. As dusk slowly crept in, the lake view became dim while the neon lights in the temple shone brilliantly out and brighten one end of the lake. 

This was Buddha's Lake of compassion. The fishes, the monitor lizards, the cranes, the geese and whatever form of lives on top or beneath the lake are well protected in this land of the Buddha. That makes Kandy Lake different from West Lake, Sun Moon Lake, Hoan Kiem Lake, Houhai, Xihai and the rest of the lakes.  

As I walked my way to my hostel, the quotes of Buddha resonates in my mind:

'Besides the respect of the lives of human beings, all the animals and plants should be on the list too. That is the real humanitarianism.'

Title: Wildlife
Text: We saw many varieties of birds around here. We also saw monitors, turtles. Water snakes and fish. It is probably best to wear mosquito repelant for an evening visit.

Title: An oasis in the concrete jungle
Text: Such an amazing relief in Kandy....to see water; unfortunately, not available for the public...no swimming, fishing etc.  Its the private property of the King and his family.  But nice to look at.

Title: It's alright. Nothing special.
Text:
It's just like any other lake. Although they have made a sidewalk around it so you can take a stroll in the evening or after dinner. There are also benches around the sidewalk. In the morning and the afternoon this sidewalk is always busy and crowded because of people coming to visit the tooth relic temple which is adjacent to the lake.

It's better to go there during sunset or after the temple is closed. It's more quiet then and you will be able to appreciate the beauty of Kandy much more.

Title: Huge man made lake
Text:
It is impossible old not to come across kandy lake while travelling around.  The lake is very big and I was informed that it was man made.

It used to be paddy fields but was remade for the previous king for leisure and views.

There are lots of fish in the lake too

Title: Sea of Milk
Text: The lake is also known as Kiri Muhuda, the Sea of Milk; an artificial lake in the heart of the city. It was built in 1807 by King Sri Wickrama Rajasinghe but apparently has been progressively reduced to its current area of 19ha. The little island once housed the king's personal harem. The British put it to more practical use as an ammunition store and added the fortified wall to the perimeter. Nice area to enjoy a stroll or just sit and enjoy the views of the lake.

Title: Nice lake
Text: Romantic place in Kandy, nice town in Sri Lanka. Nice walking around lake. Beautiful view of sunset.

Title: An oasis in the middle of town
Text: A calm expanse of water in the middle of the historic town and surrounded by green hillsides dotted with buildings of all shapes and sizes, the lake is an extensive tree lined oasis but regrettably not very peaceful as it is surrounded by busy traffic.

Title: Nice and calm
Text: Walk around lake is calm and nice. Lot of ducks and monkeys. Fence could be cleaner (lot of poop!). Big children playground on the east side of the lake.

Title: Lake
Text: This is one of the main tourist attraction here. There are lots of people here. A photo opportunity.

Title: Beautiful Lake
Text: Very nice and tranqui when take a walk on the path built around the lake. A place must be if you are in kandy and it won't disappoint you.

Title: Nice lake in the city

I know what I am talking. We also have a "lake" in the middle of the City. However, there is more or less a big street on the river Side. Nevertheless the view from the end to the city is Beautiful
Open your Eyes, there is wild life, like lizards,  kindlicher, Turtle and many more

Title: Serene and Lovely.
Text: Just sitting beside the lake relaxed me. The evening was was quiet. The lake is big and lovely with seating arrangements. Please carry mosquito repellent wherever you have to visit any outdoor location in Sri Lanka.

Text: We had a nice walk by the lake, enjoying the natural scenery and the fairly abundant wildlife of numerous types of birds, some type of lizard which was a little over a metre in length, a few wild peacocks, and other bird varieties.

Title: Very scenic place..
Text: Walkinig around the lake in the evening is a great experience. Its a gem of   Kandy's noisy surroundings!

Text: Despite the ducks; the monitor lizards and the monkeys we saw we also saw lots of dead fish and an abundance of plastic and waste!

Title: Walk around the lake
Text: The walk around the lake, youre sandwiched between the lake and traffic. But some of the views are amazing and you see fish, birds, large lizards, its a fun hour or two.

Title: Beautiful lake but nothing to do here
Text: We walked around part of the lake but you cannot walk all the way around.  From a viewpoint above the city it looks lovely , calm and peaceful but other than a quiet haven there is no lake side features, nor can you swim here or any other pleasure activities it is just a body of water in the middle of the city that looks nice and stops people building here..

Title: Too much pollution
Text: Kandy is beautiful city with lots of cultures but the heavy traffic not only make it a very hectic place, but also a very polluted one. Whilst walking around the lake, I didnt find it relaxing at all with all the honking, traffic and also fumes. The cars and buses are pretty old and the exhaust gas is purely toxic

Title: Little walk
Text: We walked alongside before we visiting the temple of tooth, not great as expected and could be maintained better for the city. Nothing really excited here

Title: Pleasant stroll

Title: Pleasant Walk

Title: It's a lake

Title: not impressive
Text: The water of this lake didnt look particularly nice as I walked around. Maybe the reason I didnt live the lake was because construction work was being done on several areas of the walkways.

Title: Nice lake

Title: Beautiful and clean
Text: Beautiful and clean so many fishes ducks and birds you can feed them too.. :) you can buy popcorns for them :) its so fun to do

Title: Tranquil setting

The lake is a serene environment near the temple of the tooth and museum. 
Has vendors selling refreshments and beautiful lotus flowers
A beautiful place to just sit and watch the ducks and feed the fish

Title: Too busy
Text:
Kandy lake in front of queens hotel ( named after HMs visit  in 1954 ) is man made and very well kept . It has a healthy breeze that keeps one feeling so comfortable to just sit and enjoy the beautiful scenery around it .
Note : Ever since the blowing up event during the civil unrest the usual road that is used for vehicles has been closed , causing all vehicles to circumnavigate the lake and cause very bad traffic jams frustrating all drivers . It was not a very good experience - Something has to be done to ease this nightmare

Title: Big renovation
Text: We walked up and down the lake every day because to our fortune our B&B was on the other side. Theres loads of work being done all around the sides, new footpaths being laid and painting. The guys and girls doing this work are doing a great job, areas that we walked past on the first day were finished by the second day. Id love to come back next year to see the transformation!

Title: A nice-ish walk in a busy city
Text: Kandy is a busy city, and regardless of which direction you come in from you'll find a bit chaotic compared to wherever you spent the previous night!  The lake is a slight distraction from that (but only slight, as there's a busy road alongside half of it!)  The walk around is not long, and right now is slightly challenging as they seem to be replacing most of the footpaths on north side if the lake, but get past that and take your time and you might get the opportunity to see a bit of wildlife.  We meandered round and saw plenty of birdlife - including a kingfisher catching fish and insects - plus aquatic monitor lizards, a few turtles, and the ubiquitous fish that inhabit the lake.  OK, it's an artificial lake, and the bustling traffic kill the peacefulness around the south of the lake, but it's free and if you take your time and keep your eyes open it can be a nice distraction from the madness of the city.

Title: Small and underwhelming.
Text: We drove around a large part of the lake during a stopover and found it to be unappealing particular to walk around as the pathways were being repaired forcing pedestrians to walk on a very busy road. The surrounding guest houses offer great views over the lake but I wouldn't make specific  trip to go I'm afraid.

Title: Well it is a lake in a city
Text: The lake is stunning. Find a quiet spot and enjoy it. The night time views and sun sets across the water are worth the trip. For me kandy has little to off except for the lake views.

Title: You'll be surprised at what you'll see

Title: very beautiful
Text: nice and good feeling walking around the lake.i like there so much .near landmarks shopping mall and bazar .

Title: A hand full if nature in the city

Within 5 minutes, cormorants, pelicans, gooth, herons and about 10 other species I don't know the name, flying foxes, varans, many fish, chipmunks, dogs and beautiful trees. Title: An oasis of quiet
Text: You can walk around much of the lake and see lots of fish in it. It makes a leg stretch from the bustling town

Title: Great for a morning walk

Title: Its a lake!
Text:
In fairness, its lovely to walk around a peaceful lake but theres a lot of work going on around it at the moment. 

The Tooth shrine side of the lake is the most peaceful as theres no vehicles but they are currently re-paving it to make it better.  Still accessible but a bit scrappy and bumpy in places

Title: Beautiful lake

Title: Beautiful by day ... but BEWARE
Text:
... by night. Do not go on the left side (coming / looking from the city center). Sometimes there are some locals sitting at the end of the lake, near to the garden cafe, and drink alcohol. Its a dark part of the walk and we had a very unpleasant situation there: a heavy drunk guy was trying to grab and touch my wife. He was rude and not going away and not scared by me, 190cm male. Even when we tried to walk away fast, he was following us and run after us. 
Luckily in the last second some helpful others locals jumped of their cars and scooters and helped, protected us. They also guided us the next 200m and picked us a safe tuktuk home. Thank you for that!!!

Title: Beautiful Lake
Text: It is a vast lake in the middle of the City which enhances the beauty of the City and the temple complex. A treat to watch.

Title: Refreshing breeze by the lake

Title: Main Kandy area
Text: Its a lake. Long enough around for a nice walk under the trees and a pleasant views of the place.... leads you into the main market area and bus station...

Title: Centre point of Kandy

Title: Okayish lake like any other hill lakes.
Text:
Man made lake with lot of fishes, 4-5 water monitor lizard and some birds.

Nothing special about it. 

This does not give any reason to come to Kandy. Absolutely avoidable.

Title: Beautiful
Text:
A stunning, stunning view and walk around the lake. Its peaceful, beautiful and tranquil. 

Definitely my favourite thing during my 2 days in Kandy.

Title: Divine kandy lake
Text: This is worth visiting for its beautiful,elongated,tortuous disposition.The surrounding nature is just awesome and will leave you spell bound.You can also enjoy boating here

Title: Spoilt by pavement restoration.
Text: We walked the entire circumference of the lake which would have been a pleasant experience had we not had to negotiate missing pavement sets, heaps of sand and rubble and piles of stacked concrete blocks and sets. Work on the pavements was being undertaken by a handful of workers who didn't seem to be in much of a rush. Care needed if you plan to walk.

Title: Best view of the lake is from the viewpoint
Text: Best view of the lake is from the viewpoint where its beauty can really be appreciated .In early Feb they were remaking the walkway around the lake ,which although walkable was not as attractive as it will be .Sadly the walk is spoilt by the busy road noise .

Title: Pleasant evening walk around the lake
Text: The walk around the busy Kandy Lake will take 45 minutes or so. There are a number of interesting birds to see, including spot-billed pelican, Indian pond heron, little cormorant, black-capped night Heron and various egrets. While we were there we saw a brahminy kite swoop down and take a fish from the lake. There was a lot of works taking place to repair the path around the lake but this didnt spoil the walk.

One of the most beautiful city in the world, I could say kandy city has a green beauti. I loved this place, when I was little I used to walked around the lake, becz of that view and natural winds. When ever I visit Sri Lanka ???? never forget to visit this Small lake.

Title: Beautiful lake in the centre of Kandy
Text: Our hotel was situated right on the lake and we enjoyed walking around it. The lake looks beautiful but unfortunately there is some building work being carried out on the paths around it which were a little annoying as you had to walk in the road. But overall a really lovely lake with wildlife like ducks, large lizards, tortoise, birds, monkeys etc surrounding it

Title: Pleasent
Text: Nice lake located in the city center of Kandy. We walked through the promenade (which was in modernization at the time of the visit) and we enjoyed views towards the city and the Temple. We did not like that there are many touts trying to sell you different things and are being quite pushy.

Title: Nice quiet
Text: fun for walk serene worth the walk. we walked everyday. clean safe  area.Center town   worth  going  Not far are arts centers for 5 pm shows 1000 rupees  its ok to go.

Title: Serene and spotless
Text: Definitely the best lake I have seen in Asia. Covers a wide expanse and seems spotlessly clean and limpid. Do schedule atleast a half hour walk around part of the lake.

Title: 5km Walk.
Text:
Nice to walk around. 
In the evening avoid trees, to many birds. ??. 
Relaxing and peace. 
You can feed the fish.

Title: Peaceful, calm lake with busy surroundings
Text: Get away from the hustle and bustle of a busy city like kAndy to the centre where we bought popcorn and fed the fish in the lake as well as some rather large lizzards

Title: Nice Place to Walk
Text:
There are few places to walk in Sri Lanka, unharrassed by traffic. This is one of them. You may have the noise of traffic 3/4 of the route, but at least you can walk safely. 
There are mature trees dipping into the water, views of Tooth Temple, some shade.
We saw a large monitor right between the path and the lake.

Title: Work in Progress
Text:
Kandy Lake is a pleasant place and an hours walk round. However they are currently laying new paving slabs on the pavements. The workmen are considerate and stop mixing up the sand and cement while you pass. The diversions are generally marked but not the best. 
In summary still a good walk but watch out you dont trip up.

Title: Its a Lake!
Text: Very green and appears unsavoury nice walk around edge. Use path to get to Cultural Centre and Kandy Dancing.

Title: Very nice scenic walk
Text: The lake is very nice and although the water is merky there's not much rubbish in it. Lots of wildlife in the water, we saw what looked like a big lizard/ comodo dragon, a few ducks and lots of fish. Very nice walk.

Title: We saw turtles, fish and iguana
Text: Walking around the lake is a pleasant outing.  Plenty to see. Currently pavements being repaired so walking a night can be hazardous without a torch!

Title: Tranquil , beautiful.
Text:
A man - made lake in the heart of the city- what's  not to like  ? With teeming fish - filled water and all manner of birds the lake is a great  place to go for a relaxing walk & to take in the views.
However,  to avoid the pollution from the city  traffic it is advisable to walk on the side nearest the Temple  of the  sacred tooth. 
Highly  recommended .

Title: Set directly next to the Temple of the tooth relic
Text: The lake has a 4km walking/ bikin path to go around. On not too hot days it can be a nice walk after visiting the famous landmark

Title: Interesting walk
Text: It is a good walk somewhat spoilt by the busy traffic. Improvements are being made to the footpath but this is causing more disruption at the moment. Worth doing to see the large water monitor lizards, which are very impressive and about 6ft long, and the turtles. Had hoped to find a cafe somewhere by the lake but none to be seen.

Title: Pretty lake, nice walk
Text: Very pretty lake in the centre of the city. Lovely to have a walk around it, as an activity as you aclimitise yourself to the city. Would recommend doing this on your first day. The is pavement all the way around so you can walk safely. Busy traffic around some of it, but you also pass by the red cross building where the Kandyan dancing is, the temple of the sacred tooth and the royal palace.

Title: It is a lovely lake.
Text: Nothing much to say. Pelicans, ducks and lizards with the temple view. One of the few places in Sri Lanka with pavements

Title: Nice lake
Text: Lovely walk round lake, lots of duck and birds to watch also some lotus flowers. Nice way to pass an hour or two whilst in kandy

Title: Normal lake
Text:
I didnt see anything interesting in the lake 
We reached on Sunday and many local were there 
Water  activities are very simple and not much interesting

Title: Beautiful
Text: Traveling to Kandy is always a joyful thing. Kandy Lake is one of the best thing to see in this small town. Very peaceful area.

Title: Overrated
Text: Man made lake. Nothing nice to look at at all. Surrounding by tall ugly run down buildings and horrendous traffic and pollution. Sri Lanka is currently overrated and Im really really disappointed to be spending a month here.

Title: Beautiful lake for a walk around
Text: This lake is very scenic, but also in a busy area, you can walk around the lake in about 40-60 minutes. However as a solo female traveller you may get pestered a lot by Sri Lankan males trying to sell you taxis or tickets to attractions. There are turtles and fish in the lake which is nice to see. It's nice to in the evening before sunset.

Title: A must to visit
Text:
Very beautiful surroundings of wildlife on the lake, can be seen via the boat ride around,
Close to the tooth temple.
The journey to the lake however may take a while during rush hours as traffic moves very slow.
However worth the travel.

Title: Definitely must visit
Text: It's very big. You can either enjoy a walk around it or take a tuk tuk ride and see it all. It offers really good views.

Title: Traffic and Mask
Text:
Awesome place....great to walk. 
Lot of traffic ongoing all the time (trust me, we left at 630am once to reach Lake at 7am...and it was STILL polluted) 

Put on a mask for my own health, of course....loved my walk...some local walked up to me, shouted vulgarities and said things like "you come to my country, you wear mask" of course I took it off immediately, fearing my own life.

Lots of harassment along the Lake. Authorities doing absolutely NOTHING to stop touters from teeming the peripheral...mostly harmless. But yes, wished I could show the video but...there was one instance where someone shouted vulgarities because we didnt get into his tuk tuk.

Laugh out Loud.

Title: Take a walk around This beauty
Text: The lake in Kandy is huge. We took a stroll around it on our first day here and it was beautiful. We did end up going off down side streets and then back to the lake again which helped us to get to see lots of Kandy town.

Title: Lake in the middle of the city
Text: The Lake is right in the middle of the city and you will pass by it as you criss cross the town sightseeing. There is a nice pathway all along the lake for those interested to walk along it. An early morning walk along the lake is really refreshing. The lake is right next to the Temple of the relic and other sightseeing places. There are large fish in the lake and people feed these fish for prosperity as it is near the temple. During the Perahera time the lake and a small island in the middle of the lake are lit up at nights and the view is beautiful. There are no boat rides in this lake. All around the lake are places to sit and enjoy the tranquil view.

Title: Stunning lake for a beautiful walk
Text:
A really really beautiful lake and one to appreciate.

The city circles this lake so it's something you cant miss when in Kandy.

The lake is calming and it appears there are even boat trips possible from here which is a nice touch. Not sure how much this costs but being a touristy place I would expect UK sorts of prices for boat rides.

We took a walk around the lake when we had some spare time and being so close to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic just added to the feeling you get appreciating the sights and sounds.

Title: Beautiful from a distance
Text:
The lake is beautiful from a distance, up close you can only walk round part of the lake which is right on the road and noisy.

There are a lot of fish which people feed and we saw a tortoise. 

Not all the the lake is pretty.

Title: Lovely
Text:
A Beautiful man made Lake...thats what our guide told us. Looks Amazing with a beautiful hill side on one side and in the heart of the city.

Go to the view point on top of the hill to get a better view of the lake n the city 2.

Title: Very beautiful in Kandy
Text:
I was visited Kandy with my family and stayed time passing neer at lake boundary. Obviously very beautiful and visit leasure time. 
Kandy lake  is an artificial lake in the heart of the hill city of Kandy, Sri Lanka, built in 1807 by KingSri Wickram Rajasinghe next to the Temple of the Tooth. Over the years, it was reduced in size. It is a protected lake, with fishing banned. There are many legends and folklore regarding the lake. One such is that the small island at its center was used by the king's helm for bathing and was connected to the palace by secret tunnel.

Title: Nice enough lake
Text:
Took a tour of the lake in a boat. The tour itself was pleasant enough but the driver of the boat was a complete nightmare. In the 20 minute tour he must have asked for a tip 15 times, completely spoiling the trip.

The lake itself is nice enough and you can see some wildlife but nothing overly special.

Title: Kandy lake boat tour
Text: We took a boat tour which we were told would be around 40 minutes but only lasted 20 minutes. It was still a good way to see various sights from a different angle. We also saw a lot of wildlife including various birds, bats and water monitors. Best done early in the morning to avoid the mid day heat and the crowds. If you have the time you may get more out of walking around the lake rather than by boat.

Title: Serene
Text: Lake is serene. Beautiful ducks around. City is just built around it. Basically you can access entire city from this place.....................................

Title: Where Queens & Mistress Took Bath
Text:
one of the nicest things to do in Kandy is walking around this beautiful artificial lake, often called as Kiri Muhuda or the sea of milk. another way of enjoying this lake is by boat. the majority part used to be paddy fields and transformed by King Sri Wickrama Rajasinha to be total lake of 19ha in 1807, with more than 3 km circle. in one of the lake side, now used as police station, used to be the Queens & mistress bathing pavilion. the lake becomes more beautiful when the sun goes down, where the lights from surrounding building reflecting the water. if ure lucky, you might witness some big monitor lizards. 

there is a nice buffet resto (upper floor of mall) in front police station with great view facing to the lake.

Title: NICE
Text: Realy nice place and very romantic...I with me husband we wandered around the lake. Very interesting ,instead of another world.Very nice see dis place and also ant sity Kandy very nice....

Title: Nice lake
Text: Lovely lake but spectacular at night. Work in progress to make a great walk way will make this lake more appealing.

Title: Nice lake in the Centre of Kandy
Text: We stayed opposite the lake and enjoyed walking around the lake each day into the shops and restaurants. There was nothing happening on the lake. Nice views and calming after the hectic streets! Watch the paths, it is easy to trip!

Title: Smaller than expected,
Text: A very pleasant and quiet pretty lake set in the chaos of Kandy! It was a lot smaller than we imagined. Lake Geneva it is not. We saw the odd boater but the lake really did not look big enough or tranquil enough to entice us on to the water. It is the focus in Kandy and Kandy itself is a must visit when in Sri Lanka.

Title: Time to relax
Text: Pleasant area to walk along side the lake ( you can't walk all the way around.),  At one end of the lake you can buy fish food to feed the many quite large fish, there is also street entertainment., Snake charmer etc. At the other end of the lake are a few floating gardens where we saw an alligator about half a metre long ,( or crocodile ) resting amongst the canna lilies.

Title: Go for a stroll
Text: You have to stroll around the lake - it is a classic Kandy experience.  See the sights, take some pictures of the monkeys and the birds.  Good way to spend an hour at sunset or early in the morning  - these times give you the best light for photos.

Title: Train rickets
Text:
Dont buy tickets for the train in advance but go to the train station. Selling traintickets is like a national scam. They sell you a ticket from Kandy to Ella for $30 pp first or second class!
When you have the ticket it turns out to be third class. The real price is 300 to 400 rupies and that is 3 to 4 dollar!

Title: Nice walk, but nothing impressive
Text: The walk around the lake was nice, but the noise from the traffic and constant honking from the cars made that walk less pleasant. The view was pleasant, but it is nothing really impressive, and i would not consider it to be something to travel for.

Title: Its Just A Lake
Text: Kandy Lake is exactly that, its a Lake in the middle of town with an island in the middle. Fruit and food sellers all round the outside.

Title: The traffic really takes away from the experience
Text:
Beautiful lake. Masses of fish: catfish and carp. Giant monitor lizards bask round the edge.
There is a lot of traffic tho.
Walking in the dark, you will find it badly lit.
Watch out for night herons and bats

Title: Lake
Text: This is a beautiful lake in the city centre. A good place to spend time enjoying the view.You can just hang around here.

Title: Lovely walk
Text: We enjoyed walking around the lake. Lovely bird life and serene setting. We met some nice Sri Lankan locals and ended up doing dinner with them at a local restaurant on the lake

Title: Serenity in busy Kandy
Text: What a great decision made by the forward thinking overseers of Kandy to  sacrifice some rice paddies to create this beautiful centrepiece for the city. Walk the circumference. Feed the fish. Sit and contemplate. Whatever the activity, time will be well spent here.

Title: Nice view around the lake with lots of birds
Text: Definitely go for boating in Kandy lake. U can spot a lot of different kinds of birds while boating. The views all around are magnificent giving u enough opportunity for nice pictures to take back home. The famous temple of the tooth sits just beside the lake.

Title: Noisy walk around a filthy lake!
Text: Fun to see large water monitor lizards and birds fishing,  a tiny part is off the main road. Not fun to see stacks of fish struggling for oxygen in the rancid water! Maybe stop throwing all your rubbish in here. Great shame, could be so different.

Title: Beautiful lake in Centre of City
Text: This is an artificial lake built by the last king of Sri Lanka. It is located in the Centre of City. It is also called Milky Ocean. It is most regarded sight in the country. Despite the location of this lake in the city centre It makes for a wonderful stroll.

Title: A serene place to spend the evening
Text: Centrally located visible from everywhere and a lovely place to walk n spend the evening. It's near too the Kandy railway station and many restaurants

Title: Lovely lake except for the traffic
Text: Kandy Lake is a lovely lake where you can buy food and feed the fish however it is surrounded by busy roads with cars and buses that love using their horns! So this impacts on your enjoyment as you walk around the lake.

Title: Its a time filler and a spot to relax
Text: Just nice to sit by the water and relax- noting special but we needed it after a gruelling and intense car drive from Colombo

Title: It's a lake
Text:
We visited the lake soon after arriving in Kandy. It's nice to walk along and is quite pretty. There are boats you can hire to take you around the lake.
If you're in the area then take a look.

Title: Lovely setting
Text: Our hotel was on the lake. It took us about 30 minutes to walk to the city centre. The walk was a very pleasant one because of the lake. What a lovely centre piece of Kandy!

Title: Lovely Oasis
Text: The lake is situated in the middle of the city and adds some calmness to the hustle and bustle surrounding it. We found some interesting bird life, great photo opportunities and just enjoyed walking around taking in the local atmosphere and enjoying the friendliness of the locals

Title: Beautiful Lake
Text: It is a huge asset for a City to have such a lovely lake. Its a nice lake to walk around with plenty of birds, creatures and fish. The walkways are good and safe.

Title: Good view
Text: The nicest thing in kandy city centre. But nothing that spectacular. They try to keep it clean though.

Title: Kandy
Text:
Beautiful kandy with awesome weather.
The most beautiful thing about this place is the kandy lake and the greenery hilly roads.

Title: Beautiful
Text: A large lake in the center of city... The temple is situated next to this lake only. You can go for boating in the lake...

Title: Beauty of Kandy
Text:
Kandy lake is liked to the history of Kandy city.  The island at the center and the boart yard gives a added beauty 
Helping by staying next to the temple to keeps the place  cool 
Night time its a paradise with the lights on
But when you walk in the evening whack the 10000 of crows on the trees
You may get a free spray from them ????????????
Walk around the lake in the evening gives you the best relaxing feeling 
If you have time take some bread or biscuits , throw in to lake bit by bit
What he 1000 of fish rushing for food

Title: Its a lake!
Text: A picturesque lake in the centre of Kandy flanked by the Temple of the Tooth on one side and hills around the others. Nice to walk around but the traffic noise does rather spoil the area.

Title: The Prestigious Kandy Lake
Text: The kandy lake is located at the center of kandy and is quite interesting, there are many wildlife around this area including exotic birds,turtles,lizards as well as pelicans.The lake is a great place for a walk or a jog as well.All around the whole area is quite breathtaking.

Title: Pretty lake
Text:
Nice place in tropical Kandy.
Good for a walk or watch the wildlife (fish, birds etc.)
Most of the main attractions in Kandy are around the lake so this is the heart of the town (former royal capital).

Title: A lake
Text:
A nice walk around if you want a stroll.
There are many animals along the way. We spotted turtles, fish, some massive lizard and a pelican.

Title: Nice walk around the man made lake in Kandy
Text: Walking around the lake is a must do activity if you are visiting Kandy. There are always local families enjoying the area. It takes about an hour with a flat and well groomed walkway.

Title: Its a lake.  With water in it.  And its kinda round.
Text: Yep. Its a lake.  I didnt really see much special about it. You can go on a boat. Not much else.  You can walk around it - but theres really not much point in it. Theres a small shopping mall near it.  And some shops.  And the temple of the tooth relic.  Other than that its just a small lake.

Title: nice to walk around and view birds, monitors, turtles
Text: noisy but nice especially in the later afternoon hours - great place to jog because shade and windy.

Title: Lovely lake in the town center
Text: Amazing lake right at town center. Makes the whole Kandy town very quaint and blends with the whole colonial feel

Title: Boat trip along the river
Text: 2000 rupees for a 15 minute boat trip lapping around the lake we felt was good value for money. We were fortunate to be in Kandy on a very warm day which made the boat ride all the more pleasant. Good for wildlife observation and the whistle stop by boat of all the main sites of wonderful Kandy!

Title: Nice walk around the lake.
Text:
We enjoyed a "peaceful" walk around the lake.
There are still a lot of traffic noise but the pavement is in pretty good condition so you can go along in your own pace and enjoy.

Title: Nice lake, with lovely forest around
Text: Lake is a place which is hard not to see during your stay in Kandy. Best is to go to one of the hills around it and watch it from top surrounded by lovely forests

Title: A tranquil view
Text: A place to relax after walking in the city center amidst many locals and tourist, Kandy Lake is strategically located. One can take photos at different areas.

Title: Nice walk
Text: Nice just to take a small walk and contemplate the multicultural city. Where different families, religions and tourists walk around just to enjoy the breeze of the lake.

Title: Clean and well maintained Lake bang opposite the temple of relics
Text: The lake is quite big and is situated in the heart of the city opposite the Temple of the Sacred Relics of Buddha.  We could see boating too on the lake however we didn't explore that possibility.

Title: nice views
Text: fishing is banned in the lake so it has a vast array of fish which boil over in teh early evening, with many fruit bats and other wildlife a stroll around the lake in teh early evening is a great way to spend a couple of hours

Title: Work in progress
Text: Kandy lake is a lovely place to walk around And take time out from the super busy nature of Kandy city itself. At present there is quite a lot of work being done on the walkways around the lake and when completed it was make the walk even better, however at present you have to watch your step on occasion. Star off for this! I would recommend a visit!

Title: Walk around
Text:
Lovely to see the lake Kandy embedded in the city..
The best view is from the south Side of the lake - going up to one of the hotels and see also the temple mirroring in the lake..

Title: Nice for a walk.
Text: Nice enough for a walk around. We went during dusk and it's plesent enough. It is close to the road tho so don't expect a quite walk.

Title: Vacation
Text: What an absolutely beautiful lake. Kandy is up dating the sidewalks around the lake for better hiking and walking. This is really a stunning lake.

Title: Beautiful but ruined by traffic
Text: So many birds, tons of fish, Asian water monitors and so much more. The lake is beautiful and a joy to walk round but Kandy traffic is getting worse every year so walk is accompanied by roar of buses, loud constant horns and pollution. We have decided this is last time in Kandy as it will only get even more terrible each year. It could be a real gem but until the local council start forward planning and acting it will continue in its spiral downwards.

Title: Beautiful lake
Text: Beautiful, peaceful lake, with calm, rippling waters. A good walk or drive around. Saw a huge monitor lizard resting by the lakeside.

Title: Just lake
Text: why not to see it if it's so close ;) Otherwise don't expect any special excitement - view over Kandy is ok

Title: Nice walk around the lake
Text: It is a nice walk around the lake. One side of the lake is the temple of the tooth relic and the garrison cemetery. From the other side, you can go to the Kandy city viewpoint. If you like walking, it is a nice place to walk around or even sit on one of the benches and observe locals and tourists go about their things.

Title: Its a lake in town!
Text: Yes its a lake, we walked around it which was pleasant enough. I guess having a lake in the middle of the town is neat.

Title: Cool and peaceful
Text: My wife and I walked around part of the lake under trees and watched the birds after a busy day touring Kandy and found it cool and peaceful away from the traffic.

Title: Middle of town
Text: The Lake gives a nice break in the middle of the city and provides a calming sense in the hustle and bustle of city traffic.

Title: wow
Text:
No entry fees
You will get to see a lot of Fish in the lake.
lot of Ducks, Turkeys are all around the lake. sun set view is amazing.

Title: Lovely lake
Text: Really pretty lake forming the centrepiece to the city. The top shore (Temple of Tooth side) is pedestrianised and peaceful whilst the bottom shore is utterly chaotic with traffic. Look out for the monitor lizards, like small dinosaurs!

Title: What a beauty!
Text: This is a pretty, and magical spot. Just off a busy road, you'd think that would affect it, but the beauty and majesty  made it a place of solitude, almost. We had a lovely walk around it, and a boat trip,which gave differing views and atmosphere, we wandered past the bath house and alongside the temple of the tooth. This is a beautiful spot with a vast array of wildlife and flora.

Title: Beautiful
Text: This is a beautiful manmade lake which you can walk over the bridge and admire its beautiffully. There you can see many families to have a time off to see the lake. I recommend walking on its sure when possible specially at the sunset

Title: Beautiful, and easy to walk around
Text: Take a walk around the entire lake. It is not that far. I suggest you go during the daylight hours as birds roost in the trees at night and you may get an unwelcome deposit. It is a beautiful walk.

Title: Great for a stroll or even a run
Text:
Kandy Lake is a prominent feature within the city and provides a lovely foreground for photographing the Temple of the Tooth Relic. A stroll around the banks of the lakes is a must when in Kandy - there are plenty of ducks and geese on the lake, as well as water monitors. Pretty much wherever you are on the lake you get a great view of the temple.

It also provides a pretty good option for a short, flat run - it's less than 3km all the way round and you get some lovely views around. There weren't too many people on the pavement to get in your way either.

Title: Artificial lake
Text:
Kandy Lake, also known as Sea of Milk, is an artificial lake in the heart of the city, close to the Temple of Relic Tooth.

The Kandy Lake is a nice place for a stroll or a jog while fishing is banned.

Title: It's an impressive man-made lake with an impressive cloud wall
Text: The lake on which the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic stands, is a man-made lakes built by one of their Kings.  Either go to the Kandy City viewpoint and get an overview or wander along part of the lake and have a look at the cloud wall.

Title: A Kandy highlight
Text: Very pleasant lake to walk around, slightly away from the hustle and bustle of Kandy city centre. Lots of wildlife, especially birds and lizards. A must do.

Title: Nice to be viewed from view point
Text: It is very pretty lake..we went at top and then took pictures from upper Lake also known as Kandy view point..

Title: To crowded
Text: Nothing special, having seen other lakes. Too much traffic, noisy and polluted. Was not worth to spend a day here.

Title: Centre of Kandy
Text:
This beautiful expanse of water is charming and peaceful. It is actually an artificial lake built in the early 1800s, by the royals of the time, apparently those that objected to working on the project, were impaled at the lake bed, (gory indeed), as told by our guide. 

The relic of Buddhas tooth has pride of place near the lake, also to get a full appreciation of the lake and surrounds, be sure to visit the Kandy view point (see review). A wonderful place to spend a couple of days at, staying near the lake.

Title: Signs of inprovement
Text: There was evidence of an amount of development work taking place around the pathway that goes around the lake. The walk around the lake is quite easy and will take about an hour without much struggle. There is white concrete fencing that remains under plastic but may add some value to the site once the covers are removed. Work on the path is also being undertaken. What the walk does allow for is glimpses of the Temple of the Tooth and in the right light, reflections of the gold  temple roof bouncing off the water. While it is still a pleasant walk there is some hope that the government will ensure it will be further improved.

Title: nice...
Text: It's a nice and serene lake and kept quite clean too....it's visible from all different corners of the town and we happened to see a dance performance on 1 side during 1 evening too!!

Title: Nice view
Text: A nice lake, looks the best from the nearby hill view. Definitely worth to visit the neighbouring Temple of the Tooth.

Title: Picturesque Lake
Text: The lake in Kandy is really pretty. We took some time to walk around the lake area and enjoy the view. It was a nice reprieve from the touristy stops in Kandy.

Title: Nice Lake
Text: Nice lake in the center of the city, near The Temple of the Tooth Relic. Walk around the lake, you can see birds, monkeys, various fish.

Title: Great Stroll...
Text: We really enjoyed strolling along the lake, as it was gorgeous especially at sundown. Beautiful architecture all around, and a ton of beautiful birds all around!

Title: Green grey expanse of merky water
Text: Thought that Mrs Johnson and I would walk around the lake after lunch. Arrived and thought better of it. It is not particularly inspiring and we were tight on time, the hotel pool was much more inviting.

Title: Give a walk around the lake a miss
Text:
Went for a walk around the lake with my wife. 

Kandy Lake should be quite a peaceful experience but is badly let down by excessive traffic and pollution from buses and tuk-tuks.

I'd say give the walk a miss until its gentrified and a car bypass is built.

Title: Small lake in a busy setting
Text: The lake is not very big. The roads around are v busy. If u are looking for peace n quite, so somewhere else! Small birds and ducks can be seen. The tooth relic temple is beside the lake and a few minutes drive will take you to the Kandy view point. A boat ride will cost u 2500lkr, which is not of much value. You can walk around the lake for liesure.

Title: Ok for a stroll
Text: Nothing really to write home about. Its just a lake. Good for a stroll to kill time. No other commentary

Title: Pretty lake, not much to do
Text: The lake is pretty and scenic but there's no water sports activity on the lake. Makes for good photographs.

Title: Take a stroll around the lake
Text: Pretty lake next to The Temple of the Tooth. Worth taking a stroll around it to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city and temple. Interesting to watch the locals feed the fish which come to the surface in 100's. Also lots of types of fowl and birds to observe. One of the most enjoyable things we did in Kandy.

Title: A man made lake teaming with fish due to the no fishing policy
Text:
Kandy Lake is in the centre of the City a man made lake that is full of fish due to the no fishing policy the best way to sea it is to get a ride to one on the restaurants on the hill and have a leisurely lunch overlooking the lake which is adjacent to the Garrison Cemetery and the Sacred Tooth temple.
Kandy is the most polluted City in Sri Lanka due to the lack of a prevailing wind.

Title: Walking about!
Text: Nice lake saw huge lizard, pelican , loads of fish, monkeys, ducks and other wildlife. There was loads of building / paving work being done around the pathway when we were there , and it looks like that was a massive job and will be going on for some time . Will look nice once done and it was interested to watch the workers so it didnt put us off. The lake did look a bit polluted but we saw quite a few conservationist types down there. In the centre of Kandy so its definitely not peace and quiet , but still decent

Title: Mostly Construction site
Text: It was fairly nice to walk around this lake, but especially on the side near the temple there was a lot of ongoing construction. Its nice to visit the lake in combination with visiting the dance show or the temple, but not a must do in Kandy.

Title: As Nature As It Is
Text: The lake itself is very quiet and peaceful compare with the main road just next to it full of transports.No commercial kayak or pedal boat at least from my observations.Very picturesque area if you find a good angle. One from view point the other is near Temple entrance.

Title: How romantic
Text:
That's right gents! Take your woman for a walk around the lake at evening time and your guaranteed some action. 
For the feminists, walk by yourselfs.

Great walk, lovely location, sure to impress all. Feed the fish and the birds as you go. Just watch for the pollution from the tuk tuk s as the fumes can get a little overbearing. 

Try it, you might like it!

Title: Beautiful lake polluted by vehicles travelling around it
Text: I used to run and cycle around Kandy Lake when I was a young boy. There was hardly any traffic at that time and Kandy was free from overpopulation and congestion. Now, vehicles have to travel around the Kandy Lake because the road running past the Temple of the Tooth was closed after a bomb exploded outside many years ago. The lake was built by the last King of the Kandyan Kingdom around 1807 before the British deviously conquered the kingdom and brought the whole island under colonial rule. You wouldn't want to walk around the lake now, unless you want to inhale the pollution generated by the continuous stream of vehicles chugging around it. It's a real shame!

Title: Kandy lake
Text: There is nothing to see in Kandy lake. We stayed in Kandy for one day but nothing to see apart from temple of tooth relic. We stayed in Kandy just to take the train journey from Kandy to Ella.

Title: Nice views
Text: This man-made lake is right next to downtown. You can get some pretty pictures of the temple by the lake. Nice place to for for a stroll after dinner. The pavement is being replaced so there's a lot of sand and stones in the area.

Title: A nice lake in a nice city
Text: Seen from any of the hills surrounding the city, the lake seems located in the middle of it and adds to its character. Yes, it is only a lake, or yet another lake, but considering its location and surrounded as it is by lots of green, it a kind of fits the city, and together make for nice combination. A walk around the lake may take you about 45 minutes and you may find in an enjoyable experience, if you have the time ..

Title: Lovely walk
Text: Worth spending the 45 minutes it takes to walk around the whole lake! you are bound to see some lovely wild life and fish, and birds, bats and enormous water lizards. even though its rather uneven walk ways, its part of the charm.. and it works up an appetite for coffee and cake at the Empire Cafe!

Title: A lot of character
Text: Though it is just a simple lake but adds a lot of character to the small hill town of Kandy.A walk early morning or in the evening gives you a good insight and lets you feel the nerve of the town.

Title: Lake walking tour
Text:
You can have a nice walk all around the Lake.
Be carefull about to every person that tries to sell you everything.

Title: Better than expected!
Text: Yes, almost everything in Kandy is about the lake. And for good reasons, it is really the highlight of the town. We enjoyed walking around it despite the dies in the fumes from the vehicles, we enjoyed it very much from our balcony in our hotel and again enjoyed from the viewpoint from the forest sanctuary and from the big Buddha hill.

Title: Lovely view at twilight
Text: The lake is very beautiful at twilight. So, time your visit in such a way that you are able to see the skyline change. The drive was quite hectic as there is always traffic in this area. But the lake is beautiful.

Title: Nice walk to get a feel for Kandy
Text:
Kandy Lake is lovely for a quick walk around. There is lots of wildlife around and the walk isnt too busy.

There is ongoing work on the paving but it doesnt cause any disruption at all.

Title: Water.....
Text:
Yep its a lake you can walk around, but its not peaceful due to setting, its not clean and there are no astounding views (except of temple).

It is the temple location that makes this Lake special.  It is not a destination in itself.

Title: Its a lake....
Text: Its a lake.... and thats basically it. Not much more then that. The suroundings and views are nice though

Title: Ok, noisy walk
Text: Walked around the lake after a visit to the Temple of the Ancient Tooth Relic. There were some ducks, fish and bats. The pathway is partially under construction and the traffic around the lake is quite hectic so its not particularly peaceful.

Title: Tranquility amidst the frantic buzz of the town...
Text: We took a stroll around the lake on our first evening in Kandy to soak in the atmosphere of the place and stretch our legs after the train journey. The views over the lake are very pleasant and our kids thoroughly enjoyed watching the fish being fed as well as the geese squabbling on the water's edge. We also got to see two water monitors, one of which was stalking some geese and the other which was eating an egret.

Title: Nice clean lake, with a jogging track around it
Text:
Nice clean lake, with a jogging track around it
almost 99% paved around it.

The north-side has only Queens hotel and temple of tooth.
South side has a busy road with bus-stand and multiple hotels.
The west side is the city-centre and lots of resturants

Overall clean and serene.

Title: Really Beautiful Lake in Central Kandy
Text:
We loved strolling around Kandy Lake, such a beautiful feature slap bang in the city centre. 
Always gives a cooling breeze. Really nice especially as the sun begins to set. There are a few nice eateries along the shore but it's the path around it that attracted us, such an easy relaxing walk. 
Make sure to spend a bit of time hete if youre in Kandy as it's by far the nicest part of town.

Title: Beautiful, man made lake, good for a pause
Text: This man made lake in mid of Kandy makes for a great spot for photos and a short brake from walking the bustling streets of Kandy.

Title: Take a nice walk around it with wildlife to see along the way!
Text: We stayed at a hotel that was on the lake so it was only 2 mins across the road and we were right on the path at the water's edge. Whilst the traffic is right next to you, the walk around it produced some nice surprises. At one end was a lovely pond with a crossing short bridge. It was covered by beautiful lilies where we saw a few birds including a stunning kingfisher. Continuing around towards the Temple of the Tooth, there were many ducks, often being fed by locals, or just sleeping under beautiful large trees. This is a nice place to stop to feed them or have a small picnic. Then you can keep walking around towards Kandy City Centre shopping centre. We saw a family of large monitor lizards basking on the grassy edge as continued back to our hotel, Hotel Suisse.

Title: Love Lake Drive
Text: Nice picturesque location and areas around the Lake. Very pleasant to walk around and enjoy the view.

Title: Beautiful
Text: Very tranquil and peaceful with spectacular views.Had a lovely walk round the lake and stopped at various points to take in the views and some lovely photos.

Title: Beautiful
Text: The lake is a central part of Kandy and a beautiful feature to see. It will take 15-20 minutes to walk around but can be combined with a trip to the Temple of the Tooth, next to which it is situated.

Title: Papadice on earth
Text: If this is a place for paradicw on earth, its the lade atthw top of themountain, every pmace was spectacular with all the colors and forest, the tuktuk ride to the top was a great experince and our tuktuk drivwr ( sureish) showed us so many plants and leaves from cinamon to coffee beans .. a time to remember

Title: Just another Lake
Text:
Kandy Lake is in the midst of this old town and you just cannot miss it. Its crowed place since this is the city center with Bus station, Town Clock, Prison, Shopping arena from the British era and the Tooth Relic all surround it.

Its a slow paced town with a cultural mix and some good eateries around and in midst this BIG beautiful lake. Nothing much to talk about... you may want to take a stroll midst the locals and walk around the shopping and temple places.

Title: Stick to the Temple side
Text: Much of the walk round the lake is right next to the road so youre accompanied by the roar of traffic and the ping of diesel. The best bit is around the temple and by the Queens Bathhouse. Plenty of wildlife spotting opportunities - fish, birds, fruit bats and an enormous Water Monitor

Title: Lake
Text: This is nice way to spend a couple of peaceful hours. Walking the perimeter of the lake. See the locals selling their wares. Even buy some bread off one and feed the fish

Title: Awesome place
Text: Must visit if in Kandy.  Take a walk around the lake.  The greenery is awesome.  Watch the Flora and fauna carefully. You might get a close up of view of many birds and an alligator if you are lucky. Combine this with Temple of Tooth relic visit. Must see in Kandy.

Title: Natural resort in Kandy
Text:
An enchanting 20mins boat ride on the Kandy lake. Lovely way to see birds, monkeys and the surrounding buildings. If the day is warm.it is refreshing. 
The comments from our "captain"were very helful. He could spot the birds before anyone.

Title: A calm lake
Text: We have to come around this lake many a time if you are staying at Kandy. It's calm and is scenic when viewed from above

Title: Nice walk
Text: We went to Kandy lake and had a nice walk around the lake while we ate ice cream. Definitely nice for a calm afternoon if you dont have anything else to do. Beautiful views. Its near the temple of the sacred tooth relic and the park.

Title: Serene, relaxing
Text: Just besides the Tooth relic temple, the Kandy lake is a wonderful place to relax and recharge your batteries. View from around the lake is very nice. Having a simple lazy walk around the lake in the evening would be wonderful

Title: Afternoon stroll
Text: A nice lake near the temple with a lot of fish and birds near by. Picturesque but the road works right next to it doesnt make it that special.

Title: Man made Fresh Water Lake
Text:
Kandy lake forms the bank on which Temple of Sacred Tooth Relic is located. The Kandy lake is a man made lake, believed to be built in the beginning of 19th Century by the King of Kandy. The lake has many historical buildings along its bank. The lake forms the center piece of city of Kandy and tourist will find it difficult to miss this landmark.
The lake is a must visit. The cool dark water of lake is soothing to the eyes and also provides great backdrop for photographs.

Title: Wonderful
Text: A nice place to relax at any time of the day. It has a beautiful view of tooth temple. Evening time would be a great time to roam around it

Title: A nice walk around lake to Tooth Temple
Text:
The lake is a nice walk around towards the tooth temple and to city area
We walked around the lake as car park is very difficult to find and you do have a a way to walk around lake toward Tooth Temple

Title: Lake is small but beUtiful.
Text:
One can take Nice walk around.can try eating local mangoes and other fruits
Kept clean.many tourists .Be care full About engaging local guides

Title: Very easy and pleasant walk
Text: Walking around the lake was an extremely pleasant way to spend an afternoon . The only issue is that is is almost impossible to cross the road to gain access to a number of restaurants on the south side of the lake.

Title: Sightseeing
Text: Nice place for a walk. Next to them are nice Restaurants and nice bars. The story begind the temple of the teeth is good to understand the place.

Title: Very Beautiful View
Text: Very Beautiful Lake, green and has many birds. It is very close to Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and worth passing by.

Title: Lovely walk
Text: The lakeside walk is about 4km long.  In parts it is being significantly renovated.  Trees line much of the walk: you see birds, monkeys, monitor lizards

Title: Pleasant addition to the city.
Text: Located near The Temple of the Tooth Relic, the lake is a lake! Not overly exciting, but it is a nice addition to the city and somewhere to take a stroll, look at the fish or experience a tuk tuk ride around it.

Title: Central to the city
Text: Kandy Lake is located in the heart of the city and provides an opportunity for a leisurely stroll. The scenery is okay but not stunning. Whilst walking along the path you'll like spot birds, ducks, geese and if you look carefully a water monitor or two.

Title: Ok
Text: The lake is pretty but not spectacular. We walked around some of it but to be honest I didn't find many views that warranted taking a photo - and I'm always snap happy! However if you're visiting Kandy it's quite pleasant for a stroll.

Title: To know more about kandy
Text: Beautiful lake, as I heard from the local people its holy as its connected to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic. Cozy place, a lot of people walking around. Close to the local market. One of the place to have pictures.

Title: Nice view
Text: We did the walk around the lake. It is really nice. You can Explore lots of fish and birds. If youre are lucky you can also explore Giant salamanders. Turtles is plopping up everywhere. And there are several trees with thousands of flying dogs.

Title: Nice place to relax
Text: Just walk by the lake and enjoy. Walk towards the Cultural center and watch the ducks and fishes in the lake. Try to feed the fishes and they start jumping in the water near you. Great relaxation.

Title: Go to the Viewpoint
Text: To see this place from the best view go to the upper view point. The lake is the heart of Kandy and lots going on. Great place for a walk! Its surrounded by a temple as well.

Title: Nice stroll
Text: Very picturesque lake nice for a stroll in the evening when it is cooler. Tie it in with a trip to the temple of the tooth and its just what is needed after the hustle and noice of the temple. The fountains are beautiful but are not always working. If you have been sat on a bus for most of the day a lovely stroll around this lovely lake is just whats needed.

Title: Must walk around if you are in Kandy
Text: Just near the temple of tooth. You never miss this place if you are in Kandy. It takes 30-45 minutes to go around a walk. Best time is morning and evening around 6.00. Nice cool wind. You can get whole boat LKR 2500/- that can share with 10-15 ppl..so dont foget to have a good boat ride.

Title: Pleasant, but noisy
Text: The path around the lake provides a pleasant walk, but it is right next to the busy road, so it is very noisy. You can spot lots of wildlife especially birds. There are cafes on the other side of the road if you need a break - that is if you can cross the road without getting run over.

Title: The walkway around the lake is being rebuilt.
Text: Not a particularly pleasant walk as the surrounding traffic is very congested and noisy.  The pavement around the lake is currently under reconstruction and in places becomes quite awkward.

Title: Beautiful evening walk
Text: Great peaceful evening walk around the lake, which is away from all busy streets. Amazing atmosphere with temple of tooth being just beside it.

Title: Refurb
Text: We walked around the part of the Lake right in the City traffic. The whole surrounding Wall is being repainted and was covered or wet. There is a bit of wildlife to see here - birds especially.

Title: Beautiful
Text: We were lucky to stay in a hotel with a clear view of the lake and loved just sitting looking at it. It is also well worth a stroll around to see the wildlife. Monkeys, monitor lizards, birds, fish etc.

Title: Nice place for bird watching and nature photography.
Text: It's a beautiful lake with fresh water near to Tissamaharama temple. It's better to do a boat tour in the evening. Many species of birds can be seen it the middle island of the lake. As well as a lot of birds can be seen. I really enjoy the boat tour. Highly recommend.

Title: Great for early morning or evening walk around.
Text: Nice place for an evening or early morning walk-around. It is a man made reservoir constructed in the 3rd century B.C. Nice view of Tissa Raja Maha vihara Dagoba (stupa) with green paddy fields in background from here.

Title: Lots of historical place around here
Text: we visited this area since there are several place of ancient. The big pagoda is a lovely site just closer to the lake here. lovely place. walked quite a lot of distance here. and a good place for a walk too.

Title: Nice walk at the shores of the lake
Text:
In the summer of 2018 we (Dutch familie of 4, kids 13 and 18) travelled to discover the beauties of Sri Lanka.
We took a walk from Hotel the Grand Yala to Debarawewa lake and then halfway around Tissa Lake. We saw a lot of birds, visited a pottery where they made oil lamps for the temples and pots for the curd, saw a lot of water buffalo's and trees full of flying dogs (we watched them fly a day later at about 17:45)
At the new boulevard we saw a lot of people bathing and were invited to see the lake from a boat which we declined.
We ended our walk at the Tissamaharama Stupa.

Title: Ancient Man Made Lake
Text:
We skirted the edges of the Wewa which was built by hand a couple thousand years ago. It is now used to irrigate the surrounding paddy fields. 
There is a promenade running around it and the locals use it for bating... although I heard there were crocodiles in it... so wouldn't catch me going near the edge.
It is prolific with birdlife and wildlife and gives off a very serene and peaceful feeling.

Title: Lovely Scenic Lake
Text:
We really enjoyed a few short visits to the lakeside in Tissa. It is wonderfully scenic with beautiful trees, lilies and a plethora of bird life.
It's a man made lake dating back almost 2000 years but it was restored and amenified by the British in the 1870's.
Today the promenade is lovely to walk along. The locals were all taking a swim in the waters as we passed and there was a lovely atmosphere.
We stayed in Tissa for two days doing Yala Safaris and the lakeside was a great way to wind down the day.

Title: Really nice lake
Text: Awsome lake in the Tissa.  Awsome view around,  many flying birds.  We enjoyed boat trip across the lake to see nice special trees, nice Budha temple view.  Very quiet and inspired place.  I love it. Must see.!

Title: Relax, enjoy, with beautiful breeze and nature
Text: Relax, enjoy, with beautiful breeze and nature.Truly a heaven on earth to relax, enjoy with cool breeze....Amazing lake... You never want to go back home :)

Title: Beautiful lake
Text: Walked a part of the lake twice. Once in the afternoon and once in the evening. The afternoon walk was great, saw lots of squirrels on a tree jumping around. And also a pair of green parrots. The water nearby the lily leaves are clear enough to see lots of fish swimming around and also tortoise. Also lots of locals swimming and washing themselves there. Evening might be a bit troublesome for single woman as you may get comments and whistles by the young locals who are wandering around with their bike. Not much things to see compare the afternoon except birds flying back to their nest and maybe a beautiful sunset if the weather is good.

Title: This turned out to be the highlight of our safari, better than Yala park!
Text:
What a nice little surprise this turned out to be, sunset boat ride was very lovely, we had a nice boatman who took us around, we saw this magical bird tree filled with hundreds of ibis and other birds, it was so breathtaking!
Retrospectively speaking, this 1 hour boat ride was much more exciting than our 7 hour Yala safari the next morning.
Boat ride as of mid-Feb 2018 cost Rs 3,000, picked up directly from the shores of our hotel. So worth it!

Title: Lovely lake, birds, flowers, crocodiles
