Text: The botanical gardens could be a whole day's trip! There is so much to see and so many trails to walk (a map is a must!) There was this cool section where there were at least 100 bats hanging from the trees and I found it neat. There's also an old suspension bridge you can cross, but I wasn't brave enough to attempt it. I spent 2 hours walking around and I don't think I even saw half of it. The gift shop also has really good quality items! If you haven't done your gift shopping and you're at the gardens, do a bit there and save yourself the headache. I found some of the same items from the gift shop at other places and the quality wasn't as good.

Title: Expansive Garden
Text: this mammoth garden houses thousands of plant species and is well known for its collection of orchids.this garden is so large that you need atleast 3 to 4 hours to explore,keeping this in mind they have kept golf carts for internal travelling at a charge.the ticket to the royal botanical garden is 1000 lkr per adult.

Title: Greenery in the city
Text: The Botanical Gardens is located near the city and it dates back to 1371! It is on sprawling grounds and there are many beautiful tall palms to be found. We also chanced upon a section of the Garden where thousands of bats were hanging off the tree branches in broad daylight. Quite a sight. It was cooling in May and pleasant to walk around even at mid-day. The only negative is that the ticket is priced quite steeply at 1500 rupees for tourists.

Title: Beautiful and so well maintained.
Text: Trees planted over one hundred years ago and many marked with who planted them and when. My favorite was the tree planted by the last Czar of Russia. Beautiful roads lined with various palms.  Exotic trees of great beauty. The most wonderful to me was the orchid house.  Well versed guides who drive you by electric carts.

Title: Large Garden - Wear Comfortable Shoes
Text: The garden was very large and nice to walk through.  It wasn't as well kept as others I've seen, and not quite as lush, but if you like botanical gardens, you won't want to miss this one.  The plant house and orchid house are small, but have nice varieties.  There is a small suspension bridge towards the back that goes over the river.  It is nice to walk out on it and take a photo.  There are also a couple lanes with palm trees on either side and they make a nice photo opportunity if you can squeeze in between the girls making duck lips and taking Instagram shots.  There is also a large bougainvillea you can sit under and it makes a nice photo too.

Title: Not to be missed
Text: These gardens are fabulous, beautifully laid out and well kept. Wonderful variety of plants, and saw monkeys playing in the giant bamboo. Well worth the visit. Quiet and peaceful.

Title: Relaxed experience
Text: Her you can have a relaxed walk and see nice trees, plants but also bats and monkeys. There were many school children at the entrance but in the park there was sufficient space so it was not crowded

Title: beautiful place
Text: This is a beautiful place to have a walk. It`s not that full of tourists and is kinda quaiet to enjoy a nice day.

Title: Nice for a "Walk in the Park" kinda mood
Text:
Well-maintained park, nice flora (plants / trees / flowers) with some cute fauna around. It's pretty and spacious, and nice for a walk on a fine day, but nothing too special, if you compare it with all the other botanical gardens that lots of countries also have.

Or maybe the hoards of flying foxes around are pretty special, if you ask me. They were all flying around in the skies, looking for a spot to rest amongst the tall trees. I'm not sure if that's a seasonal sight, but I saw them when I visited in March.

However for them to be collecting entrance fees for it seems a bit of a money-sucking move. If I were to do away with any humility here, you're welcome to visit my country's botanical gardens. Singapore's Botanic Gardens is bigger, prettier, UNESCO-listed, and free to enter.

Just sayin'.

Title: Amazing place
Text: Went for a afternoon to this place, we were lucky as our tour guide got us a buggy which was good as the gardens are huge, there are so many different species of tree which have been donated from other countries, we found it so interesting, the orchid house is amazing so many different types in the hot house, the monkeys and fruit bats in the trees, not sure how long it would take to walk round but in the bug took over a hour.

Title: Wonderful place
Text: The garden is impressive due to its size and diversity of the plants and in particular the tree-vellum fold. Definitely a place to relax and to be amazed.

Title: OUTSTANDING!
Text: The Botanical Gardens were very impressive in terms of content and scope.  A lovely way to spend a morning or afternoon.  Lovely bedding, impressive hot houses, especially the Orchid House and the Plant Room.  Everything was beautifully manicured.  Watch out for the giant palms and the giant bats!  Take your camera!

Title: Just wow
Text: You must see this place when you go to kandy , amazing, wonderful place and it was one of the places i really like, big trees with alot of roots, all kinds of tree.

Title: Orchid Garden
Text: Overall a wonderful experience.  Calm and serene, this garden shows some amazing plants, trees, and flowers.  The orchid garden was particularly beautiful.

Title: An oasis
Text: It was great to spend a few hours wandering around the gardens. There were a number of school groups at the gardens when i visited and one group took great delight in meeting me and having selfies.

Title: Chill Out Time
Text:
They may not be the greatest gardens you'll ever see but as we had a morning to fill in, a nice long walk through the gardens was perfect before continuing on our road trip through Sri Lanka. For once we didn't have our heads buried in a guide book, we just roamed and discovered as we went, including a very nice cafe that made VG coffee.
The gardens are big and nicely laid out, another legacy of the British Colonial era. The air was fresh, nice and cool in the morning and very relaxing.

Title: A gardeners paradise is
Text:
We only had an hour to enjoy this immaculate haven but we could have stayed for much longer. 

Every part of the garden was excellently kept. The highlights we found included the massive bamboo trees, the Orchid House and the Flower Garden. 

We were here around midday and found it to be very hot. I would recommend visiting at a cooler part of the day to really be able to take everything in.

Title: Beautiful gardens
Text: Well worth spending a couple of hours here as they are truly lovely. The orchid house is especially nice but the collections of bamboo, the herb garden but mainly the general fantastic layout of the garden. A must do while you are in Kandy

Title: A nice piece of nature experience
Text: Amazing trees and rare species. Good collection of orchids. Too bad we did not had a guide to explain the plants in the medicinal garden. Restaurant is very good. I recommand it.

Title: wonderful garden near kandy
Text:
we visited the garden today and found a truly amazing collection of plants and trees. 
If you want to spend a half day or more that is no problem. Al the trees and plants are well marked. And there are flying foxes in the trees near the river. it's all well maintained and beautifully made. 
A must do when you visit kandy

Title: 147 acres of well kept gardens
Text: You can cheat and spend 250rupees on taking an electric car around the main areas, but it pays to walk because you see so much more, including the large colony of flying foxes hanging from the trees. The garden is full of delights and everything is well signed in English.

Title: Garden visit
Text: My tour guide took me here @l was not disappointed very large area so we took shuttle tour  the quide explained all the trees plants very informative l loved the orchid house ask grow orchids back in Australia highly recommend you won't want to miss this one while in kandy

Title: Lovely gardens
Text: Lovely gardens to stroll around or even take a picnic. Some really beautiful rare trees all nicely labelled with good descriptions of what they are used for. A lot are medicinal and still used in medicine today. The orchid house is really beautiful unfortunately when we were there it was very busy so try and time it so you can have a really good look around at these beautiful plants.

Title: One of the best we have seen.
Text:
For us this was the highlight of our visit to Kandy.  The gardens are excellent.  Beautifully laid out, well documented and surprisingly peaceful.

They compare very favourably with Kew and those in Madeira.  You do not need to be heavily into gardening or a botanist to enjoy these gardens - just relax and walk.

One word of caution.  It can be very hot, though there is a lot of shade.  Take plenty of water, or, if the heat is problem, use the buggy for a guided tour.

Title: Lovely park and botanical gardens
Text: This is a beautiful location to visit on a warm, sunny day. It is a moderately large park so one has the option of having a great walk but there is also a shuttle bus that moves from one important part of the park to another (at an added cost above and beyond the price of entry). There are many amazing sections including imported species of trees and flowers from other parts of SE Asia and even South America. The orchid building is wonderful to visit, albeit it a little hot and humid. There are a large number of bats in the trees as well as birds. A very peaceful place to visit after the intensity of the surrounding city.

Title: Beautiful Gardens
Text: We visited late in the day and foot sore from earlier excursions so took a buggy with a knowledgeable driver,which was not very expensive.  A vast range of plants and trees in well organised sections, well worth a visit to experience another side of the busy city.

Title: The botanical gardens for people who don't like botanical gardens
Text:
DO NOT MISS IT. It's absolutely beautiful and everyone will find something they like. Planes, trees, orchids, birds, bats by thousands and playful monkeys.
It's fresh on a hot day, and oh so quiet. No honking or noisy tuktuk. It's a haven of piece in a busy town.

Title: Worth the visit
Text: This was a pleasant way to spend a couple of hours and enjoy a good walk, but go earlier in the day before the heat becomes oppressive (it opens at 8 I think). As botanical gardens go, it was interesting and extremely well established. However, if youre comparing it to Singapore, you will probably leave somewhat disappointed (especially with regard to the orchids). At LKR 1500 per person entry (approx AUD 12), its quite expensive by Sri Lankan standards.

Title: Must Visit in Kandy...Largest Botanical park in Sri Lanka!!!
Text: Must visit place do take Electric car as lot of walk is involved as Shuttle is also available at good price but you have to wait for a long for availability ...and then we found wow... suspension bridge..orchid houses..flower garden.. etc

Title: Great to visit
Text: Good variety of flora. Entrance fees on a higher side 1500 LKR otherwise worth visiting and great place to visit especially in the afternoons.

Title: Beautiful landscaping, rich flora, can forget the world around y
Text: We love nature and taking a walk, but the Royal Botanical Garden is a 5* experience. Words dont describe well, so see pictures

Title: The Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya , Sri Lanka
Text: The Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, Sri Lanka is not to be missed.  It is a beautiful place!  The trees and flowers are amazing.  It is so well cared for.  The birds are everywhere and are adding to the peacefulness by all their singing.

Title: Amazing
Text: The way the gardens are done up is spectacular. Went with children so we hired a buggy and went around. Amazing landscape and beautiful scenery to be seen. Amazing to see so many orchids in the orchid house

Title: Royal Botanical Gardens
Text:
Wide variety of plants and trees often famous for the dignitaries who planted them.  Good selection of orchids in the hothouse.  

Long periods of walking but there is a mini train that works as a hop on/ hop off bus.

Title: Kandy highlight
Text: A wide range of plants many of which have been planted by dignitaries from all over the world. The orchids are spectacular. The whole area is well kept and is a great place to spend a relaxing afternoon.

Title: Wide variety of plants and wild animals
Text: A very nice place to visit for an interesting and relaxing few hours. Great cafe. Hot house was wet and a good place to cool down.

Title: So much to see in so little time... but those fruit bats!
Text: The rain didnt spoilt our visit here, when we spent a few hours in these beautiful botanical gardens. Impressive orchids and awe inspiring trees and flowers. So many gardeners keep this place immaculate. But I will never forget the hundreds of huge fruit bats hanging in the trees! When they took to flight ... it was scary!

Title: Beautiful and a brilliant way to spend an afternoon!!
Text: The Botanical Gardens are definitely one of the highlights of a stay in Kandy.   If you are short of time take a 1 hour tour in a golf buggy with a local guide (1000 rupees) The guy we had was incredibly knowledgeable and showed us all sorts of plants and birds that we would have probably missed by just walking around on our own.   The fruit bats high up in the tree tops are fascinating.  Many of the wonderful trees have been planted by visiting dignitaries and our guide knew the date everyone was planted.

Title: A must visit
Text: This was by far the highlight of our stay in Kandy. The gardens are stunning and there are so many plants and trees to take in. We enjoyed watching the fruit bats hanging from the trees. If you dont have much time I would recommend prioritising the gardens.

Title: Lovely Gardens
Text: The gardens are huge, so there was a lot of lovely spaces to walk around and see. There were also these huge bats which were pretty cool.

Title: Beautiful gardens
Text:
We visited the Botanical gardens in Kandy yesterday morning. 
We hired the golf buggy for one hour and were taken around the gardens by a guide who was very informative. We stopped and looked whenever we wanted to which was good. 
One of our group walked around but couldn't see all the gardens in that time therefore missed out on certain parts of the garden. 
We were short on time and apparently you need four hours to walk around the whole gardens. 
They are certainly worth a look at even if you don't have four hours. 
There is also a bus which takes about ten people.

Title: Beautiful and relaxing
Text: Located in Peradeniya, just 5.5km to the west of the city of Kandy and is renowned for its collection of orchids. The garden is home to more than 4000 species of plants, spices, medicinal plants and palm trees. You can explore the grounds on foot, however, if youre feeling tired, or potentially lazy, golf carts can be rented. It costs 1500 LKR/person to enter the gardens. A perfect place to relax and take some great pictures, we spent about 2 hours here and went early in the morning to avoid crowds of people.

Title: Fabulous space
Text:
This garden serves as both a leisure park and a biological resource. It is popular but huge. It is located a short distance out of Kandy but travel is slow. It is largely open but there are areas of shade.  Plants are largely well labelled.  A good map is provided.  Polythene is not permitted

Th Royal Palm walk is splendid but there are many other interesting features. The orchid house is interesting and colourful. Dont miss the Javanese figs with their huge roots. Dont miss the numerous fruit bats in the northern area.  There is quite a lot of birdlife too.

Title: You must do this while in Kandy
Text: A visit to the Botanical Gardens should be at the top of your To Do list here in Kandy.  Its worthwhile paying for a buggy ride around the Gardens as there is much to see and the guide will point out many things you might otherwise miss.  Its also hot, so the breeze as you drive is refreshing.

Title: Overall a wonderful experience.
Text: This botanical garden should not be missed on a tour of Sri Lanka. Such a amazing place and has wide varieties of plants. Well maintained. Air was fresh, nice and cool in the morning and very relaxing. A must do while you are in Kandy.

Title: Amazing contrast
Text:
We decided to Visit the botanical gardens during our whistle stop tour of Kandy. 

We were not disappointed!! By far the best thing we did in Kandy. The gardens are a complete contrast to the busy city centre. Huge open spaces, very quiet and peaceful.... just dont look up!!!!! 

About halfway through walking round/through the gardens, we looked up only to see 1000s of bats the size of cats in the trees. Despite being harmless, it can be a little intimidating.

Strongly recommend to anyone visiting Kandy. This has to be on your list of things to do.

Title: Very boring place | Only for hardcore plant lovers
Text:
Very boring place in Kandy. Its a normal garden for most of the people, however it is heaven for plant lovers as they can find variety of trees and flowers over here. Nothing to do here and you will find lots of local couples romancing behind the trees. Also you will find lots of local school students coming for a day picnic here. Fees is too high for visitors which 3000 Rs for a couple. Entry to a garden with nothing to do is very high. Moreover there are buggies operating in the garden but again at a very high cost and their availability is very low. You will have to wait a lot for your turn.
Not a worthy place to visit! Avoid if you can!

Title: Really beautiful park
Text: Really beautiful park, with loads of of trees (some really uncommon), flowers and animals. Was able to spot a few animals, such as bats (in huge number), squirrels, snakes and birds. Probably the best attraction in Kandy area.

Title: Expansive Gardens
Text: We thought we may spend a couple of hours here and ended up leaving 4 hours later. It has a vast array of species from all around the world growing. There are plenty of toilets, cafes and restaurants scattered around to keep you hydrated. There is a shuttle bus available at a small cost if you get tired of walking. There are signposts well placed to find your way around but I found it a little difficult to follow the supplied map which came following the 1500 LKR entrance fee for foreigners.

Title: Beautifull garden
Text: There are lots of tropic trees and flowers from all over the world. Very nice place to be away from the city noise. Spend 3.4 hours there.

Title: Quite Fascinating
Text: This type of visit is generally not to my liking, so I was pleasantly surprised to have enjoyed it quite so much. It was included on our Tour itinerary, but I believe entry was about £7 equivalent & well worth it. A tranquil place, despite the large number of visitors. We saw the fruit bats in flight, visited the Orchid house, saw the tree plaques with plantings by many famous personages etc. Our guide was very knowledgeable & this enhanced the trip. Depending on your level of interest, one could spend most of a day here.

Title: absolutely beautiful. And not that expensive despite the whinging on here from some
Text:
We spend a couple of hours here at the end of our day that started in Dambulla and ended in Kandy, and they were a thoroughly enjoyable couple of hours. If we hadn't told our driver to come back in two hours we might have stayed a little longer, but I think we saw most of the highlights.
The orchids are of course fabulous, but to me the most impressive were the tress with plaques showing who had planted them and one. I must say the future Czar Nicholas II did a great job, as did Edward VII while Prince of Wales.
You wouldn't miss a great deal by skipping the suspension bridge
My one regret was that we were too early to see the flying foxes, and I failed to find the trees they were roosting in. You wouldn't think 24,000 of them could hide so well
Lots of rather sweet young local couple walking round holding hands

Title: Lovely gardens, worth a half day visit
Text: These are very well organised and set up gardens. Some very interesting specimens, and thousands of flying foxes fruit bats (24 thousand apparently). There are regular small bus tours around the grounds which would be worth taking, or simply stroll around yourself.

Title: Serene Oasis
Text: Loved this wonderful place. Best thing of all was the golf cart we rented to get around as it was punishingly hot. The guide was knowledgeable and pointed out trees planted by notable people. The orchid house was the highlight but we also liked the three palm lined avenues and the lake. It was so quiet and calm here.

Title: Very calm place
Text: It's nice to see this beautiful and old Garden. Full of tree, and nice park. It's a place for walk and relaxing, maybe one of the best place in Kandy...

Title: A beautiful walk
Text:
The entrance fee for tourists is 1500 rupee each, and they give you a map of the walks and locations of plants.

There are free toilets, water points, and shops inside selling food and drinks so dont panic if you arent prepared.

The whole place is amazing and has such wide varieties of plants. You can get lovely photos like on Instagram at the palm tree walks and the large open green is great to sit in the shade part way through your walks and get your energy back for the rest.

We leisurely walked around and stayed inside circa 2-3 hours, but if you were very interested Im sure 4 hours would be plenty.

There are TUK TUK drivers outside, as ours didnt want to wait, but please note they will ask a premium to get back to Kandy but we just asked a few and one was wiki f to take us back for 300 rupee rather than 700.

Title: A must
Text:
Excellent visit with a private guide extremely knowledgeable and interesting.
It is a must when in Kandy. When in the garden must visit the orchard house, well presented with many species.

Title: Wonderful gardens
Text: The gardens are very well looked after and are beautiful. The fruit bats in the trees were great to watch. the range of species was vast and the whole gardens very well planned. There is a super grass area which local school children were using. There is a good cafe/restaurant and plenty of clean toilets. A really good day out.

Title: Beautiful peaceful walk
Text:
Get out of the noise and madness of the city and spend a wonderful couple of hours wandering these lovely gardens. 
Stunning flowers, awesome giant bamboo and the orchids are breathtaking.

Title: A beautiful place
Text: We visited this beautiful botanical garden on our way to Nuwara eliya from Kandy on a morning. It was very calming experience and got the chance to identify lot of new plants most of them native to Sri Lanka. it was a well maintained park where you can go and spend the time relaxingly. lot of space for children to run around and have fun. However, try to visit in a morning and on a less crowdy day.

Title: An oasis of calm just outside Kandy
Text:
This Royal Botanical garden is really beautiful. We were there for about two hours which was insufficient. Allow as much time as you can as the grounds are vast. If you are short on time, it might be better to take a guide.
The gardens are set in a loop in the Mahawli Ganga (river)  on about 150 acres of land but it feels more spacious.
 Highlights for me: Lovely Orchid house, Royal Palm Avenue, Suspension Bridge, Sri Lankan shaped pond, The Great lawn, the rows of trees planted by visiting dignatories over the years, the fruit bats & the macaque monkeys.

Title: Another excellent walk around the Royal Botanical Gardens
Text: We visited the Royal Botanical Gardens with friends and thoroughly enjoyed another walk through the beautiful gardens. There is always something new to see every time we go there, including the area of trees planted by famous visitors - King Edward VII and Czar Nicholas II for example.

Title: A real favourite of mine
Text:
I love the peace and tranquility of the Royal Botanical Gardens. The plants, Mameluke and birds help to create a haven of calm amidst the frantic hustle and bustle that is Sri Lankan traffic. For me a must visit.
I read people complaining that foreigners pay more than locals. What a good idea, pity we dont do that in the U.K.

Title: Allow plenty of time
Text: We visited here yesterday. It was 1500 rupees each and well worth the money. We went in over a suspension bridge which was quite bouncy but there is another entrance if you are not keen on that idea. We felt we didnt have enough time here as we were meeting our driver and could have happily stayed another couple of hours. There is a cafe and an ice cream place in the centre.

Title: Breathtaking!!!!
Text: Royal Botnical Gardens in Kandy is the most beautiful place in Sri Lanka. It appears you have entred a dreamland with beautiful flowers all around. A must visit during your Sri Lanka trip

Title: Calm and beautiful
Text: The royal botanical gardens are beautifully maintained and we have a chance to see so many different varieties of trees and plants from different parts of the world. The kids had a great time there and there was a beautiful lake shaped like Srilanka. We got to see different palm varieties and the double coconut tree.

Title: Superb large gardens in the City
Text: Very well maintained gardens with beautiful flowers and trees.  A very pleasant afternoons walk around this large estate,

Title: Worth the Price
Text: I will begin by saying that I've been to more than my share of overpriced attractions in Asia. This garden, if you are a fan of gardens that is, is worth the 1500 LKR entrance fee. The place is absolutely huge, rubbish free, and very well maintained. I wandered around for 3 hours and could have spent longer there. I've certainly seen better collections of specific types of plants, but the overall collection on display here, and the overall feel of the place was special. One minor criticism - I would have loved to see an orchid display 10 times the size of what they currently have (think Singapore's garden). You know they grow here, let's show them off! The day I visited there were dozens of students on a school assignment mingling among the foreign visitors, engaging them in conversation as they practiced speaking English. It was refreshing to see their enthusiasm and I was more than happy to take time to chat with them.

Title: Great Gardens
Text: Really surprising Gardens, some of the best maintained and constructed gardens....the collection of fig trees are awe inspiring!

Title: Tree,s and flowers to impress
Text: A beautiful large park and gardens in the heart of the city, well worth a wander through. We only got an hour and would suggest a bit longer, we were rather rushed. Some fantastic trees and flowers especially the orchid house, well worth the entry fee.

Title: Beautiful tranquility in busy Kandy
Text:
The park is a haven of peace and serenity against the otherwise manically busy city of Kandy. Ensure that you visit in the morning, its cooler then and with less people. It is exceptionally well kept and the information about the trees and plants  rife. We were further excited to spot, within the arboretum, several clusters of the biggest bat's I have ever seen in my life, so Mrs Johnson was delighted to be able to capture them on camera. A very beautiful park.

Couple of down sides: I had hoped that here I would be able to escape the constant £ sign that seems to hang over every tourists head in this country, within the tranquility of the trees. Oh no. Security guards popping over for a quick chat, but swiftly requesting a cigarette to further irradicate their foul, bleeding gums, another chap digging a flower bed bent my ear, all be it politely, about his excellent hobby of collecting foreign currency, very clever, and to top it off, when spotting two brilliantly bright white bovine beats in a clearing, so of course stopping to oggle, their minder pops out from behind a tree and starts jibbering about rupees. Highly annoying.

Further, and my wife thinks I am incorrect in moaning about this, but the incredibly inflated price that a tourist pays as opposed to a local. Yes an average Western tourist is going to have more money, but oh my giddy aunt, the backlash that would ensue if the British charged 22 x local price to wealthy Sri Lankans or indeed any other tourist, to enter into Kew Gardens. We would be called racist, accused of defiling the parks good name and no doubt be obliged to make it a fair price for all. The park management have got this wrong here, leaving a bitter taste.

Title: Very Expensive
Text:
Before I share my experience, I would like to say that this attraction as almost every attraction in Sri Lanka is exuberantly priced by the Sri Lankan government in no proportion to equal attraction in other parts of the world. This especially stands out when the average monthly salary is about $300USD. 

The gardens are beautifully kept up and are very nice a peaceful, especially since it is set in the busy traffic of Kandy.

Go the bridge it is a lot of fun! The orchids are nice although the selection is not impressive.
This is a great place to do a bicycle trip although I don't think that this is possibility. Entrance price is 1500 local currency, no discounts available.

Title: Crazy, lovely and peaceful
Text: Sure worth the high entrance fee, inside the garden you find whatever tropical plants and trees that you don´t have to be an arborist to appreciate. Easy to miss is the spice garden - pls don´t.

Title: A Great place to be with the children
Text: We visited this beautiful botanical garden while we were in Kandy and it was a great fun for our kids. It is a vast area with lots of spaces for the kids to play. They loved it. And there were lots of tropical trees and plants which we have never known before. Some are only remaining in this park and some are of medicinal value. Wished if we could have spent the whole day here. Must visit if you are in Kandy.

Title: Clean, tidy and very beautiful
Text: Huge Botanical Park with a great variety of trees, plants, flowers, and more. Clean, tidy and very beautiful. Perfect place to take a walk or to go on a picnic. I would definitely recommend it to anyone.

Title: Great biodiversity
Text: It's a very clean and beautiful Garden. It takes more than 3-4 hours to see it all. There are so many kind of trees and plants - a great biodiversity. I loved to see the palm trees and the bamboos. You will find a lot of monkeys that won't let you eat (especially bananas) - they will come to bag for your food :)))). In one side area of the garden, there are also a lot of noisy bats (the "flying foxes" bats) - too bad you cannot see them flying (they are only flying after the sunset).

Title: Very Nice Nature Day
Text: Spent a couple of hours here exploring the gardens. Bring water because it can get quite hot. You need the map they give out to get around. Enjoyed another cold drink at the café.

Title: Gardens in kandy
Text: A beautiful garden and lots to see. V calm and many monkeys and different species of plants and trees.

Title: Very Good
Text: We are not really the type of family that wanders round this type of place but we all enjoyed it. Very nice for a stroll and a great place to chill from the city chaos.

Title: Almost as good as Singapore
Text: What a wonderful experience to walk around these magnificent gardens with such amazing established trees. It is a must do experience in Kandy. A pity tourists get stung for admission but it is worth it. Suggest avoiding the cafe in the gardens as the food is pretty average.

Title: A must do whilst in Kandy for beautiful large gardens
Text: We had a lovely day here walking round looking at all the different trees & plants etc. We spotted a few different types of birds. There was also so many fruit bats which was amazing to see! One of our highlights when visiting Kandy, definitely worth the short journey there (25 min from sacred tooth temple)

Title: Beautiful and Peaceful
Text: Definitely worth a visit if you are staying in Kandy! Although the gardens are slightly outside the centre there are plenty of tuk tuks available to take you there (we paid 500lkr each way). Entrance cost 1500 lkr per person. The gardens are lovely and peaceful which came as a welcome break from Kandys hustle and bustle. There are a huge selection of trees and flowers and plenty of wildlife too (large bats and monkeys everywhere!). The cafe provided sandwiches and drinks at a good price. Easily spent a couple of hours wandering the grounds.

Title: Yes!
Text: Personally I'm not really a person who gets all that excited about visiting Botanical gardens but as we'd heard so many positive things about it we thought we should visit and so glad we did.  Its so vast, peaceful and beautiful - and a welcome break from the hustle and bustle of downtown Kandy.  We spent several hours here and loved it - I'm a convert!  There are also golf buggies available for those less mobile.

Title: Spectacular gardens
Text: Truly impressive gardens, that are a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of Kandy city. The range of international species and the design of the gardens is outstanding. Consider taking a picnic, and take plenty of water. The cafe does not offer much in the way of food choices, and the restaurant is one of those dreadful buffet style affairs. There seemed to be limited seating around the gardens. We went on a Sunday and the few seats were taken by rather sweet couples, enjoying some quiet time together.

Title: Beautiful gardens full of surprises
Text: There are plenty of natures delights here. Firstly, the trees are magnificent and there are so many different species, many are endemic. Secondly, you can see a number of colourful birds here. Thirdly, how about the huge red fruit bats that fill the trees in their hundreds! Not to mention the macaques which roam the gardens looking for scraps. There is also a very good cafe which has good value buffet food. If you need to get back to Kandy when your visit is over, and you are fed up haggling with tuktuk drivers, just jump on the bus and pay a few rupees (around 9 pence). Brilliant place.

Title: Beautiful
Text: There are so many varieties of beautiful plants, flowers and spices. Having the monkeys around makes the experience even better. Highly Recommended.

Title: interesting garden with a huge variety of plants and flowers
Text: a garden with a huge variety of plants, some not even available in other parts of the world.  a very enjoyable walk and the gardens even had an orchid flower house with different varieties of orchids.

Title: Royal Botanical Gardens
Text: We were taken to the gardens by our guide Obama. It was a beautiful and relaxing place to visit, except the bangers being set of to scare the fruit bats off! We really enjoyed our time there. The orchid house, the avenue of palms and all the different examples of plants and trees were well worth the visit. We both would definitely like to visit the gardens again.

Title: Escape the hustle and bustle
Text: A spacious and picturesque escape from the hustle and bustle of Kandy. Take the time out for a pleasant stroll (45-60 mins) around the perimeter, or just sit and enjoy refreshments at the restaurant.

Title: Beautiful place
Text: It was our first attraction visited in Sri Lanka and one that we found with the best value. Great and majestic with a high diversity of exotic trees and plants. Truly worth the visit. I would recommend going in the morning when it's not too hot.

Title: Amazing gardesn
Text: These gardens are well laid out, with various sections including orchid houses, perennials, and avenues of various trees.  They are clearly labelled so if you like collecting information it is easy to take photos of the notices. A one end of the garden the fruit bats keep up a continuous shrieking. It is quite awesome to see so many of these creatures hanging from the trees. Some of the trees are quite old and have fantastic root structures.  This is a lovely way to spend a couple of hours.

Title: One of the best
Text: Huge grounds with the most amazing gardebs to easily walk around and enjoy. Lovely orchid house. Watch out for the trees full of bat's at one end. Everyone will enjoy this

Title: Large park with many different areas of interest - but mostly an arboretum
Text:
It is almost larger than you can take in in one day. I'm glad we went. It was cool to see nutmeg trees for the first time. It was really interesting to stroll under hundreds of roosting bats at the far end of the park. There special environment houses for cacti and orchids. There are many open park areas in which to simply relax and enjoy the surroundings.There are a few pleasant views of the river - and then there is that rickety suspension bridge people stand in line to walk on!
But there are few concessions inside the gates and when it got hot, we decided we had enough.

Title: Royal indeed!
Text: I could've spent at least a day here.  So much to see and take in.  I would've liked the golf buggies to be free to those who need them - or for people at one far end of the garden, trying to get to the other end in 30 degree heat and high humidity!  Nonetheless one of the highlights of my wanders in a city.

Title: Peradeniya plant conservatory
Text: Visited here on Jan 21st,2019. This garden is more floral than the Hakgala botanical gardens. Plenty of couples and white skinned foreign tourists here. You can also pay extra to sit in a buggy and see the place with live commentary and photo stops by the driver - which we did here. Since it is quite large if you plan on covering it by foot/walk then plan to easily spend at least 4 hours here.

Title: Visited as part of an organised trip
Text:
Had a great few hours here enjoying the green spaces and variety of trees and plants, could have spent a great deal more time exploring.
well worth the visit

Title: Peace and quiet in kandy
Text:
Great place to escape the madness of the temple of the tooth.
Good place for people watch and the café is a nice location if a bit pricey.
Would love to spend more time here

Title: Beautiful place
Text: Its a beautiful and well-organised garden, with some impressive trees. We were there around 2pm and walked for 2.5 hrs. Alot of shade and a good constant breeze kept us cool. We saw lots of squirrels, monkeys, lizards and a few interesting birds. The kids were pretty excited about spotting these. We also took lots of photos and making silly poses. All the trees and shrubs were impressive, and very interesting. The gardens were well kept and quite beautiful, looking like a scene from an European garden. Great walk after lunch and great family bonding too!

Title: One of the nicest green spaces i've ever experienced
Text:
One of the nicest green spaces i've ever experienced

Just a quick glance at all the trip advisor reviews on here and its obvious the botanical gardens are popular and highly rated.

I can only add weight to that and say that we thoroughly enjoyed spending an afternoon here, though you could spend a full day if you had the time. We were contemplating just having a rest day round the pool at the hotel but decided to make the journey here and we were SO glad we did.

Other places should look to this place as an example of a well thought out, maintained and looked after urban green space.

It contains a bewildering variety of plants and trees, giant fruit bats hanging from and flying between the trees, monkeys you can get right up close to, lakes, and an orchid house with some of the most amazing flowers.

There is a cafe / buffet restaurant in the park, but this would make a lovely place to bring a picnic.

If you appreciate and enjoy nature and green spaces then this is a must visit if staying in or near Kandy. It is approx. 15 mins from Kandy city to here by tuk tuk and the fare should cost about 5 GBP. If you have already been on a tuk tuk with a mad driver then you will understand what an 'experience' this is, and if you haven't then do try to experience this at least once in your travels !

Title: Beatiful
Text: A great place to visit just outside Kandy.  15000 rp entrance but beautiful grounds, incredible trees and plants. Good bird life and flying foxes galore.  And the cafe just outside the entrance is cheap and good.

Title: If you are in Kandy do not miss these gardens
Text: A great place to visit, interesting trees, flying foxes, according to the guide 24,000 of them, a lake, an orchid house and just a really peaceful place to stroll. We could have spent longer here but really enjoyed the visit. If you in Kandy it is a must. Entrance is 1500 rupees.

Title: Perfect day out at Royal Botanical Gardens
Text: This place is amazing! I love plants and animals and visiting the beautiful gardens was perfect for me and my husband! You can see a lot of flowers, many types of trees from different parts of the world, friendly monkeys, big bats in the trees and many more. We also loved the orchid house. At the end of our visit, we stopped to the souvenir shop and bought incense sticks and some other local goods for our family and friends.

Title: Well worth a Half Day visit
Text: A well laid out and cared for attraction. Lovely to just wander and see the colourful plants and the variety of trees.

Title: A little oasis of peace
Text: Beautiful gardens just outside of the town, quite large well laid out and easy to navigate , lots of unusual plants and trees with a large poulation of fruit bats at the top end of the gardens. Well worth a trip and easy to spend 3 or 4 hours here. Nice orchid house and a variety of animal and bird life.

Title: Heaven but not enough information
Text: Love this place and keep coming back. Tranquil and calming. Like other reviews I love the fruit bats and just walking through the trees. One big gripe is lack of books or other publications. Asked guy in shop if they had books about trees or the gardens. He seemed to think this was an astounding thing to ask. Would have liked to be able to find out more about what I was looking at.

Title: Vacation
Text: This is a very nice and beautiful garden. It is a pretty large park so the best way to see it is by cart. This takes about an hour and cost is very little. Well worth the visit and a great way to fill in the day.

Title: Beautifully kept gardens
Text: A great way to escape the manic nature of kandy for a couple of hours. This is an oasis of calm. The gardens are beautifully kept and the fox bats are an experience to see. Lots of deliffirent plants, trees and flowers from around the world are kept here. Just a few things our guide helped with. Always enter and leave via the suspension bridge entrance as it is much quieter, watch out for the monkeys, they will steal anything if you give them an opportunity and take plenty of water. There are places to buy stuff but not a great deal of variety? Worth a visit.

Title: Beautiful gardens!
Text:
Im not usually a botanical gardens kind of guy, but we really enjoyed this place and it was a lovely escape from the chaos of Kandy. We spent a couple of peaceful hours wandering around these large beautiful gardens. Admittedly there were a lot of people here but it never seemed busy once wed left the entrance behind. Lots of different garden houses to visit plus a couple of impressive avenues of palm trees, a picturesque lake and plenty of places to sit and watch the world go by. We also saw a whole lot of bats in some strange leaning trees, Ive no idea why they were leaning so dramatically. If you need refreshments theres couple of cafes for a drink. Lovely, peaceful and definitely a good place to wander around if you have some spare time on your hands. 

Iain, London

Title: Wonderful gardens
Text: Wonderful. I really enjoyed seeing the fantastic range of plants. The large colony of bats that are in the trees along the river are fascinating.

Title: Well worth a visit
Text: We spent two hours here and could have easily spent longer. Amazing variety of trees, beautifully upkept lawns. This place is used by locals and tourists alike. Entrance fee was 1500 rupees. The park is also home to colonies of fruit bats which are fascinating to watch. If you have the time this provides calm away from the hustle and bustle of Kandy

Title: Incredible 225 year old  exquisite garden !
Text:
Loved this place ! so absolutely beautiful.....If you like huge mature beautiful gardens and parks .....you will love this place....

Lots of shade but where a hat !

Title: Such beauty and variety
Text: Spent 3 hours wandering around being amazed at the variety of plants on display. Stunning orchids, enormous bamboo, medicinal plants and loads more

Title: Lovely parkland
Text: The gardens are huge and crammed with specimens although it has to be said that the bulk are trees and shrubs and these are the main strength of the place. We found the display houses disappointing and lacking in inspiration but there are some really splendid palm-lined avenue walkways and spectacular clusters of bamboo. Its really like a huge park for which there is a £7 entry fee. There is a local bus runs from Kandy clock tower for 40 rupees and the journey takes about 25 minutes.

Title: Stunning
Text: These gardens are definitely worth a visit. We spent 6 hours there, and could have spent longer. Great value for money, but regardless of that, there was so much to see, in these immaculately well kept gardens, which were easy to wander around, and a total joy to absorb oneself in. There was a vast array of plants and trees, ferns and spices, and a suspension bridge well worth walking over!. The gardens are set alongside the river, which made for a stunning setting. We travelled by tuk tuk each way which made the entire experience superb and unforgettable.

Title: Beautiful
Text:
We went to the Botanical Gardens as part of a two day trip organised by Sam Sampath, Big Brother Tours. Sam had organised a cart and a guide to take us round and I was glad that he did. There is so much to see and a huge area to cover, we learned so much from our guide that we would otherwise never know.
The flora is beautiful and the gardens very well maintained. 
Thoroughly enjoyed our visit and would recommend.

Title: Fabulous Gardens
Text: We thoroughly enjoyed our day walking around these stunning gardens which are beautifully kept. Allow a good 3-4 hours to see everything. There are plenty of seating areas dotted around if you need a rest as well as some picnic areas and a restaurant.  We got caught in a tropical storm and used the time to have a lovely buffet lunch in the restaurant for a reasonable 950 rupees per person.  It was a very enjoyable day out.

Title: Worth a visit
Text: An old British era botanical garden- huge and well maintained.  You will beautiful well manicured lawns and some exclusive orchid varieties. Some very exotic and rare trees are found here. Ticket is LKR 1000 for adults and 500 for children. Be prepared for some walking.  There are electric buggies but not sufficient for the crowd.

Title: stunning
Text:
large , well designed garden with beautiful collection trees and flowers. Especially the tree collection is impressing.I  couldnt see everything as my driver was waiting. Most of all it is very very well kept. next best to me with the « jardins de pamplemousse » on Mauritius.
tip : go urly in  the morning as it  gets stickier around noon

Title: Brilliant way to spend the day
Text: We had such a perfect day exploring the gardens, Id recommend it to anyone who has some spare time when visiting Kandy, so many interesting things to see, including this strange Irish man pretending to be a tree.

Title: Stunning gardens
Text: Could have spent a whole day in the Garden as it is just gorgeous. The Garden takes up 147 acres with over 4,000 species. Lots of walking around but I did see a trolley bus. The garden has different areas including the Orchid House, Great Lawn, Lake, Spice Garden (reached via a suspension bridge), Flower Garden and Palm Avenue to name a few all with magnificent plant specimens. It will take a few hours but when you're tired you can sit down on beautiful manicured lawn and rest a while. There's a busy cafe near the Great Lawn but toilets are few and far between.

Title: A must see
Text: The botanical gardens are the largest in Sri Lanka, with huge areas of green well kept lawns. There are many different aspects to the gardens which contain specific sections such as orchids, rubber trees, the palm avenue to name a few. Giant fruit bats hang in the trees and fly screeching overhead. There's more than enough to keep you here for a few hours.

Title: Botanical gardens kandy, Sri lanka
Text:
We spent a very pleasant 3 hours here and covered most of the gardens. The highlight was the fruit bats which were amazing, spread over the left side of the park and in their thousands. The orchids were beautiful and the trees in the arboretum spectacular, huge buttress roots lianas.  We had cold drinks at a kiosk  and coffee in the cafe, buffet lunch was available. All was good with the exception of 2 gardeners who begged for money.
We went on to the 3 temples loop, a nice change to go to sites with only a few other tourists and worth the time.

Title: What a fantastic garden
Text: Go and visit this amazing garden if you can. Plants trees orchids palms cycads they are all here to enchant and educate

Title: Beautiful place to visit
Text: Lovely place to visit. We only managed to be able to stay a couple of hours but if you can stay longer it is well worth it. Beautiful and clean and plenty of information regarding the plants. Restaurant on site looked lovely but we did not have time to try. Lots of clean toilets too.

Title: Lovely relaxing place in manic city
Text: Arrived here with our guide and had a lovely walk around the gardens, wild monkeys roam around the gardens and provide some entertainment. There is also a large number of fly foxes who hang out in the trees down by the river who made a really loud squeaking noise. The gardens are beautiful and particularly liked the orchid displays

Title: Loved it! Way beyond our expectations
Text: Am not one for mancured lawns, etc. But this was very impressive!  Orginally designed and run by British gardeners, now under Sri Lankan management, of course, and quite lovely!

Title: Beautiful Garden
Text:
The entrance fee is expensive LKR2000 per person.
There are many different species of of trees. They are beautifully line-up. There is also a section of plants planted and donated by foreign delegates. A indoor orchids orchard.
Beware, there are a few trees full of bat's hanging and flying around.
Go early as the sun climbs higher, it can get very hot.

Title: beautiful gardens,well maintained.
Text:
this is one place worth definitely visiting in sri lanka. never i have seen so many different orchids, so many different trees from different continents at one huge place. 
its is absolutely beautiful and well maintained.
take a stroll around the park and enjoy the natural beauty.
it is definitely highly recommended to visit this park.takes around 2 hours to go around the park,since the garden is so huge.

Title: Vast tranquility
Text: The Royal Botanical Garden is a must visit when in Kandy, it is vast and offers plenty of shade on hot days, beautifully kept and looked after. An amazing range of plants and trees and just a very tranquil place to be, make sure to set aside a morning or afternoon as its not a quick visit or better still take a picnic and go for the day. Stunning.

Title: SPRAWLING SITE
Text: A bit west of Kandy in Peradeniya lies this very popular site. It is spread over 147 acres or nearly .6 square kilometers. More than 4,000 species of plants, spices, palm trees and medicinal plants can be found here. It is a place for solitude, especially if you have come from the Temple of the Tooth. There are several avenues of note, including the Avenue of Palms. The Orchid House is visually stunning.

Title: Lovely gardens - take the electric buggy to see it all!
Text: If you have limited time, I would recommend you get the electric buggy around the gardens, for a small extra charge (equivalent to about £1 each).  It's a large site and you get to see a lot of it in the buggy. Other groups had their personal guides with them and got a lot more out of it than we did, as ours didn't come in with us.  But is was pleasant to be taken round and see the different types of flora and fauna.  We also saw the house where Lord Mountbatten stayed during part of the 2nd World War.

Title: Monkey heaven
Text:
A very pleasant few hours strolling around looking at the plants & landscaping. 
Its not exactly Q Gardens but interesting. 
Entry is around £10 & if the suns out its very warm. Its very clean & immaculately maintained. 
Loved the suspension bridge, although it is very bouncy. 
Loads of monkeys all around & if you look up there are trees full of very large bats.

Title: Quiet Oasis in crazy city with a tip on if you find walking difficult.
Text:
After a morning in the crazy streets of Kandy, it was lovely to get away from it all and visit the gardens. They are quite expansive and if you have a problem walking then there is a golf buggy type vehicle that goes around the gardens. I do not know how often they operate but the trip lasts about an hour. Best ask at ticket office.
There is a cafe overlooking the expansive lawns about 5 minutes after the entrance and this is a good place to plan your route with the map provided as you enter. The soft drinks were reasonably priced 160 for a  Sprite and the cafe has some very clean bathrooms. The gardens are peaceful and whilst there are many more impressive botanical gardens around the world this is a pleasant way to spend couple of hours.

Title: Beautiful Gardens and Relaxing Walk
Text: We were with a small tour group to see the gardens. The gardens are very well designed and have speciality areas for different types of flowers and trees.  Several historical trees have signs indicating who and when the tree was planted. For instance, both Queen Elizabeth and a Russian Astronaut planted trees in this garden   There are monkeys on the property so you should not have food with you while walking.  Also, a restaurant is available on the property.

Title: 2000 lkr per person
Text: Very expensive to visit here in off season. Nothing much to see in the month of jan... And not worth...

Title: beautiful gardens
Text: Huge gardens with a great array of plants and areas to walk. You can organise a drive around the gardens from just inside the gate which will help cover a lot more area of the gardens especially on a hot day.Beautifully maintained and well cared for.

Title: Gorgeous Gardens
Text:
One of our favourite stops during our visit to Sri Lanka, these historic gardens are impressive, and beautifully maintained.

Featuring trees, plants and flowers from all over the world, it is a testament to the curiosity of British settlers who first established them (and the to sustained commitment of the Sri Lankan government to preserving the site.

Lovely grounds to stroll, with many spots providing cooling shade to escape the often oppressive heat. 

We spent a few hours roaming, and saw perhaps half of the park. 

The orchid house is s highlight, as are the tree-lined pathways featuring particular species (double coconuts, royal palms, etc).

Title: Relaxing Walk
Text: My wife and I enjoyed a lovely casual stroll around the gardens on a sunny afternoon. The gardens are amazing with so many different species and variety of plans to see and admire. You can enjoy watching the monkeys play here too there are a lot of them around the trees and you can also see many flying squirrels here too. Well worth going here to chill and take a break.

Title: Magnificent gardens
Text: It's really worth visiting these gardens and don't skimp on time as there's a lot to see. It's beautifully laid out and well signposted.

Title: Beautiful garden
Text: Very large garden located about 6km away from the city centre (~6 km; 20 mins by tuk tuk). Ticket prices: 1,500 Rs (adult), 1,000 Rs (student. They accept international student IDs). Takes about 2 hrs to go through the garden. Clean, beautiful and great variety of different gardens and plant species. Would highly recommend for those seeking some serenity away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

Title: Wonderful gardens
Text: Enjoyed a full day in these splendid gardens and still didnt see everything.   Highlights included the incredible mahoganies with their extraordinary roots, the cannonball trees whose flowers are so delicate, the talipot palm with an unusual life cycle and the gracious avenue of palms.   Good buffet lunch at the canteen and a kiosk for later refreshments.

Title: Large and beautiful gardens
Text: These gardens are offering countless species of local exotic flora. My favorite was royal palms, memorial trees and house of orchids but that is just a tiny part of what you can run into there. Reserve few hours and about about 1500lkr for this large area that is an ideal place for walks and relax.

Title: Lovely huge gardens
Text: This is a lovely tranquil place in a very busy Kandy. The gardens are really well maintained. There is an area with fruit bats in loads of trees, an orchid house and a very scary looking suspension bridge. The gardens are really worth a visit.

Title: A beautiful place
Text: A beautiful place to spend a couple of hours away from the hustle and bustle of Kandy... giant bamboo... lakes..monkeys and bats. So big it cant really be crowded... calm and tranquil

Title: Extremely beautiful
Text: This park is gorgeous! It's one of my favourite places in the world because it's extremely beautiful and very well-kept. Plus, if you enjoy being in contact with nature, I'm sure you will love spending some time here!

Title: Fabulous!
Text: Visited here while on a tour of Sri Lanka.  What an oasis of calm and tranquility!  Some very impressive tree lined avenues and many fabulous specimen trees.

Title: Beautiful Tranquil Gardens
Text: We visited on a very hot day and there is not a lot of shade. Allow a couple of hours and go on the suspension bridge for photo. The orchid house is amazing there is such a variety of plants and trees. The fruit bats were interesting to see and we also saw lots of monkeys. Definitely needs to be on your itinerary when visiting Kandy.

Title: Interesting , a wide selection of trees - More Trees than Plants
Text: Impressive collection of Trees from all over the World. A pleasant afternoons' diversion from the mayhem of downtown Kandy. The tree collection is quite spectacular. The Orchid House the Rose Garden etc were a little disappointing. That said I have never seen such a range of tree specimens. The Palm avenue and the Giant Bamboo trees are awesome. Well worth a visit for a couple of hours. More interesting than Kandy itself

Title: Beautiful gardens - must see for nature enthusiasts
Text: 200 year old royal botanic garden with a huge variety of flora and fauna to see.  TIPS: thousands of bats live on the island, so if you are lucky (or loom long enough, you will definitely see and hear them. unique experience. I would suggest to plan 1.5 hrs. Garden tours on electric gold vehicles are also on offer for those who cant walk long

Title: Stunning scenery.
Text:
A beautiful  tranquil  oasis  of greenery and colour amidst the noise and traffic of downtown  Kandy. What a calming place to visit after a hectic day sightseeing in the urban area.
With exotic species  of all kinds plus butterflies and birds that really is too much to do and see in one visit. 
Highly recommended.

Title: Amazing Trees!
Text: Not somewhere we would normally go but had a spare afternoon and made a visit. Very glad we did, beautiful and extensive gardens full of extraordinary trees and specimens. Need at least a couple of hours to explore - suspension bridge over the river, fruit bats flying about and hanging down/dripping from the trees for the night, fascinating canon ball tree and many more surprises.

Title: Pleasant botanical gardens (with a lovely orchid house)
Text: This is quite a large botanical garden and takes at least 2-3 hours to walk around. It can also be quite hot as there are large sections of lawn that are unshaded. It's a nice place for a wander, and the orchid house, although not overly large, is really, really good. There's a cafe in the middle if you want to stop for a rest and cold drink.

Title: Lovely and beautiful gardens
Text: Really beautiful gardens. Plenty of space to walk around and relax.Very green and lots of places to stay and enjoy the silence. We have seen many amazing specimens. We enjoyed very much the Cook's Pine Avenue.

Title: Lots of plants and Lots of bats
Text: Really nice vast garden lots of interesting trees from all over the world. The garden is home to 24,000 bats which can be seen hanging from the trees, breathtaking. There are  also monkeys in the garden as well as a suspension bridge over a river which can be walked on. There is a lovely buffet that can be had for lunch as well.

Title: Exceeded expectations
Text: Slightly outside of Kandy with a not cheap entry price,especially for those that are accustomed to free access to parks, but well worth a visit. Wonderful place to while away several hours in a generally peaceful and interesting environment. There are lots of plants that were impressive (and a huge herd of bats) and that weve not seen before, and also interesting installations. Bring water - it gets hot and only some parts have shade. Lots of picnickers too. There is a shuttle that goes around as the grounds are really large.

Title: An hour well spent
Text:
We popped in for a walk and chill In the peaceful and beautiful surroundings 

Could have stayed longer but worth it even for an hour 

Stunning settings

Title: Wonderful gardens
Text: Great things to see around every corner and welcome shade for the hotter parts of the day! The gardens are clean and well maintained. Well worth a visit if you need a quiet couple of hours.

Title: Park
Text:
Do not be put off by the word "botanical".  This is a beautiful parkland.  We would recommend hiring a guide and also a buggy which in our case was a necessity but even so our tour lasted over an hour.  The history of british monarchs can be traced here with the planting of trees to mark their visits.  There is so much of interest, trees, flowers, butterflies, birds, insects, amphibians, fish..... and our guide was so informative.  Well worth at least a half day visit. 
The only downside was being ripped off by the tuc tuc drivers.who wait outside.  We were charged 1500 rupees for a journey that should have been 500.  Walk away from the gates and pick up a driver down the road.  The tourist board could help by printing an approximate fare list. Geraldine and Frank

Title: Beautiful trees, plants and wildlife
Text: We were hesitant to visit this garden, as we were disappointed with the botanical garden near Nuwara Eliya. The royal botanical gardens, however, are just incredible. They are so vast that you can easily spend 3 hours there. The 1,500 entry fee for foreigners seems justified as you get to see such a big variety of flowers and tropical trees and on top of it all get to see lots of monkeys, fox bats and water buffalos. There are many, huge green spaces where you can just relax or have a small picnic.

Title: Wonderful, Must-Visit For Nature Lovers
Text: The Royal Botanic Gardens are a Must-See for any nature lovers or To escape the noise and grime of busy Kandy.  Peradeniya is 15-min tuk-tuk Ride from Kandy. The grounds are expansive, there are paths and walkways and special exhibit houses for orchids, Cactus, bamboo gardens and more.  The Orchid House was my favorite.

Title: Must visit
Text: This is a must visit site when in Kandy. Very relaxing garden with plenty of different types trees, flowers and other interesting plants etc. Good reserve around 2-3 hours for the visit.

Title: Tourist tax strikes again!
Text:
Locals pay 60rp
Tourist pays 3000rp ($30)

Very pretty inside if you like plants and trees. Lots of people and monkeys. 

I wouldn't go back.
Try it, you might like it!

Title: Loved the Botanic Gardens!
Text: Definitely worth a visit. I spent a beautiful 2 hours walking around the perimeter of the gardens, so much to see and so beautifully set out.

Title: Definitely a place to visit!
Text: It is a place where you can spend a beatiful 3 hours and really enjoy in nature. It is meticulousy organized and well mantained. Bring a blanket to lay down on some of big lawns and relax.

Title: Stunning botanical gardens with historical significance
Text: I used to ride around these gardens when I was a child in the late-1960s and early-1970s. You can't do that now and it's best to hire an electric cart with a guide who can tell you about the plants. Apparently these gardens were first established by a King of Kandy in late-1300 AD. When the British colonised the country they established the Royal Botanical Gardens in 1843. The gardens occupy about 150 acres and are maintained immaculately and meticulously which is great. I spent about an hour because I didn't have time, but I think you need about 3 hours to explore every part of the gardens.

Title: Worth a visit
Text: Pleasant walking through all the massive trees. Map was useful. Even though there was a lot of people there it still felt as if you were on your own at times which was lively

Title: Beautiful Gardens
Text: If you go to Kandy, make the time to visit these gardens. We entered via the suspension bridge (rather than the main entrance) which is worth doing as it is a nice walk across the river into the gardens. Visit the orchid house, see the monkeys, see the bats (flying between the trees and hanging from overhead branches), and enjoy the peace of this tranquil place. I reckon you could lose a couple of hours here and it would be a great location for a picnic. The area is very well kept and a pleasure to walk around.

Title: WE LOVE THIS PLACE SO MUCH WE GOT A YEARLY PASS!
Text: It has something for all year round - they have a beautiful rose garden which we did in Sept., we saw the bulbs in Feb., we saw the rock garden in spring & summer - we bought a 'grandparents' pass so we can bring in kids plus 2 other adults when we go so that this is out go to place for out of town visitors, on baby-sitting days sometimes we take our grandchildren & they like the exhibits as well as the jungle gym playground that tires them more than us but we make it our last stop then home - it is 30 minutes from our home which is perfect for us but well worth a trip on its own from farther afield

Title: Charming Garden
Text: This is an interesting garden with variety of orchids, seasonal flowers & trees . Beautifully kept . Needs lots of walking around. Difficult to move if you have toddlers or children.

Title: Beautiful gardens with pleasant small restaurant/cafe.
Text: Approx 20 mins outside Kandy (very busy roads) this is a real treat for those who love gardens, trees, flowers and history.

Title: Wonderful Arboretum and Botanical Garden - poor labelling of plants
Text: Great for nature lovers, should ideally go in the early morning or close to sunset to avoid the heat of the afternoon. Many species of birds, a very large roost of Flying Foxes, lovely gardens intersting collection of fauna - but the relatively poor labelling of the plants robs some of the pleasure of the garden.

Title: Garden is lovely but cafeteria crushed experience
Text: Park is lovely and peacefull. Do not bother to order sri lankan omelette in cafeteria. U get only bland omelette with few bits of tomato. Asked about it from waitress. They just throwed me a loads of chili on different plate next to omelette. Been in Sri Lanka 1 month and this is definetly the Worst customer experience this far.

Title: Wonderful Gardens
Text: This is probably the most wonderful botanical garden I have visited. There is a staggering array of trees, bamboos, ferns and colourful flowers from all over the world. Even the huge grassed areas are remarkably attractive. The hundreds of fruit bats in some of the trees are spectacular to see. The orchid house is small but nevertheless very good, although it would help if there were labels identifying the various types. We spent about 2.5 hours here but would have happily spent much longer if time had allowed.

Title: Rival to Kew ??
Text:
Wonderful gardens immaculately maintained with a superb orchid house and plant house.
Set up in 1821, it has been extended and added to ever since.
There are some magnificent trees, both indigenous as well as tropical all set out in extensive grounds. By the river is the extraordinary sight of the flying fox bats with wingspans of over 1mtr.
For those at all interested in flora , this is a must see, and a very enjoyable way to spend a couple of hours.

Title: Glorious botanical gardens
Text: We could have spent the whole day here. Such beautiful mature trees, palms, shrubs and flowers and so well kept. There are lots of shad d places to sit down in when you are a bit frazzled with the sun. It is worth going. My favourite was the memorial garden area with trees planted by past and present world leaders and famous figures from history. The flying foxes are also a must-see.

Title: Great day out
Text:
Great day out with my mum, was very peaceful and relaxing to walk around, the greenhouses were beautiful, however not many flowers were outside due to the time of year, so would defiantly come back in summer time to see the flowers. We booked last minute and got discount online so would defiantly recommend booking online! 

However the orangery restaurant was awful!!!! Would not recommend, floors were disgusting, food was over priced, waitresses looked unhappy, coffee from machine was disgusting and the doors were constantly being left open making it cold inside! So thats the only bad thing I would say. 

Overall the gardens were beautiful.

Title: Beautiful tree collections
Text: Nice beautiful cool place in hot Sri Lankan hot weather. Natural cools air will full of oxyzen lot of flowers and trees

Title: Beautiful
Text:
Not normally my cup of tea but everyone spoke to recommended it after a long drive and visit to the tooth temple and tbh I wasnt disappointed! 
Very well kept vast gardens with many points of interest and some beautiful floral arrangements !

Title: Entry via suspension bridge
Text: We took side entrance using suspension bridge, which was fantastic. At the end of it number of monkeys welcomed us. You should be careful though as they are far for being innocent. The botanical garden is a must see in Kandy. Its calm and relaxing and you can walk around as there is plenty shadow provided by some amazing trees. Entrance fee for 2 adults and 2 children is 4500 Rs.

Title: An amazing garden
Text: An incredible collection of plant life, small and large, and well worth a visit. Take a hat and plenty of water because it get's very hot walking the grounds, but well worth the effort.

Title: Clearly a Kandy must-see
Text: Really lovely gardens and huge so you can avoid the crowds that inevitable gather here. Lots of plants and trees to see and learn about but most people engage with the monkeys. There is an amazing colony of fruit bats in the trees by the river. Allow 2-3 hours to stroll around slowly in the heat.

Title: Hire a buggy if you want to see it all
Text: Visited as part of a group and the buggy was recommended by our local guide. A great idea as the driver spoke excellent English, was very knowledgeable and clearly loves these gardens. Highlights were the royal planted trees, the palm tree walk, orchid house and the cafe with a cool breeze wafting over the terrace while we had a late lunch and cold beers. Even if you have little interest in botanical gardens do visit. Its like an oasis of fresh clean air and wide open spaces in a busy city.

Title: Unexpected Treasure
Text: We were on a day tour from the Cinnamon Grand to the Elephant Orphanage and Temple of the Tooth and our guide, Nishantha, suggested visiting the gardens. They were stunning. Unlike NZ and the UK there is no need for glasshouses and we saw many beautiful and imposing plants. The age of the trees is impressive as it is an old park (1371AD). The Great Circle was really interesting as dignitaries over the last 150 years have been planting trees. There was a riot of colour in places, awesome avenues and gigantic bamboos. The gardens are huge (147 acres) and  we would recommend paying 250 rupees (2 NZ$) extra and taking the shuttle tour if you only have limited time. You could easily spend a day here and it was a romantic spot for couples.

Title: Fantastic Variety of Plants
Text:
We could easily have spent all day here. Peaceful, quiet but beautiful. The variety of plants is amazing. 
Originally a royal pleasure garden  but laid out by the British in 1824. 
Look pout for the flying foxes!!

Title: Excellent way to fill in a few hours
Text: The botanical gardens are well worth a visit. Very well maintained grounds. You can take a buggy around however there is no English commentary. A few more English signs on the trees and plants would go over well.

Title: Lovely place to relax and escape the heat and hustle and bustle of Kandy.
Text: Lovely gardens with beautiful big trees and gorgeous plants of all types. Colourful flowers, shrubs, hedges, trees, all you would expect in a botanical garden. Lots of walking paths, some along the river and also a great little suspension bridge that goes across the river. Lots of seats to take a break as well as a cafe and toilets.

Title: Worth the entrance fee
Text: We really enjoyed wandering around these well maintained gardens for a couple of hours. It was especially pleasant after the hustle and bustle of the temple area. The orchid house alone was worth the visit - a beautiful display of colour! The cafeteria by the great lawn was very reasonable for a welcome drink

Title: Wow place
Text:
Quite big, requires a lot of long walk. But worth the ticket price.  Start early and avoid the heat. Tall trees  to shrubs , from across the world. Variety of species which are beyond description.  
Must visit attraction if in Kandy.

Title: Fantastic
Text:
After a long period of non-stop rain, we headed out to the Botanical Gardens in a tuk tuk with our fingers crossed that it wouldn't be a complete washout. The place turned out to be far better than we'd have dared to hope.

The entrance fee of 1500 rupees (about £7) for foreigners is not cheap - but nothing in Kandy worth seeing seems to be cheap. I would say though that it was absolutely worth it.

The site is enormous with a spectacular diversity of plants and trees and lots to see and do. The map was a bit rubbish as it didn't really suggest any sensible way to tackle the gardens, so we just blundered about a bit, saving the orchid house until last and focusing first on the outdoor areas just in case the rain came back.

We had lunch at the cafeteria beside the Great Lawn, watching hundreds of children playing tag during their lunch break. The food at the cafeteria was surprisingly good value for such a 'captive audience' kind of place - we had a fish curry set meal including soup and fruit salad plus a lime soda each and it was about 2000 rupees for more food than we could eat.

The fern house was a bit of a health and safety trap with tools and hoses left out all over the place but everything else was in good working order.

We got a bus back to the city for just 20 rupees each after we left. The bus stops are to the left of the entrance. Tuk Tuks were asking 500. Just ask if the bus goes to the clock tower or central market.

Title: Botanic Gardens
Text: Well worth a visit although the entry price is a bit steep for foreigners - 1500LKR per person. The orchid house displayed some beautiful orchids and there were other lovely gardens, cafes and restaurants and plenty of open spaces and shade. We took around 2 hours to explore and have some lunch, and would have spent more time were it not so hot.

Title: Delightful
Text: I didnt think I would enjoy a walk through a Botanical Garden, especially in the heat but was delighted with our walk around the gardens.  Our driver said about two hours would do it we only took an hour and enjoyed it immensely.  Not long after walking into the gardens a snake slithered across our path with my husband nearly stepping on it, gave us a fright.  The gardens were beautiful and I actually saw several types of trees I had never seen before.  The monkeys were different to others we had seen with a big red face.  A friendly Gardener approached for a chat and then of course wanted a tip.

Title: Quiet retreat
Text: Nice place to escape the busy town of Kandy. It was nice to walk around and well maintained. Also pleasant to stop for a cup of Ceylon tea and an ice cream in the tea house. Display houses not so good and man who told us a few things wanted a tip!!

Title: Eden?!
Text:
A really beautiful, expansive, well laid out garden.  Perfect Eden just out of the main city.
Informative reading material and map provided at the ticket office.
Pleasant restaurant by the main green for lunch and drinks.
We spent a wonderful few hours here strolling along the various avenues of plants and trees.
A highlight of our stay in Kandy.

Title: beautiful place in kandy!!!!
Text:
Its a lovely garden with maintained place, plenty of interesting trees to see and knowledge.
The orchid house is wonderful. There is a shop if you want to relax and have a cup of coffee. You can simply spend 2 hours to cover all the places. I would like to recommend this place if you can walk long if not you can hire a small car inside the garden.

Title: Fascinating!
Text: The Royal Botanical Garden is an absolutely fascinating place. Be ready to walk, as it takes at least 2 hours to go around and enjoy the scenery. The gardens are very well maintained and an absolute must see!

Title: Expansive place well maintained
Text:
Its a nice garden with lots of interesting trees to see and experience such as, double coconut (never heard of it before), giant bamboo tree, 25 varietes of grass.

The orchid house is nice with some very delightful species. However the display is not as tastefully done as one would see in places like Singapore or Netherlands.

We had to hire a buggy as I was travelling with my elderly parents who would have found it hard to walk the entire length.

With the help of the buggy, we saw the garden in an hour. It was handy to have the buggy (which cost 2000 LKR + 500LKR as tip for the driver) as it had started raining heavily while we were still on the rounds.

There is a small gift shop and a barrista coffee place too if needed.

Title: Get a buggy
Text: If time is short then I would recommend hiring buggy with driver. Buggy seets 7 and costs LKR2000 plus LKR500 tip for driver who doubles as commentator & photographer.  It takes 1 hour & allows you to see most of the garden. Particularly useful if weather is too humid.

Title: Just when you think what is so special!
Text: What a find, this is beautifully laid out and takes gardens to a new level, meandering walks, cool breezes, shady oasis and plenty of places to simply stop and smell the air.

Title: Stunning gardens and family park
