He even helped us take amazing photos of the animals as we only had iPhone cameras. 
We were picked up and dropped us off as part of the service, there was a driver as well as Lahiru as a guide which was a lot better than just having a driver as he was able to spot animals and wildlife better. 
We all had such a wonderful day and would recommend a safari at Uduwalawa National Park to anyone :) (especially with Lahiru!!)

Title: Solo Travelers Discriminated Against
Text:
Entry fees skyrocketed about 2 weeks ago. Solo travelers pay $43USD, which is about $7USD more than two travelers entering together and so on ($43USD for individuals vs $36 USD if you're a couple). Also, as a point of reference the current entrance fee for Kruger National Park in South Africa is $27USD. $43USD is an extremely high entrance fee for any National Park in the world.  I know there's a cost savings on vehicles when you share one, but a solo traveler penalty is ridiculous. 

I tried to find people at the gate entrance to share a safari with. Many of the tourists were interested,  but the guides have a "mafia" type "wilderness association" and refused to let any tourists share costs.

Was it worth it? Maybe once. Well, when others described "herds of elephants" in their reviews, I was expecting herds, like in Tanzania, Kenya or like other places in Africa.  I believe herds in Sri Lanka means families of elephants, which numerically speaking are smaller-- maybe 5 or 6 in a family vs 10+ in Africa. There is a good variety of wildlife-- elephants, deer, monkeys, buffalo, crocodiles, mongoose, jackals, boar, peacocks and other birds. It was nice. 

If you're interested in going, I eventually went with the owner of my homstay, Nalaka, +94 77 635 8192. He took me on a 4 hour jeep safari for 8,500 rp. He was great at spotting birds baby elephants, and other wildlife that other guides who denied me didn't see.

Title: Fantastic experience with many elephants to see!
Text: A truly awesome place! It's a huge and beautiful place, yet small enough to cover in two hours! A big win when you have kids or don't want to spend hours driving around looking for animals.  I've never seen so many elephants in my life!  Our tour guide was fantastic, very knowledgeable and helpful. We forgot something in the car, so he came the next day to Tangalle to give it to us. Very cool of him! (Lahiru +94 76 272 6799 - very much recomended!)

Title: Amazing experience!
Text: Within 5 minutes of entering the park, we saw a herd of 10 elephants bathing just 10 feet from our jeep.  We were mesmerised.  It was such an awesome experience.

Title: Excellent 6hr safari with lahiru
Text:
Had an amazing 6hr safari experience with Lahiru. He prepared  delicious breakfast for us to enjoy in the jeep. The pick up and entrance to the park was smooth. We would definately recommend his services. 
He was well priced, punctual, polite, considerate and a good communicator. He has a deep knowledge of animals and plants and answered all of our questions. His ability to get away from the crowds gives you a unique experience with the animals.
We saw so many animals and more elephants than we could count. I would thoughly recommend booking with him. Lahiru +94 76 272 6799.

Title: An excellent park
Text: I was quite surprised, the terrain was quite like many African safaris we have been on, clay roads, very uneven in parts but very picturesque. Places you would like to stop and just wait to see if any animals cross your path. In addition to elephants, and we saw many, there were spotted deer, sambar, crocodile, jackal, water buffalo, lots and lots of peacocks in display and many other birds. Elephants were single males sometimes but also several large family groups. And nice picturesque spots to just sit in quiet and wait to see if anything passes out of the bush. Our guide from Induwaru Safari Resort where we stayed was exceptional. Care was taken when driving not to disturb animals, plenty of time allowed for viewing to our requirements, effort obviously put in not to follow the crowd. Breakfast was taken on safari, sandwiches, egg, pancakes, fruit juice and fruit. A mobile breakfast better than many we have been served in the accommodations.

Title: Extraordinary with Mansala Safari
Text:
We had an incredible time in Udawalawe  in large part because we booked with the incredible Mansala Safari Resort. Whether staying in their beautiful hotel or just taking their safari, we cant recommend them enough  theyre one of the best choices Ive made while travelling.

Mansala basically arrange everything  safari, binoculars, transit, entry to the national park  and you pay at the end. It was one of the cheapest options we found but also one of the best.

Tirons guide Tharanga took us on our safari.  Like Tiron, hes locally born and a genuine animal lover. He did everything the guidebooks tell you youll want in a guide  he was respectful of the animals, never crowded them, avoided hotspots full of other drivers, gave us information without overloading us, and showed us everything. 

We saw:
-	A herd of baby elephants
-	Crocodiles
-	Water buffalo
-	Lots of deer, including stags and, essentially, bambi
-	A family of wild boar, including 8 gorgeous little piglets running about in what my partner called the best thing Ive ever seen
-	Lots of birds, including peacocks, storks, different types of eagles, woodsand pipers, little green bee eaters (really beautiful), cormorants, lapwings, hoopoes
-	A surprise tortoise
-	Surprise mongeese

You can do an evening or morning safari, or both. We did an evening safari, which finishes before 6pm; we arrived at 2pm and went straight out onto it, which was more than enough time.

The hotel itself is a lovely family-run operation, with two rooms and the family living in the building. Despite the homey, personal feel, everything from the food to the rooms to the safari is of the highest possible standard.

Food is cooked by the family, eaten on the veranda with animals around  and is some of the best we ate on our trip. Eat there rather than going out into Udawalawe.

The room was one of the best we stayed in in Sri Lanka, despite often paying significantly more than at Mansala  beautiful, comfortable, well-equipped, modern  everything we needed. 

Tiron, who runs the place, is a really kind and generous man. He was born in the house youre staying in, knows the local area really well, and was one of our favourite people we met in Sri Lanka. When the driver hed booked for our 2-hour drive to Mirissa was suddenly unavailable, he took us himself. His number is +94 77 795 9090 - he's given us permission to share it, and is very responsive to WhatsApps.

If you want a really ethical, personal, kind experience, we cant recommend Tiron, Tharanga and Mansala enough. We had a really special time, with really special people.

Title: Safari Guide
Text: My wife and I chose Lahiru as our safari guide for Udawalawe National Park. He was amazing!!! We highly recommend him. He was very punctual, and picked us up at our hotel right on time at 5:45am. He communicated with us immediately after we messaged him via WhatsApp (+94 76 272 6799) prior to the tour and we discussed what we were looking for in the safari tour. He provided exactly what we hoped for - an amazing wildlife tour of the park in the routes that werent busy with other jeeps. He was very knowledgeable about the different species of all animals in the park and how they compared to other species abroad. He answered all of our questions on the tour. He showed us all of the best places in the park and allowed us to enjoy and take in the park environment and nature. He was the best safari tour guide we have ever used. We highly recommend him - he was professional, courteous, and knew the park and its wildlife so well. He is the best!

Title: Even a full day isn't enough !
Text:
So many birds, so many animals - such beautiful sceneries... Parakeets zoom by in flocks, loudly screechig. I loved every single minute in the park.
Try to go for a full day.  Once past 10AM, you have the park to yourself.

Title: Amazing Safari
Text: Me and my wife had the most amazing safari experience this morning. We arranged it with Lahiru (+94 (76) 272 6799) the night before - he organised transport from Ella for us and took us on an incredible tour of the park. The driver he arranged was there on time and drove very carefully to the National Park. The safari itself was awesome - Lahiru was a great guide - giving us lots of useful information about the animals and spotting some hidden animals mere mortals would never see! In total we saw 20 elephants, water buffalo, spotted deer, jackal, peacocks, lots of different birds, monkeys, monitor lizards, a mongoose and much more. Would not hesitate to book again with Lahiru and well worth the money! For anyone wanting to know the trip took about 1 hour 45 from Ella.

Title: Awesome tour with the very best guide!
Text:
Before our first holidays in Sri Lanka we tried to get some information and tipps about a game drive in the Udawalawe National Park. One name appeared again and again with only very excited positive reviews: Lahiru (Whatsapp +94 76 272 6799). We contacted him about 2 weeks before our trip and booked a Safari (1/2 day). We were very curious - is there a difference to other guides? Well, the first difference was: he even helped us to organize a driver who picked us up in after our train-journey in Ella and brought us to Udawalawe, which was very herpful. Yesterday we had our Safari with Lahiru. He picked us up at the hotel at 2 p.m. and then  ... the whole afternoon was just AWESOME and OVERWHELMING!!!  Lahiru is a very good Jeep-driver who really knows the park and all it's hidden paths. Most of the time we didn't see any other safari-jeeps (while many others were driving in small convoys on the "main roads") ... but therefore more animals than we expected to see! Elephants - of course (once we were lucky to stop close to some elephants an after some minutes we found ourselfs in the middle of a herd - and buffalos, deers, some crocodiles, gold-jackals, mungos, 3 differend types of eagles, ... and lots of birds (pelicans, toucans, bee-eaters, peacocks, ...) and even the fresh trace of a leopard. It was ... NO WORDS! Lahiru knows a lot about all these animals, his eyes seem to see everything while he is driving  - it was perfect. He can also name some of the animals in German. I can recommend him as safari-guide without any doubt!

And don't forget to visit the elephant-orphanage. They take care about orphants from outside the national park and set them free in the park when they are grown up. You can watch the feeding - cued! Very affordable and definitely worth it!

Title: Most competent guide for the National Park is LAHIRU
Text:
We booked our tour in the park about 2 weeks before our holiday in Udawalawe. Many travellers on tripadvisor recommended Lahiru as the most competent guide. And we totally agree. He is very aware of the smallest signs of  animals. Birds, lizzards, mungos and even footsteps of a leopard in the sand..he sees it all, while driving his huge car safely and carefully over the bumpy road. He led us to places, where no other car was seen and we had the honour to see about 35-40 elephants..even 2 babys. We didn't drive in a konvoi and it seemed, that every time a car came close, we took the other way. So we had the opportunity to take fabulous pics. It was such an amazing experience..I'm still speechless and will remember this for the rest of my life. 
The park itself is such a gorgeous place..peacefull and quiet. You can hear so many sounds of nature. We would have liked to take a rest at the lake for a couple of hours to just sit and enjoy the scenery. 
Next time Sri Lanka we definitly will come back and make a visit. You should too and definitly contact Lahiru, he is very reliable and even organized a driver for our next destination. His number you can contact with Whatsapp is: +94 762726799

Title: Great tour with bathing elephants thanks to our guide Chaminda
Text:
We had a fantastic morning with Chaminda
in Udawalawe National park. We saw lots of elephants (including babies) but also crocodiles, monitor lizards, water buffalos, monkeys (macaques), golden jackals (and more) and lots and lots of birds and even eagles. We can definitely recommend asking Chaminda to be your guide: very kind, good English and he is a very good spotter! 

Call Chaminda: +94773379470

Title: Fantastic experience with Lahiru
Text:
We found recommendations for Lahiru through TripAdvisor and he lived up to the expectation! Friendly and so knowledgeable.. He found so many animals.. Spotted tiny birds etc. He took the time to take us out of the main area so we weren't surrounded by other keeps and we saw more animals.
We got cold water and snacks and had a fantastic time.
Finished the trip off seeing a tiny baby elephant and it's mother. Was amazing!

Lahiru. What's app: +94 76 272 6799

Title: Quiet park with plenty to see
Text: We just did one afternoon safari here and we were lucky to see iots of elephants as well as plenty of birds, a crocodile. If you want to se leopards then Yala is certainly better but there are more visitors so sometimes you do not get to see animals due to number of vehicles, to an issue here

Title: My tour
Text: Lahiru was a amazing man,, as a tour and a guide he is was also excellent!! He has the eye of a eagle he can spot a animal from a 100m away no mater how small!! He even spotted a lizard in a tree that no man should of been able to see!! We saw so many animals crocs, birds, wild cats, deer, so many elephants! We even got mock charges by a big male elephant, and he new just what to do to keep every one on the jeep out of harms way!! He gets close to the animals so you can see but not so close the animals get scared and run away!! He has a ability to find the bet views of all animals!! And he is a very nice and funny guide!! His English is perfect!! We even went for a drink after Cus we got on so well!! A true gentleman ??????

Title: Udawalawe Park with guide Lahiru
Text:
Based on the reviews from tripadvisor, we hired Lahiru as our guide. Using his Whatsapp number, i booked the trip ahead of time. He had arranged a Toyoto mini van to pick up and drop us from Mirissa. Very comfortable van. For the park, there was another big van customized for the Safari. We saw elephants really up close and peacock dancing. 
Overall, good experience.

Title: Great place for a 3hr safari trip
Text:
This is the park to be if one wishes to see elephants. We also saw lots of birds, some deers, primates a dead deer being devoured by a crocodile, buffalos and enjoyed a nice ride. 
Would recommend doing it early in the morning as it wasn't crowded (about 12 jeeps or so in total).

Title: Brilliant safari
Text: We went early to get to the front of the queue which I would recommend. We were there at 5:30, the park opens at 6:30 and were the third jeep in. We saw lots of elephants, crocodiles, deer, buffalo, birds, lizards etc. It was excellent and when we spoke to other groups we were lucky to see so much. Go early and be ready to run when the ticket office opens.

Title: Amazing Safari with Lahiru Prasad
Text:
Lahiru took us on the most amazing Safari at Uduwala. I got his recommendation on Trip Advisor and he did not disappoint. We saw all sorts of birds, water buffalo, monkeys, crocodiles and elephants, lots of elephants. He seemed to know all the best spots in the park and also was very knowledgeable. He would position the vehicle for better photo opportunities. We saw 3 separate groups of elephants with babies that came within feet of our vehicle. Plus many more from a distance throughout the Safari. Lahiru seems to really enjoy the animals and making sure you have the best experience. 
I contacted him through email which he always replied promptly Lahiru.jpdk@gmail.com
Or WhatsApp +94 76 272 6799

Title: Great wildlife, however...
Text:
Amazing wildlife. We saw a lot of elephants, peacocks, crocodiles, eagles, storks, bee eaters, a jackal, kingfishers and a lot of other birds. 
However, we thought that some og the jeeps drove too close to the elephants, stressing them. We arranged the safari through our hotel, and our drivers were respectful. We also thought that the people travelling only two in one car could have gone together to minimize the number of jeeps

Title: Awesome Safari
Text:
We took a 3 hr Safari booked through Viator with Bentota Travel. Bentota Travel is another story so i'm not going to say anything about that. 
We arrived at the reserve after going to the elephant sanctuary and transferred to a Jeep. Access to the jeep required climbing in through a narrow gap at the back of the vehicle while standing on a Beer crate!!! Not easy for a couple of portly nearly 60 year olds, but it makes for a good story afterwards!!
We engaged the services of a guide ( they do not charge as such, you just tip them at the end of the safari what you think their services were worth) I would thoroughly recommend getting a guide. We didn't know where to look and the driver is too busy keeping his eye on the track to spot for you. In the end it was so worth having him as he was able to point out Monitors, Lizards, and birds that we just wouldn't have spotted. 
We saw wild buffalo, jackals, numerous colourful birds and birds of prey, Turtles, Lizards, Monitors and Loads of Elephants. We were lucky enough to see a family group of about 10 elephants along with 2 week old calf, a couple of smaller family groups, numerous single elephants (Including one asleep leaning against a tree!), but the highlight was a Mother and Calf pair who crossed the track in front of us and went to the lake edge to drink. They then proceeded to bathe and play in the water. 
At the same time, they were surrounded by buffalo complete with storks standing on their backs (I kid you not!!)
All in all, an amazing 3 hrs and some of it quite emotional. We didn't seem to drive for more than a couple of minutes without seeing something. We did however meet some Landrovers with tourists and guide who had been in the park for 2 hrs and hadn't seen anything more than a couple of birds. i think we were extremely lucky and we happened to drop on a good guide who knew his stuff. Amazing Experience.

P.s. Getting out of the Jeep was much easier, I went out through the front Drivers window!!!!

Title: A super safari in the PARK1
Text: We took a three hour safari arranged by our hotel. We were very fortunate to see over thirty elephants around the tracks that we took. The vehicle is comfortable but the road is extremely bumpy. Many birds to see too! The driver and the guide are well versed in how to spot the animals and we were not disappointed; crocodiles, water buffaloes, cranes, eagles, owls, and the elephants! What a thrill. The safari cost is around $40 USD plus the entrance fee of $25USD for each person. Money taken in helps run the facility so great value. The more elephants protected the better. There are over three hundred  elephants in this park. Dont forget to tip your guide and driver - about 1000 rupees each.

Title: Elephants and Peacocks
Text: it was our first safari so my review might be biased. we saw a lot of elephants and peacocks and a few other birds. the park seems to be well maintained and drivers seem to be following rules and there seems to be a general respect for animals so all in all we had a good time.

Title: park with elephants
Text: The park has mainly elephants to see, make sure to book your car with a proper agency it should cost around 3600 RP for 2 + the entrance 7800 for 2 don't book at the entrance or you ll get scammed. A bit sad to have all the cars harassing these beautiful animals though... the price to pay for the protection of this place ...maybe

Title: Unforgettable Safari with Lahiru
Text: I booked myself & partner in for an 8 hour tour of Udawalawe which we visited today, we choose Lahiru Prasad as our guide on a friends recommendation & TA reviews & booked him via Whatsapp (+94 76 272 6799). The National Park itself has amazing scenery, lagoons, bush & jungle along with lots of wildlife. We saw many different bird species including hawk, horn bills, fish owl, hummingbird, bee-eaters & jungle fowl, along with crocodiles, spotted deer, chameleons, mongoose, monitor lizards, wild boar and a pack of the rarely spotted golden jackal! We also saw 30 Elephants, solo males & herds of females along with 2 babies, one of which was only 2 months old. Most of our elephant spottings were just us alone with no other jeeps around, we were able to sit with a herd of females & baby eating grass around the jeep for over half an hour! Without sounding like an advert this was 100% down to Lahiru, he knows the park very well & took us on different trails to find the animals that other jeeps werent on. Hes super knowledgeable about all the animals & answered any questions we had & managed to spot animals other jeeps with just a driver were driving past & missing. As it is also mating season the male elephants were quite difficult to approach, despite this we felt very safe & confident in Lahirus Jeep. Over the 8 hours Lahiru was still stopping & showing us things until we left the park, being so close to the elephants was an unforgettable experience, thank you Lahiru & driver & Udawalawe National Park! Lahiru also took us for a proper local curry afterwards & organised a very well priced taxi on to Ella for us!

Title: Very good - even for a non animal lover
Text: Set off from hotel at 6am just as dawn was breaking.  Fabulous view of trees against lightening sky.  Couldnt get a pic tho as driver going too fast.  Arrived at the park with what seemed like a lot of people.  But dubious at first we were going to be in one long traffic jam but the groups soon separated and we had the place to ourselves- mainly.  Saw elephants very close up, lots of birds including eagles, water buffalo, deer, monkeys and a crocodiles nose ??.  The ride was bumpy but we felt safe.  The drivers are excellent at spotting things to see and are very patient.  The best bit for me - sorry all you animal lovers - was a lake we stopped at. Gorgeous view of trees silhouetted across the lake.  Some beautiful trees in the park too.  Very worth the time and effort imo.  Beautiful place - very unspoiled.

Title: Highly Recomment Lahiru
Text: I don't even quite remember how I found out about Lahiru (somewhere on Trip Advisor), but I'm so glad we did.  I contacted him via WhatsApp literally two days before our safari, and he was immediately responsive and available.  Our driver (for the 9-day itinerary -- not Lahiru) was a bit nervous about us using a safari guide he was not familiar with, but after a quick phone conversation, Lahiru put our driver/guide's mind at ease. Lahiru met us early in the morning and brought us a box breakfast and water. The safari was just my husband and I, which was wonderful ($100 USD).  We were able to spend time on the animals of interest, and forego animals that were of less interest to us. He extended our safari by an hour so we could see more elephants (we had seen only a handful prior to the extended hour), and courteously called our driver/guide to ask "permission" to take us for the additional hour. Everything about the safari was professional and enjoyable. I would absolutely recommend Lahiru for safari.

Title: So many elephants
Text: We may not have had the most comfortable jeep (ripped vinyl seats that scratched the back of our legs) or informative guide ( our chauffer/driver who was accompanying us throughout Sri Lanka spotted more animals) but this became irrelevant with the number of elephants that we saw throughout the park. Also saw, water buffalo, birds, monkeys, peacocks, crocodiles and monitors. We also visited Yala and would recommend this park in preference to Yala.

Title: Great Park
Text: Safari in this park was excellent - we saw more than in Yala. Good keen & passionate safari driver made for an excellent visit. Lots to see! Don't expect Africa - it is very different - but still very good!

Title: Up Close and Personal with Elephants
Text: Saw elephants of all ages in their natural environment and also lots of bird life, deer, a large crocodile, a jackal and water buffalo. The highlight was watching two young male elephants playing together and at times they got quite energetic and rough (like alot of young boys). An excellent safari - highly recommend.

Title: A Daytrip with Lahiru
Text:
We had a perfect Daytrip with Lahiru. He picked us up at 6 a.m. (he arrived perfectly in time) and brought a little breakfast snack (water, cookies, kakao and a fried egg-roll).

We saw a lot of animals during our trip and Lahiru knows a lot of them. He even knew every bird and gave us a book with additional information after seeing special birds.

The total costs for the Daytrip (10 hours) was 150 for TWO person. So we had a private Safari.

We would totally recommend doing a Safari with Lahiru.

You can contact him on his Sri Lankan phone number: +94 76 272 6799

Title: Safari with Lahiru
Text: Depends on tons of positive reviews on TripAdvisor, I booked the safari with Lahiru(two for 18000LKR). Because of his knowledge of elephants, we saw two male elephants fighting. It is definitely unforgettable experience in Sri Lanka. Find Lahiru by whatsapp +94762727699.

Title: Must go here if you love elephants
Text: Really great to see elephants thriving in a natural 76,000 protected National Park habitat. Book through a wide range of tour companies..no need for a park guide as the tour guides are very good. You can get very close to the elephants...also great place for bird spotters as well as water and wild Buffalo, Monitor Lizards, Monkeys, Jackals and Leopards (if you are very lucky). Very safe and well organised. Good three hour drive from Galle and probably same from Colombo so long day ..leave 4 hours for park safari.

Title: Mansala Safari House made this a perfect experience
Text: We loved our Udawalawe National Park safari experience, from arriving at dusk and seeing the elephants waiting for bananas along the fence line, to the hospitability and great food at Mansala Safari House and, of course, our animal packed private sunrise safari tour  it was a magical 24 hours and one of the highlights of the trip! We booked only a few days before and were able to arrange a private safari through Tiron from Mansala Safari House, all through whatsapp and for a very reasonable price. On the day we were greeted by a lovely driver who spoke great English. There was no need to get a guide as he had a keen eye and was very good at spotting animals. He also provided us with Binoculars! When we entered the park entrance, there were probably 50 or so other jeeps but once we were let in we found that we were mostly alone during our 4 hour safari. If you are worried you will be in a line of jeeps and wont see any animals  we totally recommend you book with Tiron and stay at the Mansala Safari house.

Title: Trip to see elephants in the wild
Text: We stayed in the National park and arrived early morning to the reserve and were lucky enough to witness so many elephants their young wondering wild. The bird life was vast with peacocks buzzards and many more living unhindered. The vehicle we travelled in was driven by a local tour guild who pointed out the animals and told us about the protective laws now in place for the protection of the wildlife. Well worth doing but book locally as its much cheaper than using a travel agent.

Title: Lovely Park
Text:
Me and my friends decided to take a safari tour with Lahiru Prasad (+94762726799) after reading so many good reviews on here. He arranged a transfer from Ella into the park, it was very nice weather and he provide us with some water and biscuits. He was very knowledgeable about the animals and even spotted small animals other then the amazing elephants (we even managed to see a big family with even a few babies elephants), Lahiru drived us through where there werent many other jeeps and very quite places of the park so we mostly enjoyed the animals by ourselves. We also managed to see crocodiles, buffalos, eagles, and all sorts of fauna. 
Amazing experience ??

Title: Fantastic trip, definitely worth a visit!
Text:
We had a fantastic morning at the Udawalawe National Park. It was amazing to see so many wild animals out in the open plainsbirds, peacocks, elephants, water buffaloes, monkeys, chameleon. 

Our trip to the park was made possible with Lahiru. He organised a pickup from Mirissa and dropped us off at Ella in a clean and comfortable ride. Everything was seamless and smooth. He is also really knowledgeable about the park, the animals, and has a good eye for spotting them. The driver who came along was also very skilled and friendly. Lahiru also got us breakfast and provided cold drinks. We are really pleased and highly recommend him: +94762726799 (WhatsApp)

Title: An amazing experience!!!
Text:
Due to our visit in Sri Lanka this safari was on our list so we couldn't wait to feel the amazing experience being in nature, in the heart of a jungle where wild life exists and live.
After having spend around 2 hours and a half driving from Hikkaduwa and made a short stop to Elephant transit home to see the orphan elephants we took the special jeep for the safari. The day was perfect for such an activity warm but not hot and partly cloudy. Our driver was very good and was able to found all the hidden animals around the area, also very well educated regarding the animals and their bahviour.
We had so great time as we met a lot elephants alone or families, bulls, snake, peacocks, many birds and some crocodile and all in very close distance, like being part of this place. We met the youngest Elephant of the safari which was 4 months old next to his mother and the oldest which was 45 years old.
A great experience that we strongly recommend to all tourists that is going to visit Sri Lanka. Also is not a so expensive tour.
We had this tour with Norlanka Tours which are very good and very well organised company.

Title: Afternoon well spent in nature with Lahiru
Text:
We enjoyed our afternoon jeep Safari with Lahiru on the 17th in some fabulous weather. The safari jeep had six seats which we had all for ourselves - a group of 2 adults and 2 children. Lahiru had some water and snacks for us and he took us on off-beaten paths with no other jeeps around. 

Out in the park we saw eagles, bee-eaters, jackals, turtles, a croc, storks, pelicans, spotted deer, a hornbill, a magnificent brown fish owl, monitor lizards, kingfishers, cormorants, the ubiquitous peacocks and at least five herds of elephants spread across different locations totalling around fifty in all, some with one-month old babies. That I guess was pretty much everything one could spot in the park. Lahiru made us spend about twenty minutes close to a herd with baby elephants. It was exhilarating to see these mighty beasts in their eye, so close up. Lahirus photography skills were excellent too! The drive back past the Udawalawe reservoir in fading light was also awesome. 

I would say, this was well worth the 150$ for 4-hours of absolute bliss - we must have covered at least 40kms in all. We had chosen Lahiru based on the glowing TA reviews and boy, he did not disappoint. Contacting him at +94 762726799 was a breeze. One piece of advice- those with sensitive airways could do well with some masks because of the trailing dust from a jeep ahead of you on those dry jungle tracks.

Title: The best Jeep safari!
Text:
This is the second Jeep safari for us in Sri Lanka as we did not see any elephants on our first in Gal Oya National Park. 

In Udawalawe we saw over 20 elephants in different locations! There was one herd of approx 12 in a group together close to the road. We also saw a lot of other animals on the trip but the elephants were definitely the highlight! 

There are many jeeps waiting to take tours right across the road from the park. Our Jeep was comfortable and the driver/guide was great. It was 5000 rp each for approx 2 hours.

Title: Very nice safari
Text:
Very nice safari this morning with our driver Shameera. He was able to spot many animals for us with his "eagle eye". He drived sliwly so we can have time to observe the animals quietly. We saw elephants, foxes, crocodiles, buffalos, iguana, cameleon and many birds !!! Even if many jeeps are present, the park is big and we were alone most of the time or just followed by one jeep.
You can contact him at +94 76 481 0350

Title: If you like animals, you'll be bothered by this experience
Text:
This park really needs to change the way they do safaris and limit the amount of vehicles in the park. The problem is that they allow hotels to arrange safaris--which all compete with each, this results in an abundance of vehicles in the park with only 1-2 people. So when you see a family of elephants, too many vehicles swarm around them, prohibiting the animals from moving in the direction they want, and causing them to be stressed. Furthermore, with so many vehicles in one area, the exhaust smell is strong and the engines are loud---also not good for the elephants. The park also needs to be stricter with the drivers by reminding them to keep distance and respect the animals.

We all found this experience to be very troubling. I highly suggest when you book your safari, try booking through the park itself, and ask to be put with others in vehicles to limit them in the park. These animals need to be respected in their living space.

Title: Wonderful tour
Text: We decided to take an afternoon tour with Lahiru and we didn't regret it. Immediately we saw a huge mating elephant really up close, and many others throughout the tour, including some baby ones. Lahiru was great at spotting other animals, such as crocodiles, deers and so on. While we saw a few tour guides driving fast and scaring off birds and and elephant, Lahiru kept a really respective distance, and found ways to come close enough without disturbing them, which I really appreciated.

Title: If you love elephants this is the park for you...
Text: I don't think I have been so close to so many elephants on a safari, it was really special to see them thriving in their own habitat and obviously very used to  being observed by visitors as they didn't take any notice of people in safari jeeps... There was lots of other wildlife to see in the park but it was the elephants that make this such a special place...

Title: Sri Lankan Elephants
Text: Amazing wildlife safari in udawalawe. So many elephants.safari guide is very good, and knowledgeable. Nice day in Sri Lanka.

Title: Lots of elephants
Text: We were very lucky to have some close encounters with the elephants and to see jackals, crocodiles and water buffalo and then so many different birds that I cant list them all but bee eaters, peacocks, bush fowl, hornbills, kingfishers and painted stork were all to be found.  Great three hour game drive.

Title: Wonderful
Text:
We had a fantastic half-day safari where we spotted elephants, buffalo, deer, crocodiles, and a gazillion peacocks and other cool birds. We booked through our hotel and had an excellent guide who was very knowledgeable and could spot a green parrot in a tree from 20 metres! From reading other reviews it seems like you get what you pay for. 
When we were queuing we were worried about all the other vehicles around us but when we got into the park everyone went their separate ways. Maybe we were lucky, however - corona virus and the time of year meaning fewer tourists than usual. Also, I imagine some of the roads we drove down would be impassable in the wet season, forcing all the jeeps onto a few larger roads.
All in all, I loved it and got the chance to see elephants in the wild.

Title: Perfect!
Text: Wow! That was a super safari! Our guide Lahiru took us on time on the hotel and had even breakfast and drinks for us. We have seen so many animals and u.a. Mungos, various great bird species, elephants, crocodiles ... just the elephants have come close to it, but without hunting or standing them. An elephant herd of about 5-6 animals were exactly before our car and it was even a month of old baby. A very special moment. Lahiru speaks english very well and can even anneavant animals in German. Thank you again !!! Contact LAHIRU +94 76 272 6799

Title: Excellent morning safari
Text:
We went to Udawalawe National park for the morning safari, set off at 5.30am to get there for sun rise. There seems to be a race to get there as all guides have to queue on the day for permits but this was pretty quick. We saw eagles, crocodiles, heard of elephants (with young) lots of water buffalo, wild cat, and an abundance of birds - by all accounts a very lucky 2.5hrs. 

Tour guide was good and would recommend as part of overall visit to Sri Lanka.

Title: Amazing safari trip with Lahira
Text:
We had the most amazing trip with Lahira. His communication leading up to the trip was excellent and he went out of his way to ensure we had a wonderful experience. We saw many different animals and of course many many aliya!! Was awesome 
Lahira +94 76 272 6799

Title: Guaranteed to see elephants, lots of birds and more!
Text: This sanctuary for wild animals has scenic beauty that protects a wide range of animals.  Your safari tour will amaze you.  We saw elephants, water buffalo, painted storks, eagles and even the rare spotted cat!

Title: Lahiru Prasad, the perfect guide for Udawalawe National Park!
Text: My husband and I loved Udawalawe National Park, made all the better by using Lahiru and his fantastic and expert 4x4 driver! Lahiru and his driver have a great eye to see even the smallest creatures from a distance, taking us to more remote corners of the park and away from the other tour companies. We saw a huge variety of wildlife, including many many elephants, jackals, snakes, buffalo, lizards, a variety of beautiful and exotic birds, crocodiles, mongoose, and the list goes on. Besides his keen eye he has an indepth knowledge of flora and fauna and went the extra mile to ensure that we had the ultimate experience! Highly recommended! Whats App +94762726799

Title: Aeesome day and lots of elephants and other animals
Text: We had a great safari in a really beautiful national park and our guide Lahiru did an excellent job.  You can book it in advance (+94 762726799), we can only recommend it

Title: Ultimate tour with lahira and his powerful 4 X 4. The best tour available!
Text: We just returned from a tour of the park with lahira prasad. I was hesitant at first to keep my booking with him as his price was more than the others and I wasn't sure it would be worth it but due to all the good reviews on here we decided to spend the extra £20 (figured if you're coming all this way £20 is nothing to get a good experience!) Lahira organised a taxi from Ella which picked us up at 4am (need to do the safari whilst it's still cool to see the most animals)him and his driver gave us some light snacks and water and we started the tour. Straight away we saw a small family of elephants including a very small baby! We then went off and toured the park away from all the other "jeeps". Lahira s 4 x4 is the only one powerful enough to get to parts of the parks where nowhere else can go. We saw lots more than the other vehicles who had to stay on the main tracks (crocodile s close up and more elephants)At one point lahira had to help two jeeps that got stuck in the mud....his 4 x4 made light work of it and they had been stuck for a while (the people on the two jeeps that got stuck did not look happy!) Then we whizzed through with no effort at all! Brilliant day and an amazing experience. We then had transfers to mirissa and was there for midday!

Title: Lahiru Private Guide Tour
Text:
My family and I had a great private guided tour of Udawalawe National Park with Lahiru. We selected the early morning tour and it was well worth getting our 2 young children out of bed to enjoy the sunrise over the park. They both had a great time in the jeep and we managed to see lots of the wildlife in the park as well as getting up close to many of the elephants. 
Would highly recommend booking Lahiru for a private tour, he comes to collect from your hotel and was an easy process to enter the park and tour around. Lahiru can be contacted via Whats App on +94 76 272 6799

Title: More like harassing elephants
Text:
This was more like harassing elephants than spotting them in an eco friendly way. Imagine at least 20 vehicles converging on a herd of elephants & another 20 on their way. It was like a circus.

The Jeep I went with could have taken another couple but instead they put them in a Jeep of their own & there were plenty of others with sole occupants. This highlighted that it was a more a money making initiative for each driver than for the mental well being of the elephants. I have more vehicles in my photos than elephants. It is not something I will ever do again EVER. The poor elephants having to put up with all that in your face stuff, with some being quite distressed due to a constant stream of vehicles blocking their paths. It left me feeling appalled that I even did it.

It was wrong on a number of fronts. Firstly their is the mental health of the poor elephants to consider, then of course you have all those vehicles (car pooling is not considered), ripping up the environment, fuel consumption & exhaust contributing to the greenhouse gas emissions, should I go on. So it definitely was not environmentally friendly in so many ways. If you are considering going then consider the above.

Title: Udawalawe National Park safari with fantastic guide Lahiru
Text:
While researching for our Sri Lanka Trip in November 2019, we came across Lahiru. He is a local tour guide and was recommended on trip advisor and other platforms. We contacted him via WhatsApp around two weeks before the desired day of Safari and agreed on the following:

- Taxi pick up in Ella 4:15 AM
- 3-4 hour Safari in Udawalawe National Park
- Taxi drop off at hotel near Galle

Contact with him in English was easy and everything worked out as expected. The Safari with both transports was very well organised and allowed us to combine the travel from Ella to Galle with the Safari.

The Safari was absolutely amazing and we spent four hours in the national park and saw numerous animals - especially elephants. Lahiru is an excellent guide and we were over and over again surprised how fast he was able to spot different animals. He shares his excellent knowledge during the tour and is very patient with us foreigners that are stunned by the animals.

Overall an awesome experience and we can surely recommend a Safari with Lahiru.

Just get in touch with him via WhatsApp: +94 76 272 6799

Title: Amazing!
Text: Had the best safari ride this morning with the guide Lahiru (+94 (76) 272 6799) with his 4x4 Land Rover!!! It was amazing! Lahiru seems to be grown up in the park, he knew every little secret track we were taking to spot so many creatures- starting from tiny kingfisher birds and ending with crocs! And of course elephants - pack of them (female), one with a month old bany elephant and also a solo males. So, so beautiful!

Title: Lahiru & His Land Rover 4WD Is The Only Way To Go
Text: Read reviews for Udawalawe National Park Safari and Lahirus name consistently came up as great.  Based on the reviews we contacted Lahiru and scheduled the safari for this morning.  It was fantastic and Lahiru lived up to all the praise heaped on him.  Lahiru is very knowledgeable about the park and is an expert on birds.  He is a great tracker and has a keen eye for finding crocodiles, nearly every exotic bird in the park, as well as elephants.  He makes the safari fun and does not rush through the park.  Will stop, stay and watch the wildlife as long as you like.  His Land Rover 4WD allows him to take you where other vehicles cannot go.  Lahiru goes off the beaten path and does not go on the main road where the others seem to go.  As a result, you feel like your are alone in the park - rarely seeing other jeeps.  Highly recommend Lahiru for your safari adventure.  Here is his Whats App#.  +94 76 2726799.

Title: the best place to watch wild elephants in Sri Lanka
Text: it's the second time we visit the elephants in the Udawalawe National Park. We have been very lucky again, meeting a lot of this beautiful animals :)

Title: One day trip with 4x4 - Lahiru
Text:
We had a brilliant safari this morning with Lahiru at Udawalawe National Park.

We were picked up from our hotel in Ella at 4.30 by Lahirus driver and taken to Udawalawe. From there we jumped in the Land Rover and started the safari. Within a few minutes we saw some elephants not too far from the side of the road, then within another few minutes we saw a single male elephant right next to the road. We couldnt believe it! 

Lahiru was keen to make sure we saw as much as we could and had plenty of time to get photographs. He pointed out everything he saw including Chameleons hiding on branches. His driver turned the engine off when we got near any animals so we could take our time to photograph them or just stare in amazement. 

Apart from on the main toad we only saw other safari vehicles twice. The vehicle we went in was a Land Rover which meant we could go off the main roads people usually take and went down to the lake, lots of the other vehicles cant do this because of the wet ground. 

Towards the end of our safari we came across some more Elephants, we stopped briefly and headed past them to a lake to see the crocodiles before the sun got too hot. Then we went back to where the elephants were and just patiently sat while they got nearer to us, and we realised they had a baby with them. It was the most amazing thing, just being able to sit and watch them and being so close to them. 

We would highly recommend Lahiru to anyone thinking about doing a safari.

Other animals we saw include water buffaloes, land monitors, deer, Jackels, lots of birds including king fishers, crested eagle and loads of peacocks. 

After our safari the driver took us onwards to Mirissa. Doing a day trip was perfect and it was brilliant that we were picked up and dropped off so we didnt need to worry about transport. 

If youve not got much time in Sri Lanka dont miss this day trip! Just drop him a WhatsApp message: +94 76 272 6799.

Thanks again - Adam & Amber

Title: Great Experience
Text:
We visited the park on an evening safari beginning at 2pm and finishing at 5pm. I highly recommend making sure you are there as late (or as early) as possible as a number of animals came out towards the end of the tour as it cooled down.

Tour was great and the driver was very experienced and was able to show us a number of different animals long before we could see anything (wild cat, lizards, monkeys, birds, bambi and as expected plenty of elephants). It was definitely worth the trip.

Only four stars though because these tours have a long way to go to meet the price they charge. All the vehicles follow each other in the park and you almost go up the same route you came down, and only experience a small part of the park. If they were to replicate the safaris in Africa I have been lucky enough to experience they would benefit from two way radios in the car (so they can communicate when they see something), a guide to provide info on the history and about the animals and sealed roads to cover larger areas (where is the money going from all these tours??). This would allow them to cover more of the park and enhance the experience for the consumer.

Title: Best Safari and guided by Lahiru
Text:
We received excellent service from Lahiru.  He is a local guide and privately organises everything himself.  It started with a no hassle pick up (At 6.30am - most pick up at 5.00am but then get stuck in a que for up to an hour).  We were in very quickly and Lahiru was very quick to spot any movement.  We saw a large amount of birds and lizards as well as many elephant.  Our highlight was definitely the up close Elephants which he tried very hard to find for us.
Overall, we were very happy with this experience and service and I would highly recommend to others.  Also, we were his only customers in the group which he likes to have it that way.

Message Lahiru directly on WhatsApp to book +94 76 272 6799

Title: Amazing Safari Experience
Text: Instead of buying my partner a Christmas present this year, I decided to buy him an experience when we arrived in Sri Lanka. After lots of research in to different experiences and then wildlife parks and tour guides we were sold on a review of a safari run by Lahiru and we are so glad that we did! Lahiru arranged a driver for the journey to and from the park for us - a really friendly driver and 3 hours each way but totally worth it. When we arrived, Lahiru was able to take us through the routes that werent well frequented by the other jeeps which meant we had a more tailored and magical experience. Highlights included seeing lots of baby elephants <3, having elephants within arms reach on several occasions, being the only jeep to witness an elephant crossing the lake whilst two crocodiles were sunbathing at the edge of the water, seeing a huge herd of water buffalo bathing as well as seeing many other birds and animals in a natural habitat. Lahirus ability to capture fabulous pictures of the animals on our phones through his binoculars for a real close up of the beautiful animals and his friendly banter really made it a great trip. If youre looking to do a safari and see lots of animals with a personalised experience (ask for a private tour) then Id advise that you contact Lahiru to book via Whattsapp +94762726799. Thank you for a fabulous trip Lahiru! :)

Title: Udawalawe national park
Text:
My wife and I went on an afternoon safari with Chaminda, we were very specific that we wanted a quieter tour not harassing animals etc and staying away from the other jeeps where possible. Chaminda to his credit was very professional and careful in his driving and approach of the animals and birds that i think we saw much more than other jeeps that seemed to be racing around. Our guide was very informative, spotting the following:

water buffalos wallowing in a pond

Cheers Michael and Asha, from Darwin Australia.

Title: Fabulous safari with Lahiru
Text: After reading other reviews we decided to book directly with Lahiru and we were delighted with our trip. We saw so many elephants including several family groups with baby elephants as young as 2 weeks. We saw lots of other animals and roamed the park on our own, without a flock of jeeps following us.  It was so beautiful and peaceful. We saw water buffaloes, golden hyenas, two types of monkeys, a crocodile, wild pigs, star tortoise and many amazing birds including the beautiful bee catcher. Lahiru speaks brilliant English, has a sense of humour  and is very knowledgeable about the park and the animals.  Highly recommended. Contact Lahiru on whats app +94 76 272 6799 to find out more.

Title: Excellent
Text: This was one of the highlights of our visit to Sri Lanka. Arrived at 0630 and spent four amazing hours seeing all sorts of wildlife in a relaxed and positive setting. Our guide was informative and helpful and we saw so many elephants very close up. The elephants didnt seem harassed in any way and the experience was a real privilege.

Title: Safari
Text:
A must do experience wherever you are in Sri Lanka...we used a reputable courier to book the jeep hire and park fees which cost approximately £70. Pay the bit extra for the more expensive jeep which is more substantially equipped than the cheaper model...believe me, you'll be glad of it on the parks trails, which are very very unstable! 
Our guide was very informative and pointed out things we would have easily missed, they are incredibly professional and well informed, not to mention exceptional drivers! Within minutes we were in the company of a majestic bull elephant who seemed quite undeterred by our proximity! 
We booked a couple of hours in the park, enough time to get up close and personal with the famous residents, including deer, water buffalo and a vast array of birds, lizards and mongoose, perhaps a longer tour might have increased our chances of seeing more than the 5 or 6 elephant we did, but by then we'd been bounced around enough! 
This is well worth the fee and advisable early start, if just to be that close to these magnificent creatures.

Title: Chaminda - Fantastic jeep driver/naturalist
Text:
I had the most fantastic day with Chaminda, and recommend him wholeheartedly. He is polite, professional, sensitive to travellers needs and speaks pretty good English. He knows the names of all the animals in English and has reference books in the jeep. Most importantly he is knowledgeable about the creatures in the park and has a very good eye for spotting all manner of birds, mammals, and lizards. 

You can call him directly on his mobile 
+94 (077) 337 9470

Chaminda charged me the standard rate for each half day game drive (currently 5,000 rupees) and freely gave me extra time on the morning drive in order to arrive early and beat the long queues, and then added more free extra time at the end too, as he was trying to find a brown fish owl. He spotted so many rare birds for me, and the brown fish owl eluded us on this trip! 

The afternoons are best for elephants as its too hot for birds until late afternoon, when visitors have to exit the park.

Title: Safari in Udawalawe
Text: Having just been on a safari in Udawalawe, we would highly recommend Lahiru as a guide. He spotted many animals we wouldn't have seen and took some amazing photos for us. He and his driver were  also good at making sure we weren't in a convoy of other jeeps. The highlight was when they tracked down a family of elephants, including some very cute babies.

Title: Nice park with Elephants and local wildlife
Text:
The main attraction here are the Elephants in the wild, we saw monkeys, lizards, deer and various birds.
Dont come with high expectations this aint Africa, but still everyone had a great time and cruising along on Safari jeep was fun for everyone.

Title: Baby elephants
Text: We did a morning trip and this is a very well organised trip with many companies- perhaps too many as most of the vehicles had 1 or 2 people in , this is nice as you get plenty of space but not good for the environment as you could easily reduce the   Impact to both the park and reduce the pollution . Nether the less this place is definitely worth a visit with plenty of wildlife about . We were lucky enough to see a croc ( briefly) , plenty of birds , elephants galore , a mongoose , spiky tortoise , jackals and a curious monkey . Seeing a 2 week old elephant with its mum and 5 yr old sister at a watering hole was the highlight of our holiday ! And our guide was very informative- although he could have spent less time on his mobile and shaking his legs whilst we took pics - also it would have shown more respect to the wildlife. There is not much else in the local area so 1 night stay on plenty .

Title: Just another normal park.
Text: Is the national park but basically nothing to see. Elephants are easily spotted if you really like them alot. Or else is just a bird park, plenty of peacocks, few types of eagles and bee eating small colourful birds. May see water buffalos chilling in the water hole. Leopard are very rare so no high hopes.

Title: Great tour with lahiru
Text: Really good tour of the safari park with the best guide. Definitely worth booking in advance and perhaps cost is a bit extra but its definitely worth it as he shows you everything that other guides miss and manages to find the best spots for the elephants! +94 76 272 6799

Title: Good morning
Text: An enjoyable morning. Good value entry and car and guide. We booked through our hotel which was yonan river face (which was fantastic). Saw about ten elephants or so amongst other wildlife. Expect to see more than 10 to be honest... but guess thats nature! Would recommend getting a guide to give info and spot small animals - eg eagle, birds, etc

Title: Best safari tour guide of Udawalawe
Text: After reading many good reviews about the tour guide lahiru prasad here on trip advisor we decided to ask him to show us Udawalawe and wow he did not disappoint. He has great knowledge about all the animals and wildlife in the park. He is very friendly and will take you away from other jeeps so you get to experience the park completely alone. He knows lots of good spots and we would highly recommend choosing him as your guide. His WhatsApp number is +94 76 272 6799

Title: Amazing Safari
Text:
Booked the Safari with Iahiru Prasad as our guide and a separate driver.

I cannot recommend this tour enough, with the solid Land Rover which was able to reach even the tough spots we saw a lot of animals very close to our Jeep.
Many elephants with their small babies, warans, monkeys, many birds and even wild cats.

Our guide was very friendly, funny, experienced, spoke very good English and even some German. He had the right feeling where to find all the animals, answered all of our questions and gave us a lot of information at the side.

 Thanks for this great Safari.

Title: We loved it
Text: We thoroughly enjoyed two safari visits to the park. Our volunteer guide, Dammy, was excellent, spotted so much wildlife to show us and had lots of interesting information. I liked that safari vehicles didnt seem to disturb the wildlife here. Everyone had space and time to enjoy the view, it wasnt crowded.

Title: Great Park to see elephants from the closest
Text: Within 2 hours we saw so many animals. We got very close to elephants and watch them during their morning routine. We booked via Tuk Tuk Safari Tangalle and were picked up in Ella. Entrance fee is pretty high, but the park offers a unique experience.

Title: Lahiru really does a quality tour
Text:
I didn't really want to book a tour with Lahiru because it seems like everyone's reviews are about him and his prices keep going up. But we really had a great experience with Lahiru!! I would highly recommend him.
We saw elephants up so close but really felt like Lahiru respected the animals. We didn't see huge amounts of elephants but saw approx 5 different groups along with water buffalo, crocodiles (!), lizards and 15 different birds. Lahiru's ability to spot wildlife can only come from years of experience. 
Whenever we came across another jeep, Lahiru went another way so we had a truly private tour the whole 4 hours. We had heard about Lahiru taking photos through his binoculars and I hadn't thought much of it. But Lahiru was so skilled at taking photos with your own phone/camera that you could just focus of looking at the wildlife rather than trying to take a good photo.
Lahiru arranged pick up from Ella and then we were dropped off at a beach in the south after the tour. He even organised an extra driver from Ella in the morning because a land slide had blocked a road and the extra driver could navigate a different route.
The whole day cost 250 USD for three people. We booked via Whatsapp (+94762726799). Lahiru also brought food for us (but we didn't know that was going to happen so we had brought our own!).
Only feedback for Lahiru: tell people you will bring them food, give them more information before the day or when you meet them so they know how the day will run (we knew when we were being picked up and approx how long the tour went for, but when we met Lahiru it was literally just a warm hello and then we didn't know what was happening next - I guess it was just a case of 'let's get on with the safari' but we weren't sure what was going on), and let the people know when the tour is coming to an end (this wasn't clear and we were told we could choose how long we wanted to stay in the park). The time went so fast!

Title: If you've been on an African Safari, you'll be very disappointed. If you love elephants, you'll enjoy it!
Text:
After having been on safari in Botswana, this was a total let down. We ultimately only saw elephants, peacocks, and a bunch of birds. Our whole group got tired of seeing peacocks, and there wasn't much else to see. More annoyingly, the park felt small and we'd constantly be around 5-7 jeeps at a time circling around an animal. It felt unnatural and unkind to the animal.

If you've never been on safari though, I'd recommend it as a great way to spend a morning (no more than four hours is needed). The elephants are a delight to see and it's great to be in nature. The peacocks are very pretty too.

Title: Amazing trip arranged by Walawa Blue Sapphire
Text: This was my favourite safari I have done so far and we got very close to two beautiful elephants as well as seeing a group a little further away. Also saw lots of other animals and birds. I would definitely recommend staying at Walawa Blue Sapphire hotel if you are visiting the National Park. They arranged everything at a very competitive price and the staff and food were exceptional!

Title: Excellent safari guide - we spotted a leopard!
Text:
We booked our safari through Mansala Safari House and went for the full day option. At the park entrance, we were greeted by Lionel, one of the volunteer guides (note that this is an additional cost) and we are very happy to have had him with us - he has eagle eyes, quite literally, as he pointed out eagles and other wild birds we would otherwise have missed, and even spotted small lizards high up in trees and a tiny musk deer deep in the undergrowth.

Elephants, of course, are easier to spot and we met plenty along the way. Our driver and guide were both fairly respectful of their space, and although all the vehicles in the park are quite noisy, the wildlife in general seemed relatively undisturbed.

In the afternoon, we were incredibly excited to see a leopard and as there were no other jeeps around, we stood for 5 to 10 minutes observing him. Something I think well never forget! Our guide and driver were almost as excited as we were by this rare sighting. It was clearly our lucky day, as we later came across a jungle cat.

Id heartily recommend a visit to the Udawalawe National Park and if you stay at the Mansala Safari House, they send you off with the most delicious lunch, even catering for vegans like us! 

Total cost for two people in one jeep, with driver, was USD 130 (23,400 LKR). Lionels services were additional, with a voluntary and discretionary contribution.

Title: Awesome Safari with Lahiru and 4WD
Text:
We texted Lahiru 3days before the planned tour date and arranged the safari. The day of the Safari we spent the night at his brothers place. We had great food there. Lahiru picked us up from the hotel at 5am.
The safari cost 100 USD in total for Lahiru, driver, jeep and entrance fee (2 persons). The safari was great, we could take numerous elephants, water buffalos, deer, jackals, crocodiles and different bird species from the closest proximity on remote ways apart from other tourists. Due to the fact that his Jeep was so much better than the others we could go to places noone else could go. This, we were able to see crocodiles as well.
He helped us to take great photos and took a lot of time to explain the animals of the national park to us with humor in love English as well as in German. The safari was definitely worth its money.

Lahiru is also happy to help you plan your onward journey at local prices. He brought us to the next bus station to get our transfer to Tangalle.

So beware of scammers. Someone is steeling lahirus identity due to his good reputation. Just text him:

Lahiru Safari : 076 - 2726799

Title: Safari
Text:
Having come all the way to Sri Lanka from London, we wanted to ensure that we had first class experiences, including this safari. Our daughter has researched the park (here in TripAdvisor), and found excellent reviews for Lahiru (tel and WA: +94 76 272 6799). 

This was not cheap by any means, but we felt worth every penny. Firstly, our guide Lahiru was extremely knowledgeable, interesting, animated and fun.His English was first class and easy to understand. Secondly, we had a separate driver, so Lahiru was concentrating on spotting the wildlife rather than driving.

Then, another hero was the Land Rover Defender - a clear step up from nearly all other vehicles, as it is a proper 4-wheel drive, with the ability to get places the others just could not even think of. That, together with an obviously experienced and skilled driver. At one point, we couldn't get up a muddy river bank, resorting to the front winch to pull us up.

After that experience, we managed to get to an area to enjoy a lake area with basking crocodiles, which was the cherry on top of this excellent experience.

Title: Fantastic national park
Text:
We book the jeep with Usaj, from Avian Garden Guest house. It is very recommended as they care a lot about the tour and the tourists. The explained us many information about the animals and trees we crossed.
The park has many elephants, buffalos and different birds. During the morning - at 6.00am - is the best time to see the animals. It was our first Safari and we enjoyed a lot!

Title: Wonderful park and guidare visit
Text:
The park Is beautiful. Many Elephants living on their own in a wild environment.
Thanks to Usaj from Avian Garden Guest House Who organized out visit and stayed with us, the experience was great. Highly recommended the park and his house and services.
Aviangardenu@gmail.com
+94 766203016

Title: Fantastic park and beautiful animals!
Text:
We went to this stunning park in between 3pm and 7pm and it took 10 minutes to find some gentle giants! They were so calm grazing near the dirt roads of the park and were not fearful of us. 
We decided to go with just a driver and not a guide as I had heard guides are expensive and do not bring much to the experience. The driver was a great guide explaining what we were seeing and making sure we got the best views without being in danger or stressing the animals. You could see the driver really cared for the animals.

I would highly recommend going in the evening and not first thing in the morning. Tours are advertised as the best in the morning but I guarantee we saw just as much in the evening and there were very few tourists in the park, whereas in the morning hundreds arrive at once.

Title: Great safari with Lahiru
Text:
We booked Lahiru after reading many TripAdvisor reviews. 

He has a Land Rover vehicle which is capable of navigating areas of the park that other vehicles are unable to - so you get to see a lot more animals and closer than usual. He was nice to bring us coffee and some snacks as well. He had a lot of knowledge about the park, knew a lot about the animals and was able to spot them from really far away. 

He kept us entertained throughout the safari and told us a lot of trivia about the park and animals. We had a really good safari experience - thanks to Lahiru! Highly recommend.

Title: Lahiru Safari
Text: Magic trip trough Udawalawe with Lahiru & his driver! His enormous knowledge, hawk eyes and a really good sense of humour made it to a legendary adventure. He spotted animals from about 100m, we didnt even saw 5m away. His defender 4x4 is unique and we got though the toughest mud and jungle to find crocodiles, elephant so close you can touch and much more. So you gotta book Lahiru for your next safari trip in Udawalawe. Best via whatsapp. +94 76 272 6799

Title: Amazing Experience
Text:
The park is an amazing experience 
We paid to have a jeep just for us and I would say it is worth that bit of extra money to not have to share the photo ops and be able to move from side to side
We had a guide but they are not vital if you have a good driver. The guides English was poor and he just used a book to show is the birds but he was good at spotting the Elephants and knowing which way to go, although the drivers all share sightings as you move round
Seeing these magnificent creatures up close is mesmerizing
We did the 0630 trip so you see them moving round to take cover for the day ahead - it was just great

Title: Great elephant experience
Text: We took a whole day safari & so got to see all aspects of the park; grasslands where we saw many wonderful, magical elephants, it was phenomenal & monkeys; also went to wetlands area to see water buffalo & water birds; the river to see many crocs; the different forests where we saw jackals & deer; & of course loads of magnificent peacocks & other birds; the pace was leisurely & we got to see so many elephants & had the time to sit (in the Jeep!) to just watch them eat, swim, play & take great care of their young; we even saw a rare tusker - a brilliant day in the park - we wanted to see elephants up close & we did; expectations exceeded!

Title: What a great experience
Text: Did a Jeep Safari through the national park. Our driver was amazing and pointed out many of little things we may not have noticed if trying to find ourselves. Was such an amazing experience and many elephants ventured very close to our vehicle.

Title: Mother and baby elephant so close

Title: Best safari trip ever!
Text:
After researching many reviews on here, a name was repeated all the time for tours. We contacted Lahiru and organised the trip via whats app. Very easy and quick. The next day he picked us up at anantara hotel Tangalle where we were staying on time. 

Honestly I thought we would see some elephants, from afar and thats it. Lahiru delivered that and more.

He also went off the beaten track and took us places where the other jeeps could not go, as his car was the best by far. 
We ended up in the middle of the park with nothing but animals around us. Incredible. 

I admire Lahirus passion, effort and he went out of his way to show us elephants, crocodiles, buffalo, deer and all the birds in the park. 
This was truly amazing experience and I highly recommend him to anyone. Our 4 year old son was amazed that he finally saw the animals he had been reading about in books. 
Call +94 76 272 6799 Lahiru 
You will not be disappointed.

Title: Amazing 4x4 Tour of Stunning National Park with Lahiru!
Text:
First of all, the park itself is stunning. Tons of open space for the animals to roam freely and filled with lush vegetation and lakes. It was easy to see elephants from afar upon arriving.

However, what really makes the difference is your driver and guide. I had read some mixed reviews about finding a driver upon arrival, so I wanted to make sure I had an excellent driver and guide. I'm a solo budget traveler and I'm very careful about what a splurge on but I read numerous reviews of Lahiru on TripAdvisor so I thought I would contact him.

Immediately, he was helpful, friendly and professional, giving me a clear layout of the price and what was included. I needed transport from Hirikitiya and then onwards to Ella and he gave me a clear breakdown of the price for everything. The transport between cities was the lowest rate I received. And while Lahiru's rates are not the cheapest, they are a very reasonable price considering you have him as a guide with an additional driver as well (not to mention the quality of his tour).

I was hesitant but I decided to book with him and I'm so glad I did. It was one of my favorite days of my trip so far. Lahiru was so knowledgable and an expert as spotting wildlife and giving me information. Upon entrance to the park, we spotted a huge variety of species. Additionally, thanks to the Landrover, we were able to access areas of the park that most other trucks could not. There were numerous times where we were the only truck around. We managed to get so incredibly close to the elephants while still respecting the park rules and regulations. There was plenty of time for photos (which, if you didn't bring a DSLR, Lahiru will help you snap photos with his binoculars and your smartphone!) and to just enjoy as well. I never felt rushed and was always asked if I wanted more time before moving on.

Driving by most of the other jeeps, tourists seemed bored while they stuck to the main road (and drivers asked Lahiru where we had seen animals!). But Lahiru kept me entertained the entire time with info about the animals and his great sense of humor. If I wasn't laughing, I was in awe at all the amazing animals we were seeing. Time really flew by. If I had more time in my schedule, it would have been great to do a camping experience but I'll have to save that for when I return one day!

I've traveled to a lot of countries and almost never write Trip Advisor reviews but Lahiru is one of the best guides I've had and made my time in the park an incredible memory. If you're on the fence about splurging, trust me it's worth it!

lahiru.jpdk@gmail.com
+94 76 272 6799

Title: Close elephant encounters!
Text:
If you want to see elephants then this is amazing! But if you want the traditional safari big 5 this isn't the place to go, I've heard Yala National Park has leopards but it was closed when we were in Sri Lanka. 

We had a great morning at the park. Meant leaving our hotel at 4am but so worth it to feel comfortable as the temperature was so nice and cool! Such a difference from what we experienced in the daytime! 

My cousin organised this so afraid I don't have contact details for who we used! As soon as we entered the park we could see elephants in the distance. As we drove past a track our drivers stopped and reversed as they'd caught an elephant coming up the path out of the corner of their eyes! Their attention to the smallest creatures is amazing! This elephant was coming right towards us and walked past the jeeps, an experience I won't forget. 

Other animals: water buffalo, chameleons, lots of birds in trees, monkeys in an area we stopped in. Great for kids, we had my cousins children (age 4 and 6) who loved spotting all the animals!

Title: Guided Tour with Lahiru and his Land Rover
Text:
We visited Udawalawe National Park by booking a guided tour. Our tourguide was Lahiru and it was absolutly amazing!! We found his contact at TripAdvisor. 

Everthing was well organized (we also booked a transfer from Ella to Udawalawe and a transfer from Udawalawe to Tangalle with Lahiru). Due to the fact that he uses a 4-wheel drive for his Safari we were able to visit also the very muddy places at Udawalawe National Park where other guided tours weren't able to go. So we could observe a lot of animals (elephants, crocodiles, peacocks, water buffalos, monkeys, a lot of birds, etc.) in an undisturbed environmente. Lahiru explained a lot about the animals and the history of Udawalawe and we had enough time to take a lot of pictures. If you ever think about visiting Udawalawe National Park I highly recommend you to join him for a Safari. Title: Good experience
Text:
We went in the afternoon slot around 3.30 P.M but unfortunately didnt see a lot of animals other than elephants. It also started raining heavily about an hour after we entered so we had to cover the vehicle, reducing our visibility.
While we saw lots and lots of elephants, we werent lucky enough to see the other animals that other reviewers have seen. To be honest though, the elephants themselves were completely worth the money and my children had a wonderful time.
A couple of tips - if you get quotes from a few guys and go asking further down the road, you will invariably get a cheaper rate. However you will spend time doing this, which means that you might save 1 or 2 thousand LKR but lose out on safari time, so the savings arent really worth it. My recommendation is to plan ahead, check with a few operators and book a safari the previous day.
Try to go early and reschedule if heavy rains are predicted.
Just for information - the pricing model is like this: the operator will either offer an all-in rate (inclusive of jeep and entrance tickets) or will offer his jeep for a certain price and ask you to buy tickets on your own (you need to specifically ask for the second option). The price of the jeep will be approximately LKR 6000 for 3 hours, which you can try and negotiate. The price is for the whole jeep (6 seater), regardless of the number of people, so you can team up with other guests at your hotel and reduce the per-person cost.

Title: Thank you Buddhi and Ashan
Text: The weather hadnt been great the day we arrived at our hotel but we decided to take a chance early the next morning and embark on an Eco tour of the Kalametiya Lagoon with a lovely guy called Buddhi.  He met us on time and drove us in a tuk-tuk to meet the boat where we were introduced to Ashan.  We were spotting birds as soon as we left the hotel.   Dont be put off by weather to do this as we had a fantastic time.  With the help of both guides we spotted 51 different varieties of beautiful birds.  The lagoon is so relaxing.  Gorgeous water lilies and water hyacinths cover the surface.  Buddhi made a necklace from a water lily and handed us a bunch of water hyacinths.  We were given a bottle of water each and a snack.  We were out for over 3 hours and enjoyed every minute.  Dont hesitate to book these guys as they are polite, helpful, knowledgeable and funny.  There is so much more to this trip but I dont want to ruin the surprise...just book it and make memories!
