Title: Heavenly morning with Buddhi and the Birds
Text:
Wed read so many great reviews about Buddhi on Trip Advisor and were so glad that todays technology allowed us to arrange the trip with Buddhi in advance from England. Further, having Buddhi as a WhatsApp contact before the trip truly saved us from a lot of stress when the driver which we had organised from our hotel to pick us up at 6am failed to turn up (driver was not associated with Buddhi or our hotel - he was someone who had sold his services to us on the beach and let us down). I was so distraught that our driver had not turned up and that we would not make it to our 6.20am appointment with Buddhi, having woken our 3 and 7 year old children up at 5.30am! Then I remembered I had Buddhis phone number and contacted him on WhatsApp. He greeted us with the biggest smile on my phone screen and calmed me down. Buddhi arranged a tuk tuk for us from Kalametiya to pick us up from our hotel and we were there shortly after 7am (normally it would have made sense to get transport from our end, but we had no idea at that early hour how to arrange it when our driver did a no-show on us). Despite the delay, which meant that by the end of our excursion with Buddhi the morning was much hotter than it would have been if wed finished an hour earlier, as scheduled, and the water was moving a bit more (meaning that Buddhi and his helper had to row harder), Buddhi was all smiles the whole trip and is simply the nicest person who made us feel so special and welcome in his lake paradise. 

The bird watching itself was incredibly relaxing and interesting, both for ourselves, as adults, and our two children. 2 weeks on, our 3 year old is still saying bird watching was sooo fun. We all learnt to recognise many birds and also went on a little jungle walk and climbed a rock! I actually have a terrible fear of heights and stopped half way (it really was not that high!) but my 7 year old who is also scared of heights climbed it liked a mountain goat and Buddhi carried our 3 year old up and down. The view from the top was spectacular my husband tells me. 

I would recommend this trip to both experienced bird watchers who get the chance to witness the birds in such a peaceful place (we were the only ones there at the time) and to novices who want to experience the beauty of this lake with all its water flowers, birds and other animals. 

Thank you Buddhi for a lovely morning, which we are still reliving through photos on a daily basis!

Ps none of the birds or animals appeared to be affected by our presence at all, and we just felt privileged to be a part of the peaceful morning lake scene.

Title: An amazing tranquil wetland lagoon with a huge number of bird species and a great guide.
Text: My wife and I were very impressed by this Wetlands Lagoon at Tangalle - where Buddhi and Hasim from Kalametiya Eco Bird Watching poled us along on a raft type wooden boat.  This meant we were able to quietly approach islands and reed beds without disturbing birds and had some lovely close up views.  With Buddhis help and knowledge we identified 64 different bird species during our 2-3 hour visit there which was a lovely quiet interlude.  This quiet and peaceful method of boating around the wetlands, as no motor boats are allowed, ensures that the abundance of the bird and amphibian species found there is not over disturbed, for the benefit of both the wildlife and tourists.

Text: My husband and I are not really avid bird watchers but we enjoyed this trip all the same as the nature is really beautiful. It is not a well known touristy area which adds to the appeal.  We were almost alone drifting through the stunning nature reserve watching the sunrise and listening to the song of the birds. It was very peaceful. Buddhi was friendly and knowledgeable. Text: Very gentle paddle through the lagoon, spotting birds in their habitat.  Our guide provided us with fruit.  He was very attuned to nature and the need for conservation.  His English was very good and his attitude was serene and friendly.  Highly recommended

Title: Loved everything!
Text: Fantastic excursion with great guide! Buddhi has a sharp eye and a very good knowledge of birds. He is also a great host, taking care of binoculairs, water and watermelon. Our 2 kids loved this trip as well, for Buddhi involved them in a really nice way, by making necklaces of waterlillies and letting him help peddling. He showed us the most beautiful sunset and surprised us with a movie that he made of our family during this trip. It was an unforgettable afternoon, and we highly recommend this excursion, Buddhi really knows how to make a difference!

Title: Amazing experience
Text: We spent a fantastic afternoon on a boat. Our guide Buddhi equipped us with binoculars and together we observed over 30 types of birds. Buddhi helped us to identify the birds and made a list of species for us. Bird watching came to our hearts and for the next two weeks of our trip we were looking for more amazing birds of Sri Lanka. I highly recommend this trip.

Title: Best at dawn
Text: Take a boat trip at sunrise, and you will see a huge variety of  Sri Lanka's resident wetland birds in a very short space of time.  It is an amazing landscape, through which you travel slowly and silently, poled along by your boatman, who is also a very knowledgeable guide.  While the winter months will have a the migrants adding to the variety, there is no doubt that in the space of a three hour boat trip you will see an awful lot of birds, plus water monitors, crocodiles, monkeys, mongoose, and waterbuffalo.  Highly recommended.

Title: Wow! An amazingly beautiful start to the day!
Text: Our driver picked us up at 5.30 to get us to Kalametiya Eco Bird Sanctuary just before 6am where we were met by our guide and boatman. Our guide was very knowledgeable, interesting and fun. He made my daughter a necklace from a water lily and played an enchanting tune on a handmade bamboo flute. Half way through the trip we got off the boat and climbed up to the top of a large rock where we were able to see an amazing panoramic view. We were able to spot about 32 of the 140 birds which are seen at this sanctuary as well as water buffalo and Sri Lankan monkeys. This trip is a must for anyone visiting Sri Lanka.

Title: Awesome afternoon

The tour was very well organised, with water and snacks provided.

Title: Great birding experience
Text:
We chose this place because of the great reviews and we were really satisfied. Our guide was very professional and passionate, he speaks very good English. We had our own little boat, we saw loads of birds and two large monitor lizards as well. We also got our very own list that contained the bird species we saw that morning. We even got some coconut drink and fruit during the tour.
Bring hat and sun block as there are no shades during the tour.
I really recommend this place to visit.

Title: Something different
Text: We had a lovely morning with Budi on the water. It is well organised and seamless. We went on the 6am tour as the birds are said to be more active (we saw over 40 types of birds in 2hrs). Our guide was Budi and he was both friendly and knowledgeable. He was able to spot all birds with his naked eye and provided both me and my partner with high quality binoculars to get a closer look. We also saw monkeys in the trees, lizards and a water buffalo. You are given the opportunity to wade through shallow water (ankle deep) to the land and climb up on top of a massive rock. The panoramic views from the top are beautiful. Budi served us fresh watermelon and water about half way through the morning. At the conclusion of the trip you are provided with a list of all the birds you have seen on your tour. It is a unique and interesting tour that we would highly recommend.

Title: Phenomenal Bird Watching and the Most Amazing Guide!
Text: The Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary was nature at its finest. Mangroves, grasses and pristine water everywhere. So beautiful. Oh yeah and BIRDS, BIRDS, BIRDS! We saw 44 species of birds as helpfully and masterfully identified and explained by Buddhi, the most polite, knowledgeable and friendly guide you could ever imagine. Water and fruit were provided and the double hull platform boat had comfortable upright seating that allowed for panoramic views using professional quality binoculars provided for us. I couldnt imagine choosing a different company for any reason. 100% guaranteed unforgettable experience!

Title: we saw 45 different kinds of birds

Title: 2nd Visit.
Text: Found Kalametiya on the internet before our stay at Tangalle last year and our driver took us very early morning. We enjoyed it so much we did it all again this year and were not disappointed so many birds and the tranquility is perfect with just the sound of the punting pole pushing the catamaran among the inland waterway as the sun comes up.

Title: Buddhi is the best!
Text:
We arrived via cruise ship so were later than optimal for viewing the maximum number of birds (usually Buddhi starts at 6 AM and we started around 9:30 AM).  Despite that, Buddhi did a fantastic job for us--due to his keen eyes (and those of his friend, who was poling the pontoon boat through the mangroves), we were able to spot and quickly identify reclusive birds: 50 different species!

It was so quiet and peaceful as we glided through the water, with many stops for sightings.  Too many highlights to mention, but a couple include seeing Sri Lanka's largest kingfisher as well as every variety of egret - all at once!!!! - riding on the backs of swimming water buffaloes!

Buddhi provided excellent high power binoculars, bird books, water and fresh watermelon as a snack midway through the tour.  He is quite musical, too - played a traditional flute-like instrument for us on the way back.  After our tour, we were invited to his home for refreshments:  homemade fresh fruit smoothies (made from fruit from their own trees), thin coconut filled dosas and crisp fried (not sweet) 'cookies' or biscuits.  Yum!

Later, Buddhi sent us a wonderful memory of our trip that he filmed during our time with him.  Tip:  Buddhi arranged our transport from the ship to Kalametiya for us.  We chose an A/C car (which took about 1/2 hour).  This is definitely the right choice. We could have had a tuk-tuk but it would have taken a lot longer and not as comfortable.

To sum it up:  We could not have been happier.  Great alternative to Hambantota choices closer to the ship.

Title: Birds everywhere
Text:
Beautiful and quiet flowting in a fantastic
bird sanctuary. The small wooden boat has no motor and is being staged around the low water area. We saw 54 different types of birds in 2 1/2 hours. The guide was very knowlegdable.
Very enjoyable and can be recommended if you love birdwatching,  but also if you just enjoy a slow floating experience in a beautiful piece of nature.
I recommend to buy the book "Birds of Sri Lanka" (Helm field guide) at home to bring on your holiday.

Title: Buddhi Superstar
Text:
It was a real pleasure to do another boat trip with Buddhi - a fine young man so passionate about his job,so knowledgeable about the birds and engaging considerate and always smiling but importantly a consummate professional.
He is in top tier of things to do in Sri Lanka on trip advisor and will do in his power to maintain is 100% five star reviews and will not favour financial gain to compromise this.
For example during our trip it was quite windy and although we saw 34 birds well down from last year it was still very enjoyable in the paddled boat.He advised a group he would not take them in the afternoon as it was too windy and they would be disappointed -  he could have gone ahead for financial gain but did not - that is his integrity and honesty that i admire
He has such a bright futiure - a mega watt personality carry out a highly professional eco conscious tour 
Well done Buddhi

Title: Beautiful place for Bird Watching
Text: We did the morning boat tour with Buddhi at Kalametiya.  We were very impressed with his knowledge of the birds of Sri Lanka.  I loved that the boats were non-motorized...it was so peaceful.  We noticed another boat only had one guy doing it all.  Buddhi has a guy poling the boat through the water for him so that he is not distracted and is able to spot many birds for us.  His English is very good and he is very enthusiastic about what he is doing.  And that smile!  This is a wonderful way to spend the early morning.  I highly recommend it.

Title: Intense birding experience
Text: A relatively small area, with lits of interesting birds, hence a very good density. Excelent photo oportunities of spectacular birds (Darter, Jacana, Purple Swamphen, Grey-headed Fish Eagle etc...). Buddhi was my guide, he is very knowledgeable of the local birds and happy to oblige for a good spotting or a great photo. Plus a very nice company in general. Overall a great experience and a very good value for the money.

Title: Beautiful scenery and time
Text: It was a nice chillout time with guides who are able to spot beautiful birds. Professional, nice, helpful team of guides, with a lot of humor. Binoculars, fruits, water included. Hiking to the top of a rock not challenging, to be done by small kids. Beautiful view from the top. Very recommended!

Title: Our best memory from Sri Lanka
Text: Buddhi is such an enthusiastic, friendly, proessional and knowledgeable young man that you cannot help to enjoy this bird watching boat trip, even if you never before gave wildlife a second thought! We saw over 50 different species, not fleetingly, but sitting still on trees or water, long enough for really good examination. Buddhi taught us a lot in the time we were with him! Early morning was such a peaceful, quiet time on the water. Overall, this was probably our best experience in Sri Lanka.

Title: Peaceful Bird Watching on a boat - with well informed guides
Text: This was an amazing experience and we saw lots of birds. The guide knows a lot about them and we learned a lot. We also got watermelons and water. Will definitly recommend this activity.

Title: Wonderful experience, peaceful and informative
Text: Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary is a beautiful place. Buddhi, our very experienced guide made our visit very special. I was alone with my son on the boat and we enjoyed every moment of it. Plenty of time to take pictures, listening to Buddhi's explanations. We also climbed a rock to enjoy the sunset. Fresh fruits and water were offered. Thank you Buddhi for the lovely video you sent me. A very special memory...

Title: Do this this tour if you want something special!!
Text: Our best day in Sri Lanka? Eco bird watching with Buddhi and his friend Asham. It was amazing!!! I never see something better and enjoyable. Buddhi is a really nice person, I felt so good with him. Thank you Buddhi and thank you Asham. When we come back to Sri Lanka, we will definitely come back to meet you.??

Title: DO THIS TOUR!
Text: I'm not a birder by any means and had a great time on this tour. We saw 57 different species of bird of all sizes and brilliant colors. Buddhi is a fantastic guide - he is passionate and enthusiastic about his job, knows all of the different species on the lagoon, and his English is great. He also has super-human eye sight and could spot and identify birds that I could barely even see without my binoculars! If you are in the area, you really, really should do this tour. I highly suggest going very early in the morning when you're likely to see a lot of different types of birds and there are very few people out on the lagoon. Do it, do it, do it!

Title: Bird watching
Text: My wife, her sister and I went bird watching with Buddhi, our guide, in a catamaran boat powered by his assistant who used a long pole to propel us. The setting was tranquil, with the small sound of water napping our boat. We saw maybe five or six different birds in the first few minutes and we're told the names of all of them. Unfortunately we forgot them shortly thereafter, but luckily we saw them again and again so we got to practiced their names. In the end we saw more than 40 species. I highly recommend the tour for both the birds you will see and the knowledgeable guide.

Title: Superb!!
Text:
We visited the bird sanctuary after reading all 5 star reviews on TA and Buddhi didn't disappoint us. 
The place is very quiet with hardly any tourists around. Buddhi is a very knowledgeable person and takes efforts to show as many bird species as possible. We saw more than 56 types of birds. Undoubtedly our best experience in Sri Lanka!!!

Title: Definitely Recommend
Text: We went on the bird watching tour yesterday at the sanctuary and it was a great experience! We got to ride on a little catamaran boat through this beautiful wetland area and we saw 58 different species of birds! The guide was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about the birds! We did a little hike up a rock for a great lookout of the whole area. We also got some cookies and water during the trip and some fresh mango and wood Apple at the end of the tour. We also were given a list of all the birds we had seen during the tour. The guide also took some really nice pictures during the trip and sent them to us afterwards.

Title: Fantastic trip
Text: Excellent trip, fantastic experience and a very knowledgeable guide, really great experience, the place is so peaceful and quiet, a bird's paradise to watch

Title: Fantastic trip, great tour guide
Text:
We fancied doing something a little different whilst on the South Coast of Sri Lanka, and a bird-watching tour seemed like a good thing to try. We couldnt be happier with our choice - the trip was both enjoyable and educational, and our tour guide, Buddhi, was extremely friendly. 

We got up at 5am to take a tuk tuk (at 05.30am) from Tangalle to the location of the tour, in Kalametiya. The tuk tuk driver was organised by Buddhi, and he was super friendly (he even gave us some free tea on the way). 

Buddhis passion for the birds was very evident, which certainly rubbed off on us too. Buddhi was also happy to answer any questions we had.

Moreover, this is more than just a birdwatching tour. Halfway through the trip, we got out of the boat and climbed to the top of a rock which looked out over the water. The views are incredible. Free snacks and drinks were provided too.

I strongly recommend this trip for anyone whos interested in birdwatching. But I also recommend the trip for anyone who just wants to do something different and experience the beauty of Sri Lanka.

Title: We Are Glad We Took This Tour!!
Text:
On our 6 day trip to down south, we decided to devote half a day to do a bird watching tour in Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary. From a recommendation of a friend, we selected Buddhi as our host. The choice we made was excellent because the tour was a highlight in our entire trip. Here are the reasons why you should do this tour and why you should do it with Buddhi.

1.	Buddhi knows his stuff well. The birds, the best timing to watch birds, habitats and everything you can think of.

2.	 Even if you go empty handed, knowing nothing, he will give you leaflets to refer, binoculars and even refreshments!

3.	He will take his time and try to show you everything possible. So, the money you pay is worth paying.

4.	He will give you the best experience and he will make sure you will enjoy it to the extreme. He took us to the rocky hillock on the side of the lagoon. When you climb to the top, you can see a 360 view of everything around you and mind you, its amazing!

5.	He will give every chance to take pictures, even if you are not a photographer.

6.	He can play the flute well. He will play you a tune when you are about to end the tour. Imagine hearing flute music early in the morning while you are floating in a boat, surrounded by nature! Thats wonderful.

7.	At the end of the tour, he will get together with you and mark all the birds you saw in a sheet and thats like a record book.

8.	Buddhi is one of the most humble and amazing personality and he will make sure to give you the best of it. If  we go there again, we will definitely go to him again. Even if you go the same tour again, I am pretty sure it will be interested every time

Title: Wonderful birdwatching
Text:
Thanks to bhuddi for a wonderful morning trip! Buddhi had so much knowledge about birds! 
And makes a very Nice video with all the pictures he takes of you! 
Highly recommended!

Title: Hidden Gem
Text: I had read about visiting the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary and am so thrilled we decided to go. Its certainly a hidden gem for those  who love to see birds! We saw over 44 kinds of birds and were able to get some wonderful photos. Buddhi was absolutely the best guide. I started calling him superman as he really has incredible hearing and sight and could see the rare species and direct us to it. He is a wonderful guide with a wealth of knowledge and passion for the area! He is also a great flute player we got to know  and made a really great real time video of our experience!! Would highly recommend visiting and exploring with Buddhi!

Title: Pleasant afternoon with Buddhi!
Text:
We spent a good time with Buddhi and his friend,
He seems very passionate about birds and full of surprise!
We spend a pleasant and peaceful time with him watching the beauty of nature ,

Title: A fantastic trip brought alive by Buddhi's enthusiasm
Text: My wife and I went on a fantastic two and a half hour trip with Buddhi and his friend Hashan (who rowed the boat). This was our first time birding, and Buddhi's enthusiasm and knowledge really brought the landscape to life as we observed and learned about all the different species of bird in this picturesque wetland reserve. We saw 53 different species of bird in one morning (everything from herons to kingfishers - and even a monitor lizard) amazing! They supply everything you need - binoculars, water, snacks - and can arrange transport from your hotel. Buddhi even played a little tune on the flute on our way back which was a nice touch. This was a glorious trip and a real highlight of our holiday in Sri Lanka.

Title: Incredible Experience!
Text: The combination of excellent birding and stunning scenery made this tour with our guide, Buddhi, an experience i will never forget! Buddhi is very enthusiastic, a smile on his face at all times. He also has an incredibly sharp eye and can spot birds excellently and identify them instantly. We saw 62+ species from 6am onwards, watching the beautiful sunrise surrounded by hundreds of birds. I highly recommend Buddhi and his business and this tour is a must for any nature enthusiast in Sri Lanka. Many thanks to Buddhi for this unforgettable birding trip!

Title: Excellent tour!
Text: We absolutely loved the tour of Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary with Buddhi.  He was able to organise a 6am tour for us at very short notice (night before), it was well organised and a lovely experience for birders and non-birders alike.  Buddhi is very knowledgeable about the local birds and a pleasure to spend a few hours with.  Highly recommended.

Title: Unforgettable, unmissable.
Text: This tour has been an absolute highlight of our trip. We took a peaceful ride through the sanctuary, whilst Buddhi took his time to explain and show us as many of the birds as possible, whilst also explaining the area. We went in the afternoon and I can certainly recommend doing the same if only for the beautiful sunset on the rock at the end. It was a very special moment. As we slowly returned Buddhi played for us on the flute, together with the scenery it was a magical ending. Thoroughly worth the visit, do not hesitate to book with these guys. Thank you!!

Title: Excellent birdwatching trip
Text: We travelled in a punt on a large lagoon and saw many interesting birds.The location is beautiful and tranquil.  A pleasant way to spend time even if you're not very interested in birds.  Our guide Buddhi was excellent: knowledgeable, personable and conscientious. His email is info@kalametiyabirds.lk

Title: WONDERFUL
Text:
Go there. That's incredible, and every nature lover will be amazed :)
Many different birds, guides that help you understand what birds are there, where they are (they really have a good eye !)
GO THERE :)

Title: Pleasantly surprised
Text: Buddhi was very nice and accommodating throughout. He has an impressive knowledge and a sharp eye for birds while the rest of us took awhile to spot them even with binoculars provided. He had little surprises along the way which made it a truly memorable experience. He also took us to some dry land and climbed up a rock overlooking the beautiful sanctuary (you'll be stepping barefoot in some shallow waters). It can get quite sunny but umbrellas are provided. All in all very pleasant and relaxing. I'll be happy to go back there again. Keep it up, Buddhi :)

Title: The best!
Text:
We came on this boat Safari tour with our local guide who recommended it as the best!  It really was: we started early at 6am and met Buddhi who gave us a wonderful experience.  We saw over 60 different birds both from his boat and from a high rock overlooking the whole wetland.  He was kind and helpful - we are seniors - very knowledgeable, well equipped and also provided light refreshments.  Binoculars were available as well as bird books.  We were shown photos of the birds that we had seen to reinforce our memorys.
As we returned after 2½ hours, he played haunting tunes on his Sri Lankan flute.  Altogether we had a wonderful experience.  I would highly recommend these tours in the peace and beauty of the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary.

Title: Wow wow wow
Text:
My wife and myself went today on this tour and I must say it was one of the highlights of our trip.

We saw 50 different species of bird and our guide Buddhi was amazing.

Hes only a young man but he has amazing knowledge and more importantly he has a big heart and is a very likable man.

There are tours and there are tours and this was certainly the latter.

This trip should be one of the first on your list.

Highly recommended

Title: Awesome Experience
Text: The Bird Watching Tour was one of our highlights during our 3 weeks stay in Sri Lanka. The tour took about 2,5 hours and started at 6:15am in the morning. We went there by scooter from Tangalle by our own with no problem (30min ride). The boat ride on the lagoon during sunrise was amazing. We also climbed up a rock and had a great view. Our tour guide Buddhi is a very polite and positive person. He has such a great knowledge about birds. Very brilliant. We really enjoyed the tour and can highly recommend it.

Title: Best tour
Text: Awesome tour! So many birds, calmness, adventure and meditation all in one! We enjoyed it so much and will definitely do it again! Thank you

Title: Buddhi you are a star
Text:
This is our third boat tour over a number of years at Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary with Buddhi.He has an absolutely delightful infectious and fun personality.He is a passionate environmentalist and has respect for the fragile ecosystem where he operates his tours.
He takes you along a magic journey where his ability to spot birds and with his encyclopaediac knowledge describe them in detail holds your attention.
Obviously the last few years have been tough for guides like Buddhi who in spite of the challenges remains firmly positive and we must cherish his expertise 
You are a very special person Buddhi and such a model to your generation as your character personality principles and respect for those you engage with ticks all the boxes

Title: A morning on the lagoon with Buddhi is one you will not forget
Text: If you enjoy spending time in an unspoiled natural outdoor setting where you feel like you are the only human soul for miles around, be sure to put Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary on the itinerary for your next visit to southern Sri Lanka - and absolutely hire Buddhi as your guide. We did, and the morning we spent on the lagoon with him and the able pilot of our little catamaran (which is piled through the lagoons winding channels - no motors around ) was the highlight of our trip! We arent birders, per se, but Buddhis passion for the birds of Kalametiya is infectious. Never have we had a more engaging, entertaining guide on such an outing - and we have been on many. And while his birding knowledge and skills are first rate, he has also mastered a local type of flute (he serenaded us with a couple of songs during our safari), he can turn lotus flowers into necklaces, and hell amaze you with magical tricks. And be sure to give him your phone if your photographic skills leave something to be desired - Buddhi will make you look like a National Geographic photographer with the photos and incredible videos he takes! We did a morning excursion and will remember the sunrise from the top of a large granite boulder offering views over the entire lagoon for a long time to come. It was a truly wonderful morning that we couldnt recommend more highly

Title: Great afternoon in the lagoon
Text:
The excursion was really good. The guide is super nice and the birds and landscape are incredible. 

Very good option if you are in the south area of the country, definitely recommended!

Title: Glide through the waters for peace and birdwatching
Text:
We did an early morning tour, leaving at 6am. The early start was well worth it, to enjoy the tranquility of the waters and the amazing array of birdlife'
Gayan provides binoculars and drinking water. He shares his great knowledge of the birdlife of the area, and points out the different species that can be seen.
Highlights for us were a close view of a spoonbill, and a glimpse of a yellow bittern.
We also enjoyed a snack of bananas and biscuits, made by Gayan's mother.
It's worth having a sun hat and sun cream.

Title: What a stunning afternoon
Text:
Had read about this place, booked a 4pm tour and travelled over from the Anantara with two kids aged 8 and 11.

So glad we did. Gayan was our guide and took us out with a boatman on a little catamaran. Was a bit unsure at first that it would get boring for the kids but they loved it. Binoculars supplied for all and Gayan was patient with our complete lack of bird knowledge.

Was amazing soaking up the atmosphere especially as sunset approached. Saw an incredible number of amazing bird life plus buffalo wandering in the mangrove. Whole place exuded zen and we left feeling wed seen something very special. An incredible visit and very good value too ($45 for the whole family for 2.5 hrs).

Title: Amazing experience
Text: Amazing experience with Buddhi. We had no expectation and what a great time we spend on bird watching. Buddhi is great man with a shiny smile who gave us so many information about bird spieces. And also he had a surprise for us ?? highly recommended

Title: Just Amazing.............
Text: It was a beautiful tour, at sunrise, in a real natural paradise ..... My guide, Gayan,  whom I recommend to everyone with all my heart, was a great help to me, because he is a very good local wildlife-birds  specialist. It was something like a dream, something I will never forget for the rest of my life....

Title: Magical experience seeing over 20 bird species!
Text: Our guide Buddhi was extremely knowledgeable and had an eagle eye when it came to spotting the birds. He provided binoculars and books to show us the species we saw from afar, and along the way he even treated us to some flute-playing! It was a thoroughly relaxing and enjoyable experience, and seeing the sun rise over the reserve was just beautiful.

Title: Awesome experience
Text:
As an adult family of 7 we thoroughly enjoyed this experience - it was one of the highlights of our two week stay in Sri Lanka and we are in no way bird watchers! Buddhi and his brother were fantastic guides and we saw 40+ different species whilst being paddled around the beautiful waterways as the sun set. The climb up the rock was fab - a definitely spiritual place. Very highly recommended if you love nature, want to get off the beaten track and are into sustainable tourism - a really genuine experience. Thanks Buddhi for some wonderful memories:)

BTW I think the previous reviewer must have been talking about something else!

Title: Simply amazing!!
Text: This activity was excellent! We saw loads of birds and it was completely eco friendly. We watched sunset from a rock and had a wonderful time. The staff were knowledgable and very friendly! Thank you for an amazing experience!

Title: Trip to Kalametiya Bird Santuary
Text: We had a wonderful trip to the sanctuary with Bodhi. Even though we arrived late he was courteous and made sure that we saw as much as we could in the time available. What made the trip so special was to witness the passion that Bodhi has for nature and birds in particular, as amateurs we were inspired to spend more time at this gentle and mindful activity. The lagoon itself is stunning, with exotic birds at every turn - truly a highlight of our short holiday....

Title: Amazing trip with lovely people
Text: We started our tour at 3:30pm which is perfect to catch the sunset from the viewpoint there. We saw over 30 different species of birds. The guides were very knowledgable and super friendly. They dont use petrol engines and really care about preserving the area. Bhuddi and his team were amazing! Would recommend to anyone who loves animals and nature or just a fun trip :)

Title: Boat trip
Text: We had an awesome guide - Buddhi, who loves birds and knows a lot of them. Moreover, he could see them everywhere. Buddhi equipped us with binoculars and we were able to see the smallest birds and their baby birds. The funniest part was climbing the rock - it has very good views. In total, we have seen 38 birds, some with baby birds in 2 hours thanks to our guide!

Title: Special tour of the beautiful Kalametiya lagoon
Text: We spent a beautiful afternoon at the Kalametiya lagoon viewing a multitude of birds by boat with Buddhi, our host, who expertly pointed out birds of all shapes and sizes in and around the lagoon.  He provided binoculars for us to use and we traveled on a quiet boat around the lagoon, powered only by his friendly crew using poles.  We highly recommend this tour for anyone who loves nature and special places.  It was the perfect way to round out our trip to Sri Lanka.  We also left with some amazing bird photos.  Not to be missed!

Title: Awesome experience
Text: If you are into animals this is a must do! We booked a morning trip, arrived at 6am and at 6:15am we were on the boat. Buddhi and  2 other friends/guides were the most friendly people we have met so far and especially Buddhi really knew what he was talking about. After a few minutes on the water we already saw a lot of really nice birds and Buddhi kept on pointing to them, they were everywhere! Also they told us a lot about the background of the lagoon and how the Tsunami in 2004 changed the scenery around there. In total we saw around 55 species of birds. I cant recommend this enough, go do this!

Title: Just makes you smile
Text: We did a lot of things during our trip in Sri Lanka, but we didnt had a boattour to see the beatiful birds yet. We thought lets try it and enjoy nature. Wow! It was so quiet and so serene. Our guide Buddhi knows so much of all the birds. He always smiles and and is always super excited to tell us about the birds he spotted or the surroundings. It just gives you a smile on your face. In the middle of the tour buddhi asked if he could change boats with his brother so buddhi could share his enthousiasm also with a little birdwatcher on the other boat :). The brother was also super nice and always laughing. We loved that!!! We could even try to paddle ourselves through nature. Nice experience to do! The tour ended by climbing a big black rock, where we could see the whole surroundings from above. Just experience yourself!

Title: Wonderful, relaxing, family experience
Text: You should make a point of taking a trip with Buddhi at this gem of a place.  Even in the non-migratory season, we visited on 29th July'18, we still spotted well over 40 species of birds.  Part of the safari was on a comfortable punt boat and part on foot on and around a rocky outcrop, mid voyage.  All the time Buddhi points out birds of all types from great distances, just by eye sight, whilst we need our binoculars, though many of the birds are comfortable with us coming quite close, as the boat is so quiet, having no engine.  Apparently, early mornings are slightly better for bird numbers, but we did an afternoon / evening trip and saw lots and enjoyed the setting sun over the lake and landscape.  The price is very reasonable and the duration a good 3 hours and no rushing, and a local fisherman punts the boat whilst Buddhi concentrates on the tour.  We are a family with two late teens boys, and they enjoyed the safari in equal measure.  We only had one pair of binoculars of our own, but Buddhi lent us 3 other pairs, so we missed nothing.  I suggest you do this as your second safari in Sri Lanka rather than going to two of the wildlife parks.  Good English spoken by Buddhi, along with passionate info about the birds and the location, and a check list of the birds we saw, to take away.  We booked ahead of time, by direct email, and all went very smoothly.  Enjoy your visit!

Title: fantastic birds up close
Text: Indian darters, herons, ibis, egrets, sea eagle and even a hawk eagle to mention just a few.  Seen on a quiet boat moved by pole, it was lovely and I got some fantastic bird in flight photos.

Title: Wonderful trip with Buddhi
Text: This was an absolute highlight of my trip to Sri Lanka.  Buddhi, like me, is really passionate about birds and it was wonderful to spend three hours out on this beautiful stretch of water seeing so many birds including painted storks, pied, common, white-throated and stork kingfishers, even a redshank.  In all we saw 57 species - in the low season.  He was a great guide and took us all around the lake on a punt pushed by his colleague.  He also had great high quality spare binoculars.  If you are in Kalaymetiya go with Buddhi to see the birds.

Title: Birds, binoculars and biscuits
Text:
This was not part of our itinerary until we stumbled across the reviews on tripadvisor. And thought it would be a good morning stop off from Tangelle to Yala, and we werent disappointed. 

Buddhi greeted us, and even offered to look after our big bags whilst we went on the tour. The conservation area is 500m from his house, and is well worth the walk as Buddhi started spotting birds immediately. 

We were provided with binoculars, biscuits, water bottles. And Buddhi had a number of bird books with him for reference, although his knowledge of the bird species impressed us. 

The conservation area is unspoilt and although it was out of season we spotted 48 species of bird and some monkeys. 

Great tour, great experience and great guide!

Title: Picture Perfect, Hidden Gem!
Text:
This is a hidden gem of Sri Lanka, the perfect place to experience the beautiful birds with out the humdrum of jeep engines. Located on a peaceful lagoon, we travelled the tranquil waters and bore witness to an aviary.  There was a plethora of different birds, an absolute birders paradise.  Painted Stork, Spot-billed Pelicans and even several glimpses of the rare Black Bittern. Buddhi knows his birds and nature, he truly enjoy his vocation and shares his knowledge and expertise with you.  I have to admit a bit of envy at him having such a beautiful spot as an office. Buddhi challenged us to count how many different species we saw, we failed miserably; there was just too many!
We would truly recommend this place to anyone who wants to see the beauty of Sri Lanka's wildlife in an intimate and non invasive way.

Title: Unpredictably fantastic
Text:
Udawalawe??????????????????????
????Buddi???????????????????????????
??????????????????????????????????????360????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

We stopped by the place from udawalawe national park to galle. Even though the experience that we had at the national park was unforgettably awesome, literally Buddi's given epic moment which was beyond our expectation. Enjoyed geographically treasured landscape and birds all the way around the river. Ending with majestic sunset went down the jungles with silence made me impressed. 200 percent worth to recommend.

Title: Magical Stillness
Text: We had a wonderful, peaceful morning, gliding across the glassy  water, brushing through reeds, surrounded by stillness  and the sounds of birds distant and near - sometimes with the addition of  Buddhi's flute.  I lost track of the different birds we saw - 40 or 50 by the end of the trip. Buddhi's enthusiasm, knowledge and keen eyes conjured them out of the sky and and around every rock. Not forgetting the water buffalos and water Monitor. A magical morning. Highly recommended.

Title: Amazing Buddhi
Text:
Just to say how much we enjoyed our birdwatching tour with you - you are a very special person in a very special place 

You are a fine young man with star quality - you have a wonderful delightful and catching personality an excellent communicator with a gentle caring nature

We can only strongly recommend you contact Buddhi on mobile +94 71 355 79 25 for a unique experience of a lifetime

See you next year

Title: Great Bird Watching with guide Buddhi
Text: The wetlands are beautiful in the early morning, it was a very serene atmosphere. Buddhi our guide, has a lot of knowledge about the birds an was very enthusiastic. We saw about 46 differen birds. Buddhi played on his bamboofluit, what gave a beautiful sound over the water. I had a great experience and like to recommend this eco birdwatching absolutely. Thank you Buddhi for the wonderful time and the woodapple juice!

Title: Fantastic guided tour gently drifting on a boat
Text: The tour lasted about 2.5 hours starting at 4pm in the afternoon. Our guide Buddhi was brilliant, very knowledgable about the local bird life, a good communicator and excellent spotter. We really enjoyed the calmness of this tour gently approaching the birds by boat only hearing the wildlife, the paddle dipping into the water and our whispering. We saw over 40 different birds and learnt a lot in the process. We are now able to spot and identify about 25 ourselves. The setting and landscape was also wonderful. Thank you Buddhi for such a great experience.

Title: Bird watching, photography, boat tour
Text: We had a lovely tour with Buddhi at dawn. The trip was great and we saw many bird species, Buddhis knowledge of birds was really good and he helped us learn and identify many species. He was keen to help us learn and gave a really good service. The boat ride was also really beautiful on the lagoon. Thank you very much for a great experience!!

Title: Fabulous, peaceful visit
Text: Passed a couple of hours here out in a catamaran on the lagoon. The birdlife is spectacular and our guide was very knowledgeable and great at spotting the birds too. We spent a couple of hours here, very restful.

Title: A fabulous experience
Text: After a drive into what felt like the middle of nowhere we were greeted by Buddhi at 6 in the morning and headed out for a very enjoyable two and a half hours out on what was a millpond smooth estuary.  You could see that Buddhi loved what he was doing and was passionate and knowledgeable about the bird life in the Kalametiya.  This was one of the highlights of our trip to Sri Lanka and we wouldnt hesitate to recommend it to anyone.

Title: A wonderful experience - serene, beautiful and informative
Text: This is a must do for nature lovers visiting the Tangalle area. The lagoon is vast, beautiful, peaceful and full of life. We spent a leisurely couple of hours being expertly guided on a noiseless catamaran and saw lots of different birds. Even without the natural interest this is a lovely thing to do just before sunset - a stunning experience.

Title: great view and lots of silence
Text: paddling down the quit river was pretty nice.we may not have seen a lot on the first halve of the tour but near  the end the sanctuary really started to come to life.pelicans,darters,herons,a stork or 2,godwits,spoonbills and ibisses.really worth it

Title: Superb tranquil lagoon teeming with burdlife
Text: How delighted we were when our hosts at the charming Asha Beach and Spa accomodation, Tangalle suggested a dawn visit to the lagoon. The guide is excellent and does a great job pointing out the birds. An unexpected treat was a little treat of cookies made by his mother. This experience is highly recommended and you do not have to be a twitcher to enjoy.

Title: A great afternoon relaxing in the sun
Text: We loved our afternoon with Buddhi drifting around the bird sanctuary and spotting the local birdlife. Buddhi was such a smiling, happy and welcoming host, and he made a special effort to keep our children entertained too. Thank you!

Title: Don't have to know birds well to enjoy it
Text: My wife and I don't have much of a combined knowledge of birds, but we figured "why not?" when our hotel offered the tour. We had read about the sanctuary, and we figured it would be a neat experience to see something like that. The boat ride was really peaceful, and the guide was very sharp at pointing out various birds and some monkeys. There is an absolutely plethora of birds, quite the variety really. I don't remember how long the whole trip was, but we were out for a while, and I think we saw a lot more than we imagined. My only regret was forgetting my lens that zoomed in much closer.

Title: Beautiful unspoilt lake
Text:
A lovely trip on the lake with our young, but well informed and enthusiastic, guide.  So many different species of birds to be seen.  Bring your camera if you have one.  
Buddhi has a powerful pair of binoculars which allows you to get the most out of the trip.  We went at the end of the day and watched the sunset from the middle of the lake.  Go now whilst it is still so beautiful and unspoilt.

Title: Best tour of our trip!
Text:
All the glowing reviews are true!! Many tour operators almost make you feel obliged to write them a TA review as they get some bonus from it; but Im writing this review solely because Buddhi does such a fantastic tour and is truly deserving of all the praise.

We were a family of 2 seniors, 2 tweens and 2 adults doing his morning tour. We only saw one other boat out on the lake and about 40 birds. Buddhi provided us with quality binoculars to use which thrilled the kids to no end.

He has eagle eyes and can spot so many birds, even one 12cm one from our boat!

Biscuits and water was provided which was great as we were hungry by midway having set out so early.

Extra fun included in the climb up to the rock top. 

Id do this tour again when I revisit Sri Lanka!! Dont miss it!

Title: Beautiful tranquil bird spotting
Text:
After rushing around Sri Lanka it was wonderful to have a few hours floating on the lagoon with such a charming knowledgeable guide Buddhi.
We saw 48 different species of birds and were provided with water and biscuits. Just perfect.

Title: highlight of our trip
Text: Buddhi is a delightful young man who has realized that UK visitors love birds and so he has become a local expert. You drift around this amazing lagoon with his expert guidance and we saw around 50 species in 2 hours. Even if you aren't a birder it is fantastic. You get to wade through the water and muddy pools( not compulsory!!) and climb a huge rock from where you can see for miles. Eagles, bitterns,kingfishers, darters, sunbirds,  herons, lapwings, Jacanas etc. Make sure you follow his directions for arrival as it is a bit tricky

Title: Lovey
Text:
Beautiful trip around the sanctuary, saw monkeys, fruit bats, loads of birds including eagles!

Very calm quiet and relaxing

Title: Amazing tour
Text: We went on the morning tour with Buddhi and his colleagues and it was AMAZING, definitely a highlight of our holiday in Sri Lanka. We were really impressed by Buddhi's knowledge about birds and love for nature. Plus, it is a beautiful national park, very peaceful and full of wildlife. I highly recommend this tour, you will not be disappointed.

Title: Great tour in stunning nature!
Text:
We did the tour yesterday morning with Buddhi and really enjoyed it. Buddhi is a very kind and funny guy and really well trained in spotting birds no matter how far they are away. We could hardly turn our heads that fast :) But at least we saw 55 different species and even 2 rare ones, as Buddhi told us. It was a great experience in a stunning surrounding and Buddhi has a very detailled knowledge of all the different birds in that area. He even brought two very good binoculars and bird books with him, which really helped us during the tour. Overall the tour is very recommendable!
Thanks Buddhi for doing that tour with us and being very patient in explaining the positions of the birds, even we couldn't see them always directly... ;)

Title: Fantastic Experience
Text: A really great tour and fantastic value for money.  Kalametiya is beautiful and very tranquil, and we saw a huge range of different bird species. Buddhi is an excellent guide - very knowledgeable about the birds, extremely enthusiastic and adds lots of nice touches.

Title: Beautiful, Idyllic & great Fun!
Text:
This trip was booked as part of my special ?? birthday treat. 
Whilst being gently punted around a vast wetlands by 2 lovely boatmen we saw an abundance of birds, water buffalo & the piece de resistance- a Water Monitor Lizard!! 
Buddhis knowledge, enthusiasm and passion for this place is incredible. Buddhis extra touches like a bouquet of water hyacinths & garland of water lilies were very special. We also enjoyed some very welcome fruit and water provided by our team. 
With Buddhis eagle eye & the provision of binoculars we saw species of birds we would never could have imagined! Who knew there were so many types of Kingdisher! 
After punting through the mangroves & passing lounging water buffalo we then embarked onto land to scale a rock. We paddled barefoot through the beautiful Water Hyaciths and then with Buddhis expert guidance & skill (and nerves of steel!) we climbed the immense rock barefoot!!! The panoramic views from here were breathtaking. 
THANK YOU for adding some incredible memories to my birthday ????

This tour is an absolute MUST DO if youre visiting  Sri Lanka. Its suitable for ALL ages and will open your mind to a world of tranquil, beauty and nature at its absolute best. 

Book with Buddhi - you wont be disappointed ??

Title: Tranquil magical punting adventure through lagoons and mangroves!TRULY ENCHANTING!!
Text: 6.30 sunrise punt silently past bathing buffalo, glide through water hyacinths and if you are lucky observe a giant lizard asleep in a tree.Leave the  boat to wade through open meadows and clamber a rock for 360 degree viewpoint of mangroves, lagoons and sea.This trip is NOT just about BIRDS if you enjoy boating trips appreciate a variety of landscapes and want to view nature in its morning glory then this is the trip for you.If you are a bird enthusiast you will be in your element! The guide is english speaking knowledgeable and enthusiastic.We saw so many different species of Sri Lankan birds, so colourful compared with our own birds. I took so many stunning photographs, a truly memorable trip. DO IT! Worth every penny our guide was so  passionate about his job and this enthusiasm ensured the trip was full of awe and wonder for his guests. Thank you so much Buddhi Priyankara the trip was greatly appreciated! The trip lasted about 2 and a half hours.Awesome trip and highly recommended!!

Title: A must do in the south of Sri Lanka!
Text:
We had a really wonderful time with Buddhi on his boat. He does his job with so much passion and we could feel that at every moment during our cruise in the stunning lagoon. Even though it was raining we were lucky to see around 45 different birds, all spotted through the binoculars that Buddhi had offered us. It was great to get all the interesting information about everything we wanted to know and Buddhi really made an effort to make it a truly amazing experience for us. 
We would highly recommend it to everyone who is keen on seeing many beautiful birds in a peaceful landscape and just relax a bit outside of the busy beach. It is definitely worth to do!

Title: Fabulous
Text: This bird sanctury is well worth a trip, lots of birdlife and serene being paddled on lagoon by informative guide

Title: Highlight in Sri Lanka
Text: Buddhis enthusiasm and knowledge of local bird life make this an experience not to be missed.  The variety of birds is something special and Buddhi incorporates lots of little surprises to ensure you have an unforgettable outing.  It is so peaceful out on the water, the trip is excellent value and even for non bird enthusiasts this is a wonderful way to spend a few hours.

Title: For Any Bird Lover
Text: The owner young Buddhika and his friend Ushan are excellent on the subject. We were able to see and photograph a variety of birds with their help. Being on the paddle boat made all the difference as there was no noise of a motor which I thought was very environmental friendly. Buddhika's reed music while on the boat was enchanting and made the evening even more beautiful. That was not all! They got us to climb a rock! It was hilarious as we struggled up and down on our fours! This activity (bird watching) is a must if you are spending an evening in Hambantota.

Title: Great experience
Text:
We took a sunrise lagoon tour with Buddhi. Such a peaceful, relaxing experience and unlike other Sr Lankan wildlife tours this really was just us and the birds. Buddhi's amazing spotting skills ensure you will see upwards of 50 different bird varieties, his knowledge and enthusiasm make this a very enjoyable experience. Amazingly beautiful place, go now before it gets discovered!

(Just one complaint, Buddhi is a terrible judge of age, don't let him guess yours!)

Title: Bird lover's paradise!
Text:
We did the tour with Buddi on 16th Jan and it was one of the highlights of our two week trip. We were staying in Tangalle at the time and had been tipped off by our driver about Kalametiya being much better than Bundala National Park for seeing birds as you can get much closer to the birds. Buddi was also recommended to us as well, and his tour does not disappoint!

We saw 53 species of birds in total, and as Buddi has an encyclopedic knowledge and great eye for the birds of Sri Lanka, you'll be sure to get to see plenty! It just depends what nature has in store for you that day! 

Buddi has binoculars if you don't have your own and he also carries field guides with pictures for reference. 

You'll get to climb a small rock for scenic views, and you'll actually see some different birds whilst you're on foot. We saw a very low perched shikra on this part! 

The freshly sliced watermelon and bottled water was also a very nice touch, expecially as the morning temperature starts to rise. We also did a quiz back at Buddi's with a glass of fresh wood apple juice, which is well worth trying if you get the chance! 

Overall, a very calm, relaxing morning tour in beautiful scenery, with plenty of birds to see as well as Buffalo and sea/land monitors. If you're really lucky, you'll also get a flute solo from Buddi, a man of many talents!

Title: Wonderful
Text:
This place is a must see for all nature and birds lovers, you can really watch many many different kinds and unbelievably beautiful birds in natural environment. Slow and silent move of the boat does not distract you or any birds so you become a part of the mother nature life in this area. 
Buddhi was delicate and passionate about birds, he answered all the questions we had, and even more. He's dedication and passion are really inspiring. I thank him for this excursion and safe and interesting path to the rocks. Wood Apple drink was also great before and after the trip. In total we saw 44 of 141 birds and a Buffalo.
Cheers, - Vova

Title: Fascinating, tranquil tour
Text:
We spent a magical afternoon drifting on the lagoon with Buddhi and his crew. We saw at least 30 species of birds, the nests of weaver birds, and storks in flight. 
This is a lovely tour, and very different from the other things we have done in Sri Lanka.

Title: Best tour so far
Text: The tour was excellent, Buddhi could identify so many birds and was very knowledgeable about them all. Its his hobby and you can tell he loves what he does. We even saw water buffalo and monitor lizards as well as so many beautiful birds. Its the highlight of our trip so far.

Title: Great place for birds watching
Text:
Great experience watching birds in the lagoon with very friendly and knowledgeable guide.
We took the afternoon (3:30pm) tour and it was quite hot but no doubt worth it

Title: 100% recommendable bird watching tour and more
Text: We loved the bird watching tour experience in Sri Lanka. The guides, Buddhi and his friend, are highly motivated and competent, we were sitting on a little paddle boat without engine :) and could observe 50 different species of birds in the picturesque lagoon. In the evening we even saw a flock of water buffalos on their way home. Sunset was beautiful there too. It's totally worth doing the tour!

Title: amazing guide (Buddhi), amazing  bird sightings
Text: amazing guide (Buddhi), amazing  bird sightings. took a 2 hr long boat ride and saw around 40 species. Buddhi has a passion for this. Great experience

Title: 50 species of birds!
Text: Our trip with Buddhi and his uncle around the lagoon was peaceful, productive, and enjoyable. He is a knowledge and personable guide. He helped us identify 50 species of birds by checklist. Highly recommended.

Title: Bird watching at it's best
Text: My girlfriend and me got this tour with Buddhi as a present, everything perfectly arranged from Germany. The 3h trip was stunning and fascinating. We saw 50 different birds, big & small, fishing and chilling. We also saw wild monkeys and climbed a rock in the end. Our guide was outstanding nice and good knowledged. His crew was really friendly and in the end he played so nice songs on his flute for us. Never forget this trip, thanks so much.

Title: Stunning place
Text: We went around late afternoon and the light was fantastic as the sun slipped away.A beautiful unpolluted place just to see without the birds but birds there were in their scores putting on a majestic display....well in other words it were proper good!

Title: The bird watching was such a wonderful experience & so much more.
Text: Such a beautiful location & so serene. It is well worth doing. We were there at first light in the morning & saw so much bird life. Our guide (Buddhi) was fantastic & his knowledge was invaluable.

Title: Amazing experience
Text: During this peaceful tour we saw 40 different species of birds. Our guide had so much knowledge and could spot and identify birds instantly! My mum was talking about the wood apple fruit and Buddhi was so kind and invited us back to his home (nearby) for a fresh glass of wood apple juice! We felt so welcomed and are thankful for the kind hospitality and great experience.

Title: Excellent afternoon if birdwatching in this stunning location
Text: This was an extended family tour of the south coast including birdwatching in Yala and Bundala parks. Despite having seen a good number of wetland birds already we managed to clock up a few more on Buddhi's highly enjoyable excursion round the beautiful lagoon at Kalimatiya, handy to walk to from our hotel (Turtle Bay). Even if you are not a bird watcher this is a relaxing and interesting trip which we would highly recommend. Buddhi and his colleague who steered the boat provided us with a great insight into the wetland area and he has an enthusiastic love of the area as well as good knowledge of the local wildlife. Booking and communication with Buddhi was excellent and efficient. If you are in the area and you enjoy the scenery and bird life in this special environment  contact Buddhi and let him take you in his unique tour!

Title: Joyous
Text: This is a peaceful,  simple and affordable afternoon out if youre on the south coast.  We knew nothing about birds and were mostly looking forward to the time on the boat and the views.  We got all of this plus new knowledge of about 40 species of birds. Our instructor was so keen it was infectious.  Highly recommended.

Title: Truly unique experience
Text: This trip was definitely one of the most beautiful, pleasant and inspiring experiences during our wonderful stay in Sri Lanka. While perhaps a little bit off the beaten tourist track this is also what makes this trip so special. It was a quiet and almost meditative experience accompanied by sounds of nature - no engine involved. To enjoy this trip you don't have to consider yourself a bird watching specialist. We are not at least, but have a general interest in nature and wildlife and we saw a lot of interesting birds on this trip. Our guide was so nice and enthusiastic and even helped our kids climb a rock to view the sunset. Thank you Buddhi!

Title: Wonderful tranquil trip around a peaceful lagoon.
Text: You do not have to be a twitcher to enjoy this wonderful 2 hour experience of tranquility. Mahesh our guide was very knowledgeable and friendly pointing out over 40 different species of bird along with monkeys and water buffalo. Thank you also to the gentleman doing the hard work punting us around the lagoon. A must do.

Title: An out of the world and time place
Text:
Our Sri Lanka tour finished by three days in Ranna and we discovered this bird place into our guide book.
We did visit many birds places and wanted to see this one but we did not expect much.

Thanks to Buddhi who organized a tuktuk pickup from our hotel we arrived on time for an almost three hour tour starting from 3:30 pm. After having a refreshing fruit juice in Buddi home place we started the visit. We boarded on a small boat with our guide Buddi and a boat paddler.

Once on the boat we crossed the laguna and entered into another world. We saw hundred of birds. They were everywhere.
Overall we saw 47 different birds species. as well as buffalos, varans, monkeys. The sunset on the water with birds on the back of water buffalos was outstanding. You could stay a whole day in this paradise where the time seems to have stopped.

The laguna is wide and very quiet. You will listen only the birds music and the sound of the water made by the paddle.
Buddhi is a bird lover and he is a pationate person. He is dedicated to nature and birds. He made this visit the best birds watching we never had. We were amazed by the amount of birds we saw. Most of the time in these kind of visit you see some few birds very far away. Here you are surrounded by birds. They are everywhere just few meters away. You do not need expensive camera with long focal lenses to take nice birds photos.Surprisingly a small fish attacked by an heron jumped on the bench on which I was sitting and it was not a flying fish.

My wife, who is not mad of birds as I am, came with me and was not expecting to discover such an amazing place.
She went in love with the beauty and the peacefulness of the laguna.

The end of the trip was accompanied by the music played by Buddhi on his flute and this added a 48th bird to our visit.
We warmly want to thank Buddhi for permitting us to discover this magical place.

If you are in Tangalle area this is the place you have to visit.

Title: Excellent experience from booking to drop off
Text:
We booked this trip after searching on the internet once we arrived in Sri Lanka and were not disappointed it really was excellent value for money .
Saw many groups of elephants at various locations . It was busy but 2 parks currently closed due to flooding so all trips having to use the Eco Park so it was to be expected .
Roshan was a great driver / guide trying to get the most out of the experience for us .
Would go again in a heartbeat, fabulous to see these great animals up so close

Title: Amazingly close to elephants
Text: This was an amazing experience, we got very lucky with the weather and in the middle of a monsoon got a few hours of sunshine. You get so close to the elephants it's unbelievable and they don't seem bothered at all, they continue grazing at their own pace even with the little ones around mum. Most of my photos are on my camera so excuse the selfie! The guides are really knowledgeable about the wildlife and stop, wait until you have your photo and then drive on again. Be careful when you go up the watch tower as there are some snakes chilling up there but their only small and didn't even move when we went up

Title: Great experience
Text: Although it rained while we were on this excursion it was still a fabulous experience. We saw heaps of elephants and were given plenty of time to watch and photograph them. Open keeps were great...until the rain came, our drive put the cover over quickly - although we got wet we still thoroughly enjoyed it.

Title: From here to there and everywhere
Text: Roshan is an excellent driver and safari guide. He ensured that we saw as many animals as possible on our safari. He was ethical and respectful when seeing the animals, stopping at a distance. We had a great time. We also had him take us to Ritigala and Polonnaruwa. Highly recommended.

Title: Spectacular vidit
Text:
At first we arrived in a jeep and there were so many other jeeps, but once you get going and they take you to where the elephants are, its breathtakingly spectacular! 

To see these animals in their own environment and eating, playing, fighting and babies feeding from their mums.. an absolutely unforgettable day!

Title: A must do tour
Text: Amazing tour, excellent driver and tour guide who had amazing sight into picking out the birds, lizards, golden jackal, crocodile, deer, monkeys giant squirrel and of course the wonderful elephants who walked between the cars. Very informative re the flora, highly recommend this tour, once in a life time exoerience.

Title: Amazing Herds of Elephants!!!!
Text: As we entered we saw single elephant...went further another single elephant our child was getting more curious our guide said wait will show you more in hundreds...and as we entered main Jungle we could see Hundreds of Elephants with Baby elephants and we were Happy but we need to be careful as they can aggressive..we also saw some birds...

Title: The Highlight of my Visit to Sri Lanka ????
Text:
Wowee!
We joined an elephant jeep safari on the very first day our holiday and it was truly the best experience I could have had. 
Having loved elephants all my life this trip was heaven. Of course, there were lots jeeps, tracking the roaming elephants and it did seem intense at first, as we were so excited at trying to spot them in the vast reserve. But we finally came across a group of 50+ elephants grazing with their young and we did not disturb their peace. 
It was wonderful to watch them so close up.
I will never forget this experience.

Title: Elephant safari
Text: Just absolutely breath taking to see such beautiful creatures roaming freely and so up close, never seen so many elephants.

Title: Good trip
Text: We did the elephant safari and enjoyed it immensely there where lots of elephants and monkeys, it was very rough terrain in places so beware if you have back problems. The trip was probably 3 hours and maybe a little to long in the afternoon sun with no toilet breaks . All in all very good

Title: Just too many trucks
Text: It's a great place to go, but unfortunately the way the "safaris" are run is that almost everyone goes at the same time and it's just a massive scrum to see anything. The amount of trucks and people simply spoil the experiance. Save your money, go and visit an elephant orphanage instead.

Title: Always a Risk
Text: We had a fantastic experience on our 2.5 hour safari - we saw several herds of elephants, a bull elephant, a pregnant elephant  and a baby elephant. We even saw an elephant with a tusk which isnt very common in Sr Lanka. The driver was great and the vehicle comfortable. This had been pre arranged by our tour guide so Im not sure which company we went with but we started at a hotel called Cinnamon Lodge. Obviously there is always a risk you might not see the elephants... but certainly one worth taking.

Title: EXCITING ELEPHANT SAFARI PLUS MORE
Text: What an exhilarating experience, riding in jeeps where you can stand up and take your photographs or enjoy the ride. Spotted so many elephants, up close and a bit too personal at times. Saw baby calves playing chasing after birds. Loved this experience but the highlight was seeing an eagle take off, swoop diwn only meters away and snatch up a rabbit.

Title: Herd of Jeeps
Text:
We went mid afternoon to see the elephants in the wild, and it was wonderful to see so many family groups around the park. Apparently they just over 100 there.
The disappointment was the quantity of jeeps surrounding every sighting, jostling for the best viewing position. Whilst they kept on the tracks, and , frankly, the elephants pretty much ignored them, it seemed a distraction from what would otherwise be a wonderful opportunity to marvel at these magnificent animals. The park needs to be careful not to kill the goose by overcrowding.

Title: Saw 14 day old baby elephant ??
Text:
Saw 3 different large female herds including a 14 day old baby elephant on our 90 min safari 
Lots of birds too 

Open top jeeps that you can stand throughout to get views - very dusty so wear sunglasses to prevent dust in your eyes 

Over 50 jeeps operating so its not an intimate experience but very enjoyable non the less

Title: Vacation
Text: A very good safaris. I would saw we saw two Tuskers and 46 other mother elephants and babies. This is so worth the time and cost. A must do adventure.

Title: Never expected a safari in Sri Lanka
Text:
Fabulous experience, seeing the wild elephants so close up. 
I  think there should be less jeeps allowed in at one time as it got very congested in the park with so many jeeps around the herd

Title: Highlight of our trip
Text:
It was the highlight of our trip and we saw more than 200 elephants. We got close enough to the elephants and it was truly a treat. It is important to have a guide who cares about the elephants (ours did) so that he can direct the driver to park his jeep in a place that will not intrude too much in the elephants' space.
I did feel like the elephants were stressed by all the human activity so as visitors we can try to mitigate the stress by not insisting we get too close to the animals.

Title: For The Love of Elephants
Text:
We took the Jeep safari tour to see the elephants, unfortunately it was not the season to see big gathering but we were able to see some here and there, the jeep can get pretty close to them so you can take your time to enjoy the experience.. 
it was also a nice trip for bird watching, we were able to see amazing birds. 
The whole tour was about 2.5 HRS for a convenient price too.

Title: Absolutely the best place to see animals and birds, without too many jeeps
Text: Observe elephants on mass in social groups, and many animal species. Important to get an experienced driver/guide, as our driver arranged, as some are disrespectful to the animals, and do not have enough knowledge.

Title: Lots of elephants
Text:
Nice wildlife park.
We saw lots of elephants, water buffalos, water birds and a cow just gave birth in front of us!!!
Worth doing!

Title: Not many Elephants when we were there!
Text: Nice jeep tour. Not many elephants were there and too many jeeps going all at the same time. At one point there were traffic jam in the National Park. Didn't like that all the jeep leaves at the same time, no spacing out. Taking pics were a rush to get the best shot. Lots of dust while driving in the open top.

Title: not to miss
Text: we loved this park although in theory it does not compare with Yala in the number and quality of animals that can be seen. But the Jeeps are open, and photographing is easy, and in the end we saw a lot of buffalo, deer, and even some elephants... although the latter are elusive. Worth the experience.

Title: Amazing experience!
Text: Went on a safari to see Elephants and we saw loads. They were upfront and close and herds of them. We saw male ones, 2 week babies and so many...The safari is bumping and they remove the roof so you can stand and see. They do give you a volunteer tour guide with your driver which we weren't made aware of so you need to tip them if you get one or they can get very upset! Overall a great experience.

Title: Elephants, elephants and more elephants
Text: We went in the afternoon and got to see lots of elephants, walking eating splashing in the lake and best of all baby elephants playing chase with birds. It's hit an miss what other animals you see, we saw lots of owls, Eagles, peacocks and a bull.

Title: Our Driver cheated us for money
Text:
our driver cheated us for money. before we enter to the national park the driver said we need to take a tracker with us in the jeep.
for the tracker he asked money 5000lkr but inside the park when we were talking with our tracker he said his price is only 2000. the driver took the rest of that money.

Title: no vehicle after a payment
Text: we confirmed and requested a jeep with a driver at 2.00 p.m but i did not came we hat to arrange another jeep from hotel it was little expensive in the hotel thats why we ordered here. cannot recommend this to other travelers

Title: Great experience
Text:
Promptly picked up from our hotel. We went to kaudulla National park from Sigiriya. Best to go in afternoon because most elephants there then. Driver and companion good at spotting animals although not much English spoken/info about animals. 
Saw crocs, eagles, peacocks, buffalo and 40+ elephants. Lovely to see these animals in the wild. Got very close to the elephants too.
Dropped us in Dambulla for little price too!

Title: A must do
Text: Anyone visiting Sigiriya must do the safari at Minneriya. Sighting of the wild elephants is almost a certainty and it is an amazing experience.

Title: A good mix of off-roading & animal spotting
Text:
The tour team made a good job of making the trip to the water hole to watch the elephants fun & engaging by making the trip feel like an off road experience - this was particularly effective in the rain!
When we got to the lake, there were plenty of elephants to see, along with buffalo & a variety of birds.
A very pleasant afternoon.

Title: Elephants!
Text: Great safari with loads of elephants, the babies are especially cute. Beautiful birds- storks,pelicans,stilts to name a few and of course peacocks. Water buffaloes were plentiful too. Shame it rained but it didnt dampen our expectations

Title: Simply breathtaking
Text: This place is breathtakingly beautiful, we saw so many beautiful birds, elephants, water buffaloes, monkeys, big lizards... the area is stunning - it completely blew me away, unbelievable, we had such a good time here.  There were hardly any other vehicles here when we went - and if we did pass a vehicle it was all done with smiles and a chat.  An absolutely wonderful place - I would completely recommend a visit.  Our teenage children had a fabulous time also (always a good sign).

Title: Superb way to view many birds and animals.
Text: We had a private jeep tour around the national park. It was stunning! At one point a huge iguana wandered across our vehicles path and there were two types of monkey around as well as dozens of types of bird - everything from the tiny brightly coloured Bee-eaters hovering by flowers to the massive storks standing unmoving by the waters edge. Our driver was excellent at pointing out ones we would have missed - also showing us nests etc - really knowledgeable and interesting. He never made us feel that the time was limited as he shared his obvious love of the wildlife. We skirted around two separate groups of elephants - one of some 40 animals and the other of 60+ animals - what a glorious sight! All ages of elephant - even tiny babies. What a privilege to see in such close up that binoculars were not needed. Would certainly recommend this. It was quite expensive as it cost us 60 Dollars each.

Title: Good safari ruined by the basic lack of care.
Text:
The experience itself was good and there were many animal sightings. Elephants, water buffalos, all kinds of birds - nothing much to complain about. However, the experience was tarnished by the old and VERY dirty jeep. Its was all covered in red dust and just a few minutes in it was all over my clothes. I had to cancel some of my other plans to go to a hotel and change.

The problem could have easily be solved by a little bit of care and cleanliness. It isnt that difficult to wash the jeep once in a while.

Title: Best time ever !
Text: This safari was by far my favourite moment of Sri Lanka. There were hundreds of elephants which made the visit quite a spectacle. The only small problem was there was about a 30 minute queue to enter the park.

Title: full of elephants
Text: its great to see so many elephants along with that many jeeps in the middle of jungle. it start bit slow and once you reach there its fun and exciting to see hundreds of elephant together. its bumpy ride, so be prepared for it. we were just one couple and we were charged $80, but the jeep can accommodate 6-7 people so even if they charge more for one jeep it will be cheaper per head.

Title: Lots of elephants
Text:
Its amazing how many elephants, wild birds including herons, eagles, storks we saw. 
A couple of crocodiles too. 
Lovely, respectful driver who spotted everything for us and stopped for photos every time. 
Well worth a visit. You see more in a couple of hours than any other safari Ive been on.

Title: Hundreds of them!
Text:
The initial stages of the safari are slow going but once out into the plains everything changes. It is stunning aesthetically regardless of whether the elephants are grazing there or not.
If they are however prepare for a melted heart because they're pretty freaking adorable.

Title: Average at best
Text:
Compared to the African safaris this attraction is dirty and dusty and overpriced. Yes the elephants are glorious at the end of the bumpy ride but not really worth the price. Additional sightings were one monkey and one bird !!!
A visit to Pinnawala is a much better hands on experience. Give this place a miss

Title: Fun and very interesting
Text: We have done safari in Africa so went to this with very low expectations. But it was surprisingly very fun. There were little baby tuskers who were bothering everyone in the herd. Such fun watching them

Title: Best Safari Choice
Text:
If you want to see the wild life in srilanka (elephants, birds ...), this is the best place.

It is smaller than Yala national park, and has much to see. In less than 10 min from your start up, you will meet around 40-50 elephants and other species, but elephants are majority in additions to oxes.

The difference from Yala national park is that you do not wait in the jeep to start your safari, and you see the wild life in less time.
