Text: Nice stroll through the tea fields with a very nice view. Waterfall is nice but nothing spectacular. Good way to spend some time outdoors and always nice to have "goal" of your trip/hike

Title: Very picturesque
Text:
nice place to visit. we came there by bicycle and spent some time enjoying the atmosphere. the views are amazing.
also you can go to the Hindu temple in the town  just down the road from the fall.

Title: Nice falls
Text: This is a nice falls. Need to walk a bit to get to the falls and have a good view, but worth it. Cant get to the water though.

Title: Enjoyable hike
Text: Nice hidden falls above a tea plantation, enjoyable visit and easy to find. If you are in the area, worth the time.

Title: Nice waterfall
Text: Nice waterfall. it involves a bit of hiking and not for people who require assistance. one can get really close to the waterfall as against others which needs to be viewed from far.

Title: Beautiful water fall along the road from Nuwara Eliya to Kandy
Text: The series of water falls along the road from Nuwara Eliya to Kandy simply makes your eyes jump with joy. There are well constructed view points and one can easily come down the hilly road to the base of the water fall. The waterfalls in the ambience of lush green trees  even in winter with no pollution & only sounds of water & birds humming refreshes one.

Title: Enjoyed the walk
Text:
It is easy to walk from the main road near Pedro Tea Factory. The tuk tuk drivers gather at the start of the walk to convince you that it is 8-10 kilometres and much easier on a tuk tuk. Don't listen to them! It only took us about half an hour to walk, and the bumpy track would have been very uncomfortable in a three wheeler!! 

Tea plantations on either side as you walk up, and lovely views over the town below. You get quite close to the waterfall. It's not the largest or most interesting waterfall as others have mentioned, but for us, it was worth a good walk and the views of the falls at the top.

Title: 30 metre falls near Nuwara Eliya
Text:
It is possible to walk through a tea plantation to view the falls from the top. Unfortunately we didn't have time and viewed from the road below. It's certainly an impressive drop and worth seeing if you're passing (about 3 kms northeast of Nuwara Eliya). 

That said, we are fortunate to have seen a number of larger and more impressive waterfalls and can only rate this one as average. But don't let that put you off - it's definitely worth seeing.

Title: Mind blowing!
Text: The route to this place is accessible via tuk-tuk/cars/cabs up till a certain point. Beyond that, you have to trek (easy) a bit which takes around 20 minutes. You then reach exactly in front of the waterfalls. From here, the view is so mesmerising that it is sort of unbelievable. The waterfalls look brilliant and has an intense flow. There is another option after reaching this point- going ahead and reaching exactly on the top of the waterfall. I didn't go there as it was almost 6 pm and was getting dark, so it was not a feasible option. There are usually polite locals around this place who help you to trek up. The place is so quiet, serene and scenic, that you are bound to love it :)    TIP: Please go during daylight as it gets dark quite early and you may not be able to enjoy the view.

Title: surprising amusing plenty of water
Text:
it talked us over a hour to get by, and this for sure was worse it.
we did enjoyed with extremely good colours and clarity this day, when before and after usual rain, so because of much rain, plenty water and colours help;per to get phenomenal pictures

Title: legend
Text: place full of stories :) nice to see like any other waterfall! I saw it from a distance, didn't go on top to see or 'afll' :)

Title: Good to walk and nice view on your way to the fall
Text: We walked up here from San Pedro Tea Factory. It was just a 5 km roundtrip and the view during the walk was awesome. Especially when you walk this route just before sunset. It gives a good view on the tea plantations and the city. The ground was a little muddy since it rained so much in the past days, so dont be afraid to get dirty shoes during rainy days. The fall itself is beautiful, but not spectacular. At the end we found this a nice activity.

Title: it falls from relatively high up
Text: It falls from way up but is not as glamorous as The  Angel's Falls in Venezuela which falls from a height of 3000 ft.

Title: Average, there are better falls in the area
Text: Pretty average falls, but a nice quick walk if you're visiting the plantations. Interesting to see the climate change as you ascend.

Title: Not a bad afternoon stroll
Text:
Worth a visit if you are heading towards Pedros Tea Factory, but we didn't find this waterfall particularly special. A nice easy half an hour walk through the tea plantation (from the factory), and up a rocky terrain towards the end. The walk itself was enjoyable, and the waterfall was pretty, but plenty more spectacular sites elsewhere in the Hill Country.
That being said, would still recommend this as a peaceful way to spend an afternoon, paired with Pedros Tea Factory.

Title: Secluded and Picturesque
Text:
A short view filled walk from the main road through real working tea plantations where the workers are happy to engage and show off their stuff without the usual money-grabbing attitude. Bring some pens or sweets for the little children, we gave away 6, and don't be guilted into giving money to the older boys who put on a 'we are orphans show' that quickly disappeared when no money came.

The waterfall itself is unspectacular but does have good views over Nuwara Eliya and you can sit and watch the mist it creates very peacefully without the usual tourist mobbing at most other falls. A bevy of 8 swedish girls did nothing to diminish the views and when mentioned almost had me leaping from my lover.

Title: A short walk with great views
Text: My husband and I did this walk after attempting to visit the tea plantation across the road. It's an easy hike to the top - only a couple of miles round trip - and offers pleasant views of the surrounding countryside. Worth it if you've got a couple of hours to spare.

Title: Enjoyable!a
Text: It 's not a very big waterfall but it's nice and enjoyable, there are a lot of monkeys in this area, you should try to avoid them, as we were told that they got parasites and we can get infected! it's close to nuwara ellia you can reach it by train or by car

Title: Beautiful waterfall
Text:
We definitely went the wrong way! Our tuk tuk driver dropped us off somewhere very random and we ended up scaling the waterfall from the bottom. Still made it though! 
There's a much easier way which is mostly flat and the waterfall is definitely worth it. There weren't that many people there either. However it's the sort of waterfall you can only look at, and can't really go into. Worth a visit if you have a few hours in the afternoon as it doesn't take long.

Title: An exciting route with bit of climbing
Text: A very good waterfall, and we were intrigued with the name of the falls. A tiny passage which our driver tried to do with his van which is not recommended. Better to go in a tuk tuk. The road ends at a point after which there is about 200 meters walk to the falls.

Title: Leisurely walk with reward at the end!
Text: Lovely short walk from Pedro Tea Estate entrance.  Walk through tea plantations with stunning views over the tea estates.  You will most likely be the only person there when you get to the waterfall which makes the walk worth it.  Will meet kids along the way asking for a pen, biscuit, chocolate, money, I wish I would have had something to share. Check out directions online before you set off.

Title: Not worth the trouble
Text: A long tuk tuk ride and the a long walk to get to fairly ordinary waterfall.The walk was the best part

Title: Nice Falls, Poor Road
Text: We rode a tuk-tuk up the bumpy road as far as they will go. The rest of the path is not maintained and you arrive at a spot to view the falls but really it is not a great waterfall. Maybe it was not the best time of the year for viewing. I probably would not bother to make the trip again.

Title: Beautiful Scenery
Text: Waterfall was beautiful, BUT the walk through the country side was so lovelyyyy. I'm personally very fond of water falls and all. There are few waterfalls in our way to Nuwara Eliya all are beautiful.

Title: Lunch with nice view
Text:
This place offers a very nice view, good Food and a nice garden surrounds the Restaurant.
A good place for a rest.

Title: Lovely walk
Text: The waterfalls were OK, but the walk through the countryside was lovely. Combine with visit to Pedro tea factory, and it makes a great morning

Title: Beautiful if the sun is out!!
Text: A really beautiful place to visit, there's a hotel at the top the drivers take all visitors to as a stop.  You can walk down to the base of the waterfall down a narrow path and stop for lunch on the way back up in the hotel.  A decent buffet curry for the price.

Title: Ramboda Waterfall
Text: Ramboda waterfall is one of the tourist attraction in Sri Lanka. It can be seen from different places. Fall is located on the way to Nuwara Eliya from Kandy. it is in the hill area of Sri Lanka.

Title: Weird but nice
Text:
The waterfalls can be seen from different places but for the best views, you have to go through a hotel and restaurant. They have made this accessible by building steps though narrow. Its a pleasant walk to the falls and not crowded. You can get tea or coffee and relax 
Once again thanks to Manik Tours to take us there

Title: Waterfall accessed through a hotel
Text: Weird setup to access the waterfall through a hotel. It is free to visit, and is nice. But it's not one of the better waterfall experiences in Sri Lanka

Title: An Average experience!!!
Text: To get there, have to pass by a hotel and a restaurant, and a few steps down to reach the spot, to have a close look at the waterfall. Honestly, its not a huge waterfall or anything special about it but its worth a one time visit.

Title: Visit and Lunch with the views of the waterfall
Text:
Our driver stopped at this place for us to view the waterfalls. Access to the waterfall and the beautiful lush green surroundings is through the hotel and it's restaurant. Waterfall was little disappointing as there was not that much water.
After viewing the waterfall, we stayed at the buffet restaurant, which has very nice views of the waterfall and a lot of greenery. It was quite a pleasant experience.

Title: Nice
Text: I wish there was a lot more water coming down but unfortunately for all the people here there is somewhat of a drought which limits the amount of water flowing over the falls. We didnt truck up to them but looked from the vantage point off the main road above the souvenir shop.

Title: Its a trek
Text: The 11st highest waterfall in Sri Lanka, it is close to Nuwara Eliya. Be ready to trek up if we want to get close to the falls so wear trekking shoes and carry your bathing costume, so you can enjoy the waterfall after the long trek up.

Title: Nice falls
Text: The Ramboda falls are nice but not really worth the walk. Maybe because it was warm and hardly no rain. But find the falls not spectacular.

Title: Worth the efforts!
Text:
You will have to walk up alot to see the actual waterfall..but the view is worth it!
Do wear comfortable shoes n clothes for the walk up!
It has a small are on the top were you can go in the water,under the waterfall or just sit beside it..its beautifull!!!!

Title: Not a walk in the park
Text:
There are two sites to view the waterfall.

The first can be accessed though the hotel and is a short walk down some dodgy steps.

The second site which you will have to pay 50LKR per person will take you on a 20-30 minute walk up a number of dodgy steps. 

Both sites are worth it but if youre looking to save some time, pick the first one.

Title: Nice
Text: Very nice waterfall and good to walk to. Some lokal shop around with fruit and stuf. Same man a bid to ager to sell. The do not understand no i think. But good stop fot a picture.

Title: Spectacular
Text:
Dont be fooled, although there is a waterfall here right adjacent to the road you need to walk for about 20 minutes upstream to get to the falls themselves. There is a small ticket booth on the left where you pay 50 rupees to enter and then you follow the path uphill.  Its a bit of stiff climb in places but perfectly manageable if youre reasonably fit.
When you get to the main falls the walk will have been more than worth it as they are stunning. The falls are said to be 109 metres high and the water cascades down into a shallow pool where people swim from the rocks and a small beach area. whilst people clearly have a great time swimming and possibly no under the falling water it does detract a bit from the natural splendour of the site sadly.

Title: Magical Falls
Text: Despite there having been little rain for a while, these superb falls are well worth a visit, as they roar down the mountainside in a series of steps, creating a magical sight and sound.One not to be missed. Get yourself there by local transport for a complete local experience.

Title: A beautiful waterfall at a stone throw distance from the hotel
Text:
The hotel management of Ramboda Hotel was magnanimous enough to all us to use their hotel lift to go down a few floors to have a closer look at the water falls.

Due to paucity of time and also due to the rather cold weather, a bath in the water falls was prudently avoided.

The hotel is located right on the main road between Kandy and Newerelia.

The water falls is magnificent and an added attraction to the hotel guests.

Recommended for those brave souls who love a rather bone chilling cold water bath in the falls.

Title: Nice trip from Nuwara Eliya on a hot summer day
Text: Ramboda waterfall was a very nice choice for a hot day in Nuwara Eliya. You can take a public bus from Nuwara Eliya bus station to Kandy, it takes around 40 min, the bus stops right in front of the entrance and the journey costs around 80 rupees per person ( the same applies for the way back - you can just stay on the same spot and the bus will stop). The entrance fee is 100 rupees for foreign tourists. Once you reach the top ( its a 500 m hike on stairs ) you can swim there but look for some private spots also on the way as we did! Would definitely recommend!

Title: A pleasant long walk to see the real falls
Text: It is beside the road so you can't miss it so why 50% of the photographs on tripadvisor for this site have nothing to do with the waterfall I dont know. But what you can see from the roadside is OK but not the main event. That costs 100 rupees per person to enter and start to walk about 1 km mostly uphill. 450 steps I would say plus a couple of sections over large stones and rocks. Easily managed for us approaching 70 years old but for those with walking difficulties perhaps not. And the view at the end is well worth the walk, and short dip in the pool if you are inclined. Photographs best describe it so have a look.

Title: Water Falls
Text: We had heard about these falls but luckily they had a view point in the road and did not have to trek we were able to see 3 waterfalls from the view point

Title: Awesome views.
Text: Big water falls. Need to go up for see the actual beauty. Steps are slippy but not so difficult. Entry ticket 100 LKR.

Title: Enjoyable
Text:
the waterfall is beautiful. we had to go through a hotel to get to it but it didn't matter. it's a great place to take pictures & simply enjoy it's beauty. 
however, we made the mistake of going in the afternoon & the sun was brutally hot & there wasn't much shade. 
i recommend going either early in the morning or while the sun is setting.

Title: My favorite falls in Nuwereeliya
Text: We had visited twice to this Ramboda falls while going to kandy once & while staying in Nuwereeliya once. Once we walked down to the main fall & its great taking. A bit long walk but worth it. Second time we were hurry we found a short cut few step away to dip on the water. Stairs made to go for those who wanted to make a quick dip & go, one of my favorite falls in Sri Lanka

Title: Ramboda  falls
Text: nice  falls  and  nice  views  once  you get to the  top. The  trek  is  very steep at  few  points  and  is  very tedious.You can swim if  you like  on the base. water  is  cold  and  its  real fun

Title: nice falls but must access through the Ramboda Falls hotel to get up close
Text: 7 Km from Damro we arrived at Ramboda Falls. Our driver instructed us to take the Ramoda Falls Hotel shuttle down the steep road to the hotel. After paying access fee for the falls at the reception, we made our way down the elevator and walked to the falls.

Title: Very attractive falls
Text: Ramboda falls are one of the must visit places on your route to Nuwara Eliya. The falls are huge and offer a spectacular view. One can easily see it from the main road or go to ramboda resort pay 200 bucks for using their elevator and go to the basement from where you can walk upto the falls. There is a view point just next to the falls which offers a stunning view. Be careful of as the track is slippery and you also get wet because of heavy winds. But the view is surely worth the effort. You can also have some snacks at the ramboda restaurant by paying huge premium. You need not pay for the elevator if you are having snacks at the restaurant.

Title: Impressive
Text: The waterfalls are really impressive and well worth the stop if you are driving through. There are a few viewing platforms

Title: Beautiful
Text: Theres two ways of enjoying ramboda falls. First is to watch it from d main road , maybe go a few steps inside too. The second one is a hike of around 30minutes to the almost top of the falls and watch in awe how d water just keeps gushing down. We did d second one. A tiring half hour hike with sweat all over, we reached d top. And then when u see d falls u forget d hike, u just watch. Entry ticket of 50LKR to be paid before starting d hike. Please wear proper shoes. Slippers can make d hike slippery and theres a risk of leeches too. If u dont mind d hike I suggest u enjoy d falls d second way.

Title: Amazing waterfalls 
Text: Ramboda Water Falls is an amazing water falls and it can be accessed easily through the Ramboda falls Resort and the main advantage is taking photos from very near. Nice site seeing and tourist attraction highly recommended to visits with no entrance fee.

Title: Waterfall
Text:
It's a very nice waterfall just near the road. You don't have to climb or put out to much effort to reach to the it.
Quick stop, quick visit, admire, take few photos and be back on the road again.

Title: Nice but not must
Text: Like many other and beautiful waterfalls at Sri Lanka, this one is pastoral too. If you stop by it's cool, but I don't think that you should really plan a special visit there.

Title: What a view
Text: We seen this waterfall from far, but this has great views and surrounding areas looks beautiful and we stayed for 30 minutes

Title: Breathtaking view
Text: Well, you see it from far, but if the weather is right it can be a really breathtaking view. Spend 30 min here just hanging out.

Title: Pictureasque waterfalls
Text:
The falls are located next to the Ramboda hotel, and you need to navigate some steep steps to get to them.  The waterfalls are not overly large, but are picturesque. 

The initial road to the hotel itself is rather steep, and slippery after rains.  We were lucky that our guide managed to get us seats on the hotel shuttle to and from the building.  

To get to the waterfalls, you need to take a lift down from the  hotel towards the restaurant, where there is a path through a small patch of tea plants.

Title: Great nature
Text:
This is a huge waterfall . You ll walk and climb a lot . 
Come with crocs . 
Tinny and unsafe steps to reach the top . But great natural masterpiece .

Title: Pretty waterfall, terrible restaurant
Text: Very scenic waterfall which makes for a good hike and great pictures. However there is a restaurant right next to the waterfall which serves very average food and has awful service!

Title: Beautiful!
Text: Its a small little hike to go to this beautiful waterfall and it should definitely be on your list. We were lucky when we went there was no one and we enjoyed nice chilled beer! The gushing waterfall and the greenery is magical!

Title: Wonderful sight
Text: The Ramboda falls can be accessed only through Hotel located in Nuwara Eliya. One has to walk down a small incline to the hotel and take the elevator to the dining area where there is an exit leading to the falls. A rough path leads right upto the falls. The falls is the 11th highest one in Srilanka and is truly breathtaking! A must visit.

Title: Ramboda fall
Text: We have visited the fall on our way back to Colombo from adam peak ..though the walk was steepy but it's worth the effort ...a spectacular  veiw

Title: Take a break
Text: Round the bend on the main road to Nuwara Ellya and all is before you.  A great spectacle and not even the rainy season.  A lot of locals were climbing over the rocks and into the pools to cool off - what about H&S did I hear you say, just like 4 up on a moped.  A great photo opportunity, free parking is very limited.  Monkeys and birds add to the areas attraction.

Title: Beautiful sight
Text: Lovely waterfall worth a stop if passing although there is a small parking fee to pay to an attendant. Otherwise it's free. Good photo opportunities.

Title: Gorgeous Falls!
Text: Very impressive waterfall with beautiful valley view. Our driver parked at the top of the falls and there was a special transport van that was waiting to bring us to the bottom of the road, where the lobby of a hotel is. We walked through the hotel and took an elevator down to an exit outside. The path was well marked but uneven at times and it is a bit of a climb back up. There is a cafe near the base of the waterfall. Very nice little walk to see it, definitely worth a visit. Might be challenging for those with mobility issues.

Title: Wonderful waterfall
Text: You can see this wonderful waterfall from the main road on the way to Nuwara Eliya. The extent of the water fall really depends on the season, so much more impressive during the rainy months.

Title: Breathtaking Waterfalls
Text: This waterfall is so exciting and beautiful to watch that you will have to be dragged away. The cascading water and the sound is really mesmerizing. Better take an umbrella or be prepared to be drenched by the spray mist from the cascading water. There are stone steps leading to the base of the waterfalls, but you have to be careful as they are very slippery due to the water mist drenching them. A small hike but it is worth the trek, as the view is fantastic and breathtaking. A small fee is charged for the hike to the top, but the view is more than worth it. Don't ever miss this spot, which our driver cum guide Rasiga took us to, if you are in Kandy you can contact him on +94 779191672.

Title: Worth the visit and stamina
Text: Visited last Jan 2017 - was well worth the visit - a good hike to the top and we almost missed the stone steps leading to the base of the waterfall - this was the best part are the tiring hike - the water was cool and a good relief

Title: Very beautiful stop En route.
Text: This is really beautiful, but I would not go out of my way as they are so many beautiful waterfalls in Sri Lanka. It is however worthwhile stopping to look at as it is rather pretty. It is definitely worth stopping for a sellfie.

Title: Beautiful
Text: So many waterfalls in Sri Lanka but this is a real beauty.  We really enjoyed our visit.   Walk is easy too.

Title: Beautiful
Text: This is beautiful water fall on your way. The water fall can be seen by the road side. There are many food outlets here. A good stop.

Title: Half an hour Hike
Text: You need to hike for about half an hour to see the main waterfall.Which is the beautiful one.There are many waterfalls around here you can see on the Kandy  Nuwara eliya road.

Title: Beautiful waterfalls
Text:
We came here in July, and the waterfall was full. A good time to visit! There's a parking area at the top of the paved driveway which leads to a hotel. Then take the elevator down and the trail from there to the falls. It is a bit of a walk, but you don't have to be in great physical shape to do it and it's all downhill. 

Coming back, it's about a five minute hike up the trail. Once you're in the hotel, you can get a shuttle van for only 100 rupees to take you back to your vehicle - well worth it! 

You'll pass several other waterfalls as you drive to Ramboda, as well as a large lake and several huge tea plantations. The whole region is gorgeous - be sure to visit if you find yourself in Nuwara Eliya with a few free hours.

Title: Worth a stop and a photo.
Text: If you are passing by here, do stop and have a look. This place makes for a good spot for a selfie or group photo.

Title: Bad Hotel, Very Poor Service
Text:
Very,very poor service.Stafff were very bad.Rooms are looks very old type.Music was too much sound..we didn't sleep whole night.
On the checkout they have given me a feedback form..i have attached it here...

Title: Stop & enjoy a dip
Text: This is a beautiful waterfall that is not too difficult to access via narrow pathways and stairs. You can stop and take a dip if you like. Since the water is quite cold it would be wise to take a a towel and swimwear so that you can quickly dry off.

Title: Nice Big Falls
Text: Its a lovely falls with a good view, its about 30-40kms on your way to Nuwera Eliya. Its nothing great to talk about but the mere fact that it is a nice stop on a good climate and dip yourself in the serene local and environment. There are plenty of view points.

Title: Lovely
Text: Lovely waterfall with a good view. About 32 km outside town centre. Must visit when in Nuwera eliya.

Title: Nice falls
Text: To be honest its not a standout by world falls standards but a nice stop on the way thru in a cooler environment. Theres also a nice restaurant there overlooking which is a good lunch stop.

Title: "Noooooooooooo!!" We Silently Screamed At This Stunning Sight
Text:
We also said it aloud and complained somewhat and struggled.  For we are humans of moderate fitness and less than 12 hours ago we had come down off Adams Peak and oh me oh my were our legs still feeling it when we had to walk the short walk down the slight gradient of the driveway, a couple of flights of stairs and again the slight gradient down to the waterfalls viewing platform.    

Was it worth the effort.  Yes!    It is a beautiful waterfall and I would highly recommend the walk regardless of how you're feeling at the time.   Staying (seated) for a buffet lunch at the nearby restaurant overlooking the waterfall is also recommended.

Title: Great place to visit
Text: If you are going to Nuwara Eliya you must stop by at the Ramboda view point to see the Falls. It is one of the best natural sceneries you can ever see with the Falls, the mountains, the green landscape, the tea farms, the clouds. It it a breath taking place to see.

Title: Amazing experience
Text: Beautiful view and amazing experience, the only problem are the long steps down to the falls which is risky.

Title: Water falls
Text: Visited the falls on April 2018, this place is adjacent to tea bush factory. We need to walk a bit distance to reach this place

Title: Great hike, stunning views
Text: 50 LKR entry fee but worth it! Super nice hike, not strenuous, about 30 min :) great views, managed to get really close to the waterfall. We could stand on the rocks and feel the spray of the waterfall

Title: A Must See (the largest of the falls)
Text:
Ramboda is the name of the town and there are several waterfalls. Some of the reviews on here are not of the actual fall that most go to see. The beautiful one in the bulk of pictures is found by walking through the Ramboda Falls Hotel.  

GETTING THERE: You have to go all the way to the bottom of the stairs and then walk along a path.  It is not a 15-20 min hike. It's a walk down a street then down the stairs of a hotel, then along a path that is about 100-200 meters. It can be a bit taxing if you are not in great shape as it is still a lot of stairs.  Also, if you're walking down to the hotel from the road you might find it difficult. From the road, down the hotel stairs over to the falls, is a comfortable 15 minute walk.  There are restrooms in the hotel. I think there is also a lift that you can extra for.  The street down to the hotel is rather steep.

THE FALLS: We saw 3 falls in Ramboda.  One was a quick one by the side of the road after the Rothschild tea farm.  Then this one. In the distance you can see a huge waterfall that is likely quite the hike for advanced folk. The one through the hotel, though is likely the one you want to see. On my insta, I'll be posting a video of some of the photo shots that are possible. When we were there, there were a few girls and guys that were clearly doing a photo shoot in front of the falls. I had envy. It's so beautiful and the set up for the shots is soo easy.  When we went it was not crowded, so we could do whatever we wished.  

TIME OF YEAR:  May is not quite wet and not quite dry season.  The images of people in the water must be during dry season. It would seem rather dangerous during May to go into the water.  The beauty of the falls is kind of independent of the weather season though, IMO.

WHAT TO BRING/WEAR: Def bring your photo gear and anything you want for a photo.  Also, I would def wear shoes with good treads in the month of May. Despite a great walkway they've put up, you will end up with muddy shoe wear and it can feel a bit unsteady if you don't have any treads.

Title: A nice view with lunch!
Text:
We stopped here on the way to the tea plantations and enjoyed the views of the waterfalls and surrounding scenery. The lunch we had was very good and the stunning waterfalls made up for the fact it was raining! 

A nice spot to see on your way round the region.

Title: Beautiful falls,worth the hike
Text: Ramboda Waterfall is at the end of a 15-20 min walk. The walk is worth since the waterfall is breathtaking. And you can find places to dip into the water on the way as well (but keep in mind water levels change and its not really advised to dip in)

Title: What a view of the lovely falls and also a refreshing swim
Text:
There are two levels to the Ramboda falls and you can see both like we did. 

The first easily seen from the Ramboda falls hotel where there is a viewing terrace to see one level of the falls. 
Cost is free. Hotel has toilets and there is even a wee coffee shop. 

The second is a 15 min hike up uneven steps and path to get to a viewing hut and also access the the pool at the bottom of the falls where we went for a swim. There are signs that say no swimming but we swam in the pool which at the time was safe. Keep an eye on the forecast as rain can make the falls gush more but might then not allow swimming. Water was lovely and refreshing. 
Cost is 150LKR to get access this way. No toilets.

Title: Picturesque waterfall and cooling swim
Text:
There are two levels to the Ramboda falls and you can see both like we did. 

The first easily seen from the Ramboda falls hotel where there is a viewing terrace to see one level of the falls. 
Cost is free. Hotel has toilets and there is even a wee coffee shop. 

The second is a 15 min hike up uneven steps and path to get to a viewing hut and also access the the pool at the bottom of the falls where we went for a swim. Water was lovely and refreshing. 
Cost is 150LKR to get access this way. No toilets.

Title: Absolute WOW experience!
Text: I can see why its the number one thing to do and see. Its absolutely breath-taking. what many may not know is there are two falls. one at the bottom and another bigger and best one up the hill and its quite a stairway. it was absolutely breath-taking and no one was there which made it absolutely awesome to take photos. A MUST SEE and super highly recommended.. You can also swim but be careful as the rocks are super slippery

Title: A must do in Ramboda
Text: I can see why its the number one thing to do and see. Its absolutely breath-taking. what many may not know is there are two falls. one at the bottom and another bigger and best one up the hill and its quite a stairway. it was absolutely breath-taking and no one was there which made it absolutely awesome to take photos. A MUST SEE and super highly recommended.. You can also swim but be careful as the rocks are super slippery.

Title: worth a visit
Text: visited the waterfalls on the way to nuwara eliya from kandy. would recommend visiting if in the area

Title: Uplifting
Text: We didn't hike up to the falls, but the scene from the road was quite uplifting. Good place to stop for a break of around 20 to 30 minutes. Allow for more time if you are feeling energetic and want to go for a climb.

Title: Spectacular waterfall amidst tea garden
Text: This is a spectacular fall set amidst tea estates. It is worth the climb  to the top to get a good view of the fall. One has to be careful of the slippery bit where moss may have collected due to  water running slowly.

Title: Must see in Ramboda
Text: We enjoyed the view but due to the hot weather , the climb was tiring. Suggest make it a first thing in the morning visit as we went around noon. Certain part of the steps are quite steep though not many.

Title: unforgettable picnic
Text: We were taken to that place by our tour guide and driver Kusumsiri Wijetunga( you can find him on FB and I can recommend him) The view of the waterfall was really marvellous and what is more Kusum took us for a picnic just close to the waterfall. The water is rather refreshing but one of us decided to bathe!!

Title: Beautiful Falls, Surrounded by Scented Tea Plantation
Text:
You have to walk through the hotel to visit the falls. A very short walk down, dont avoid it. Its a brisk walk but the scene at the fall is awesome.
You also get to see Tea leaves pickers peeping out from the Plantation. Smile and wave, youll see their smile brightens up. 

Tea leaves scented the journey to the fall.

Title: Very beautiful
Text: The falls are excellent ... water all year round . Must visit if you are on your way to Nuwera Eliya by road .

Title: Average waterfall right by the road
Text: If you are passing by car you can just stop for a quick view. Local people are bathing and washing in the waterfall. There are many other waterfalls along the way which are as nice to watch.

Title: Worth a Stopover
Text:
There are two Ramboda Falls which are not really far from each other. The first one is situated along the highway right next to Ramboda Tunnel and second one (109 meters high and 11th highest in the country) is near Ramboda Waterfall hotel. You can take a nice photo of the 11th highest from the view deck located few meters away from the other waterfall.

I've seen lots of beautiful, massive waterfalls in my life but this one is still worth a stopover.

Title: wonderful
Text: we were in a group friendly tour. we stayed beside the fall for an hour and took a lit of photos and breath the wet air there. a cantilever deck is near the fall which the tourist can go there and watch the fall there and take photos.

Title: Nice fall
Text: There is a shuttle to reach the hotel below the road, but you can go walking it's not that far. The fall is nice and you can have a cup of tea while watching it.

Title: Amazing
Text:
Stayed at Ramboda Hotel and the falls were in full sight from our cabana. 
Able to walk to the falls down fairly steep steps. But there is a hand rail. 
Certainly worth the walk to stand in the mist of the falls and hear them.

Title: Wonderfull waterfall
Text:
It is a scenic picture at the waterfall of Ramboda! The rainy days made the waterfall full of water which made it even more wonderful!
It is possible to walk down to a terrace near by the falls and make beautiful pictures or just stare at the powerful happening.
Our tour guide and driver took us up to this scenic place. He is an easy going guy who knows the gems/hidden places in his country! Just tell him your wishes and he comes with custom made tours at amazing reasonable prices! Contact him: Anil Jayantha Balasooriya 
0094772993730
Balasooriya119@yahoo.com

Title: Tropical rain will enhance the falls
Text: Fortunately or unfortunately it started to rain as we pulled up across the bridge on the Nuwara Eliya - Colombo main road. The fortunate part means extra water over the waterfall and down the rapids. The unfortunate means photography is more difficult and keeping your camera dry. The 5-600 meter climb up to the main vantage point can be a bit taxing as it is steep and becomes slippery in the wet. If you are wearing sandals watch out for leeches they will get you. Reaching the sheltered viewing station allows for relative dry photography. With the tropical downpour the volume of water can double in a matter of minutes with an attendant rise in the sound as the water flings itself over the top ledge. I don't believe these are the highest falls in Srilanka at around 110 metres. Well worth the effort of climbing to the true waterfall.

Title: A ordinary looking  waterfalls
Text:
Ramboda waterfalls is said to be tallest in Srilanka. But at the location we saw it . there was copiou flow of water down thw falls . But the height could not be guessed from where we saw it.
Any how it is one of the places on the highway where you can spend and relax for 30 mts of sight seeing

Title: Lovely place to stop
Text: Easy walk down to the bottom of the falls, pretty flowers on the way. There is a lovely restaurant at the top to have a cool drink or something to eat. There was also a couple of cottages to stay which would be very peaceful and some where nice to eat at night

Title: Take a break in Rambo
Text: Ramboda Fall is a place to take some quick selfy and some nice pic of the waterfall. It will give u some good memory when u look back your tour pics

Title: Average Waterfall worth a stop only if on the way
Text: They charge you to enter the waterfall area which is a surprise since this a natural attraction with no added maintenance. The water fall is the 11th highest in Sri Lanka so it's not like a must do. If it's on your way from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya, you can spend about 5 mins here. Don't bother to take a detour for it.

Title: Gorgeous waterfall
Text: This is a waterfall which just appears on your side on the road. You need not go treking and in search of it. It is so very nice you can take lot of pictures its really lovely

Title: Nice place, but water was almost dried up in March
Text: you need not go out of the way for this, this will come on your way itself to Nuwara Eliya. a deep valley & falls in front of you, but not a very great sight. got few rain showers here.

Title: huge fall
Text: this is biggest of the falls in and around Ramboda. nice photography stop over to the winding roads to Nuwara Alia. surrounded by greenery and beautiful landscape

Title: Beautiful place
Text: I love this place so so so much. You have to go beside the lake and be so careful while reaching out to the water.

Title: Great photo opp; nice walk up
Text:
The Ramboda falls are along the road to Kandy-Nuwara. Easy parking and access to the first part of the falls. If you like a good hike up the mountain you will have to buy a ticket at LKR 20,- . It will take about 15 to 20 minutes to hike up, to see a nice waterfall and area to pose. Probably afternoon is better because in the morning the sun will be behind the waterfall making picture more challenging. When we walked up we were all by ourselves. Walking down we met a school trip crowd of about 50 going up...
Still great walk up, nice photo opp.

Title: Very Good Falls
Text: Visited falls with Family. It is very nice. Water flow was very good. Walked on the stairs for some time. Please do not miss; walk and try to go to top. View is really good.

Title: Awesome View!!!
Text:
Awesome property and staff are really well behaved... Thank You Mr Shishan Wickramasuriya for making for stay a memorable one.
Breakfast & Dinner spreads are also quite  good.

Title: Huge waterfall
Text: Having lunch next to the Ramboda Fall was quite relaxing. It looked great after heavy rain in the afternoon and you might get wet if you walk close to the water fall. Buy it worth going near to it and feeling fall

Title: AN AVERAGE SPOT
Text: We visited Ramboda falls while going to Nuwara Eliya from Kandy. The fall is about 25 km before Nuwara Eliya. Ramboda Falls looks far away from road side. You can see it at a vast distance and some parking place is created on road side. Not a great place but ok for some photography. Ramboda falls is believed to be 109 metre in height.

Title: Water and Falls.
Text:
Long time I haven't see a nice falls in my life, so we decided to ask out driver Mr. Sunil to take us there.

The place is very comfortable since there is an hotel near by and you can even enjoy the view of the Water Falls and  have a buffet lunch.

Title: OK
Text: The valley and the road to see the falls are very interesting. Tea gardens all around. The falls are quite impressive but are viewed from a distance.

Title: Ramboda Falls
Text:
Not Niagara, nor Gulefoss. Not the Rhinefalls  nor Tummelbach falls - near Lauterbrunnen in the Berner  Overland. 
 This is the Ramboda falls- less powerful than all the above but at 60 metres + taller than all but the first. There are a number of similar but smaller falls nearly making this one stunning vista. 
  Sri Lanka at her most beautiful.

Title: Lovely
Text: The falls can be seen from were we had lunch at the Ramoda Falls hotel, lovely gardens and the falls are worth the visit.

Title: worth visit
Text:
beautiful scenery. lots of flowers and greenery.
The best view is from hotel and restaurant Ramboda Falls.
There is a path and one can walk closer to the falls.

Title: More than one waterfall
Text: Rambodea Falls is a series of falls, the one we enjoyed most has a small charge to hike up to, it is adjacent to the main road. The walk is about 20 minutes to a viewing gallery and then part of the way down you can take a path which leads to part of the falls where you can swim in a small pool or just sit with your feet in the cold water.

Title: Spectacular Waterfalls
Text: Very pretty and worth a view if you are passing. The. falls and the spectacular views down the valley are worth seeing if you are passing, however as there's not much else there I'm not sure I would travel just to see the waterfall.

Title: Waterfall among tea plantation
Text:
Access for best view through Ramboda waterfalls hotel. 
No one asks anything, no one bothers, just walk in, stairs down to resaturant and waterfall is on your left. 
Small path takes you closer, fantastic view. 
(Rained a lot in previous days, so not sure how it is in the real dry season).

Title: Worth a visit
Text: Worth a visit. One of the few semiconductor attractions we visited in Sri Lanka that we didn't have to pay for. Easy walk and nice place to stop for lunch.

Title: Lovely
Text: Beautiful waterfalls. Can trek closer or can see from Ramboda Falls Hotel directly to the left of you.

Title: Beautiful waterfall
Text: Very beautiful and easily accessible waterfalls. If you like you can climb up. Places to eat nearby.

Title: Wonderful Waterfall
Text:
We were staying in Ramboda falls hotel,  so this Waterfall was like 100 steps away..  There was so much water flowing. We were wondering the source of so much water in a non rainy season
 The water has an are upto which you can go and take snaps..  As people who stay in the hotel are the majority who visit this, there is less crowd early morning. 

Me and my wife went early morning and we could take a lot of snaps without anyone being there..  

If you want to see a Waterfall with a fantastic view of hills,  you should visit this if in sri lanka

Title: Nice but not much to see
Text:
Careful, this is a ticketed waterfall with no price listed for foreigners - locals pay 20 rupees.

My tuk tuk driver got us in for local rates. It's falls itself are better viewed from on of the viewing platforms on the opposite side of the hill.

Title: Nice falls.
Text: Nice falls on the way between Kandy and Nuwara Eliya. There is a restaurant where you can have lunch and enjoy the view.

Title: Scenic
Text: A very scenic waterfall with two cascading drops set in the hills amongst the tea plantations. I didn't have time to go through the hotel but used zoom lens from the viewing platform and still got good photos.

Title: A place to visit when in Ramboda
Text: An average place of interest probably because of the dry season. The fall is near the main road and has a good view to the top of the fall. We stayed at the Ramboda hotel for a night which has a walkway to the bottom of the fall. It's was a much better view from here.

Title: Great waterfall!
Text: Slightly strange that you need to walk through a hotel to reach these falls, but they are amazingly beautiful!  (We ate at the restaurant - which was fine.)

Title: Stunning
Text: Very scenic waterfall on way to Nuwara Eliya. We did not go close by as it did not appear safe but the backdrop makes a wonderful snap.

Title: Beautiful falls off the road to the south
Text: If you are driving from Kandy down to one of the national parks, you'll pass the Ramboda Falls. It's worth jumping out of the car as the falls are more impressive up close.

Title: Climb till the end for spectacular views
Text:
The climb for the waterfalls starts right from the main highway. Foreigners are required to pay LKR 20 as an entrance fee (which i personally felt was dodgy). The climb / trail is generally easy and runs through some medium tree cover.  On the top there is a run down viewing spot but offers spectacular views of the waterfall and the surrounding areas. The footfall when I was there was almost non-existent and should give you a chance to take a lovely dip in the cool waters of the waterfalls. The best time to visit is early morning to beat the strong mountain sun

Note: there is only point where the trail enters into a tunnel. You need to cross this to get to the top.

Title: Perfect
Text:
Very nice view but some walk is needed to reach the perfect spot for taking pictures. We walked downhill but took the free bus from Ramboda fall hotel while going up.
We didn't order in the hotel restaurant, maybe there was a certain deal between our driver and them. You can't stay for more than half an hour since the noise of the water could disturb you.

Title: Awesome scenic beauty
Text: We were here for lunch at the nearby restaurant. Good ambience,good food.. and great variety.Wonderful experience.

Title: Amazing view
Text: Er only stopped for lunch. The food were a little pricy But the view is amazing. Do stop if you are pasning..

Title: Stunning!
Text: You can´t miss Ramboda Falls on the way from Ella to Kandy. If you pay attention, you´ll see them from the road, you can stop near the Ramboda Falls Hotel and easily access the falls from the aforementioned hotel. It´s a stunning view, very peaceful and calming.

Title: Stunning
Text:
Stunning waterfall with breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and tea fields.

Definitley worth stopping off on your way to/from Nuwara Eliya

Title: Beautiful waterfall, awesome views from the hotel restaurant
Text:
The nature there is magnificent - the waterfall, the green surroundings, another waterfall, the mountains pics, the small tea plantation with Sri Lankan women berrying tea.

There is a hotel next to Ramboda watetfall with nice restaurants with splendid view. You may walk to the waterfall from there. It's a short walk.

Title: Wow must visit
Text: Wonderful water fall with increadable views and green high mountains. Sky look at Sun down was remarkable. The steps to go near the fall is risky and narrow. More care while walking to be considered. Soprty wear will perfect for such location.

Title: Simply superb
Text: A great great great view. There is a restaurant hardly 200 m away from the lake. You need to find the track from the restaurants which goes to this waterfall.

Title: Enjoyable mini adventure
Text: A decent walk to the view point 500m ish and then down to under the falls for a dip - very beautiful and very fairly priced to enter at 50 rupee.  TIP: make sure your foot ware has a bit of grip as the walkway can be a bit slimy especially if raining.

Title: Rattlesnake Falls - Beautiful
Text: I do not know why the locals call this waterfall as rattlesnake waterfall....but this waterfall is indeed one of the best available in Sri Lanka. The climb up the waterfall can be tedious but definitely worth it. The view is stunning and the water is refreshing. Definitely a great spot to take some really nice pictures.

Title: Great stop off
Text: Use the hotel for access - you can walk right down to the falls - spectacular views and great picture opportunities

Title: Among the best waterfalls in Sri Lanka
Text: Great climb to a set of some of the best falls in Sri Lanka! Take the time to go both on the side trail for a great view of the lower falls and the upper trail to a view of the falls en toto. Well worth the sweat all around!

Title: Awesome view
Text:
There is a Hotel Ramboda falls and one can get the best view from here. They arrange to take people down through a winding narrow lane to the hotel. From there you take an elevator to the view point location to see the falls.

Lovely waterfalls with green foliage surrounding the whole area. With the advent of the monsoon, the water power was enormous and it was a sight to see. The height of the falls is about 110 meters drop and then the river goes through rocks and stones. 

Beautiful setting

Title: Strange to get to have your dinner here on the way to Nuwaraeliya
Text: Slightly strange to get here as you have to go through a hotel and down the steps at the back however it is a good stop off to have your sandwiches if you have driven from Kandy to Nuwareliya. Its good to stretch the legs and have a photo op.

Title: The best we've seen
Text:
One of the best we've seen. Wonderful view. You have to walk down till you reach a closer view of the waterfalls. 
There is a place where you can take some pics. 
Do not cross the border it is not safe & slippery

Title: Nice water fall beside the road.
Text: We stayed in the Thuruliya Lodge which is next to the falls. From this hotel it is walking distance ( 1/2 minutes). There are some street shops and normal shops nearby the fall. So we found it a bit crowded. As we were running out of time, we just took some photos on our way back to kandy. But we saw peoples are having bath and hiking. The fall looked beautiful. May be next time I will prefer to go closer to the fall.

Title: Picturesque Spot
Text:
On the way to Nuwara Eliya loved to explore this beautiful waterfall. You have to cross Ramboda Tunnel and Ramboda Waterfall Hotel to reach at this picturesque spot. During rainy season the force of the water is more than summer. 
You can even enjoy the view of this fall while having food at Ramboda hotel. A must-visit natural beauty.

Title: very nice area
Text: if you are in the way between Kandy to Nuwara Eliya, you have to stop there and enjoy the fresh air and have photos

Title: Could be a nice place
Text: Not worth it! It could be a nice place but surrounding is dirty as locals dont care about environment.

Title: Very nice!
Text: We stayed in the hotel next to the falls so had a great view. You can walk from the hotel to the falls. Very pleasant and soothing...

Title: Cool place to visit
Text: This is a 109 metre waterfall near Nuwara Eliya . The place is full of scenic views and natural landscapes. The waterfall was gushing with full force in April and I guess it would be more beautiful in rains . You can go down to the base of the waterfall through the hotel situated there . Good memories can be made here

Title: Very nice and Awsome!!!!!
Text:
I reached Rumboda around 3 pm we dumped bags in Oakray Tea Bush hotel which is situated at nice location and rooms with panoramic view......we rushed to fall before it get dark. There are steps to get to the fall (down grade). It is Awsome and breath taking to watch it.....Great gift by nature to County. No measures taken by authorities to make it more beautiful. Only a corrugated sheet roof supported by pipes and 3 benches.....the standing point has pipe railing but very dangerous for kids as they can fell down. It could have been much better......
It has natural beauty and it worth seeing but no contribution from human beings......can be made more attractive with little effort.....I will recommend to visit great site for capturing pictures.

Title: What a amazing experience
Text: Its on the way to Nuwera Eliya from Kandy. One must a stop.....enjoy the beauty...chilled beer.....and lunch. I can assure you that you will not regret. The entry is through Ramboda Fall Hotel and they provide free transport as the location is very steep down from the highway. Their drivers are expert. Food and drinks cost is reasonable. They have rooms, cottages as well if anyone want to stay.

Title: Ramboda on the way
Text:
On the way to nuwara eliya we stopped by ramboda falls it was refreshing and quite interesting 

Try to visit during rainy season for a more profound view

Title: Beautiful
Text: This waterfall is on the way to Nuwara Eliya. It's an amazing place and nobody wants to sell anything!  When we were there it were just a few tourists. It's not possible to swim or go into the water because it wouldnt be possible to climb down the stones.

Title: Ramboda Falls
Text: Beautiful view, easy access through the Ramboda hotel, they provide a car and an elevator to take you their, which was impressive.

Title: Must see
Text:
This is a magnificient  place. You should not miss it.
The view from the hotel restaurant overlooking the falls is also wonderful especially during rainy days.

Title: Wonderful Photographs Taken
Text: A sight to behold, Ramboda Falls. The hotel that overlooks the falls has the absolute best views. Our photographs did  not do justice. A must do stop en route to Nuwara Eliya

Title: Just Falls
Text: The falls are magnificently beautiful....They are strong and pure white. In the mid of night or the chirpy morning you cannot miss the sound of the waterfall

Title: Nice waterfalls
Text: The waterfall is pretty but you cannot get in. It's a tourist destination with lots of people and very little feeling of nature.

Title: Thanks to the hotel
Text: The waterfall is really wonderful, you can get there through the entry in the hotel, they were really kind because they allow everyone to go through their hotel to see this beauty.

Title: Beautiful waterfall
Text: Thanks to the generosity of the Rambods Falls Hotel, you can access the base of the waterfall through their property at no charge. This is a stunning waterfall that offers plenty of great photo opportunities. Also keep an eye out for the ladies picking tea leaves on the hillside as you walk down.

Title: Picturesque Falls
Text: Ramboda falls are on the way from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya. The falls are magnificent. To have a closer view of the falls you need to climb down steep hill through the Ramboda hotel. There is no other way and you have to go from inside the Ramboda hotel.  But the route is narrow and slippery so need to be cautious. Going through the hotel becomes a bit clumsy but in the end it's really worth it. The falls are wonderful and huge.

Title: Beautiful place
Text: Ramboda Falls it's a natural place and it's good to see Waterfall coming from the mountain you can take a good pictures and have fun

Title: Nice Setting!
Text: This is definitely worth a visit! The waterfall itself is really nice. Got to go down to the viewing platform. The surrounding is quaint with nice scenary. One can also see the ladies at work with the tea leaves.

Title: Great Photo Opportunity
Text: Stopped here on our way back from Kandy to Bentota. Visited for just under an hour to walk to the waterfalls, via the hotel, and get up close to the waterfall on the viewing platform. Great photo opportunity. Worth doing as part of a broader trip into the heart of this lovely country

Title: Beautiful falls
Text: Ramboda falls are on the way from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya. The falls are magnificent. To have a closer view of the falls you need to climb down steep hill through the Ramboda hotel. There is no other way and you have to go from inside the Ramboda hotel. The falls are wonderful and huge. But one cannot stand there for long time as the route is a narrow passage and if it gets crowded it might cause inconvenience. Going through the hotel becomes a bit clumsy but in the end it's worth it.

Title: Hotel with excellent falls and hill view, great service and food !
Text: Stayed here, great service and people. Nice view, excellent place to relax. Food has been great and tasty. Real a place to be ...not to be missed !

Title: Beautiful waterfall
Text: Worth a visit - there is a restaurant at a hotel with the best view of the Ramboda Falls and the beautiful surroundings, a very nice place to take a break if you are on the road. It might also be worth considering to stay one night at the hotel, as the villas have excellent first row views to the Ramboda falls, must be nice to wake up to that view.

Title: Beautiful Falls
Text: You can see the falls from the road from a distance and they are quite beautiful. The falls are quite high and with plenty of water and the surrounding mountain scenery is pretty good as well. Select a nice sunny day for your visit as this area can get misty and rain.

Title: Steep climb, really worth it
Text: Most people gather at the first entry point to the falls near the bridge. This is nice but not a patch on what you get for a bit of effort. Though there are steps, the climb is steep and hard work and more than once we considered giving up unsure as to where the path was leading. However close to the top the steps fork...one path leading up to the left one going down to the right. The right one leads you to a plateau where the water cascades over. It's easy enough to traverse which then leads to the main falls and a freezing but beautiful pool in which you can swim safely. Out of the hundreds gathered at the bridge only 4 others made it when we were there. So tranquil and a real gem.

Title: Great scenery!!
Text: The view is just amazing, you really get to appreciate it if you go right down to it. While seeing it from the road, I was not expecting much to be honest.

Title: "My Tour 2015 " - Ramboda Water Fall.
Text:
One of the famous waterfall in the central province of SriLanka .  I have seen Ramboda fall from the A5 highway at Ramboda pass. There is a view point on the highway just opposite of the fall.

 It was a misty day.  So could not enjoy that much from a far place.  It is formed in Panna Oya a tributary of Kotmale Oya, at Pussellawa area in the district of Kandy.  

Total height of the fall is 109 m.

Title: Ramboda Falls
Text: While visiting Hanuman temple at Ramboda we stopped over at Ramboda water falls. We had to walk down a little but the effort was worth while. The water fall is magnificent and we enjoyed the surrounding mountains and greenery which was fabulous.

Title: Beautiful place
Text: It's a bit of a walk to get to the falls. We had to get past a hotel to access the falls. The view from the walkway is amazing with lush green mountains on one side and the falls on the other. We had lunch at the hotel there and it was quite good.

Title: Great waterfall and mountain views
Text: There are a series of waterfalls all visible from the road for those not able to walk up to the base of the falls. Spectacular views across the valley and mountains.  A good spot to stop and take photos.

Title: A very good Experience
Text: Ramboda Water Falls is the only natural water fall in Sri Lanka. I am surprised to see that in Sri Lanka there is no Ice Peak/Hill then how and from where the huge water comes in the falls. This was a great experience. I stayed at Ramboda Falls Hotel, which is situated at the Water Falls itself and the view from my room was amazing.

Title: A pretty stop point
Text: This waterfall is spectacular for its height, and the view over the downstream valley is beautiful. We stopped to view from a nearby hotel on the A5 with a balcony-style viewing platform.

Title: Nice little waterfall on the hilly road to Nuwara Eliya
Text: The Ramboda Falls is a nice set of two or three water falls, pretty but not spectacular by a stretch. If you are on your way to Nuwara Eliya, you could stop, take a comfort break and a selfie and carry on with your journey in 10 minutes, tops. The best way to enjoy the falls is to stay at the Ramboda Falls Hotel and savour the entire view with waterfall, the faraway lake, the tea gardens and the sound of the waterfalls. It would be a tad disappointing if you trekked from coastal Sri Lanka (where most tourists land up) to Ramboda to see this fall.

Title: Wao....stunning
Text: What  a beauty.....after really long got a sight of so amazing falls.the photographs came out to be marvelous

Title: RAMBODA FALLS
Text:
Gliding swiftly down mountain slopes, thick forests and valleys of Tea Estates, small convergent brooks in the central highlands gives birth to some of Sri Lankas most magnificent waterfalls, one of which is the Ramboda Waterfalls in Nuwara Eliya. Cascading down at an altitude of 3200ft. the Ramboda Falls brings pride and glory to this beautiful island making Sri Lanka a popular tourist destination for both the romantic escapee & nature lover.

After all this you can have lovely lunch buffet @ Ranboda Falls Hotel at just SLR 1,300 / Head.

Title: Worth it if you never saw a waterfall
Text:
If you have never seen a waterfall then it's a good place to start.

My wife and I were staying in a nearby hotel so we had the time to quickly pass by to see it.

The whole thing took us 20 mins only.

The location is good for a photo shoot. I uploaded 2 examples.

If it's far away from you then it's okay to skip it.

Title: Beautiful
Text: We had such a nice time at Ramboda Falls. The walk to the top is lovely and you can stop at different parts to see water pools, large rock and the falls. I could have spent all day at the top, it was so peaceful and beautiful. Swimming in the water was so refreshing (once youve braved the cold!)

Title: One of the best experience in Srí Lanka
Text:
Ramboda Falls was one of our best experience in Srí Lanka.

We went from the main road, so the climbing to the main fall was quite demanding - 30 minutes through bamboo jungle on steep stairs. We wanted to give it up, but fortunately asked some people coming from the falls if it worth the effort. And it absolutely did!!

The fall was huge, not crowded at all, with a nice lagoon where you can take a refreshing bath. Just amazing!

Title: Beautiful Falls!
Text: We didn't make it to the upper falls, but our driver took us through the hotel and to the lower falls, which were quite spectacular.  Very high with lots of water, you get up close and personal to these falls.  Just stand there and feel the wind and mist hit you in the face on a hot day.  Quite lovely!

Title: Nice place to make a stop
Text: Nice place to make a stop but from the streetside you don't have a complete overview. If you go out from the restaurant of the Ramboda Falls hotel you can make a little walk to a nice viewpoint.

Title: Great spot to expore
Text: Our visit to ramboda falls was a little different to most. We caught the bus from nuwara-eliya and then got dropped off at the blue fields tea factory, our bus driver told us this was the best way to the falls. There is a road behind the tea factory that meanders through the tea fields to eventually reach the top of the falls. The walk is about 10km return and is uphill all the way to the falls and features some of the best views I have seen in Sri Lanka.

Title: AMAZING waterfall.
Text: You had to pay a small amount to enter but it was worth it. After a short walk (about 10-15 minutes) you see the big waterfall which in fact is multiple waterfalls from different sides. The view takes your breath away. You could also take a swim there if you like.

Title: Rainbow spray
Text: This is very scenic during raining season. However it never dries off. If you walk up along the walking path uphill, the proper fall can be seen. Path could be slippery. Take care. Bathing is not advisable. Good for photos.

Title: Beautiful stunning view- recommend a visit !
Text: We loved our one night in this lovely place. We walked down to the waterfall to admire the stunning views over the tea plantations.  Staff were very friendly.  The room was very comfy with extras like an iron and hairdryer. Our room was on the edge beside the waterfall so we fell asleep and woke to the noise of the waterfall and it was powerful. Dinner and breakfast were very good. Strongly recommend a visit to this lovely place to enjoy nature at its best.

Title: Nice place..
Text:
Easily approachable and you can go very close.
Nice waterfall. Location is beautiful especially at the sunrise time.
Few rooms have a view of the waterfall which gives complete peace of mind.

Title: Breathtaking falls... among the best!
Text: Was interesting to walk through the Ramboda Inn to see the waterfalls. They provide shuttle service and use of escalator to get near the falls. Breathtaking indeed!

Title: Nice but tiring
Text: Nice water fall where you can dip in the water. There is an entrance fee which is not much. You can climb up the mountain and go to the top from where you can see the almost start of the fall. Going up they have built steps which are steep at places and it's a long climb. If you are not fit don't go up. The place is nice at the bottom and at the top, there is nothing much to see while climbing.

Title: Photo opportunity
Text: A place to take a rest break from driving and to take a few minutes to take photographs of the twin falls

Title: Worth spending some time here
Text: We walked down to the base of these falls for the best views. Worth spending some time here and taking some photos,

Title: Great spot for a dip
Text: Walk right up to the viewing platform first to get a good photo of the falls, then back down to the base of the main falls. Put on swimmies, then go for a dook. Chilly at first, but warms up. Deepest on the left, and can swim about a bit. Before heading back, go immediately down river from the main falls (it's a bit slippy in places) for an amazing view. If you scramble down a bit there's another pool there. Head down the path and about half way down there's another great pool for a dip. The whole thing is sublime.

Title: Perfect Final Stop!
Text:
After touring most of Kandy and Nuwara Eliya, this was our last stop. We stopped around noon and the view was pretty cool. I stayed back in our bus with he baby but other members of my family climbed all way to the top and had a dip in the waterfall which they explained as 'refreshingly cool'.

There were plenty of lil shops nearby where we can purchase food items and other basic necessities. a restaurant was also close by. 

would recommend a stop if you are visiting. :)

Title: Great Waterfall With A Nice Hike
Text:
On the way approximately one hour from Nuwara'eliya is this waterfall; not much is visible from the road side and requires a 15-20 mins hike along a few uneven steps - the hike up to the "hut" at the top adds much colour to the overall adventure.

The cost is LKR 120 (USD 1.00) per person, self guided visit at your own pace. There are two options once you reach the top section of the hike - continue ascending and reach the 'hut' at the top (good for photography especially around 5.30 - 6.00pm during the sun set) or take the path down to the pool at the bottom of the fall. Found both experiences very pleasant.

On the way, there are numerous foot paths one can take to different pools of the waterfall and have a dip, which number of locals were doing - it all adds up to make the adventure great!!

(Might be challenging for very young kids to hike).

Text:

Title: Beauty in the High Country
Text: Ramboda Falls is a beautiful waterfall along the highway in the High Country of Sri Lanka. Wonderful place to take pictures and enjoy the cooler climate.

Title: Huge waterfall  worth a visit

If you  are staying at Hotel Ramboda Falls, then all the more good since there is a nice pathway from the hotel restaurant to visit the waterfall and take pictures. Text: Ramboda Falls is worthy of stopping and having a coffee in the hotel which bears its name. Stop in the little car-park at the top and await the shuttle down the almost vertical hill to the hotel.

Title: Quick stop en route to Nuwara Eliya
Text:
We stopped to take in Ramboda Falls whilst travelling from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya. 

A great vantage point from the Ramboda Falls Hotel where you can get a quick refreshment / comfort break. 

The falls were not at their most spectacular given the dry season however well worth the stop to see Sri Lanka's highest falls.

Title: Good views, Hotel Needs Improvement
Text:
On our way to Nuwara Eliya from Colombo, we stopped at Ramboda Falls Hotel for lunch. This hotel is ideally situated to get the best views of the Ramboda Water Fall. Our driver stopped the car on the main road. Many people find it difficult to walk down the steep winding alley to reach the hotel entrance which is far below the road level. The hotel is not even 50 metres from the road, but has a shuttle service to take people to the hotel and back. 
When we arrived at the hotel, the placed was packed with people. Several tour groups have arrived in buses and they were enjoying the buffet lunch. The hotel staff basically force you to have buffet lunch saying ordering food from the menu can take a long time. We reluctantly took the option of going for the Buffet lunch and found the food to be very ordinary. There were too many people and the food was not being replenished fast enough. We found some of the visitors scraping the bottom of the containers unable to find enough food in them. We found an empty table in a far corner and kept our camera and the handbag on the table to show the table is occupied. We asked for a ginger beer. They have run out of ginger beer and we had to manage with only a bottle of water. We served our food and brought the plate back to the table to find another person sitting at our table in spite of our handbag and the camera. We were not sure how to handle it and luckily for us, the waiter came and asked the person to move to another table. He was a single person on his own. We heard the person arguing with the waiter saying he was occupying the table before we came and they cleared it before he finished eating. Anyway, he has finished eating his desert and left the table without a fuss. I was feeling a bit awkward, but these things can easily happen when the restaurants are over crowded. My advice is that all the people should not leave the table at the same time. You leave at least one person at the table when you go to serve your food. 
I took a few photos of the water fall from the back yard of the hotel. A few years ago, it was possible to walk right up to the water fall. Now they have put a fence preventing the people getting too close to the water fall. We left the place a bit shaken, but this is one place you should visit when you are on your way to Nuwara Eliya. I am not happy with the quality of the food and my advice is to avoid staying overnight unless you are a keen nature lover and like to explore the area. If possible, avoid the big crowd by not going there during the lunch time. A soft drink or a beer with a side plate like chips or sandwiches is better than their lunch. In any case, you cannot avoid paying extra money for the food, just to have a good look at the water fall and the beautiful scenery around the area.

Title: Well Worth a Trip
Text: The waterfall is beautiful but maybe even more stunning is the valley that it is set within. The scenery in the entire area is unbelievable and there are tea pickers working on the slopes of the hills close to the waterfall adding to the overall charm of the place. The steps down to the waterfall are quite steep and narrow but it is safe and at a leisurely pace it wouldn't be too much for an older person. A lovely day out and a view to be remembered

Title: Worth visiting ....
Text:
We visited this place while we were going nuwara eliya from kandy.. We walked a long way to reach the view point. It was lovely and very refreshing and noisy as the water fall was quite big and it's sound was amazing ..

I'm very fond of water falls .. This one was very very impressive and beautiful with lush green surrounding .
Love it

Title: Worth a quick stop over
Text: You can access Ramboda Falls by dropping into Ramboda Falls Hotel. It's a quick 5 minute walk on a trail to the platform where you can get a great view of the falls. Not sure if it's worth going out of your way to see the waterfall but if you are passing by on the way to Nuwara Eliya, by all means go take a look and take some photos!

Title: Exciting for nature lovers and free of charge!
Text: We had lunch at Ramboda Falls Hotel and went to the waterfall after that. It was a great experience, free of charge and we saw a lot of flowers on our way to the viewing platform.

Title: Impressive and photogenic falls and tea pluckers
Text: These are well worth the trip down the hill and back up again! Oddly accessed through the reception and via the lift of a hotel, the falls are photogenic, as are the views down the valley, and we were lucky enough to see some tea pluckers at work nearby and from close-range. Recommended.

Title: Beautiful surroundings
Text: Beautiful view of waterfalls from the restaurant side and you can feel the nice ambient air and surroundings. One can spend some quality time to enjoy the nature at its best. Must visit place for tourists.

Title: Worth a halt
Text: Worth visiting, This will come on the way to Nuwara Eliya and  along this road you will also come across many smaller waterfalls. No point in staying the night at Ramboda, just see the water and drive on.

Text: short walk down to the falls, you can meet tea picker ladies, they wave at you and smile. walk is not difficult at all, but because of weather,rocks and steps might be wet,covered with moist so skip flip flops. once you get close to the fall you are amazed with its sound and energy. i guess amounts of water rolling down  it depend on the time of the year when u visit, we were lucky the falls were truly massive
