Title: Beautiful waterfall
Text: Such a beautifull work of art from the nature, very near to a dam. The weather was good, really cool with the fresh air. Next to big forest.

Title: Amazing
Text: We didn't go through the hotel. Our driver took us to another place to see the falls. You walked up a windy road and some steep stairs and through Sri Lankas amazing nature. This was truley a highlight of our trip

Title: Beautiful Falls
Text:
Ramboda falls is a beautiful falls located en route to Nuwara eliya from Kandy. A small walk from the Ramboda Falls hotel, you get to see this beautiful waterfall.

Heavy rains during our visit made the falls a picture perfect experience.  Don't forget to sip a tea at the hotel and enjoy the view of the falls and the nature at its best

Title: Refreshing! With panoramic nature views...
Text: A short yet refreshing photo-op stop-over before you head to the tea farms and factories. The best way to access it is from the Ramboda Falls Hotel. No fees required. Walk to the viewing deck, sit, relax, listen to its rumbling sound, take pleasure in the beauty of nature surrounding it and take lots of photos.

Title: super falls
Text: good falls to have a dip. also looks to  be a safe falls. my husband took a dip and me and my daughter just wetted our legs. water was so cold, nice.....

Title: Spectacular
Text: Huge amount of water gushing down the water worn gorge.   It is possible to walk down to it from the Ramboda Falls Hotel.  There are a number of falls in the vicinity but this one has the easiest access.

Title: Don't miss
Text: Visited while driving from Nuwara Eliya to Colombo. There is some distance to walk down from the car park. There was not a lot of water, but still the view of waterfall from the bottom is quite good..

Title: A great experience under the rain
Text: A little disclaimer: we were there under a heavy rain that added a big deal to the experience. The experience started with a shuttle drive to the hotel. It's a short drive down an extremely steep and winding road, with an extra bonus of the front window being completely foggy due to the rain and the temperature difference. From the hotel, there is a set of gentle stairs which presumably provide a very easy stroll down to the waterfall in a good weather, but become a waterfall of their own under a heavy rain. Ramboda waterfall itself is quite big, though not particularly picturesque. Climbing up the stairs was even more challenging with so much water flowing down that at some moments it was quite a challenge to move against the stream. A nice little "adventure" in a heavy rain, and should be just a nice walk and several fine minutes in front of the waterfall in a good weather.

Title: A pleasant lunch-time stop
Text: As we had to stop for lunch and were near this waterfall, our driver suggested this stop. To get close to the waterfall, we could only access it via the Ramboda Falls Hotel. It was a pleasant and very easy walk (about 100ms). There's no entry fee but suspect that buying lunch at the hotel is the payback (no issues with this). I don't recommend this as a 'must-see'   but it wasn't an unpleasant lunch-stop.

Title: Worth the walk
Text: From far it is the usual waterfall... But if you do take the walk till the bottom of the waterfall, you will feel the power of this waterfall and you will enjoy the trip... Do stop and visit...

Title: Great Place with Excellent Views to Relax and Relieve Lifes Stress - Sarath & Ramani Opatha - Brisbane, Australia
Text:
We visited Thuruliya Lodge for the second time in January 2015. The upper two floors of the Lodge had been completed with a very spacious and clean Restaurant at the top level with most beautiful views of the Ramboda Valley and the Water Falls(see the photos I have added to the website). When travelling to Nuwara Eliya, this is a very good place to stop and have a cup of coffee or tea or have the lunch while enjoying the beauty of the Ramboda Valley and the Water Falls. Recommend to get the table onto the balcony of the restaurant to enjoy the views.

Newly constructed room No. 304 has the best views of the water falls and the valley. To get the best out of this beautiful place we stayed in the Lodge whole time relaxing and enjoying the unbelievably beautiful views including the Mountains & Valley, Waterfalls, Kotmale Reservoir and the magnificent Sunset. Our room was very clean, spacious and the staff was very friendly and helpful. Unquestionably Thuruliya Lodge was one of the most beautiful places we have ever stayed. Sad to leave the place but sure we will visit again.

Title: great falls
Text:
there are 2 falls in the village the lower falls an easy walk from the Ramboda fall hotel.
The higher fall a good 30 minutes walk from the bridge in the village.
Both well worth the time.

Title: Worth a short stopover
Text:
We were very lucky to see the fall after a days worth of rain; seeing the full splendor of the fall in its flowing best. 

The climb up after seeing the fall is a bit of a walk though, perfect for morning exercise.

Title: Peaceful, amazing place for nature lovers
Text: Pure and simple beauty. Very nice surroundings. Worth to stay around for 1-2 days. There are some restaurants with View and I highly recommend to slow down here and take your time to digest these natural beauty. I would visit again.

Title: Beautiful but busy
Text: Literally on a road, constantly being harassed by people trying to sell tat or asking for foreign coins. Difficult to relax and enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

Title: A place to fall in love with
Text: Its a fantastic place. Just next to the Kandy-Nuwara Eliya road. In between the mountains. The view from the falls is amazing.

Title: Perfect bath 15-20' up stairs from road
Text: From the road from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya when the road cross Ramboda Oya (google maps). Park there and on the left side there are stairs up hill. Follow for 15-20' and will arrive a cross path, on the left you up for 5' more to basic building to get full view, on the right down less than a minute and arrive. You can cross the water and reach the waterfall. Highly recomendend. Today, july 6 no people there, we were alone. Water perfect temperature, and easy to get a relaxing bath.

Title: Lovely &  Refreshing waterfall
Text:
On our way to Nuwara Elilya on 20/6, my tour guide brought my family to Ramboda Falls . 

The waterfall is simply beautiful and the scenery in the surrounding area is breathtaking with lush greenery and tea plantations. It offers magnificent views and is so refreshing to spend time watching the full stream of falling water from mountain top. We were so glad that we visited this place enroute to Nuwara Eliya .

Access to the waterfalls can be made via the Ramboda Falls Hotel. Strongly recommend this place to all who are around Nuwara Eliya as it is worth the visit to enjoy the scenic view

Title: Magnificant Falls
Text: We passed the falls on our way from Kandy to Nuwara Ellya. It had been raining so the falls were full and at first coloured with the red soil. Over the day they changed to white. The sound if them was like hearing the waves crashing on the beach. Surreal.

Title: Amazing!!!
Text: Must visit. Nice to get close and get photos. The sound of water turns you awesome. Need to move up with another hotel's way out which is little bit clumsy.

Title: Lovely Waterfall with Rainbow
Text: Visiting this Ramboda Falls recommend by our driver which is Sri Lankan. We came to this place via Ramboda Falls Hotel. There is easy walkway to the waterfall. We can see the rainbow down there from the water splash. Visitor is not allowed to swim down there but as per our driver, we can go hike around 25 mins to reach the top of the waterfall and take a dip. But rainy days might have leeches so be careful. We enjoy the view of the waterfall and took some pictures. There is cafetaria that you can have a break while enjoying the waterfall.

Title: Wonderful place
Text: You should visit this place, it is breathtaking and beautiful, you will have great photos from here and unforgettable emotions.

Title: A country rich with water
Text: On the way from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya we stopped on the highway to watch the Ramboda water fall. It is a nice scene but nothing extraordinary.Actually we didn't go directly to the water fall it is far and doesn't worth, from that terrace where we stopped is more than enough to take a rest and do some pictures.

Title: Nice waterfall
Text:
So we visited second time to Ella. Really incredible place. We can see nice waterfall and monkeys. It is forbidden to swim now because a German woman fell hard yesterday and broke her head ??
I recommend.

Title: It has always been beautiful
Text: May be it is my twelfth visit! Several stepped Ravana falls has always been the main attraction to visitors to Ella. Columns of clear water with bubbles and froth mixed in it  like a thick lace curtain makes it a picture to stare at. It was interesting to see the surrounding rock faces through a telephoto lens or binoculars where I could spot rock shelters or semi caves in the upper region of the hill. I wonder whether ancient humans lived in them during the stone ages.

Title: Monkeying around: exploring the breathtaking views and playful primates of Ravana
Text:
Ravana Falls, located just 10 minutes away from Ella by bus, is a must-visit destination for anyone exploring the region. One of the main attractions of the falls is the stunning views it offers, with water cascading down from a height of over 80 feet. The lush greenery surrounding the falls adds to its natural beauty, making it a picture-perfect spot for photography enthusiasts.

Visitors can also enjoy the playful monkeys that can be spotted around the waterfall. These furry creatures are often seen jumping from tree to tree and adding to the fun atmosphere around the falls.

Apart from the scenic views and playful monkeys, visitors can also take a refreshing swim in the cool waters of the pool at the base of the falls. The water is crystal clear, and the pool offers a great spot to cool off after a day of exploring the area.

In summary, Ravana Falls in Ella is a picturesque destination that offers breathtaking views, playful monkeys, and the opportunity to take a refreshing swim in the pool at the base of the falls. It's a great spot for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike, and it's definitely worth a visit when exploring the region.

Title: Must visit!
Text: If you are in Ella, you must visit the Ravana waterfalls. go and take few pictures for your IG feed :p if you are into collecting rocks and stones, you will find a few small vendors there.

Title: Stunning falls
Text: My first visit to Ravana Falls, why did I not go there earlier?! The falls are by the road and easily accessed and unfortunately in my own mind rival my favourite  Sri Lankan Waterfall, the Diyaluma Falls. The Rhesus monkeys are overly friendly and while we were there snatched a cob of corn from the hands of a lady eating it. Her screeches had to heard to be believed. A warning DO NOT HAVE FOOD IN YOUR HANDS the monkeys can be over friendly.

Title: Amazing waterfall
Text: Amazing waterfall. If you like you can bathing thare. But raining season careful bath sosometimes quickly high water. Super place

Title: Pretty waterfall
Text: Pretty enough but not the most impressive waterfall Ive seen in my life. You go there and take pictures then leave really. Its a brief stop but if its on your way to somewhere worth stopping by.

Title: Worth visiting if passing
Text:
The waterfall isnt unimpressive and youll get a nice shot or two, however wouldnt recommend going out of your way to go there, but instead try to accommodate it as a stop off on your way to somewhere else. Its not suitable for bathing as is dangerous. 

If you do decide to go, from Ella we got a local bus which took 20mins and cost 50lkr per person vs a tuk tuk for c.1500-2000lkr.

Title: A very nice waterfall immediately by the roadside
Text: A lovely tall waterfall, not a single drop fall but a cascade over several levels making for a very picturesque scene. Immediately by the side of the road with no entry necessary so no cost.

Title: Beauty
Text: Near the main road , no one misses around in taking photos. Beautiful , elegant and everything on it. Love the place and always

Title: A must see!
Text: Stunning to see. Unfortuantely I din't get to view it from the top, which I've been told is amazing, due to visiting late and it was getting dark.

Title: Refreshing view
Text: This is such a serene place in Ella. In the surrounding, there are small stalls where people are selling souvenirs and food. Its worth a stop, while travelling uphill.

Title: Admire the water cascading over the rocks
Text:
These are good falls surrounded by picturesque views of the hills. The perfect place to cool off. I'm not completely sure but if you enjoy swimming, taking a dip was also possible. But do be careful, because rocks tend to be very slippery. 

It is on the Beragala-Hali Ella Highway.

Title: The only waterfall accessible without a hike
Text: Did you know that the name "Ravana Falls" was derived from an old legend? It is said that King Ravana had kidnapped Princess Sita and hidden her in the caves behind this waterfall. Ravana Falls still ranks as one of the widest falls in the country and the cave behind is yet in tact.
