Text: A favourite place. Calm and beautiful. We visit here and pay our respects every time we come to Kandy. A visit here to the main Temple, the Devalayas, the Bo trees and the museums is highly recommended. Namo Buddhaya.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Visiting the Temple of the Tooth Relic was a very nice experience
Text:
Kandy is a beautiful city , I visited on a Saturday in January and the weather was warm but cloudy with a couple of downpours of rain . Didnt manage to get much time to go to the shops but spent time at the Temple which was very well organised and although there was a long queue the security guy insisted tourists went to the front of the queue which was a bit embarrassing I would have happily waited my turn ! 
Inside the temple was very busy but everyone was friendly and the atmosphere was nice . 
The queue to see the relic was well organised and went down quickly.
 
Altogether a very nice experience .

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Very interesting!
Text: We went to the Temple during the ceremony, it was incredibly interesting to see this tradtion and to learn more about Buddhism. Would definitely recommend a guide as ours was not only very knowledgable and explained a lot but he also managed to push us through to a good spot to view the golden casket - it can get very crowded during this time.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful temple with amazing history and view
Text: We visited the temple around 5pm. It was really pretty with the sunset. We met a guide there, Dinesh. He walked with us around and in the temple and told us the history and the important meanings. He was a really nice man and he is really good in English! He had the nicest voice to listen to and it didnt took too long. He also gives you moments to walk around alone, or takes pictures for you. So if you are there, go with Dinesh! (+947710044)

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Buddha's tooth
Text: Once you in Kandy I would recommend to visit this temple and take guide that he/she can explain you meaning, purpose of Buddhist philosophy and history. We did and it was great experience as for us as well for kids. Ticket cost 1000srk whta is about 3$ per person and guide around 11$ for an hour.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Not very good
Text: It was overpriced and over rated. Avoid the guides just say no. Busy, It was a lot of Buddas . Felt that the place just wanted money.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Was ok
Text:
I understand it means a lot to Buddhists but as a tourist it was a bit underwhelming. 
It costs 4000 r to get in for two and also you are expected to donate more money to just get your shoes back. 

The museum part was more interesting as they have a lot of old artifices and very old jewellery.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: So much to see here, time it right to see the ceremony
Text:
This is quite a magnificent shrine to Buddha, lots of colourful paintings, we were lucky enough to to see the monks enter the Shrine to the tooth through two massive metal doors.

We went in the evening, be shore to cover shoulders (ladys) and cover knees (men) I had to rent a sarong to be able to enter.

Be a sure to visit the massive elephant, one of if not the largest taxidermy animals Ive ever seen, a lot of history surroundS this magnificent beast.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Need to go for the display...
Text: Unfortunately our timing was not right to see the display and the temple itself is a bit underwhelming - there is no reduction in cost if you do not see the display (which we were told was spectacular) - you have to leave shoes outside and then lots of walking around in bare feet - unfortunately it absolutely poured down when we were there so cut short our visit

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Temple and Museum
Text: When in Kandy one of the must-do visits. Interesting museum on Buddhism and holy temple with the sacred tooth.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Dont miss this site, beautiful setting and interesting
Text:
Interesting highlight in Kandy, but a guide is required to understand the full history of the site and story.
Great insight into the faith

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must visit place
Text: definitely worth visiting while in Kendy. Try to be there during the ritual to experience the tradition and faith the best.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful temple- Take a guide for the best experience & timing matters a lot!
Text:
Planning the visit is extremely important- given the ceremonies & limited window when doors are opened. We hired a guide & got there around 5.45pm- just in time for us to enter the central premises & visit other shrines. Guide helped us navigate & explained the different parts of the temple in details. 

Some tips for fellow travellers- 
1. The tooth relic is not for public viewing everyday- only taken our during ceremony. Instead we get to see the golden caskets holding the relic from 6.45pm in the evening. So get there on the right time! 
2. Several shrines are present inside temple premises, like Crystal budhha, Hari Krishna, original manuscripts, museum & royal elephant memorial. Taking a guide is best to navigate & not miss out key sights. 
3. Golden Canopy above the relic is not to be missed- stunning sight in the evening light! 
4. Moonstone entrances, beautiful paintings & carvings- despite the rush, take sometime to admire the place.
5. There are some ground rules for taking photographs- No selfies, no photos showing back to the Buddha statues, etc. So be mindful of them, while enjoying the temple. 

Entry fee for SAARC members is 1500 SLR per person. Ticket counter is next to the temple on side of the lake. Would suggest so spend atleast 1.5hrs to cover the entire temple.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Get In Touch With Your Spiritual Side.
Text: One can visit in evening to view pooja ceremony. Different section hold scriptures and gautam Buddha idol. Tooth is placed in a secret  area so not publicly displayed.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting place
Text: Very interesting place but you have to be carful with people who want to give you a tour or just do it without asking and then want you to pay a fortune in the end. Not the prettiest temple

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: The most religious place in Kandy
Text: For Buddhist and non Buddhists alike , an important venerable place. Definitely worth visiting in Kandy. Shouldnt miss it. Try going there during the rituals to fully understand the religiosity and faith of the people.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Please Visit at least once in your life
Text:
Visit in afternoon around 5pm,i was walking from my hotel to temple.
So relaxing and great for meditation and to see history of Last king of Kandy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: The Holiest Place in Sri Lanka
Text:
Had the most amazing experience in Kandy at this most sacred site.  Be sure to use one of the onsite professional guides to show you around and explain everything...guide may be a bit pricey ($20-$25 tip) but you cant learn about the temple without this vakuable resource.
Out guide took us right up to the front of the line to peer into the vault containing the Tooth Relic.  I was told that this was unheard of and that we were so unbelievably fortune to be on front and to have seen the opening of the religious vault.
 The territory is absolutely amazing.
Be prepared to show your Passport upon entry through the security check ooint iutside the temple area.  It is mandatory!

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Mesmerizing : Must See Attraction
Text:
Visited on 18 February 2020 at 10.30am

Dress decently. Very important is to wear cloths which cover the body and legs. No shorts or sleeveless tops allowed. For hot days carry cap/scarves. Please note.

On Kandy sightseeing, this was the first stopover of the day. The entry tickets were arranged as part of the package which included a CD and souvenir. The location of this temple is beside a lake and approach road has many colonial buildings.

The temple complex has many attraction within. Museum, floors, different portions dedicated to rituals and related things.

Photos are allowed but not selfies. Respect the rules.
This attraction will have long walks so suggest take a guide along and senior citizens must take rest breaks.

There is a souvenir shop inside the Museum complex selling authentic Sri Lankan craft at appropriate prices. Authenticity is guaranteed.  Do use this opportunity to take few products back to your country. I bought Elephants (SLR 350), key rings (SLR 80) and fridge magnets  (SLR 200).

Beautiful flower shops will amaze you when you exit the temple.

You will feel a calmness and happy after visiting this place.

Go and enjoy .

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must while in Kandy
Text: Very interesting place to visit. Thoroughly enjoyed an afternoon there . Helped having a guide to tell you all the facts. Lots of security evident due to previous terror attacks

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Join the crowds to experience something remarkable
Text:
We joined the queues during morning prayer. There are two queues to get in: one for the men and one for the women. Like most things in life, the men's line moved faster. This is mainly due to two things: 1) most women carry bags that need searching (most men don't) 2) the women perhaps face a little more scrutiny over what they can wear and must cover-up. Shoulders and legs need to be covered, so make sure you have a light scarf and sarong. Men too should carry a sarong to put on although some western males it seemed were managing to get through in shorts.

Once inside make sure you follow the tourist crowds to the right and enter the temple through the tourist entry. Here you leave your shoes, you will be expected to tip after collection. 

Inside, at prayer, this place is busy. At times you are moved along with the crowd. The locals are of course queuing to leave gifts and to pray so don't feel too bad if you 'skip' queues and glide past those locals waiting on the stairs.

The relic itself can't be seen. Instead, you can peer into the golden shrine where it is stored, but at this point in the temple, the crowds are at their busiest so you main only manage a cursory glance.

The best part about the temple is exploring the grounds and additional rooms and buildings. The carvings and sculptures of Budha are beautiful, and in most spaces, you can take photos. Just be mindful of people worshipping and not to take pictures with your back to any Budha statue.

The grounds of the temple are beautiful, and there is an elephant on the site too, which is used in ceremonies. Although, it is clearly an old elephant and seeing it so heavily chained doesn't make for the best view.

At night time, around the temple and Lake, there is a cacophony of noise as bats and birds come to roost in their hundreds. It is the most spectacular site in Kandy and a must-see.

The museum of World Buddhism, which is on the site is also worth a visit, and with a tourist ticket to the temple, you have access.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Worth the Frisking
Text: To enter this place involved some major security & some strange interpretations of covered & uncovered ?? The wife finally got in and we enjoyed the Temple. The actual relic is behind locked & closed doors and only brought out on special occasions. On the floor where the relic is housed the faithful sit down & pray , after leaving floral tributes. The whole thing is quiet & peaceful and the vibe is pleasant. The building & other statues are well worth a look.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Impressive
Text: Spectacular large temple site, very interesting if you have a guide to explain it all.  Ladies need to cover their shoulders and everyone must take shoes off - take socks with you as some of the pavements get very hot! Very interesting woodwork with amazing carvings, and fabulous paintings and decoration.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: can been busy but must visit
Text: it was vry busy when we visited, but nice place. I was expexted little more , it is basically a museum but if you are in the area then it is a must visit

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Peaceful, tranquil, beautiful
Text: Beautiful temple, very sacred, tranquil and calming atmosphere. Some parts closed due to coronovirus but so pleased we had the opportunity to visit.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: 1 of 4 Seniors in Sri Lanka
Text: Temple where a tooth of Buddah is kept inside 7 golden caskets. Very busy. Good museum explaining Buddhism around the world. Be careful need to take off shoes and the snd get v hot can wear socks.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Was very busy when the door to the tooth is opened
Text: Our guide a buddhist explained the significance of our arrival at the Temple of the Tooth but he didn't forewarn us of the desperate measures some locals will go to to see the casket holding the tooth which was amazing. Be prepared for a crushing and don't go if crowds are not your thing

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Excellent temple complex
Text: This is an excellent temple complex that is locate on the lake side. It will take you half a day to visit the whole site so plan accordingly. A point to bear in mind is the fact that the tooth relic will be on view at certain times of the day so make sure that you time your visit with this. The initial ceremony is on the ground floor but the exposition is on the first floor so don't miss that. It will be busy!

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Fascinating
Text:
Always wanted to visit here as a highly regarded religious site. Had to wear a sarong as we tuned up in shorts. Immediately when we went in a male latched on to us to give us a guided tour. Although he gave much detail he was a bit irritating and hard to shake off. To be fair he showed us everything we wanted to see eg the temple of the tooth and other things in other temples including a stuffed elephant we wouldn't have known about. Temple was being cleaned when we visited so you ended up with very wet feet. 
I asked why flowers were such a big thing and was told that the Buddha didn't want material things like money or gold so flowers were preferred. I was slightly bemused when on leaving the temple he asked for money. When I offered money I was told it wasn't enough. We eventually settled on 1000 rupees. The person holding the shoes also wanted money so the lack of materialism inside didn't stretch to the staff.
Glad I went and would recommend if you have an interest in this sort of thing.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Must see in Kandy
Text: We were there in the time of ceremony and it was full of people praying and enjoying the ceremony. The temple and his garden is someting really beautiful. You can really connect with all this people and clear out your mind.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: The most sort after place in Kandy
Text: The temple of Sacred Tooth relic is one of the most sort after place in Kandy. The best part is all the five temples inside the campus are open in the evening hours only for 15 minutes which is worth to see. Although the place was severely damaged in  a terrorist attack but the management could able to retrieve the lost glory.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Underwhelmed
Text: We had to walk all the way around until we found an entrance that would let us in. Although the temple is undoubtedly beautiful, we didn t see the tooth. Also we had to take our shoes off which we have no problem with but weren't warned of the heat of the outdoor floor tiles that we had to walk on and scorched our feet.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting Cultural Site
Text: This is another UNESCO World Heritage Site with interesting history and background. The site is located in city centre of Kandy right in front of Kandy Lake. Tooth Relic is believed to be sacred for Buddhism and the royal family was responsible for the safekeeping of the tooth relic. It is believed to be brought from Anuradhapura to Kandy Kingdom. Two storeys building was constructed for safekeeping the tooth relic. But the building was destroyed several times. Each time it was restored whenever it was destroyed. There will be ceremony everyday for the blessings by the devotees. We visited around late afternoon and waited for the ceremony around 6pm plus. Interesting cultural sights, but be prepared for uncontrollable crowds and haphazard situation during the ceremony. The tooth relic is said to be kept within a gold plated ornament, hence it cannot be seen by anyone even during the ceremony. The international Buddhism Museum within the compound is worth to check out too for the interesting architecture and interior design. Overall, it is still worth the entrance fee of LKR1,500 per person and appropriate attire is required and tight security check at the entrance.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must in Kandy
Text: very clean surrounding. Enjoy lakeside walk. The inside of the temple is nice. You cants enter in 3/4 shorts & must have long trousers for entering inside. You can get the cloth to wound around on hire for LKR 200. there sre couple of museums in the vicinity. tickets for SARC countries has discounts

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Its ok
Text: As for every temple you have to dress properly. Came here on one of the holy days, think the price to get in is a little overpriced. The temple looks nice on the outside and inside

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Good
Text:
First thing to do is to cover your body fully as shorts or sleeveless shirts are not allowed.
It is a worship place of God budha's tooth relic.
 It has timings of darshan.
So plan well before going there.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Wow
Text: Amazing place to visit.  Security high but understandable.  I was able to get a (paid) guide inside who explained everything to me.  Huge amount of people visiting but it is amazing.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Very beautifully maintained Temple
Text: It is really a very beautiful temple. Maintained very well. For tourists they charge 1000 Srilankan Rupees per person but I think it's worth to pay the money.  The main Sactom Sactoram will be closed most of the time and will open some 3 times a  day for just 15 minutes.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beware if you have sensitive feet
Text: When you arrive you are sent to foreign visitors section. It is 3000 rupees each and you have to pay cash with correct money as machine doesnt give change and they are very loathed to give you change. You then have to leave your shoes at the gate and walk barefoot throughout the whole of the temple, museum and grounds, on hot concrete, so i would suggest bringing some old socks to wear. Was a nice walk round and museum had lots of info on the creation of buddhism but not well signposted as to what everything is. They ask for a donation when you go back to get your shoes which i think is unnecessary after your entrance fee.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Tooth Relic
Text: I don't know, for people who are not much interested in  the religion and tooth, not worth visiting. but the city is nice though.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Must see attraction if you in Kandy
Text: Very busy but interesting place to see. Depends on how you view religion of course as to how meaningful you find it but purely as a good place to spend some time, worth visiting

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Don't miss
Text: Beautiful temple on one side of kandy lake. Absolutely shouldn't be missed if you are visiting kandy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Intresting  visit
Text: We did this with our guide who was most knowledgeable. I think that without  him we would not have known what we were looking at. Although  some information  was in English  we would not have seen do much or learnt  as much with out him. One tip wear socks as even in the early evening  the floors are very hot.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Part of official visit
Text: No rush... Had an excellent guide  who took us around the temple museum.... Palace surrounding Temple relic was informative....lots of history.... About Buddhism and Sri Lanka.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: a lot of culture and history
Text: We saw a lot of culture and history in this place, people must wear white and the locals come to the site are really religious. I love the museum. Make sure dress appropriately otherwise you'll need to get cover up from the entrance.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Well worth a visit
Text: The temple is one of the major Sri Lankan sites. Allow a reasonable time to visit and plan in advance what time of day you will be going. No shoes inside so a moisturising wipe is a great idea when you leave

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Not really worth it
Text:
We are a couple in early 30s with 9 and 10yr old daughters.
Firstly we hadn't dressed appropriately so had to rent sarongs to cover up. The guy was nice enough but still 400rs down.
It's a bit of a faff to get in, we went through one lot if security then you get your bag checked again before you go in. We had a tip off from the sarong guy that they take away your cigarettes and lighters so I hid them well in the bag.
You have to put your shoes in a shoe storage area. Other reviews are correct about them asking for a donation, I was aware of this and just played deaf when they asked me, I had to assist my child... Oh and don't think you can put your shoes in your bag - that's not allowed! 
The ticket machines don't give change so you do have to have the right amount on you. There was an attendant who said we didn't have to pay for the children which was good and we didn't have the right change but he helped a guy behind us which then gave us the right change. So that was kind.

First off you walk on boiling hot pavement in bear feet. Then I guess the rest is interesting if you like architecture and religious history. As atheists we were a little bemused by all of it. There's nothing to tell you where the tooth is. We assumed we were in the right place by the people praying on the floor... But there's no signs etc and we didn't have a guide.
There's a museum which was a little interesting.
The saddest part is the taxidermied elephant. Poor thing was captured and kept for a good 50years before he died. He's now stuffed in a glass cabinet. There's a photo timeline of his life since capture but it doesn't have any translation so we don't really know the story...

If you like this sort if thing and are in Kandy then maybe pay it a visit... But I definitely wouldn't drive to Kandy for a day trip just for that. In my husbands words "I wouldn't go again even if it was outside my front door".

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Worth a visit
Text: I found this to be quite a moving experience given the importance of the site to the believers. Worth visiting the adjacent museum too.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Must see if in Kandy.
Text: This is a very tranquil place, despite being busy. Lots to see, although not the actual tooth relic itself. We were part of an organised group visit so I don't know what the entrance price is.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting temple
Text: You need a guide to get something out of the temple . A long story about Buddhas travel to Srilanka and relics left behind. A sacred place for the inhabitants of Sri Lanka .

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: It's a just a temple
Text: Don't expect too much. Dont even get to see the chest with the tooth relic. Some of the drawings are quite interesting. Entrance fee is too high

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must visit in Kandy
Text: This pilgrimage holy place is visited and worshipped by million of believers all over the world. A magnificent temple were the Buddhas tooth is kept as Relic ,secretly transferred from India and brought to Kandy.Located in the royal palace complex of the former Kingdom of Kandy, which is a World heritage Site, mainly due to the temple.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Sacred experience
Text: A wonderful temple situated next to the water which is a must visit if you are in Kandy. The temple experience from buying tickets and entry is well controlled and efficient. Please note you must be conservatively dressed and gents must have shorts below the knee. The temple is visually beautiful and a great experience. The evening prayers time can be busy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Underwhelmed
Text: Maybe our guide wasnt very good here because I came out and felt largely underwhelmed by the visit. It also rained as we walked back to collect shoes. Busy location with little social distancing evident.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Amazing place to visit
Text: We were very lucky that our tour guides uncle had worked here for almost 50 years. He was able to quickly move us around, he knew the sacred tooth was about to be shown, as there is only a 5 minute window each day, and he got us quickly through the line. He also knew the ways to keep us away from the crowds and still see everything. This temple is not to be missed and one of my personal highlights of my trip to Sri Lanka.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: MUST GO
Text:
Really beautiful place, worth the price of the ticket and the time it will take to visit (quite a lot!).
The atmosphere is great, locals consider it a very sacred place. Go dressed appropriately and, if you want to join the locals, in white.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must see in Kandy
Text: We met our official guide inside the grounds and he walked us around the whole temple pointing out the best places for photos, even taking a few snaps of my wife and I for us. The temple is beautiful and a great education into the history of Kandy and the story of Buddha's tooth. It was the weekend when we went so was busy with locals leaving flowers at every Buddha statue and burning incense which added to experience. Beautiful temple and great guide.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: No social distancing, rude staff
Text:
As a non Buddhist this place is quite underwhelming. Despite Sri Lanka being strict on covid, there is zero social distancing in a very crowded building. People push and shove past you in the queue and you're absolutely surrounded by people, almost as if covid doesn't exist within the walls. If you're conscious of covid, I would stay away. You have to take your shoes off, which I appreciate, however your shoes are then held hostage by a rude man behind the desk until you pay the ransom/tip. 

A nice building to look at and the lake nearby is beautiful.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: OK temple
Text:
Visited the site today. The temple is nice but nothing that other temples don't have. 
The tusker museum is OK if you don't mind taxidermy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Symbolic place, but not the best tourist attraction.
Text: As a building its not the most inspiring. The old timber shrine is impressive, but there isnt a great deal else to see. If you are a Buddhist, then Im sure the place will mean a lot more to you.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful Temple
Text: This temple houses Buddha's tooth which is contained in 7 containers and behind a wall. Pilgrims from all over the world come to this Temple to pray and bring lilies. The artifacts, paintings, Buddhas in the temple are beautiful and wonderfully maintained. This is a must see site when in Kandy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Nice couple of hours
Text:
We visted the temple as part of a two day trip with Sainas and Lovely Jubbly Tours.
Temple itself is beautiful as are the grounds.
The let down for me was the guide.who did explain that he had been unwell. But, it was hard to understand what he was saying and the story of the temple.
The visit was better than average but not very good. Hence the 3 star rating

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Walk around the grounds better than the temple itself
Text: Nothing too special. From a historical point of view, worth a visit but have seen many more artistic and jawdropping temples. If on budget one can skip the bit more pricey entry fee and walk around the complex. The walk around the lake provided more then the temple itseld.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: OK experience
Text:
It was an OK experience. You don't see the relic, just half second (if you are lucky) to see where the relic is stored. 

Note: I am writing this review after completing 15 days holiday in Sri Lanka; therefore, I have considered all pro and cons.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Surprised how much we enjoyed
Text: We visited in the evening and were really surprised how much how much we enjoyed this visit. The photos you see really  dont do justice to the beauty of the temple. The atmosphere in the evening light is also wonderful.  We really enjoyed our visit around the different areas of the temple. I was conscious of how tourists can be intrusive in such a sacred place but I felt a warm welcome as people guided us around or patiently let us past. It really was a lovely evening visit. I am guessing there are less tourists than usual so perhaps that helped but this is definitely not to be missed.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Overly crowded
Text:
A temple is a place to relax your mind and worship but this temple has become overly crowded by worshippers most times. This place can be quite overwhelming to enter with all checkpoints and security. The organization of people taking in to the temple very poorly done.   
The history and the monument it self is magnificent.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful "
Text: A beautiful place with historical significance.  There is so much to see there.  Don't forget to check this out during your visit. My English is not very good I wrote using Google Translate.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Stunning temple
Text: We were lucky to visit just before the full moon, It was filled with worshippers. Cover your shoulders and knees.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Kings palace
Text: Last kingdom of Sri Lanka, and This is the Kings Palace. Have lot see. Anyone who comes to kandy surely will go there.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting to observe the local customs and the museum.
Text: Hard to review. It is a place of devotion and spirituality for the local buddhists and it has an interesting history, the tooth. They don't show the actual tooth to the public anymore, maybe once a decade according to the guidebook. If you go here don't expect to we wow'ed by the tooth. I enjoyed the Buddhism history museum (included in the ticket) and the light during dusk outside. I found it interesting just to observe the local absolute devotion to a relic, real or not, (no offence intended) and the ceremony going on where you can glimpse the inner shrine for a moment. It is also interesting to walk through the museum of the tooth relic and read the signs inside the new shrine. It will cost you 2000 rupees to go inside + some tip to the shoe guy. Remember to cover your knees and shoulders (both men and women). I would say that if you find the local traditions and religion interesting it is a place to visit, otherwise maybe not.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Nice temple but not the best experience in Sri Lanka
Text:
I was very excited going to this temple, but unfortunately it was a bit bad experience. 

The temple itself is amazing its true, if I have skipped this I would be sad. However there were some strange point: 
At the beginning few local guys came to us telling that my boyfriends trousers are too short we have to buy a blanket from them. The trousers end at his knees. We rejected as we wanted to see firstly how we can enter. Of course this was not true we were able to enter without the blanket too. (However these local guys followed us till the entrance). This is annoying. 

When we entered we felt that our visit is very limited. Every second moment there was an instruction like not going there, that part is closedecc. we were unable to see the garden :( 

The worst experience was at the end because they asked money for keeping our shoes (we had no problem of course taking off our shoes, I have problem about the paying). We have payed already 2000 rupias for the entrance ticket and there is no information about the extra fee.

The temple was nice and interesting however you cannot experience in full and fele good because of these small inconveniences.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Temple with secrets
Text: Was very disappointed as the tooth relic can't be shown. Well built temple with wonderful paintings and sculptures. Good museum providing history.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Positive Vibes
Text:
The Buddhist temple a Hindu temple and a church all in the vicinity 
The vibrations Recieved were very positive 
A truly pilgrimage site of the Buddha

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting Temple
Text: Temple inside and outside was very beautiful got some knowledge about the tooth relic and the importance of this temple, interesting place to visit if u're in kandy :)

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Average temple, cant see toothe
Text: Cant actually see the tooth, its behind curtains. It is a reasonably Tempe, a bit tacky and strong security. people asking for money at points which is a smidge annoying. Toilets very far away. No shoes on the entire place, floor quite mucky, would still recommend as a go, but with low expectations, and can just wiz round it

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Holy Buddhist temple
Text:
This temple is said to house one of Buddha's tooth; you cannot enter the complex that actually has the tooth. It (rather, its replica) is said to be taken out twice a year.

The temple depicts historical events, especially on Buddha's journey in Sri Lanka.

There is also a museum that has a lot of items, used going back centuries. 

PS: SAARC citizens, carry your passport for reduced entry ticket prices.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Constantly bugged for extra cash. Somewhat overhyped.
Text:
It was okay. We both felt we had seen better temples. The staff we quite rude and abrupt. We were hounded by people to be our guides as we approached the temple. To the point where we had to shout no and they wouldnt take no for an answer. As foreigners we had to pay 3000 which was a lot we felt. A so called guide even followed us into the check in gate and got annoyed when we politely said no thank you. More persistence. Then we were told without a guide we wouldnt understand. This is not true as just about everything is translated to English. There was a booth to leave our shoes at and when we returned we were hounded again for money for looking after our shoes. We already paid far more than we expected to get in so no thanks! A staff member followed us around when we were in a museum and made me show my ticket a number of times. It all felt like harassment. We are really not made of money, quite the opposite in fact. Something I thought was strange is even though you have to remove your shoes, all the staff didnt which made me ponder what was the point. How can it be rude for us to wear shoes and not them? The tooth display itself was okay but of course you could
Not see it so who is to say it was really there?

Hey we can appreciate the religious/cultural significance - we arent made of stone but we had heard Sri Lankan people were welcoming: They are when they want your cash!

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting Buddhist temple
Text:
The temple area is quite large; In the centre is a building, and within that building is another building! We went at 6:30 pm which is when they were having a service. This meant that we could have a look at the sacred tooth, albeit from quite far away. One aspect I especially enjoyed was the elephant exhibit showing an elephant that had carried round the sacred tooth for a number of years. 

They were quite strict at covering your knees and your shoulders (even a small slit in the dress wasnt allowed), so we would recommend taking an extra scarf just in case

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Sacred Buddhist Icon
Text: visited the temple of tooth and had the most cultural experience. The temple is more like a huge palace and it is very harmonic and peacfull. a very religious place and a must visit icon in the country.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Sacred place, well maintained, peaceful
Text:
This place brings sanctity to Kandy. It is called Dalada Maligawa in the local language. The temple is golden-roofed. Locals and tourists visit the temple for prayers with flowers and incense throughout the day. The temple keeps the tooth relic of the Buddha in its main shrine. The premises also houses several shrines, museums, and temples. Museums include the International Buddhist Museum, Dalada Museum, Raja Tusker Museum, and Royal Palace Archaeological Museum 

The temple is open for tourists from 5: 30 AM to 8:00 PM. Pujas happen at three different timings  5:30 AM to 6:45 AM, 9:30 AM to 11:45 AM, and 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM. It's advised to dress conservatively and wear outfits that cover your shoulders and legs.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Be careful what u wear
Text: Be careful what u r wearing! Dont wear shorts, short skirt, Top , if u do , you will lose the visiting of this beautiful temple.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Touristy and busy
Text: An over-rated attraction in my view.  Not recommended for people who do not like crowds.  Requires ticket.  High security to enter.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Busy place to visit
Text: Beautiful place but pretty busy. Important Holy Temple to visit especially if you are a Buddhist. Modest dressing a must.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Starting point of Kandy Trip
Text:
This was once a Royal Palace and now a Holy Temple. Ancient architecture , blissful environment, peaceful vibes and Buddha's blessings , this place has it all. 

Point to note: 

Entrance fee is different for tourist from SAARC countries and other foreigners.
Modest dressing is advisable. Shoulders has to be covered and the length of outfit should be below the knees.
Not necessary to buy any offerings while entering the temple.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful temple, nice short visit
Text: It is a respectful place to visit. The importance of Buddhist religion in the community of Kandy is manifested in this temple. Very helpful guides and an acceptable conservation state of all the area is observed. Walking around and the possibility of meditate in some corners in the area is an opportunity you can take.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: High Entry fee -  not worth it
Text: There is a grossly high entrance fee not worth it. Plus ppl near temple will try to scare you to buy / rent a sarong (sri lankan saree) to cover your knees at a grossly exorbitant price!! Be cautious!

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Nice place
Text: Good place to visit in Kandy.holy Buddhist place , need to cover knees no shorts allowed. A very calming experience

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Ancient....!
Text: Excellent temple. Lots of beautiful architecture and really amazing history, if you take the time to read the placards scattered around the grounds. Remember that it is a sacred place of prayer when you enter, and you'll have to dress and act accordingly.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Fantastic experience
Text:
Attended the evening offering ceremony, great experience in this sacred place. 

When visiting try to attend one of the offering ceremonies when all the sacred items are opened

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: APPRECIATE THE ATMOSPHERE
Text: The holy of holies for Sri Lankan Buddhists, the visit is a must though perhaps for tourists not at one of the scheduled pujas when you feel the crush of devotees attending to pray and offer food. If you want the atmosphere of a puja, drum beating will announce its start and continue throughout, the actual ceremony performed by the monks behind the closed temple doors with massive elephant tusks in front of it. The highlight is the ever so brief time you have looking at the large gold casket in the distance, devotees handing food and flowers over to the monks. Visit the library with its Buddhist texts on palm leaf and dazzle at some of the jewel-encrusted vases and the like. In another area you can get a history of the tooth relic over 21 panels. As you exit, the grounds are rather pretty. While there are elements of the visit that will leave you dissatisfied, try to soak up the overall atmosphere. You have to go through security.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Historic Relic, A Bit Dull
Text: Set in a large garden with several historic statues, this holy site is well kept, with an ornate building housing the tooth, but not much else. Much of the temple was heavily damaged by a LTTE suicide bomber, so much is modern. There is also a series of paintings that tracks the tangled history of the tooth. See it for the history.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must-see of the city
Text:
I recommend to visit before 4PM as there are some parts (museum) of it that closes at this time!
Bring with you an extra pair of socks if you don't love to walk bare feet

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Avoid busy times
Text: We went on a Monday before Independence Day and so was busy , but we managed to see the ceremony where the stupa is unveiled to the general public . We were just luck so plan and do your research , there are also other rooms to see the history of this very religious site

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting but crowded
Text: We managed to visit on Sri Lankan Independence Day. The queues at the main gate were horrendous but we found another gate near the Kandy Garrison Cemetery that had no queue. We decided to look around the grounds before deciding whether to buy tickets. There is a lot to see and we decided not to spend 45 minutes in line to see the main Temple. The whole complex is No Footwear, No Headgear, something to bear in mind on a sunny day.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Lots to see
Text: Colourful Temple with lots of history attached.  Worth seeing. We were unable to time our visit with the ceremonial Puja, but found the museum really interesting.  Don't miss a visit to the Tusker museum to see the life sized Elephant Raja (now preserved) who carried the sacred tooth for over 50 years.  You have to remove your shoes to enter but socks are allowed.  I would highly recommend you bring a pair of socks to wear as the ground can be a bit stoney and unpleasant for bare feet! We arranged a day visit here through Ceylon Escapes.  Our lovely driver Peter was so helpful and informative and brought us on a most enjoyable day out including a visit to a family run tea factory, lunch in the Olde Empire Cafe, Temple of Tooth and finished with cultural dance. BRilliant day out and thanks to Ceylon Escapes and  our wonderful driver Peter for making it all so enjoyable.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Scammed at the ticket machine
Text:
We had some problems at the ticket machine, and a friendly employee offered to help us. Entry fee for 2 persons is 3.000 lkr. We gave him 5.000 lkr, and waited for the change. When asking for it he claimed that we had only been giving him 3.000 lkr. He literally stole 2.000 lkr out my hands.
At the exit I complained to the officials in military looking uniforms, but they didnt really wanted to help us out.

I can see from other reviews, that other guests have had the same experience

No donations to the temple that day!!

The temple itself, not worth travelling a long way to visit

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Tooth
Text: Didn't go in as they are strict about covering knees and shoulders. Seems ok to go. Next to Kandy lake.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting and crowded
Text: We arrived here at about midday and it was extremely crowded.  Our guide took us round to the various important parts of the temple and we felt very humbled to be sharing this place with hundreds of worshippers who were there for a very serious reason to offer flowers and pray - we appreciated how much this meant to the people who had come far and wide to be here. I felt almost like an intruder and we didn't loiter too long.  We did see the place where the sacred tooth is stored but we didn't get to see the daily ceremony where the door is opened.  Apparently it is inside several caskets and is now never seen.  The building and contents are beautiful and it was lovely to see and briefly be part of this important place.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Nice
Text: Ceremony in this temple is always in the morning and evening. ceremony is quite long and with many peoples there but it worth it.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A Must See, beautiful temple
Text:
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic is a very interesting temple with all the history and the rooms are amazing.
A must see, Superb

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Superb.
Text:
A wonderful place. Definitely go and have a tour around this stunning, historic property. You will leave having learned so much about Sri Lankas amazing Buddhist history. One thing to note: no shoes are allowed so walking around is HOT on the feet. 
Go here. You will not regret it!

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: nice
Text:
it's a nice Temple with a lot of Security where all your stuff is checked. you pay a lot of entrance fee, and then you should also donate for the storage of your shoes.
there were many many people and we had been at many different temples in Asia but i am not sure if i would say this is a "must see" for me.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Expensive waste of time
Text:
There are plenty of other Buddhist temples in the world that are more interesting than this one.  Not only is it expensive to get in but you then have to pay to have your shoes stored (you have no choice). At every opportunity there are donation boxes, we counted well over 50. I dont know what they do with their wealth but its certainly not spent on the poor of Sri Lanka and have you ever seen a hungry monk???

I recommend not going here.

There are plenty of pictures on Google if you want a keepsake. Spend your time and money elsewhere.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Very crowded
Text: The Temple was a great place to see, but I didn't like being moved around by the people overseeing things. They didn't want anyone to stop and look for more than a few seconds. It didnt make the Temple feel like a Holy place, just somewhere that crowds were being shunted through... I've never been treated like that in a Temple before.. It would have been nice to spend some time having a good look round, especially as we paid to go in...

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Ok, not too dissimilar to the other temples
Text:
I believe the temple is only open to tourists later in the evening from about 1730 to 2000ish.
The temple itself is fairly impressive but there were a lot of tourists and locals there and I found other less crowded and more peaceful/reflective. 
Dress - knees and shoulders have to be covered and shoes are given in to a rack. For a tip/charge.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Worth a look
Text:
Always happy to look around a Temple. The setting on the lake is lovely & there are numerous different areas to explore. 
If its youd first Temple youll find it great, if youre a seasoned traveler to Asia youll have seen much grander Temples. 
An annoyance for me is the 2 different Qs. 1 for locals & 1 for tourists. Not forgetting 2 very different entry prices. You also have to hand in your shoes for a small charge. 
They are also strict on the dress code, which is fair enough, dont get caught out.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Look impressive but...
Text: Missing explanation all around the site. Nice temple and scenery but dont really understand where to go and what to find where. Expensive entrance fee and they ask you to rent cloth to cover your legs if you are in bermuda or short

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Historic and cram
Text: Sri Dalada Maligawa known as the temple of tooth relic,is a sacred place to all Buddhists.The temple is a breathtaking sight located near the Kandy lake as well.All in all this is a beautiful place to visit.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Not for us
Text: Visited the temple as it was a must see. Understand its one of the lost sacred places. Temple was a temple nothing much to see, we actually felt a little rude as people were praying and a ceremony was being held while we were wondering around.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Amazing place
Text: This temple has Gautam Buudha's tooth which is worshipped. there are nice places to eat near the temple and walk side of the river is just awesome.SAARC  visitors pay LKR 1000 and under 15 yrs are free.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Religious site with a Buddha tooth relic
Text:
Religious site with a Buddha tooth relic with a newer building built over the original relic casket. Been told that at twice a day the casket door will be opened for special prayers. The temple was built circa  4th century AD. 

When we visited there were so many locals sitting on the floor for prayers. They offered white flowers for prayers. 

The tooth relic was brought over by the King and Queen, and she hid the relic in her hair, when the capital was moved to Kandy. 

Every year in August, the Festival of the Tooth is one of the grandest festivals in Sri Lanka and in the Buddhist world. It is held every summer in Kandy to honor the sacred tooth of Lord Buddha and to pay homage to old gods of Sri Lanka. For the people of Sri Lanka, it is a time to celebrate the country's rich culture and history

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Must visit
Text: We visited the Temple on the morning of New Years Day. Although there were crowds the place was well organised and the crowds were patience and respectful. Well worth a visit.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Crowded, Hot & Cant See Much
Text: This revered site is much talked about in all of the travel books, YouTube videos and magazine such that you think that you are missing one of the top 10 things to do if you dont go. While definitely interesting, it is decidedly crowded. If you go upstairs and use the faster moving line to the right, you really cant see anything as the tooth is so far away with people jostling each other with cameras over their head. If you really want to see something, get there early before the evening showing and upon entry, make a bee line up stairs staying to the left. That way, you can actually see the casket and beat the long line.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: great place
Text: Enchanting views, can capture Queens hotel from the entrance of Temple of Tooth relic at dusk. The pond you see if on left has small garden in the middle. Crossing two coconut trees will mesmerize you for sure in the evening. Walk through pond side pathway and feed fishes in the pond. Boe trees surround the views will enhance the view beautify.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: See Ceylon
Text: Peaceful temple. People dress in white for temple. White is peace and purity.ticket price of 1500 LKR for foreigner.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Good Sacred place
Text: Very peaceful and Sacred place to visit. Other than the temple they have a museum beside of Buddha and worshipped places.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Somewhat underwhelming
Text: I think I built myself up this and that may have been why I was underwhelmed. Went about 5 pm and it was not busy. I felt I was intruding a bit on whorshipers.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: holiest of the holy
Text:
he holiest religious place for the Buddhists in Srilanka. 'houses the tooth of the Budha. 
It is an old building part of which was demolished in a bm l blast in the LTTE days. The ground floor is rebuilt but the first and second are original. the devotion and the positive vibes are palpable and real.            the darshan of the relic which is housed in a golden pagoda can e had easily most times though it is always crowded. The building is very well maintained and also houses a museum and a gallery housing the paintings depicting the journey of the relic from India to Srilanka and then its protection by various kings.
Security is tight and the temple but they allow you to take pictures even of the relic but posing agInst any monument is not permitted. 
an absolute must-see for anyone visiting Kandy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A very crowded but beautiful Buddhist temple
Text:
It so happened that we went there on Christmas day and seeing the long queues, we decided to go back later. But the crowds were still there when we returned in the evening. So we went early the next day. It is quite a walk from the main gate and the surroundings are really beautiful. Once we got in, we were surprised at the people inside. They were mainly devotees. We had to inch our way up through a crowded staircase to the main relic. I felt claustrophobic.You are allowed just a second and then you have to move. It was a relief to get out.
.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Crowded but worth it
Text:
Get your information and timing right if you wish to visit this ancient and holy place. The door to the main relic is opened at specific timings, so check before you plan your trip. While the doors to the main shrine are closed, the crowds start building up, so if crowds scare you this place is an absolute no. Although the crowds are quite well behaved. 
Be sure to cover your shoulders and legs else shell out money to locals for giving you wraps etc. 
You need to buy tickets at the entrance from kiosks which need exact change. You will need to remove and deposit shoes at the counters outside. Once inside it gives you the feel of an ancient place but well preserved and maintained. Lots of devotees with offerings throng the temple every day. 
Do not miss the oil lamps lighted outside by numerous devotees. You are allowed to take pictures but take care not to have your back towards the main shrine - else you will be asked to delete them by the vigilant guards. 
You marvel at the architecture of the temple and palace and leaves you asking fir more. The gardens are huge and well kept. 
I would recommend going there in the evenings, and once the temple visit is done you can enjoy the beauty of the kandy lake and the hills in the background.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Lots of hype, lots of crowds
Text:
We saw that the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic was on every list when we researched things to do in Kandy.  It is, of course, a beautiful temple.  I especially liked the ceiling murals near the main entrance.  The main temple, however, was so crowded that it was hard to enjoy.  We happened to be there near the new year, when many people were coming with offerings.

You will need to leave your shoes at one of two kiosks before entering the temple.  Therefore, the walk from the shoe kiosk to the temple can be uncomfortably hot on your feet, so plan accordingly and perhaps wear socks.  Also, there are ticket machines where you buy your tickets, and for some reason they require exact change.  Very bizarre.  There is a man sitting near the machines who will give you change, but it was an odd encounter because we didn't really know who he was or what he was doing.  

Overall, I was underwhelmed and went because it is so famous.  However, I feel our visit to Kandy could have been fine without this.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Busy but worth biding the crowds
Text:
As perhaps the most important Buddhist site in Sri Lanka, it is almost always busy, even when we went in the last few hours it was open.

Yet, there is no denying it is a special place, with its ornate design (it was formerly the Kandyian kings palace), and beautiful artwork within.

It is a bit of a process to enter, multiple security checkpoints, a shoe drop off and automatic ticket machines that have several other visitors frustration (we agreed to let a gentleman who offered insert our payment and all was fine - these others seemed concerned this was a scam of some sort, it was not...).

Bring your patience and you will be rewarded with a memorable visit.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Overrated
Text:
If you've seen a buddhist temple before, you can safely ignore this attraction.
We did not enjoy it, as right after we got passed the security gate some charlatan tried to pursue us to hire him as guide to explain us the surroundings - he insisted 3 times after which he gave up and insulted us.
After that, we found that there are special prices for tourists (even though everyone arrives in the main hall) so we had to leave our shoes in the storage area, where we were asked again, on somewhat aggresive tone for a donation.
We got inside just before the service started and it was way overcrowded with people shoving themselves all the time.
All in all, not a good experience.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful place to visit
Text: We visited the temple on a Sunday and yet we had a great time! It was busy but we learnt so much about the history and the story behind the enlightenment of Buddha. They have gorgeous carvings and statues which look amazing and extremely picturesque

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must see in Kandy
Text: The number one tourist destination in Kandy is surely this Temple. Easy to find in central Kandy. The entrance is adjacent to the old Victoria Hotel. Be aware that your legs and shoulders must be covered (no shorts allowed), so local sellers do sell some wraps or baggy loose trousers for a fee. Once in, a short stroll through the garden to the museum itself. If you are not native to Sri Lanka, you must go to the right to deposit your shoes in a locker/storage area before then queuing, searching and enter the temple. You also may want to pick up lotus or incense offerings before you go in too. Follow the crowds, its easy to navigate, and try not to take too many photos inside (which may offend) and pay the appropriate respects to those there for religious purposes. There is also a museum on site too towards the rear of the temple thats worth a look too.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Religious fervor for a sacred relic
Text: The temple shows how Buddhist worshippers from Sr Lanka and around the world show their devotion. We were there in afternoon to look at the different parts of the temple including the history of the relic being enthroned in the temple. At the back is a museum of Buddhist religions in the world (included in your ticket but no photos allowed). Our visit culminated with the afternoon prayers with monks bringing offerings into the chamber of the sacred tooth (off limits to worshippers). Visitors need to be appropriately dressed and leave shoes in holding places. Since the holding place for foreigners' shoes was far from the entrance, we left our shoes (in our shoe bags) in the locals' holding place which is nearer the entrance. Just show your ticket.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Temple of the Sacred tooth
Text: Very interesting temple, lots of history and great cultural and religious significance. A must see attraction.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Theres an awful lot of relics around
Text: You dont actually gt to see the tooth, or the hair or the other teeth when you visit the temples but its still very much worth going

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Holy temple for locals, less significant for tourists
Text: Stayed in kandy for one night and we were getting mixed reviews about this temple so decided to visit and check on our own. Firstly be prepared to face huge crowd as there are plenty of locals who visit here any given day. While we as tourists manage to pass the queue by paying some 1000 LKR per person, you hardly get some space inside the temple. The so called chamber with the sacred tooth remains open only for a specific time and you hardly get a glimpse of it. Keeping aside the history and faith of locals, there is nothing much for the tourists here.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Fascinating and busy
Text:
Amazing place full of pilgrims.  As foreigners you skip most of the queues which I found a little uncomfortable.
Fascinating place well worth the trip

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: It's SOO busy that we didn't manage to get inside the temple
Text:
Please take my review with a pinch of salt as this is only my experience trying to get inside the temple.  

We arrived pretty early in the morning (no later than 9:30-10) and got a ticket. We waited at a huge queue for a security check which is fair enough. When we managed to get in the temple garden we saw a queue of what I believe was more than 5.000 people under unbelievable heat and sun (over 32-34 degrees). 

Needless to say that we left as it would take more than 2 hours to see the actual temple .

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Best Temple
Text: I visited with my family, great history and very peaceful, I personally liked this place, interesting Buddha story in the temple

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Great Visit
Text: We enjoyed visiting the temple with our Sri Lankan driver and guide.  He gave us a great perspective on both the temple's history and the contemporary celebrations that take place there.  He helped us interact with the temple in a more meaningful way than merely as tourists, which was special to us.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting
Text: I found this place really interesting. The temple has a completely different lay out to most Bhuddist temples I've seen outside of Sri Lanka. It's a good idea to stay a bit longer, see the entire grounds and the museums, and then watch the puja. The puja is crowded and somewhat chaotic, but it was an interesting experience. I also expected it to involve more waiting time than it actually did.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: History temple.
Text: This temple is a must see thing when you are in Sri Lanka. Tells a long history of buddha and kings. Passing the relic from 1 to another. Expect a long queue inside the temple during weekends. Photo takings are allow inside the temple.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Religious significance
Text: This temple is the main attraction in kandy for locals and tourists. However, they rip off the tourists with high entrance fees while the locals go in for free.  This temple is meant to house the tooth of lord buddha but visitors cannot actually see it. It's nice inside but very busy.  Dress standards are strict to enter the temple. Ladies need to wear clothing which extends below knee level and also covers shoulders.  Men need to wear long pants and shirts. There are a lot of guides at the entrance who will take you in to explain things and charge around 1000 rupees. Try and get a good guide fluent in english. Also watch out for your valuables as it's very crowded inside.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Wasn't that great
Text: Having seen many Buddhist temples across countries, this one lacked the energy and calmness of temple. It felt very commercial ( from tourists point of view),

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A memorable visit to Sacred Temple
Text: It was indeed a memorable visit to sacred temple. We had to walk on bare foot. My wife was not allowed as she had head scarf. It is a nice religious place. There were plenty of worshipers. A must visit place at Kandy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Very interesting and great to visit
Text: It is important that you choose the right time to visits as there are only 3 ceremonies per day where you can actually see the tooth relic. Otherwise you wont be able to see. We went there at 6 pm which was perfect timing. You need to take off your shoes so I suggest you bring some wet tissues to clean your feet. Entrance is pricy but it was worth it. Definitely important to visit while you are in Kandy.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A sacred place for the Buddhists
Text:
We visited this place on a Sunday so it was crowded however it was so serene to see all the devotees in white with their love offerings waiting for the evening prayer time at 6:30 p.m. 

It is a very big complex, neat and well maintained and has security checks at all entry points. Our guide Hiren explained the significance of this holy place.  The statues and artifacts are so beautiful to see.  The motifs and frescoes are a treat to the eye.

The sacred relic is exposed in a procession every 5 years. The altar housing the relic is so beautifully decorated.

They even have a museum included in the cost which has rich culture and heritage explained thru the artifacts well preserved where photography is not permitted.  There's an entrance fee for foreigners at this place.

This place is bang in the city so parking can be a challenge especially in peak hours.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Expensive and you dont see the tooth
Text: This is one of the biggest rip offs in Sri Lanka. You pay a small fortune and you dont even see anything that good. I would advise to skip and walk around the outside for free

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Great temple
Text: If you're not familiar with buddhism, take a guide (they are walking around - you'll easily find one, or they will find you :)) . We did it and it was a great way to get to know more about the philosophy and history of buddhism. Remember to tip your guide as well as the guy who is looking after your shoes :)

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: What an experience.
Text: Great experience, very significant religious location for Buddhism followers. Well maintained grounds and facilities. Although, make sure that you do some research, as the proceedings can be confusing for first comers. If you in Kandy, must to see.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful n peaceful
Text:
The sacred temple of tooth relic is located right in d centre of kandy city. There are multiple entrances and we made d mistake of entering from d main entrance. We literally stood for a good half hour to clear security. Its too crowded. After entering inside we realised theres other not so crowded entrances too. 
Entry for foreigners is 1000LKR. Its a huge temple complex. The actual tooth relic is open to public only twice a day. We werent tht lucky to see it. There are also a couple of museums inside d complex,do check them out. Spend some time exploring d whole complex. Click a lot of pics. If ur in kandy then do visit this temple that holds the actual tooth of Lord Buddha. Whole temple had peaceful positive vibes. We especially enjoyed the visit to the Buddhism in the world museum,u will easily miss it in d premises if u dont go looking for it. Do visit it, the entrance ticket includes d entry for d museum. It has some unbelievably amazing exhibits

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Caution at tooth temple
Text: This temple is very interesting and it's good to have a guide explaining all about bhuddism and the story of the tooth and the temple itself. However, be careful of the person who offers himself as a guide. He will be very polite and knowledgeable but will not tell you what he charges. As a tourist paying an entrance ticket,we thought that at the end of his explanation we would give him a tip. However, when he finished, he asked to see our tickets to check how much time he had spent with us. He then asked for 3000 rupees per hour. We decided to give them to him to save arguing, however, we told him that he was a dishonest person and should be ashamed. Sri Lanka is a lovely country but such actions will not help their bid to regain their tourism again.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Great experience
Text:
When visiting the temple, you must take off your shoes and have your shoulders and knees covered. Respect other people's culture and customs. 
The temple itself is beautiful. Flower-giving ceremony ist just fascinating to see.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Very interesting
Text: We visited here when there was a special ceremony taking place.  The whole occasion was fascinating.  The floral offerings were magnificent.  Though there was rather a crush as everyone tried tried to place their flowers.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Worth every moment!
Text:
What a place!

I would suggest trying to go during ritual performance times as it really brings about a whole new atmosphere.  

The grounds are very big and there is even a museum full of buddhas from around the world.

There are many relics inside to look at and you can even see the golden mini stupa where the tooth is contained.

A definite while in kandy!

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Very enlightening
Text: We are not religious people but this Temple gave us so much serenity. Not only is it a Temple but also a Museum. It was very enlightening to say the least. So glad we visited.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Fascinating history
Text:
This was enjoyable and I walked out having learnt quite a lot about.the history of Bhudda after his death. 

It was fascinating to see the ceremony that takes place every evening and knowing that one of the tooths of Buddha is located there and the other one in India. Wars took place thereafter and how the British were also involved. 

Sadly its more commercial than spiritual but i guess that is to be expected.  Definitely worth visiting if you are interested  in history and or Budhha.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Sacred Relic in a Historic Building
Text: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth holds Sri Lanka's most sacred Relic, a tooth of the Buddha. Unfortunately we did not get to see the casket housing the Relic, but were still awed by the beauty of the architecture and the décor of the frescoes, moonstones and wooden frames. See the beautiful seated statue of a golden Buddha flanked by two white marble statues, other images and the ivory tusks, and then look to the ornamentation of the ceiling above. The Main Hall showcases man statue of the Buddha in various poses; suspended plaques over each give an explanation of he painted scene above. At ceiling height, above each statue, there is a sculpture of an elephant head and tusks, all coloured gold. Some wonderful features both indoors and to the buildings' exteriors. The complex was crowed with tourists and worshippers, sound muted as if all acknowledge the sanctity of the place.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A must visit.
Text: We visited at 5.30 pm which was a good time for the 6.00 pm ceremony. It was busy but not as hot and crowded as probably earlier. You must leave your footwear outside but the ground isnt too hot in the evening.. it takes quite a while to get around due to numbers and so much to see. Allow at least a couple of hours. Give respect as this is a very important site.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Calm
Text: This is a calm and tranquil place. Lots of people making offerings and has great significance for the Buddhist religion. Some interesting paintings depicting the life of Buddha and how the tooth became to be in Sri Lanka You dont actually see the tooth

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Honeymoon Couple
Text: Nice place and very beautiful. Worth visiting just ensure you have long pants, shoulders are covered and all is good. Felt we were being stared at a lot but just part of being a tourist possibly.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Nothing special for tourists
Text: Whilst the atmosphere is quite busy with devotees and the air redolent with incense this temple was really nothing specially for tourist although obviously a very holy and revered place for buddhists.  It has no particular historic significance, having been set upon inside the former palace and lacks the gravitas, spirituality and beauty of most old buddhist temples.  Security is tight which was appreciated in the circumstances.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Sacred Temple
Text:
I really enjoyed visiting this temple. Bare in mind they are very strict with dressing. The shoulders must be covers and the dress must be under knees and not see through otherwise they will not let you in.
The ticket cost around 8$. You can not see the Tooth relic and it's sealed in 7 coffins and they rarely take it out. 
You will leave your shoes at the entrance so if you go in the afternoon the pavement might be hot.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Buddhist
Text: This is the famous Buddhist temple which has the tooth relic of Buddha. The annual festival of perehera  . The tooth relic is taken around town in an elephant once a year.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Great place to visit
Text: It is great temple and maintained very well. I enjoyed the time at this temple. It is maintained very well and has good Security measures in place.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Beautiful place to visit.
Text: All te staff were very friendly and there will be a guide once you have put your shoes into the shoe bar. The guide was fantastic and as I was a solo traveller he was happy to take the photos of me at the right placed.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Spiritual and Humbling
Text: I went to the temple at night and it was still very busy.  My experience was of feeling very spiritual.  The ceiling frescos and buildings are amazing.  When in Kandy this is a must.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Breath taking temple & museum
Text:
We were lucky to stay for the evening viewing of the tooth casket. Overall the temple is as gorgeous as any of the Buddhist temples in the world.
But the Buddhist museum behind the temple which is easily accessible with the same entry tickets was beautiful & educative for the kids too.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Saret Buddism Temple
Text: You need to take off your shoes before entering the temple, it was raining when i visited the site.  The floor was wet and with dirty water ponds.  I reckon it would be hot surface if it was sunny weather.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Super Culture and Cultural Dance
Text:
Thank you Kingfisher Tours Sri Lanka for taking us here and arranging all our Tour in Sri Lanka!

We are really thankful for them because we will miss these wonderful if we are alone

Visited this temple and our guide was awesome explaining the history and all the things 

The main thing was the Cultural Dance!
we really enjoyed it and the dance with the fire walking made us wow

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Worth a visit but you wont see the relic
Text:

2 remember to cover your shoulders and knees.

4 the relic only shows to the public every 10 years. When we visited, we heard the last time the relic was out of the container eight years ago. Every day 6:30 pm, people cn line up to see the container with the relic.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Must see!
Text: We visited the temple early in the day when it wasnt too busy but be prepared for a reasonable sized crowd. There is plenty to see including the museum sections which are worth the time.  Try and be around for the offering time. We saw one at 9.30 am. It happens three times a day - it is also the busiest time. Enjoy this wonderful place.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Interesting
Text:
We visited during one of ceremonies where they take the tooth out to display. 
Long queues but all quite interesting. Clearly an extremely important place and solemn ceremony for Buddhists.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: Worth a visit

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Title: A MUST IN KANDY
Text: Many people. A place to visit, plse note a guide is really good for all the explanations and to go around as it is not easy to find your way and understand all.

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

Enjoy

Location_Name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
